gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mcho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur khang gis bsgrigs/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod 〉rtsom sgrig chogs mi/gtso sgrig pa/ dge gnyen/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ tshe mgon/ bla ma lha/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ hūṃ chen/ gcod pa klu rgyal/tshe ring bkra shis/ phag mo tshe brtan/

dkar chagadage gnyen/rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/ ( 1 )gsar 'gyur 'phrad bris/so nam pa/mthong thos de las sems su 'di tsam shar/ ( 1 )dpyad gtam/dpa' mkhar rgyal/tshan rtsal gyis dbul skyor byed pa'i bya ba ha cang gal che/ ( 4 )kun dga'/mi rigs dpal 'byor gong du 'phel bar yar skul byed bsams na/gom gang mdun spos sgos thon skyed nus shugs bcings 'grol gtong dgos/ ( 6 )dpyad gtam pa/gnod 'gog gzhi sa legs 'dzugs byas nas mtsho sngon lho rgyud kyi dpal 'byor gong du spel dgos pa/ ( 9 )— 1 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/ched brjod/dpal yon gnyis mnyam du yar thon yong ba mngon 'gyur byed par 'bad brtson bya dgos/ (12)rdo che brtan/bslab bya thengs shig (15)che skyid/tshong rar brtag dpyad ni khe las gong du spel ba'i thabs jus leṭa po zhig red/ (18)khu byuga'abyung 'gyur 'tshol ba (20)bo thar bkra shis chos 'phel/spyi tshogs khor yug yag gtong skor gleng ba/ (22)bsam 'grub che ring /srol rgyun ngan pa ste gtes rtsod las 'phros pa'i gtam/ (28)so nam pa/'brong gi gtam rgyud yang bskyar gleng / (31)so nam pa/bod srol sa gdan gyis mdun lam gsar ba 'ding yong nges/ (36)so nam pa/skya thig 'di ltar phab yod/ gtsags drub khab skud rgyus dang / (42)so nam pa/— 2 —

tshodame/zabazungab/ da wa ‘‘'bu’’brko ba'i skal ba thems stangs/ khrims mthun lugs mthun dgos tshul/ (49)so nam pa/gtsang po 'byung yul gyi las dbang / 'brog dmangs 'byung 'gyur gyi mdun lam/ (56)'phrin gsar/rdo rje rin chen/mtsho sngon zhing chen skabs dang po'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom tshogs 'du chab cha nas bsdus pa/ (62)sha bo che ring /sa zhing gi gzhi rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun rgya cher spel nas grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs pa/ (65)tshe mgon/yul shul khul du 'bri chu 'bab rgyud kyi nags skrun 'gog skyong ar las kyi las 'go tshugs pa/ (69)dpal chen rgyal/mi rigs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum thad grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs yod/ (71)che gzungs/zi ling du bod kyi‘‘drug pa'i glu rol’’spro tshogs rgya chen po bsdus — 3 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/pa (75)stag lha/thun rin rdzong gi grong gseb mnyam las thebs rtsa tshogs pas dpal 'byor gong du spel ba'i thad phan nus bton pa/ (77)dpal chen rgyal/zhing las la mu mthud du shugs snon rgyag dgos/ (79)mkha' mcho/yul shul mi rigs lcags rigs bzo grwas rang sa'i rtswa thang gi‘‘sdeb bzhi’’'dzugs skrun thad byas rjes bzhag pa/ (82)g.yang pa/'tsho dpal ldan pa'i mtsho sngon bal 'jam lug (84)sung dbyi me'o/mgo log khul gyi phyugs las thon skyed la lo legs 'byung re yod/ (86)gangs dpal/yul shul khul gyis ljang mdog gi lcags ri ring po skrun bzhin pa/ (88)g.yangapa/spre' nag shang tang as tang gi gzhi rim rtsa 'dzags kyi 'dzags skrun ra ba ra mi dag rig dam 'dzin byas pa/ (91)garjopa4/ —

dkar chagamatsho lho khal gyis da lo yang zhing phyags las thad lo legs blangs pa/rabye ra (94)don 'grub che ring /mtsho nub khul gyi dbul skyor thad grub 'bras mngon gsal byung ba/(97)blo bzang /yul shul gyis rmang gzhi'i 'dzugs skrun la shugs bsnan nas dbul skyor thad skul 'ded byas pa/ (99)gangs dpal/rma lho'i‘‘gser chu brgyud lam’’du 'od 'tsher mu tig star la brgyus pa (101)dpal chen rgyal/rta'u rdzong gi 'pho 'gyur la mig zhags tsam 'phangs pa (104)dpal chen rgyal/spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas〈snyan zhu〉la gros zhib byed pa/ (107)dpal chen rgyal/yid mthun spyod mthun gyis gros gzhi bzang po mnyam 'don byed pa (110)dpal chen rgyal/go skabs gsar bas 'bod 'gug byed kyin yod/ (113)g.yangapa/ — 5 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dril sgrog 'du long nyin mo/ (117)krad zha'o me/'di las tang gi thugs khur zab mo mtshon pa/ (119)nyi ma/ya mtshan ltad mo 'di na mchis/ (122)che dpal rgyal/tshan rig dang slob gso ni mtsho sngon dar rgyas su gtong ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin pa/ (124)hren+t+ra ma31/rkyang sul shang gi deng rabs phyugs las kyi dpe ston rten gzhi/ (127)ban de che ring /rmog ru zhol ma sde ba'i bkra shis/ (129)gu grags rgyal/thun te rdzong gis kher sger gnyer khe las shugs chen pos 'phel rgyas su btang bas grub 'bras mngon gsal thob pa/ (131)phag mo che brtan/bkag lug skyong bar mkhas pa'i sgrol ma skyabs/ (133)phag mo che brtan/byis pa'i mdun lam bsams nas mkhar grong du yong ba/ (135)klu rgyal/dkar yol btsongs nas phyug por gyur/ (137)da 6 da

dkarachag da waphag mo che brtan/bkur 'os pa'i sman pa bzang bo/ da wa'agyuramed rdo rje/ (139)dpal chen rdo rje/lha mo sgrol ma'i 'dzum las/ (143)phag mo che brtan/'brog thang gi mo tho zhig gso mkhan stag 'bum rgyal/ (145)dpal chen rdo rje/kha char bu yug khrod nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i khros po/ (147)15 sbubartsalnga/shang grong khe las pa wang khra'o zhus la bcar ba'i zin bris/ (150)phag mo che brtan/'brog pa nas tshong bar gyur ba'i g.yang skyabs rgyal/ (152)ban de che ring /dgun gsum gyi grang ngar che rung sems pa me ltar dro/ (155)rgyas 'phrin/rdo rje chos 'jin/lus phung la skyon yod rung snying stobs mi nyams pa'i bod kyi sman pa mgon rgya mtsho/ (158)hra'u yun kha'o/bcos bsgyur je mgyogs dang je zab tu gtong ba ni phyugs las — 7 ge

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gong du spel ba'i gnad 'gag red/ (160)hri hra'e khrin dang karma che ring /rang rtogs dang hur thag gis chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur nang zhugs dgos pa/ (163)hra'u yun kha'o/mi rigs las byed pa zhig gi brtse sems (166)hra'u yun kha'o/gzhong sa chen po gsum gyi 'gyur ldog gsar ba/ (172)mkha' mchos bsgrur/mu tig gi 'od zer yul shul rtswa thang du 'tsher/ (177)che gzungs/lus ngag yid gsum mi rigs slob gsor phul ba/ (180)5)bshebasko pa/mi rnams las la brtson pas na/ phyug po'i lam sne zin nges so/ (183)bkra bha/lo gzhon kha yi gtam gsar snyan/ (185)lha 'brug che ring / rdo bzo lha lung thar/ (187)mkha' mcho/brtse sems pha yul la phul ba'i bod rigs bud med sman pa/ (189)che dpal rgyal/— 8 —

dkar chagakhri shor rgyal mo'i 'gram ngogs kyi 'brog dud rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i dpal la ltos/ (193)che dpal rgyal/'byor phyug lam gyi sne 'dren pa/ (195)rig mardzod skyid/pad ma 'di la dri bzang mnga' (197)skal bzang bkra shis/bcos min brtse bas rgan mo'i sems pa bsros/ (202)mkha' mcho/shang tang u hru'u ci dang dwa phrug bzhi/ (205)bkra shis don grub dang hri hra'e khrin/nyin phyug rtswa thang gi hru'u ci bzang bo (209)khyung thar rgyal/me tog gangs lha'i gzi byin/ (213)sangs rgyas/las byed pa dang mang tshoṭa kyis mnyam du dbul skyor gyi dbyangs snyan gyer ba/ (223)lha mkhar/sems shugs yod rgu sde dmangs la phul ba/ (227)cang tso con dang klu byams/mdun du skyod bzhin pa'i hi nan rdzong bod sman khang/ (231)— 9 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/g.yangapa/dmangs yongs kyis dpal yon me tog skyong / (235)rig 'dzin che ring /dus rabs kyi ras gzhi'i steng tshon mdangs stug po'i pur smyug bsgyur mkhas pa'i na gzhon rtsom pa po rnam sras/ (241)sangs rgyas/lo ngo bcu yi dka' spyad las/ 'bras bu g.yur du za ba blangs/ (245)chu med dang chin lha/paṇa chen rin po che'i sku 'khor du phyag las sgrub pa'i dus yun/ (249)khyung thar rgyal/'od mdangs rab tu 'tsher ba'i mu tig cig (254)sangs rgyas/rang lus legs par bskyangs pas mi gshis bzang po grub pa/ (261)sa'o lan khyun/thang rgod mu'u1000la‘‘gos ljang’’bskon mkhan/ (264)bla ma lha/phyug 'gyur mtsho mor skyod pa'i ded dpon/ (267)15 ma31/rtswa thang nas dpal 'byor 'phel gnas gsar ba 'tshar longs 'byung bzhin yod pa/ (270)tshe dpal rgyal/ ge 10 —

dkarachag da wan tshod phra yang 'gan khur ljid/ (275)bla ma lha/mang tshogs sems kyi re ltos/ (277)mkha' 'cho/gnya' nag sde ba na klu dbang rgyal zer ba zhig yod/ (280)bla ma lha/mkhar grong du mngon pa'i mig gi bdud rtsi/ (282)nyi ma/char dus phrad na smyug gsar spro/ (285)ban de che ring /yon h+phun sde ba'i mthong snang / (288)ban de che ring /rmog ri gong ma'i mthong snang / (291)ban de che ring /dbul thar phyug sgyur gyi sne khrid pa g.yang tho/ (294)che ring bkra shis/dpa' bo'i byas rjes nam yang nga tsho'i sems khong du gnas/ (297)ban de che ring /rdo gos tshong las gnyer snga bas/ (305)ban de che ring /sde don rang don gnyis ka skyong mkhas pa'i rdo rje dbang rgyal/ (309)so nam pa/— 11 —
gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/brag dkar sprel rdzong gi mthong snang / (313)rgyal sras/'jang sa dam sa cha'i yul srol gyi mthong thos (320)par ngos dang 'dra par/mjug byang/ (339)

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/da 〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉spel 'go tshugs par zhus pa/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i nang / tang krung dbyang gis rang re'i rgyal khab kyi gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las rigs la yang dang yang du‘‘nye bcar gsum’’gyi re 'dun te/ ‘‘dngos gnas dang nye bar bcar ba/ 'tsho ba dang 'e bar bcar ba/ mang tshogs dang nye bar bcar ba’’bcas bton zhing / sngon bas bzang bar rgyal khab kyi‘‘dpal yon rnam gsum’’gong du spel bar zhabs phyi dgos tshul nan ston gnang phyin/ gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las don tsam gyis ma zad par/ rig gnas las don spyi nas kyang thad kar spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho tshim par bya dgos pa'i re 'dun bton/da lan nged tshags par khang gis〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉spel 'go tshugs nas lo ngo55'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i tshul gyis〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉ces pa'i mu ldan deb phreng 'di spel ba'i 'go bzung /deb phreng 'di'i khag dang po la deb bzhi 'dus shing / rang re'i tshags par du lo mang po'i ring bkod zin pa'i gsar 'gyur brtsams chos dang rtsom rig brtsams chos dang rtsom rig dpyad mol dang rtsom rig mi sna ngo sprod bcas phyogs kyi rtsom yag shos las tshod 'dzin nges can zhig yod par phyogs sgrig byas yod pa yin/ de yang / 'di ni lo mang po'i yun du rim pa so so'i tang ge 1 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/srid dbu khrid dang zhing chen phyi nang gi rgya che'i rig gnas las gnyer pa dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis nga tshor rgyab skyor thugs khur gnang bar drin lan ma brjed pa'i sems tsam mtshon pa'i legs skyes su‘‘me tog chung yang lha rdzas’’tshul du phul ba yin/ 〈dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs〉ni sgrung gtam dang lhug rtsom dang snyan ngag sogs kyis grub pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi deb cig yin/ spyir bod yig tu rtsom rig spel ba'i srol rgyun ring yang / srol gsar 'byed pa'i phyogs nas da dung 'bad dgos par gzhigs nas khyad chos nges can ldan pa'i brtsams chos btus nas bsgrigs pa yin la/ nang sgos ring thung gi tshad tshags par du 'god 'tsham la sngon gyi srol lam yangs bskyed la phan par dmigs nas lhug rtsom gyis gtso ba bzos yod cing / 'di ni srol rgyun ldan pa'i rig khag de phun sum je tshogs su gtong ba'i 'dun pa mtshon tsam lags/ 〈nags klong khu byug 'du gnas〉ni deng rabs bod yig gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs dang len bzhin pa'i rtsom pa po ngo sprod dang khong rnam pa'i 'thus tshab tu rung ba'i rtsom re gnyis ngo sprod tshul du bsgrigs pa yin/ 〈mu tig gling gi dga' ston〉nang du rtsom rig dpyad mol gyi rigs bsgrigs yod/ snga ma bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig lo rgyus 'bri bar mthun rkyen bzos pa yin pas rig khag gsar ba bskrun par gzhigs pa dang / phyi ma bod yig brgyud pa'i rtsom rig dpyad mol da rung zhan pa la skul spel dang / bod du da rung rtsom rig mtha' dpyad(sprastsa7snyetshocispratshi7ram̐/1)kyi rig khag chags med pa de 'thus tshang yong ched bsgrigs pa yin/ 〈gom stabs dang zhabs rjes〉ni gsar 'gyur gyi rtsom btus te/bod yig steng nas da nung gsar 'gyur rig pa'i rig khag dar med par gzhigs nas 'di'i lam srol 'byed par mthun rkyen tsam bzos pa yin/— 2 —

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/rtsom rig ni dmangs spyi la dbang ba'i khyad chos 'dzin zhing / mi dmangs kyi rlabs po che ba'i spyi tshogs lag len dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba rol stangs dang yid du 'ong ba'i chags sdang rnam 'gyur bcas ni rtsom rig gi brjod don thams cad kyi 'byung khungs yin la/ 'di dag gsal lhang brnyan 'dra dang bcas par mtshon pa'i 'gan babs khur 'dug pa ni rtsom rig ljon dbang nyid kyi tshe dpal nyams med ring du 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan du'ang gyur yod/ rtsom rig gi ngo bo nyid ci yin pa la kha tshon gcod sla ba zhig min na yang / rim byon mkhas mchog rnams kyis yang yang dpyad nas bye ma las gser btsags yong ba'i gnad rnyed pa lta na/ rtsom rig ni ngag gi sgyu rtsal la brten nas dngos gnas las lta ba mtho ba dang / dngos gnas las go ba zab pa dang / dngos gnas las 'bur du thon pa dang / dngos gnas las 'tsho ba'i don dam rtogs pa'i tshul du mtshon 'god byung ba na/ yong khungs dmangs yin la 'phrod yul yang dmangs yin pa'i nang rkyen gnas phyir/ de ni spyi tshogs 'phel 'gyur gyi 'phar rtsa brtag gnas shig dang dmangs kyi 'tsho bar blang dor bslab pa'i gnas shig yin la/ 'gro ba mir ltung shan gyi gshis kyang zhor du ldan pa'i‘‘rnam shes’’de ya rabs dpal yon can gyi phyogs su ngang gis 'dren pa'i yon tan bskyang yong ba yin/ srid zhi gnyis las mngon srid spyi tshogs kyi don skyong bar spras brjod dang 'khyog brjod kyi sgyu rtsal thabs lam nas gnas tshul du gnas lugs ston 'gyur ba ni nyid kyi khyad chos lhang nge ba zhig red/ gsar 'gyur la'ang dmangs spyi la dbang ba'i khyad chos yod cing / brjod bya 'dzin stangs kyi cha nas brnyan 'dra dang bcas par mtshon dgos pa'i nges pa med pa dang / spras brjod dang 'khyog brjod dang sgyu 'phrul lta bu'i nyams snang mi bzo ba dang / dngos gnas ge 3 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/las lta ba mtho ba dang go ba zab pa dang 'bur du thon pa dang 'tsho ba'i don dam rtogs pa bcas thad nas rtsom rig las dma' ba tsam las shin tu nye mtshungs yin srid/ deng gi dus 'dir ga 'dra'i yag par snang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i don dag la bsngags skul gtong rgyu yod pa/ ga 'dra'i rin thang ldan zhing gzengs su 'don 'tshal ba'i don dag dar spel gtong rgyu yod pa/ ga 'dra'i ma rabs tha shal gyi don dag la mtshang 'byin lcag gzhus gtong rgyu yod pa/ 'di dag ni gsar 'gyur gyi dmigs bya yin la rtsom rig gi dmigs bya yang yin pas/ 'di gar 'dus pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos dang gsar 'gyur brtsams chos kyang 'di nang bzhin lag bstar byas pa'i grub 'bras lags/‘‘nye bcar gsumari’zer ba'i dmigs gnad de dngos gnas su snang ba'i skabs bab dgos mkho dang 'tsho ba las thon pa'i skabs bab dgos mkho dang mang tshogs la phrad pa'i skabs bab dgos mkho tshim par byed pa la kha gtad yod pa red/ nye bcar gyi ldog zla rgyang bkyed pa yin nges/ nye bar bcar ba'i dmigs gnad kyi sdog zla'i don ni skabs bab dang thad kar gyi dgos mkhor brtsi 'jog dang len mi byed pa la go / gal te khyed kyis bris pa'i rtsom mam gnyer bzhin pa'i rig gnas gang de dngos gnas dang 'tsho ba dang mang tshogs dang rgyang bkyed cing / skabs su bab pa'i thad kar dgos gtug la brtsi 'jog dang len ma byas tshe/ phan mi thogs pa min pa'i dbang du btang na yang / gos lham phyi nas za 'phrug langs sar 'brad pa dang gnyis sa med pas/ gang dang sa yis dmigs btsags nas khyed kyi grub ri ri ribasko sa ri 'bras la mthong chung byas pa min na yang / dngos gnas dang 'tsho ba dang mang tshokās ñjas kyang khyed kyi las ka der brtsi 'jog dang len thad nas rgyang

rig gnasaljonadabangalasmonapa/ da bkyed srid pa red/ yang na/ ya rabs su snyeg pa ni mi'i rang gshis ngang spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo dang sbrags mar gnas pa'i khyad chos shig yin srid mod/ 'on te de dang 'gal zla gcig gyur gyi tshul du mi'i rigs la da rung ma rabs ltung shan gyi rang gshis dang spyi tshogs 'phel phyogs dang phyin ci log pa zhis kyang lus dang grib ma ji bzhin yod pas/ rig gnas kyi las ka thams cad po yar 'phel sngon thon gyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i nges pa med/ 'di bzhin du nye bcar gyi rig gnas las ka la'ang lhad skyon mi 'dres pa dang rdzun 'khrul mi 'byung ba zhig ga la yin/ yin na yang bcar nye ba'i dbang du dang len 'thob sla ba dang 'thob pa khyab che ba'i rkyen gyis lhad skyon sel mgyogs pa dang de'i phyir bden rdzun brdar myur ba'i khyad chos 'dzin pas/ yar 'phel sngon thon gyi chos can dang yang bcar nye ba yin srid/ ‘‘lag len ni bden lugs bsher ba'i gzhan bkag tshad gzhi 'ba' zhig yin’’zhes pa'i legs bshad 'di nas kyang / bden pa rnyed dgos na bcar nye min dang lag len dang 'brel dam min bcas la rag las yod pa mngon shugs gnyis nas shes de yang / rnam pa gang yang rung ba'i rig gnas shig chags zin pa na/ de la 'chun skul gnyis kyi byed nus yod pa yin/ srog gcod mi rung zhes pa'i rig gnas lta ba 'di chags phyin/ mi gsod rta 'ded dam mi shi rta 'gyel lta bu'i nyes dmigs 'gog pa dang / skye khams kyi dngos po kun dang mdza' mthun ngang 'tsho ba rol nas phyi ma'i phyi mar 'tsho rten skyong ba'i thad nas 'chun rkyen du 'gyur srid/ yin na yang / rig gnas de 'dra'i khor yug nas nya las skyong ba dang bshas tshong rgyag pa lta bu'i lag len la tshod 'dzin byed pa myong grub yod pa de bzhin/ 'chun rkyen des phyin log la tshod 'dzin byed pa tsam gyis ma zad par yar 'phel la'ang tshod 'dzin byed srid/ 'on te gtso bo phyin — 5 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/log la tshod 'dzin pa red/ skul rkyen des ya rabs la skul 'ded tsam gyis ma zad par ma rabs la'ang skul 'ded byed srid/ 'on te gtso bo ya rabs la skul 'ded byed pa red/ de'i phyir mi dmangs kyi dngos gnas lag len dang 'tsho bar bcar nye ba'i rig gnas spel na/ skul rkyen gyi drang phyogs yon tan ches cher gtong ba dang 'chun rkyen gyi ldog phyogs byed nus las sgrol bar 'gro ba'i phan yon de rgyang bkyed pa'i rig gnas las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba shin tu gsal/ rgyu mtshan 'di'i dbang du nye bar bcar ba'i rig gnas spol na ni yar 'phel sngon thon gyi ngo bo dang yang thag nye ba red/ nye bcar rig gnas spel ba'i mi la rgyang bkyed rig gnas spel ba'i mi las rig gnas dang lag len byang tshad thad kyi blang bya de bas mtho ba red/ kho tsho rig gnas la mkhas shing rig gnas lag len la 'jon thang ldan dgos pa ma zad/ yig thog gam rigs gzhung tsam gyis mi chog par/ spyi tshogs la brtag mkhas shing spyi tshogs lag len nang thad kar zhugs nas skabs bab don bya yag 'khyongs la'ang 'jon thang ldan dgos/ rgyang bkyed rig gnas gnyer stangs las mang shos de mi sger gyis yun ring las bya'i rnam pa can zhig yin la/ nye bcar rig gnas gnyer stangs las mang shos ni sde khag gam de bas khyab che ba'i khongs kyi mnyam las la brten 'dug de la khab gsog nas snyung bu dang snyung bu gsog nas gri lta bu'i brgyud rim zhig kyang rtag tu snang / de lta na tsag tsig gsog nas ma lag can zhig skyong ba dang / skabs phrad gnyer nas yun ring la phan pa zhig skrun pa/ rags rob gsog nas zhib rgyas can zhig bzo ba'i gnyer rim zhig brgyud kyi yod pa'ang nyid kyi rang bzhin dbang du gyur yod/ da lan nged tshags par khang gis〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉bsgrigs pa'ang 'di lugs su lad mo byas pa yin/— 6 —

rig gnasaljonadabangalasmonapa/ da wad wanye bcar rig gnas spel rgyu de rig gnas ma lag gsar pa zhig skrun pa'i 'jug sgo gal chen zhig yin srid/ rang don 'khyongs pa'i khyim tshang zhig la mtshon na/ dus srol yul srol dang 'tsham pa'i nang nom phug nor dang ca ga ca lag 'dzoms dgos pa nang bzhin/ rgyal khab bam mi rigs shis gi cha nas bshad kyang / dus rabs dang mthun zhing 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan dag las rang tshugs lcogs pa'i dpal 'byor dang rig gnas dang tshan rtsal gyi stobs 'byor zhig cis kyang dgos pa red/ de ltar yin na da gzod dza drag che ba'i spyi tshogs 'gran rtsod nang nas yun brtan pham min gyi go gnas shig 'dzin nges/ rang re'i rgyal khab kyis gral rim 'thab rtsod gnad du bzung ba'i jus chen bsgyur nas dpal 'byor thad kyi 'dzugs skrun lte ba byas te bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi jus chen lag bstar byas tshun/ dpal 'byor dang rig gnas dang tshan rtsal bcas kyi phyogs gang mang nas 'dzam gling yongs kyi mig ldan ha las pa'i byas rjes bzhag yod/ da lta'i krung go ni 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gong spel dang zhi bde rgyun skyong thad kyi sgul stobs 'byung gnas shig tu gyur yod/ 'on kyang 'phel rgyas su phyin che ba'i rgyal khab dang bsdur na da rung he bag mi chung ba yod pa dang / nang sgos dpal 'byor 'phar snon 'byung stangs dang rang bdag shes bya'i thon dbang bis dpal 'byor dang tshan rtsal la bzo ba'i shugs rkyen thad nas mngon gsal du 'an pa yin phyir/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba lag tu bstar bar do snang byed pa dang / gron chung can gyi spyi tshogs skrun par do snang byed pa/gsar 'byed can gyi spyi tshogs skrun par do snang byed pa bcas kyi byed phyogs srid jus rab dang rim par bton zhing lag len byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin/rang re'i bod khul dag la mtshon na/ gzhung po ti ga tshod ldan pa dang bcu —— 7 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/phrag rig gnas kyi gzi brjid gang 'dra yin par 'ud sgrog bskyar zlos tshul gyis yid tshims par 'dug pa'i skabs shig min tshod red/ de dag ni bran g.yog spyi tshogs nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs su zhugs pa dang / snga thog gi 'thog sgrug dpal 'byor dang gshor rngon dpal 'byor nas rang byung cha rkyen la brten pa'i zhing phyugs dpal 'byor(rang byung dpal 'byor zhes kyang bya)la zhugs skabs/ mes dbon rnam gsum gtsos pa'i sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis snga bzang rgyun skyong dang gzhan bzang dpe g.yar dang gzhi de nas gsar 'byed byas par brgyud nas rang rigs la bzhag pa'i nang nom phug nor red/ des na bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs su zhugs pa dang / rang byung dpal 'byor nas rlangs sgul glog sgul 'phrul chas sogs kyis mtshon pa'i bzo las spyi tshogs su zhugs skabs/ 'u cag gis rig gnas nang nom phug nor dang ca ga ca lag ci zhig bsrel yod ces pa na/ yid mug mug dang zhe skyo skyo tshal du 'dug pa'am a tshags can kha tshor r+sār zhes rang su mo rtsar no༅ wadro/shas kyas ngad cag la da 'dra ma ldan kyang chag lta bu' lkug rdzu 'dabs pa las brjod kyi mi 'dug ma rtsa ring lugs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs spyi tshogs su zhugs 'go brtsams shing / bzo las dpal 'byor nas 'phrin sprod lag rtsal dang ang rtags lag rtsal dang skye dngos lag rtsal sogs lag rtsal mtho gsar gyis mtshon pa'i shes rig dpal 'byor ram phyi'i bzo las spyi tshogs kyang zer bar 'jug bzhin pa'i deng rabs/ rang re'i rig gnas nang nom phug nor dang ca ga ca lag gang ci bzhag cing bsrel yod ces pa na/ phal cher ha las pa'i tshul du 'dug pa las smra sgo 'gag 'gro/ de'i phyir/ bod khul la mtshon na nges mkho rig gnas dang thun mong rig gnas thad nas spyi tshogs la bu lon steng du hūm̐daka brtsegs pa'i chad stong mang drags song / rig gnas rgyun skyong

rig gnasaljonadabangalasmonapa/ da wathad nas thabs zhan pa dang / dpe g.yar thad nas lam dog pa/ gsar 'byed thad nas stobs gnyom pa bcas kyi gnas tshul mngon 'dug yin na'ang khag 'di gzhan la 'gel ba dang 'khang ra byas nas ci yang mi 'ong /thabs lam 'dems mkhas la gtsigs 'dzin byas nas ga'an las 'bad brtson snying rus che bar mchong skyod lta bu'i 'phel rgyas bsnyeg dgos na/ thog mar rig khag gsar ba dang gzhogs gtogs yan lag rig tshan gsar pa 'thus tshang du gtong rgyu 'di ni rig gnas spyi'i rgyun skyong dang dpe g.yar dang gsar 'byed bcas kyi rmang gzhi'i gnad dam pa red/skabs bab dgos mkho dang dngos gnas lag len las bton pa'i blang bya ltar na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi spyi tshogs khor yug 'di nas nges par khrims lugs la gtsigs chen byed pa dang / dpal 'byor phan yon la gtsigs chen byed pa/ mi'i bar gyi rton srung la gtsigs chen byed pa/ mi'i spus spyi dang rig gnas tshan rtsal 'jon thang la gtsigs chen byed pa bcas kyi blang bya sngon bas mtho bar gyur yod pas/ rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel de'ang sngon bas kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur yod/ des na nga tshos ji ltar gzhal yod rgyu stobs dang mi stobs legs par spyad nas go skabs ma shor bar rig gnas gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel la mchong skyod lta bu'i 'phel rgyas 'byung 'jug pa ni mi rigs spyi'i lo rgyus las 'gan du gyur yod/ de 'dra'i dbang du rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel las don 'di dmangs spyis stobs sgril nas lag rub bya 'tshal ba zhig yin gyi/ rig gnas can nyung shas kyis a gsar rang mtho mtshon pa'i gnas ma yin/ 'on kyang rig gnas can gyis thad kar tshul gyi zhabs phyi brgyud pa na/ da gabrod gdong mchong sna khrid kyi nus pa 'don 'gyur ba dang / gdong mchong sna khrid kyi nus pa gang —— 9 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/legs shig 'don dgos na/ nges par thad kar gyi zhabs phyi'i nang nas 'khyongs dgos pa myong grub byung yod/ las rigs so sos rang babs lo rgyus las 'gan 'khur phod pa dang 'khur mkhas pa'i gzhi nas/ spyi yongs dang yun ring la bsam blo btang nas phan tshun mthun rkyen bzo ba dang phan tshun ram 'degs byed pa'i phyogs nas las rigs tha dad bar du mnyam las mi 'khyongs pa'i gnad 'gag bsal 'tshal/ dmangs spyi'i smyan byad de gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las khungs kyis smyan byad kyi yon tan de sgo kun nas legs par skyong dgos la skabs don zin 'god kyi sbrags su gzhi rtsa'i rgyal khab skyong jus che shos te/ dpal 'byor spel ba lte bar bzung nas bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed rgyun 'khyongs byed pa dang / khrims la brten nas rgyal khab legs skyong yong ba/ tshan rtsal slob gso la brten nas rgyal khab dar rgyas yong ba/ pho mo 'dra mnyam yong ba/ rig gnas la brtsi 'jog dang 'jon ldan la brtsi 'jog yong ba/ 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye rgyun 'khyongs yong ba bcas phyogs nas babs 'gan gang lcogs kyis 'khur ba dang / ched las zhib 'jug las khungs dang ched las mkhas pa bar phan tshun sdongs grogs tshul du nye bar bcar ba'i rig gnas gnyer ba'i brgyud rim nang nas rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel la thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa 'don par blo dang jus kyi bkod pa yod 'tshal snyam/ 〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉ni gong glong ji bzhin lag len byas pa'i grub 'bras las sde dang po tsam yin/‘‘nye bcar gsum’’ni rig gnas gsar pa spel ba'am gzhi de nas sngon thon rig gnas spel ba'i bgrod lam gtso shos shig lags/ nga tshos phyogs 'di'i gnas lugs snga char ma rtogs pa nas da lta gtsigs 'dzin byed pa dang /sngon du gzhan skul tshul nas da lta rang 'gul tshul du 'gyur bar da rung lag — 10 —

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/len dang gleng phyogs gnyis kyi cha nas 'bad 'tshal ba red/rig gnas gsar pa de sngon thon gyi thon skyed nus shugs dang thon skyed 'brel ba rmang gzhir bzung ba'i spyi tshogs lam lugs gsar pa'i rgyu rkyen sna tshogs nas 'byung ba yin srid/ des spyi tshogs kyi deng byung dgos mkho dang dmangasam+bhi'i da lta'i khe phan la brtsi 'jog byed pa'i thad nas sngon thon rig gnas kyi rang bzhin dang mthun pa red/ nye bcar rig gnas yin na sngon thon rig gnas kyang yin pa'i nges pa med na yang / sngon thon rig gnas yin na des nye bcar gyi rang mtshan 'dzin pa ni bsnyon du med/ sngon thon rig gnas la deng gi mkho ba tshim la go chod pa/ 'byung 'gyur la'ang phan thogs shing gzhi btsun pa'i khyad chos yod kyang / 'on te des srol rgyun rig gnas dang mi rigs rig gnas kyi khyad chos 'gog pa zhig gtan nas min/dgos mkho che ba dang phan pa che ba la gzhigs nas gna' bzang deng spyod dang gzhan bzang rang spyod dang rnying bsal gsar 'don tshul du rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin/ rgyu mtshan 'di'i dbang du sngon thon rig gnas kyis 'das zin lo rgyus las nyar tshags byung ba'i dge mtshan ldan pa'i rig gnas kun dang /'gro ba mi'i thun mong du dge mtshan ldan pa'i rig gnas kun la brtsi 'jog byed pas/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar go chod min dang mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i phan khe dang mthun min 'di rtsa gnad du thug 'dug 'di dang 'gal ba'i rig gnas gang de ma smad ma dgag kyang nyid kyi tshe dpal 'tsho stobs rang shugs su nyams 'gro ba smra ci/ de 'dra'i dbang du spyi khog tsam nas bltas na/sngon thon rig gnas ni deng gi spyi tshogs kyi dmangs spyi(nyung shas la min)la mkho che ba dang go chod pa dang phan 'dogs thub pa bcas gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa dang / gna' bzang deng spyod kyi rgyun skyong dang gzhan — 11 ge

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bzang rang spyod kyi dpe g.yar dang gzhi de nas dus kyi dgos dbang du gsar 'byed bcas gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa dang / mi rigs kyi nges pa dang thun mong gi nges pa dang rtser son gyi nges pa gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa bcas ni nyams myong las sgrub nus/dus rabs gsar pa la rig gnas gsar pa 'byung ba'i cha rkyen ldan 'dug rig gnas gsar pa'i sa bon ga sa kun tu 'debs bzhin pa la ni bsnyon du med/ bod khul dag tu slob grwa'i slob gso dang rgyang bsten slob gso dang spyi tshogs slob gso bcas kyi sa zhing da rung mu mthud du rgya skyed 'dugacha 'phrin lag rtsal dang gsar 'gyur smyan byad dang rig gnas theg byad gzhan dag la brten nas rig gnas gsar pa'i smyu gu ga sa kun nas 'khrungs bzhin pa'ang bsnyon du med/ bskal bzang 'di'i go skabs ma shor bar 'bad brtson sngon bas che bar btang na/ bzo las spyi tshogs nas phyi'i bzo las spyi tshogs su zhugs 'go brtsams pa'i dus 'dir/ rang re'i bod la'ang gzhan gyis yid smon 'chor ba'i rig gnas ljon dbang rgyas 'gyur zhing /de'iwīn grol 'bras bzang gis rang rigs la phan pa 'byung ba tsam gyis ma zad par/ yul gru'i khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos de sngon thon gyi ngo bo dang gcig sgril yong yod pa'i cha nas mi rigs gzhan dang rgyal khams gzhan la'ang sman par 'gyur nges/ dus rabs gsar pas mngal la rig gnas gsar pa 'dzin bzhin pa 'di la rdzun med pa yin na/ 'byung 'gyur gyi rig gnas gsar pas kyang dus rabs 'di la gzi brjid kyi mngon rtags legs par brgyan yong /rig gnas skor gyi gnad don la da dung 'dzam gling khyon nas yang brtag yang dpyad kyi 'du 'dzi mtha' rdzogs dka' ba'i skabs 'dir/ gong — 12 —

du gleng ba dag ni bar skabs 'di'i slob sbyong las thob pa'i ngos zin tsam yin pas/ mkhyen ldan rnam pas dgongs 'char bdud rtsi mngar mo la skom pas re sgug ji bzhin lags/sgrig pa po dge gnyen gyis2006lo'i zla4ba'i ches15nyin zi ling nas/

gsan 'gyur 'phrad bris/mthong thos de las sems su 'di tsam shar/gsar 'god pa/ so nam pa/da lo nas bzung ste grong khyer hran tha'u ru grags khyab che ba'i‘‘srol ngan dang 'bral ba’’zhes pa'i bya 'gul spel cing / tha mag spyod pa'ang srol ngan zhig tu brtsis te/ zla5pa'i tshun spyi 'du'i gnas su tha mag 'then mi chog pa'i bca' yig gtan khel khyab sgrog byas pas/ tha mag gi tshong tshad sngon rgyun dang bsdur na46lhu je nyung du song / zla12pa'i ches 14nyin gsar 'gyur zin 'god pas hran tha'u nas btang ba'i glog 'phrin ltar na/ nyin der de ga'i slob grwa 'bring chung140lhag gi slob ma khri las brgal tshod kyis slob grwa pa khri15yis ming yig bkod yod pa'i dar ring zhig khyer nas rgya srang du chas te grong dmangs la tha mag spyod pa'i nyes ngan dang rang rgyal khab tu 'phrod bsten dar srol yag po'i grong khyer 'dzugs skrun bya ba'i dril bsgrags rgya chen po byas la/ kho tshos phyar ba'i bsgrags yig khrod du‘‘tha mag spyad na rang la gnod cing gzhan la 'tshe/’’ ‘‘na chung dus su tha mag lob pa ngan/ na tshod bgres dus skyo ba rang sdug gyong’’zhes pa sogs kyis tha mag spyod par ngo rgol byed pa'i rnam —— 1 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'gyur mngon par bton pa red/'di dag mthong ba na/ kho bo'i sems su 'char snang 'dra min byung la/rang re'i yul 'dir bsam blo thongs dang / zog nor gyi lus nas spags spu bkog nas rgyab la gon pa'i don du dang sa sag mar sbar snyob byed pa lto za ma'i don du los yin gyi/ thob sgo de tsam nyid kha sna'i bu gar du ba gtong bar spyad na a dgos e chung / bu chung 'ga' yi ya kha na snabs kyi gyong ro thur du chags pa dang / 'dabs ka na phab rgyu mi chud gyong ru gyen du brdzes pa de/nad ngan thebs pa'i bya zhig 'phur grabs byed pa dang gnyis su med mod/ da dung kha la tha mag sne mo brgyan pa'i tshul de dgod re e bro/ rgan bgres 'ga' yikhog stod dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'tshang zhing nyin mtshan bar med kha lud 'phen par brel ba dang / rked pa gzhu mo ji bzhin gug cing rkang snam pu sa mo'i mtshams su ral tshul stag mo kha gdang 'dra yang / da rung lag yong gi'ang gses tsha kha sna'i bud shing du dgos pa'i tshul de yid re e mug spyir na 'tsho ba'i 'dzad gron rnam grangs las tha mag 'then pa ni med kyang rung ba'i 'dzad spyod 'ba' zhig ste/ yong khungs dog cing yong sgo 'tshol dka' ba'i zhing pa dang 'brog pa/ nang sgos 'tsho rten gzhung dang gzhan la re dgos pa'i slob ma'am na chung grogs po rnams la mtshon na/ srol ngan bdud kyi rol bya'i tha mag 'dis lus bo'i bde thang ngam khor yug gi gtsang sbra'am 'tsho ba'i bkod sgrig gam tha na dus tshod bed spyod la sogs su'ang gnod pa mi chung bas na dgag bya sha stag red/nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla ba gsal ba/ zla ba'i 'od kyis 'dzin ma gsal ba/— 2 —

gsar 'gyur 'phrad bris/gzhan dpe rang la len pa dang / rang dpe gzhan la 'jog pa nang bzhin/dpal yon can gyi spyi tshogs 'dzugs spel byed pa ni rgya che zhing sne 'dzings pa dang dka' khag shin tu che ba'i spyi tshogs sgyur 'god cig yin la/ 'u cag skye bo so sos 'bad dgos pa ma zad/ jus gzhi'am dmigs gnad dam las rim sogs blo bkod 'then pa'i thad 'di gtso che ste/ rang re'i dar rgyas byung tshad dman pa'i sa khul la mtshon na/ 'byor ba'i stobs dang rig pa'i stobs/yang na yul bkod gnam gshis kyi cha rkyen sogs gang ci'i thad nas kyang tshod bzung mang bas/ las tshegs yod kyang 'gro gron chung ba dag lag pa 'jug sa'i sngon ma bya ba dang / srol ngan ri ltar snang ba rnams dmigs 'ben gtad sa sngon ma bya ba dang / na chung la srol bzang bslab pa lta bu phan yon gyi yun ring ba can rgyun brtan du rkang ba 'dzugs sa bya ba bcas ni gal che ba'i blo jus shig dang byed thabs shig red snyam pas bris pa/(1997lo'i zla1pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal)

dpyad gtam/tshan rtsal gyis dbul skyor byed pa'i bya ba ha cang gal che/dpa' mkhar rgyal/rang zhing gi dbul phongs sa khul mang che shos su thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod pa dang / rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs las la brtson pa zhig yin/ yin na'ang tshan rig rig gnas sogs rjes lus yin gshis/ rang byung thon khungs sngog 'don bed sbyod bzang po zhig byed mi thub pa dang /thon skyed gong 'phel btang ba'ang ha cang dal ba zhig yin pas/ mang tshogs mang che shos shig gis gser gyi dkar yol bzung nas sprang zas la re ltos byed bzhin yod/dbul phongs sa khul gyi rnam pa bcos sgyur bya dgos na/ las don mang po zhig bsgrub rgyu ha cang gal che/ lhag par du tshan rig lag rtsal dbul phongs sa khul du spel ba de bas kyang dgos gal che/ rang zhing phyugs las thin gyis dbul skyor las don tsho chung dang phyugs zog tshan rtsal pa 'ga' rtsa 'dzugs byas nas gung ho rdzong er sti shang du song nas nor dang lug rgyud legs bsgyur byas pa'i lag len khrod du gsal bshad 'di ltar thob pa ste/tshan rig lag rtsal la brten na nges par du lo gsum nas lo lnga'i bar dbul — 4 —

dpyadagatam/ da wad waphongs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i rnam pa bsgyur bcos bya thub/ yin na yang nga tshos do snang bya dgos pa zhig ni gzhi rtsa'i rtsa gnad cig byas nas/ dbul phongs sa khul rang gi gnas tshul la bstun pa ngang rang gi dpal 'byor gong 'phel gyi myur tshad je mgyogs su gtong ba dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'ang sngar bas je bzang du gtong dgos/ tshan rtsal gyis dbul skyor byed pa 'dir phan 'bras mngon sum du yod la bya ba de legs par bsgrub dgos na/ 'brel yod mgo khrid sde khag gis skul 'ded dang rtsa 'dzugs byas nas tshan rtsal mi sna 'bor chen zhig dbul phongs sa khul du phyin nas brtag dpyad nan mo byas te/ rang byung cha rkyen dang thon khungs sna tshogs kyi khyab rgyus gsal lon/ mdun lam sngog 'don dang gnas pa'i gnad don thag gcod/ ma dngul bsdus shing khrom ra 'dzugs pa sogs kyi rmang gzhi'i steng du/ dbul phongs sa khul so sor 'os shing 'tsham pa'i phyug bsgyur gyi lam zhig ston dgos/ tshan rtsal gyis dbul skyor byed pa'i nang du gong rim nas mngags pa'i tshan rtsal mi sna kho nar brten na mi 'os te/ sa cha de dag gi las byed pa dang na gzhon shes yon can sbyong brdar byas nas kho tshor sne khring kyi nus pa 'don du 'jug dgos/ der ma zad dpal 'byor dar rgyas che ba'i sa khul gyis dus nges can nang du tshan rtsal ched las mi sna skul 'ded byas nas dbul phongs sa khul du song nas rogs ram byed pa dang / ma dngul dang lag rtsal gyi gnad don re 'ga' thag bcad na shin tu bzang / de bas rim pa so so'i mgo khrid pa dang las byed pa/ tshan rtsal mi sna/ dbul phongs sa khul bcas kyis mnyam du 'bad brtson byas na mi ring ba'i dus su dbul phongs kyi zhwa mo phud thub nges red/(1986lo'i zla8pa'i tshes28nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)— 5 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mi rigs dpal 'byor gong du 'phel bar yan skul byed bsams na gom gang mdun spos sgos thon skyed nus shugs bcings 'grol gtong dgos/kun dga'/mi rigs gnad don gyis rang zhing gi dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro sgang du go gnas gal chen zhig bzung yod/ deng skabs thon skyed nus shugs kyi tshad gzhi rgyun 'khyongs byed pa'i thad kyi slob sbyong dang gros bsdur des mi rigs gnad don la ngos 'dzin je zab tu gtong ba dang /zhing chen yongs kyi mi rigs so so mnyam du dar rgyas gong 'phel dang mnyam du dar rgyas phun tshogs yong bar yar skul byed pa'i phyogs su don snying gal chen yod/rgyal khab btsugs nas lo sum cu lhag gi ring du/ rang zhing gi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las don sna tshogs la 'phel rgyas chen po byung mod/ 'on kyang spyi yongs nas bltas na/ nang sgos su mi rigs dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi sngar bzhin ha cang zhan pa dang / sa khul mang che bas sngar bzhin‘‘gnam la brten nas kha gso ba’’dang‘‘gnam la brten nas phyugs 'tsho ba/’’nor shugs zhan pa dang mi rigs slob gso rjes su lus pa/ tshan rtsal dang rig gnas da 6 da

dpyadagatam/ da walas don 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba dal ba bcas yin pas/ mi rigs ngapal 'byor gong du 'phel ba'i gzhi khyon dang myur tshad/ phan 'bras bcas la thad kar shugs rkyen thebs pa dang / zhing chen yongs kyi mi rigs sa khul gyi las don sna tshogs khyon yongs nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar shugs rkyen bzos/rang zhing gi mi rigs sa khul gyi bcos bsgyur dang sgo 'byed pa'i gom stabs je myur du btang nas mi rigs so so mnyam du gong 'phel dang mnyam du dar rgyas yong bar yar skul byed ched/ nga tshos nges par du bsam blo lhag par bcings 'grol dang / bsam blo bcings 'grol dang dngos thog bden 'tshol bar gyi 'brel bar ngos 'dzin dang thag gcod yang dag byed dgos/gnas tshul dngos la do snang byas nas mi rigs bar du don dngos thog gi he bag sogs dang len byed dgos la/ cha rkyen bskrun nas rim bzhin du he bag de med par gtong ba dang rjes lus mi rigs dang sngon thon mi rigs bar gyi mi 'dang sa yang je nyung du gtong dgos/ de 'dra byed bsams na tang gi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi thog ma'i dus rim gyi gzhi rtsa'i lam phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas thog mi rigs so so'i gnas tshul dngos gzhi 'dzin pa dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skun snying bo yin pas/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus sgul shugs la brtsi ba bcas byas te/ gom gang mdun spos sgos mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi bca' khrims lag len mthar phyin dang thon skyed gong spel dang / spyi tshogs yar thon la skul 'ded/ mi rigs so so'i bdag dbang dang rang brtsi/rang spel/ rang skyong / rang gis rang la bsgyur bkod byed pa dang rang rang so so dar rgyas gong du 'phel ba'i nus shugs je drag tu btang nas mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang mthun sgril dang / phan tshun rogs ram bcas mngon 'gyur byed dgos/— 7 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/nga tshos gom gang mdun spos sgos thon skyed nus shugs bcings 'grol byed bsams na/ mi rigs sa khul du lag tu bstar ba'i srid jus lhag par gu yangs su btang nas srid jus kyi nus pa 'don spel dang krung dbyang gi srid jus lag bstar legs po byed dgos/ nga tshos sngon chad mi rigs sa khul la dngos rdzas kyis rogs skyor byed pa de deng phyin srid jus thad kyi rogs skyor du bsgyur dgos pa dang / rang stobs rang spel dang dka' spyad las skrun zung 'brel byas nas/ rtsa ba'i steng nas mi rigs sa khul nang rol gyi dpal 'byor 'tsho stobs je drag tu btang ste mi rigs sa khul gyis lhag par stabs bstun dang lhag par gzigs skyong gi srid jus 'og tu/ 'dra mnyam gnyis phan gyi rtsa don ltar ma dngul dang lag rtsal/ shes ldan mi sna bcas lhag par mang po zhig blangs nas/ phan yon go skabs yod tshad dam 'dzin dang 'phred phyogs dpal 'byor mnyam 'brel legs sgrub/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tshong zog dpal 'byor gong spel bcas byas pa'i khar/kha phyogs rang bzhin ldan pa'i mi rigs dpal 'byor nang gi bzo gter khe las dang ming du grags pa'i thon rdzas skor zhig gsar gtong byed par rgyab skyor ngo ma byas te mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor gnas bab yag po chags su 'jug dgos/gong du bshad pa de dag byed thub pa bya bsam na/ mi rigs so so dang phyogs so so'i tshan rtsal shes ldan mi sna gces skyong dang nang 'dren byed dgos pa las gzhan/ da dung shugs chen po'i sgo nas mi rigs slob gso dang tshan rig rig gnas las don gong du spel dgos/ nga tshos mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor gsar gtod la dmigs nasga shugs chen pos mi rigs rang gi slob gso dang tshan rig rig gnas bcas las don gong spel byas nas rim bzhin mi rigs rang gi slob gso khongs gtogs 'thas tshang du gtong ba dang da wa 8 da wa ༄

dpyadagatam/ da wa'abrel/ mi rigs yongs rdzogs kyi tshan rtsal brje spel dra ba dang rig gnas sgrig chas sna tshogs gsar 'dzugs dang 'thus tshang du gtong dgos/(1988lo'i zla1ba'i tshes24nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal)gnod 'gog gzhi sa legs 'dzugs byas nas mcho sngon lho rgyud kyi dpal 'byor gong du spel dgos pa/tshags par khang gi dpyad gtam/mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul du gnas pa dang rang byung cha rkyen zhan pa/gnod 'tshe thebs snga zhing thebs thengs mang ba'i rma chen rdzong gis gzhi rtsa'i cha rkyen zhan pa dang / phyugs las 'phel rgyas byung tshul brtan po min pa'i gnas tshul rtsa ba nas bsgyur te/ gnam la brten nas phyugs 'tsho ba'i ga'an dbang gi rnam pa bsgyur ba dang / rang byung gnod 'tshe 'gog pa'i nus pa dngos gnas je mthor gtong zhing / phyugs las 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i rjes shugs je drag tu gtong ched/ mgo khrid pas sne khrid nas 'du shes bsgyur te‘‘rmang gzhi je drag tu gtong ba dang rtswa mdwo phyugs dar yong ba/ tshan rig ltar phyugs 'tsho ba/ phan 'bras mthor 'degs byed pa’’bcas kyi 'phel rgyas bsam 'khyer btsugs te/ ‘‘lnga brgyad’’nas bzung ste/ dgun dpyid rtswa sa — 9 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'dzugs skrun byed pa gnad che sar bzhag pa dang 'brog khyim re sde tshan byas te hur brtson sgos rtswa ra bskor ba dang mis bzos gzan rtswa'i gzhi sa 'dzugs pa/phyugs spyil las pa/ 'brog pa'i gtan sdod khang ba las pa bcas cha tshang sgrig pa'i phyugs las gnod 'gog gzhi sa'i rnam grangs 'dzugs skrun brtan pa'i ngang khyab gdal du btang / dpe mtshon gyis sne khrid byed pa dang hur thag gis ma dngul grabs gshom byed pa/ dka' ngal sel ba/ lo re bzhin lag bstar byed pa bcas brgyud de/ 'gag brtol rang bzhin gyi 'phel rgyas byung /rma chen rdzong la legs 'grub byung ba las mtsho sngon lho rgyud la dngos yod kyi dpyad gzhir 'dzin chog pa'i nyams myong zhig 'don sprod byas pa red zer chogamatsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul ni rang zhing gi 'brog khul gtso bo nang gi gcig yin pas/ de'i rtswa sa dang phyugs zog gis phal cher zhing chen yongs kyi phyed ka tsam zin yod/ mtsho sngon lho rgyud kyi phyugs las 'phel rgyas de zhing chen yongs kyi phyugs las rgyal pham la thug pa'i nus pa 'don bzhin yod/ 'on kyang gnam gshis cha rkyen btsog pa dang rmang gzhi cha rkyen zhan pa/ dpal 'byor cung rjes lus yin pa/ sa gnas nor srid la dka' khag che ba/dbul phongs mi grangs cung mang ba bcas kyi rgyu rkyen dag las phyugs las thon skyed brtan po'i ngang gong du spel ba tshod 'dzin thebs/ cang ma 'gor ba'i sngon du zhing chen u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci dbyin khe hrin gyis 'brel yod blo mthun rnams bsdus nas ched du mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul la gnod 'tshe byung rjes kyi 'phel rgyas gnad don la zhib 'jug byed dus bstan don/ ‘‘mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul gyi 'phel rgyas la mthong chen byed pa de zhing chen yongs kyi khyon yongs la 'brel ba yod pa dang / chab srid brtan po yong ba dang dpal — 10 —

dpyadagatam/ da wa da wa'abyor brtan po yong ba/ mtsho sngon lho rgyud mi dmangs kyi bde sdod las brtson bcas la 'brel ba yod pa red’’/ de ni 'brog khul gyi dpal 'byor rgong du spel na thog mar phyugs las kyi rmang gzhi je drag tu btang dgos pa dang /rmang gzhi je drag tu btang na/ gnod 'gog gi nus pa je drag tu 'gyur thub pa dang / phyugs las rgyun mthud dang brtan po'i ngang 'phel rgyas 'byung thub pa/ mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad je bzang du 'gyur thub pa bcas kyi rkyen gyis red/ de'i phyir nga tshos nges par du mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul gyi phyugs las rmang gzhi sgrig chas 'dzugs skrun byed pa de 'thab jus kyi go gnas su bzhag nas mthong chen byed dgos/‘‘sdeb bzhi’’gtso byed pa'i gnod 'gog gzhi sa 'dzugs skrun nan 'dzin byed pa ni mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul gyi bya ba sna tshogs las ches gal che ba zhig yin pa lag len las ra sprod byung bas/ rma chen rdzong gis sgrub thub pa zhig yin pas na mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul gzhan dag gis kyang 'bad brtson byas pa brgyud de sgrub thub nges yin pa nga tshor yid ches yod/ da lta krung dbyang nas zhing chen bar du gnad don der do snang dang rgyab skyor chen po byed bzhin yod pas/ nga tshos go skabs bzang bo 'chor du mi 'jug par gong 'og blo gcig sems gcig dang phyogs kun gyis rgyab skyor/ nan 'dzin dngos sgrub bcas byas te/ mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul gyi gnod 'gog gzhi sa'i 'dzugs skrun la 'gag brtol gsar ba zhig yod pa bya dgos/(1996lo'i zla4ba'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dpal yon gnyis mnyam du yar thon yong ba mngon 'gyur byed par 'bad brtson bya dgos/tshags par khang gi dpyad gtam/tang gi skabs bcu bzhi ba'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs lnga ba nas nan gyis bstan don/ nges par du bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun de sngar las mngon par gsal ba'i go gnas su 'don dgos pa dang /dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi 'dzugs skrun de krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs rang lugs deng rabs can las don gyi gcig gyur dmigs 'ben du brtsis te/ nam yin rung phyogs gnyis 'dzin pa rgyun 'khyongs dang phyogs gnyis dam 'dzin byas par brten dpal yon gnyis mnyam du yar thon yong ba dang dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs mthun sbyor sgos gong du 'phel ba mngon 'gyur byed dgos/deng skabs/ rang zhing gi bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun spyi yongs kyi blang bya ngang 'char gzhi gtan la phab zin/ rjes phyogs kyi gnad 'gag ni yid ches je che dang snying stobs cher bskyed/ dngos 'dzin rnal sgrub/dngos phan brtson len bcas byas te spyi tshogs ring lugs bsam pa'i dpal bhe 12 —

thadarnga〉thadab//spesbu// da wa yon 'dzugs skrun gyi shugs je cher gtong ba'i las 'gan sna tshogs dngos gnas don dngos thog 'bebs dgos/mtsho sngon gyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi zhan pa dang rig gnas sgrig chas rjes lus yin pa/ rgyu shugs dang dngos shugs dkon pa dang mi grangs spyi yongs kyi spus tshad dma' ba bcas yin pas/ bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon pa'i las 'gan lhag par lci ba yin/ 'on kyang /nga tshos gnas tshul gsar bas bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon byed par thob dka' ba'i go skabs ldan du bcug pa de yang mthong dgos pa red/ gcig nas krung dbyang dang zhing chen u yon lhan khang bis bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la mthong chen gnang gi yod pa dang gnyis nas rang zhing gi bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun de lo mang bo'i lag len brgyud myong ba dang grub 'bras mi nyung ba thob cing / nyams myong cung mang po bsogs pa bcas yin pas/ rang re'i bya ba yang skas rim gsar ba'i steng du 'bud par skul 'ded byed pa'i thad rmang gzhi bting / gsum nas rang zhing gong spel gyi brjid nyams 'char gzhi gtan la phab pa dang〈rtsa gnad〉dngos bstar byas pa/ krung dbyang srid jus kyis dbus nub rgyud sa khul gyi gong spol la phyogs zhen byas pa bcas kyis gom gang mdun spos kyi sgo nas bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon byed par mdun lam ha cang rgya chen po phye ba red/ bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi gnad 'gag gtso bo 'dzugs skrun dang /dngos sgrub byed par thug yod/ nga tshos rang sa'i gnas tshul dngos gzhir bzung nas gnas tshul dngos la rtog zhib dang skad cha bden pa bshad pa/don dngos 'dzin pa dang phan 'bras dngos la mthong chen byed pa/ shugs chen sgos phyi tshul ring lugs 'gog pa dang phyi bkrag nang stong mi sgrub pa bcas — 13 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bya dgos/ gtan la phab zin pa'i las 'gan ngag thog dang tshogs 'du/yig cha/ spyir btang gi rtsa don gyi blang bya bcas kyi steng 'jog mi nyan par/nges par du phan 'bras dngos 'thob par lta dgos/bsam pa'i dpal yon ni mi la drag chas spras pa dang khrid ston byed pa/gzugs brnyan gsar bzo dang skul ma gtong ba bcas rgyud rim ldan pa'i bzo skrun zhig yin pas/ sde khag so so dang mang tshogs tshogs pa/ spyi tshogs las rigs so so bcas kyis rim pa so so'i tang u dang srid gzhung gi mgo khrid 'og rang rang gi 'gan nus dang nus pa 'don spel gang legs byas te mnyam du 'bad brtson byas nas stobs sgril du 'gyur dgos/phyi chad kyi lo ngo15ni rang zhing spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun snga mthud phyi 'dren dang snga 'dzin phyi gtod kyi dus skabs gal chen zhig yin/ nga tshos nges par du blo brtan 'gyur med dang rang rtogs kyi sgo nas tang gi rtsa ba'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang rtsa ba'i lam phyogs mdzub ston byed pa rgyun 'khyongs dang / phyogs gnyis 'dzin pa dang phyogs gnyis dam dgos pa'i rtsa ba'i byed phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi 'dzugs skrun de lhag par mngon gsal yin pa'i go gnas su bton nas zhing chen u yon lhan khang dang zhing chen srid gzhung gi mgo khrid 'og dpa' ngar sngar las che ba'i nyams 'gyur dang spro sems sngar las rgyas pa/rang 'gul sngar las che ba'i snying stobs dang sngar las tan tig yin pa'i spyod tshul bcas la brten nas/ sems shugs gcig sgrim dang snying stobs cher skyed/ yar rgyas brtson len byas te/ krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs drug pa bsdu bar khor yug bzang po bskrun dgos pa dang rang zhing gi bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun gyi rnam pa gsar ba gtod par byas rjes gsar — 14 —

dpyadagatam/ da ba 'bul dgos so//(1996lo'i zla5ba'i tshes8nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal)bslab bya thengs shigardo tshe brtan/dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i dus mjug la/ a me ri kha'i khāng nar zer ba'i slob grwa chen mos skad grags yongs su khyab pa'i nyams sad thengs shig bgyis/ tshod lta'i tshan chung 'di'i zhib 'jug mi snas glo bur du sbal ba zhig gdu bzhin pa'i snum nag gi sla nga'i nang du 'phangs pa na/ tshor ba ha cang rno ba'i sbal ba 'dis/ shi gson dang 'brel zhing nyen kha rab tu che ba'i skabs 'dir/ skad cig nyid du stobs rtsal yod dgu phud nas mchong thengs shig gis rang srog 'chor thag chod pa'am lhog lhog gdu bzhin pa'i snum nag gi sla nga las phyin thon te/ nyen kha chen po las thar par byas/de nas chu tshod phyed tsam 'gor tshe/ kho tshos slar yang che chung mtshungs pa'i lcags kyi sla nga zhig gi nang du chu 'khyag lnga cha'i bzhi zin pa tsam blugs rjes/ 'chi nyen las thar ma thag pa'i sbal ba de yang bskyar sla ngar 'phangs pa na/ de la sems khral ci yang med par chu nang du phar rkyal tshur rkyal byed kyin mchis/ de mus su tshod lta mkhan gyis kha rog ger sla nga'i 'bas su me — 15 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/sbar nas bskol 'go brtsams pa na/ sbal ba 'dis gnas skabs tsam du ci yin 'di yin ma tshor ba chu'i‘‘drod skyid’’longs su spyod kyin bsdad/ de nas sla nga'i chu rim bzhin tsha bor gyur nas bsran thabs bral ba na/ sbal ba'i zhe la nges par du phyir mchong na ma gtogs nyen kha las thar thabs ma mchis pa'i snang ba shar mod/ 'phyis drags pa te mchong rtsal mtha' dag dron po'i chu nang du shor zin pas/ 'khol la nye ba'i chu nang du 'chi bar sgug 'dug pa las thabs zad/nyams sad 'di las bdag cag la yid 'jog 'os pa'i bslab bya zhig mngon byung ba ste/ nga tshos 'das zin pa'i lo zlar phyir 'dang re brgyab kyang 'di 'dra min pa zhig ni ga la yin/ 'tsho ba'i khur po lci mos bdag cag mnan nas dbugs dbyin dka' zhing / dka' ngal dang bar chad/ 'gal rkyen dang bgegs rkyen bcas la sogs pas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi thar lam mtha' dag bcad pa'i gnas su lhung dus/ mi rnams kyis rtag tu rang gi bsam yul las 'das pa'i nus rtsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyad de/nyen kha las thar ba'i thabs shig ni cis kyang 'tshol nus mod/ 'on kyang rang la grub 'bras thob cing snyan grags rgyas pa'am/ bsam don yid bzhin grub cing zhe tshim la/ tha na gang ltar kyang rang las mchog tu gyur ba zhig ni ma mchis snyam 'dug pa'i skabs su/ bar chad 'dra min sna tshogs ma bsam sa nas byung ste/ pham kha chen po bzos pa'i tshul ni gang mang 'dugachag sgo gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung ba ni bdag cag la mtshon na tshogs bsags kyi skal bzang zhig min pa'i nges pa med par/ 'tsho ba skyid cing longs spyod bzang ba/ bag med chud zos dang rgyas spros bcas kyi 'tsho ba yang bsod zad bgegs rkyen gyi gzhi ru 'gyur nyen ha cang che/ mi'i rigs kyi — 16 —

dpyadagatam/ da r+hamadun du lhags pa'i dka' khag re re bzhin nga tsho'i rtsal la nyams sad thengs re yin pa ma zad/ rtag tu rang dbang las 'das pa'i rgya rnyi 'ig tu 'gyur kyang srid/bdag cag gis mi tshe thung ngu'i khrod du/ yang snying slob sbyong dang shes tshor gyi skal bzang ga 'dra zhig ldan pa'am/ yang na bsam yul las 'das pa'i bar chad gang mang zhig nga tsho'i mig khar bsnar 'ong yang tshor snang ma mchis tshe/ bdag cag dang sla nga'i nang rim bzhin 'khol ba'i chu nang du rkyal bzhin 'chi ba'i tshor med sbal ba dang khyad par ci zhig 'dug gam/smras pa/dri ngan kha ru 'byin pa'i dug zas las/ /phyi pags bu ram can gyis dug ngan mang / /rab gdus snum las thar ba'i snal ba nyid/ /rim bzhin bskol ba'i chu las 'chi la ltos/ /(1996lo'i zla11ba'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsalari)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshong rar brtag dpyad ni khe las gong du spel ba'i thabs jus legs po zhig yin/gsar 'god pa/ tshe skyid/ tshong ra'i 'gran rtsod nyin bzhin drag por gyur ba dang bstun nas/thon skyed khe las dang 'tshong rgyug khe las gang yin rung / tshong rar brtag dpyad byed pa der nyin re bzhin mthong chen byed kin yod/ gling chen yo rob dang me gling rgyal khab sogs kyis tshong ra'i brtag dpyad de las rigs shig tu brtsis nas/ khe las mang pos tshong rar brtag dpyad byed pa'i rang tshugs sde khag btsugs te/ dus kun tu 'dzad spyod mkhan rnams kyi dgos mkho'i gnas tshul brtag dpyad byed pa dang / phyogs bsdus can gyi 'dzad spyod mkhan gyi dgos mkho'i 'gyur ldog gnas tshul dbye zhib byas mthar/ rang khe las kyi thon skyed dang brin tshong la mdzub khrid byed kyin yod/ 'on kyang rang zhing gi khe las mang che bas thon skyed la mthong chen byed pa las 'dzad spyod mkhan gyi dgos mkho la'ang brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byed par bsam blo mang po btang med pas/ 'gyur ldog che ba'i tshong khrom nang du gyong gun tshabs chen thebs/spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul dang mthun — 18 —

dpyadagatam/ ro r+hathabs yong ba dang thon rdzas brin par byed 'dod na/ tshong rar brtag ngapyad zer ba'i go don gsar ba der go ba zab mo len dgos pa ma zad/ khe la sa kyi thabs jus shig ru brtsis nas lag len du bstar dgos/ rang 'ing e lan rdzong gi shang grong khe las kyis tshong rar brtag dpyad thad la mthong chen byas nas grub 'bras g.yur du za ba zhig blangs pa red/ kho tshos nus shugs gang yod bton nas khe las do dam nan mo byed pa'i thog tshong ra'i sngon dpos dang rnam grangs dbye zhib la mthong chen byas pa ma zad/ da dung ched du mi mngags nas byang skyod lho 'gro sgos tshong ra'i dgos mkho brtag dpyang byas nas/ rang nyid kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i thon rdzas la tshong khrom chen mo'i khrod du tshong lam btsal/ gal srid rang zhing gi khe las mang che bas o lan rdzong gi shang grong khe las ji bzhin tshong rar brtag dpyad dang 'dzad spyod mkhan gyi dgos mkho zhib 'jug byas pa'i thad 'bad brtson byas pa na/ tshong khrom chen mo'i 'gran rtsod khrod du khyad stobs sngar las legs po 'don thub par slam/(1997lo'i zla1pa'i tshes12nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'byung 'gyur 'tshol ba/khu byugadus rabs nyi shu pa nas nyer gcig pa'i brgal mtshams su slebs pa'i gangs ri pa zhig yin tshe/ mdun lam gyi re ba chen po de 'das pa'i byung rabs shig gi gzi brjid la mi bcol bar/ phyogs ris chags zhen gyi mdud rgya bcad de 'byung 'gyur yar rgyas gong 'phel gyi thabs lam yang dag pa zhig btsal ba'i rgyang lta dgos pa ni ma 'ongs pa rjes dpag byed pa'i shes rab ste/deng skabs 'dzam gling yongs su bcos bsgyur gyi gom 'gros dang bstun pa'i mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i kha phyogs ni/ da lta nas ma 'ongs par 'khor ba'i gsar brje yi rlabs rgyun drag tu 'phyur ba'i shugs kyis bod mi'i bsam blo yang 'das pa la chags zhen che ba rim gyis dor te 'byung 'gyur la mi phyogs ka med du gyur pa'i dpe mngon sum du grub/ mar me nas glog sgron/ skad bskur nas glog 'phrin/ rta g.yag nas rlangs 'khor/ 'ur rdo nas me mda' sogs bgrang gis mi lang pa byung yod cing / sgos su lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring du bod mi rigs kyi skyid sdug gi mar me'i las dbang de dus rabs 'phel 'gyur las byung ba'i nyi glog dang chu glog skam glog dang rlung glog sogs kyis dus rabs gsar ba'i mun pa sel ba'i las 'gan dang du blangs pa mngon sum du grub kyang / gal te nga tsho'i bsam pa'i kha phyogs de 'das pa nas — 20 —

dpyadagatam/ da wa 'byung 'gyur/ srol rgyun nas gsar gtod/ kha 'thor nas gcig gyur du bsgyur ma thub na/ yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ba la thabs med pa red/deng rabs bod mi thams cad kyis dus rabs nyer gcig par phyogs pa'i bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel 'gyur dang 'tsham pa'i lta ba dang / yang na bod kyi spyi tshogs khor yug dang mthun pa'i blo gzu bo'i sgo nas rang re'i mes po nas brgyud pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas la ngos 'dzin gnas lugs dang mthun pa zhig dgos par ma tshad/ de la snyigs 'dor bcud len gyi khar mi nyams yar rgyas kyi rgyun 'dzin dgos par snang / gsar gtod kyi gzhi ni srol rgyun thog tu yod cing de mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa la srol rgyun gyi rgyun 'dzin dgos la gsar gtod kyi snying stobs dang brtson 'grus de bas kyang dgos/rgyun 'dzin gyi ched du rgyun 'dzin ma yin gyi/ gsar gtod kyi ched du rgyun 'dzin dgos pa yin/ dus rabs gsar bar spyi tshogs lam lugs yag phyogs su 'gyur ba'i yar thon gyi bsam pa yod pa'i steng nas gsar gcod la 'bad pa byas nas 'byung 'gyur gyi rang gi las dbang de rang la rag las pa zhig red/ deng sang 'dzam gling gi yul gru la la skad cig tsam du'ang rgyun ma chad par yar rgyas gong 'phel byung ba ni mu mthud du gsar gtod byas pa'i rkyen gyis yin la/ gal srid gsar gtod med na thams cad sngar gnas rang sar lus pa las sngon thon gyi gral du tshud pa lta ci/ des na nges par dus rabs kyi 'phel 'gyur dang bstun pa'i gsar gtod kyi blo stobs chen po yod dgos/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis dka' ba brgya phrag gis bskrun pa'i dpal yon de rang rang gi lto rgyab tshim pa'i chog shes tsam du mi 'dzin pa dang / yang na sger don zhig gi dgos mkho ma yin par spyi'i dgos mkhor lhos nga/ red/des na 'byung 'gyur gyi sger don zhes pa de ni mi'i rang 'dod kyis rtsa ba byas — 21 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/pa'i so sos rang gi ched du gzhan la phan bzo pa dang / mi'i rigs thams cad 'dra mnyam gyi gzhi rtsa'i lta ba'i thog nas mngon du 'gyur pa'i sger don de spyi don du 'dres pa'i mdzad pa zhig yin dgos/(1999lo'i zla6pa'i tshes18nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)spyi tshogs khor yug yag gtong skor gleng ba/bo thar bkra shis chos 'phel/mi zhig la mtshon na lus sems gnyis cha bde thang ngang yun ring por 'tsho rgyu ni rgyun par sems la 'khor ba mi srid kyang don gnad chung chung zhig ni ma yin pa kun gyis mkhyen/ lhag par du lo zla bstud mar mnar ba'i nad pa zhig la mtshon na lus khams bde bar 'tsho ba'i rin thang de da gzod mkhyen gyi yod/ spyi tshogs khor yug nyam chag tu song ba yang lus la nad phog pa dang kun nas mtshungs/ rig pa sems ni bdag po dang 'byung ba lus ni gnas gzhir grub stabs/ lus kyi cha shas thams cad la nad med par 'tsho skabs da gzod bdag po sems kyang bde 'bol le dang lhod shig ger bzhugs chogadape mtshon 'di ji bzhin 'phros pa na/ nga tshos 'tsho ba'i khor yug gi rig gnas skor yang rgya je cher gleng btub/ bsam gzhigs zhib tu btang na/ go la ril bo'am sa sgang zlum po ni 'gro ba mi'i thun mong gi longs su spyod bya yin — 22 —

dpyadagatam/ da wa pa de rnam shes lnga ka'i rten du 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i lus khams grub pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/'o na nga tshos tshul ji ltar lus po dang 'tsho ba'i khor yug la srung skyong bya dgos she na/ lus po 'di nyid nam rgyun rang re rnams la ches sbrel zab stabs/ mi thams cad kyis de tsam phog thug mi gtong ba dang/ gal te lus kyi cha shas shig la nyam chag 'dra byung na'ang myur ba myur mor sman thabs kyis gso bzhin 'dug bya spyod 'dir brtag na rang re'i spyi tshogs khor yug ni mi bde thang can rnams je mang dang/ mi rnams kyi gzugs byad mdzes shing lus mtshag bzang ba yong pa'i thabs kyi gzhi gnad du mngon/ rgyal khab gzhung nas kyang chang rag dang du nag smad 'tshong ma sogs dgag bya 'ba' 'ig tu 'jog pa ni 'tsho ba'i khor yug la gnod skyel mi phog pa'i ched du ste/ bya gzhag 'dir rgan gzhon kun gyis dga' mgu yi rang bya ba'i gnas su 'khums/ bye brag tu smad 'tshong mar mtshon na/ nad rims mang po spyi tshogs thog tu 'byung gzhi dang bza' tshang kha 'thor du 'gro ba'i rkyen du mthong bas/khrims dang goms srol gnyis kas 'di la mchil zhags dang bkag 'gog nan mo byas na kun la nye ring med pa'i phan thogs mchis/ legs bshad gter las/ ‘‘'go ba'i nad bzhin spang bar bya’’zhes gsungs yod na/ blo gros mig ldan rnams kyi nad gzhi yang der mtshungs su spang dargos pa smra ci/der ma zad goms srol dang lo rgyus dbang gis mtho bod mi rigs kho nar grub pa'i rtswa sa rtsod gleng dang grub mtha'i rtsod gleng / chang bzi bas 'khon rtsod dang lam 'gro bar 'phrog bcom sogs kyang 'go ba'i nad bzhin spang bya 'ba' zhig tu mngon te/ klan ka de dag ni rang re'i 'tsho ba'i khror yug la rdog brdzi nyam chag 'byung ba'i khungs su mthong / thad 'dir nga tshos mi — 23 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dmangs kyi shes rig yon tan gong 'phel btang nas kun po zhi bde dang 'phel rgyas la do snang dang sems khur yod mkhan du bsgyur dgos/ mi zhig gal srid spyi tshogs la thugs bsam bzhes pa'i lhag bsam dang sems khur med na/ rang gi lus po tsam srung skyong byed pa las 'tsho ba'i khor yug la gnod 'tshe yod med sems su 'dzin mi srid/ nga tsho bod mi'i khrod la yang skye bo tha shal ba re gnyis yod stabs/ yul gru mang po'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug ni mdzes sdug yid 'ong gi 'gal zlar gyur 'dug bod yul stod smad gang la phyin kyang/ rang byung khor yug kho na gtsang shos su gnas te/ yar a sngon dgung la bltas na/ sngo bsangs g.yu zhun 'dra'i mkha' dbyings ni dal mor g.yo ba'i sprin dkar gyis mdzes shing/ rang klung nags tshal la gzigs na/chu phran dwangs mo shag shag 'bab pa'i spang gshong ni bya byi'i sna tshogs kyis gtams shing/ ri skyes me tog rnams kyang dbyar gyi lang tsho ngom pa'i rgyan du ma btab pa 'khrungs yod/ ri klung khor yug de 'dra ba yod stabs/ grong khyer na mchis pa'i mi rnams bod yul la ches dga' po byed kyin 'dug deng gi grong khyer khag ni spyi tshogs dang rang byung khor yug gnyis kar skyon cha nyung nyung min par je mang du song yod/ snang ba'i lam du khang brtsegs dang tshong khang sogs gzugs mdzes po chags kyang don la ni 'ur zing che zhing nad yams mang ba/ mi dang mi'i bar la phrag dog che la brtse sems nyung ba sogs spyi tshogs khor yul la skyon de 'dra yod pa ma zad/ rang byung khor yug la mtshon na'ang/ mkha' dbugs thams cad rdzas ngan gyis khrems nas btsog par chaṭa shing/ bzo grwa dang las grwa rnams je mang song bas thal dud snyigs ro gang sar mthong srid/ des na mtho bod kyi sa cha ni‘‘gnam dwangs la chu gtsang ba’’sogs dge mtshan mang po yod pas phyi rgyal dang nang logs grong — 24 —

dpyadagatam/ r+had khyer gyi mi rnams thugs smon skye bzhin par khag ci yod/ 'on te nga tsho bod yul la'ang skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig mthong ste/ nags tshal dang chu klung sogs la gnod 'tshe skyel ba'i lo rgyus mang drags med kyang sdod gnas su gyur ba'i grong rdal khag rnams ni ha cang btsog par chags 'dug dper na/ sngon zhig gi dus nang rang khams sde dge yul la 'cham 'cham du 'gro myong/ ngo ma ljongs der par khang chos mdzod chen mo yod pas thengs shig slebs nas bod kyi shes rig bang mdzod la mjal phyag zhu bar cis mi dga'/ 'on te nga la bzhag pa'i bag chags ni srang 'gag dang lam phran kun du skyag dris khyab nas mkha' dbugs gzhan du bsgyur 'dug pha yul skye rgu dang grong khyer nyi ma lha sa soṭa la'ang skyon mtshang de 'dra mang du mchis/ bod mi rnams chos la zhen pa sha stag yin pas/ ngo ma bshad na lhag bsam dang spyi sems 'dzam gling na 'gran zla bral ba zhig yin dgos tshod 'dug 'on te chos kyi snying po de gzhan don la sems pa'i byams snying rje yin pa ni ma dgongs pa e yin/ bod kyi yul gru kun na gsang spyod kyi sgo ni lam nang du kha gtad kyin mchis/ lam khar sgo gtad pas dri ma ngan pa dang gcin skyag lam nang du byo nas dbyar gyi dus su 'gro lam 'dam chur 'gro ba dang / dgun gyi dus na chab rom du chags pa/ sos ka'i dus su thal rdul gyis khengs pa sogs gnod skyon gang mang mthong / go thos su spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs su rgyal sa pe cin du yang las phran kun na gcin skyag dang 'dam rnyog sogs kyis bkang bar grags/da lta ni gzhung lam che chung thams cad ar 'dam gyis g.yog nas gtsang ma gtsang rkyang du mchis/ 'gro sa'i lam ni rang re bod yul la'ang de 'dra byung na phul byung dang / de ltar ma byung na'ang gcin skyag sogs ni nges par du gtsang mar phyags na 'os 'gab sems/ gzhan sdod gnas kyi ba gam ni phar —— 25 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bltas na grong khyer gyi khang brtsegs rnams rdzig por 'dug kyang don du skyid po gtan nas mi 'dug de las nga tsho bod kyi ra ba yod pa'i thog khang 'di rnams bza' tshang tshor gzhigs na bde skyid dpal gyi ra bar grub yod/ thad 'dir nam yang phyi rgyal dang nang logs grong khyer la slob sbyong gnang rin mi 'dug grong khyer khag rnams ni mi grangs mang drags nas khang pa gnam la yar je mthor brtsegs snang / mi nam mkhar sdod na gshog pa 'dra da dung tshan rig pas gsar btod ma grub pas rang dbang zhig gang na mchis/ de las sa thog rang na ra ba skor nas sdod na rang dbang che zhing sos dal bag yangs kyi bde skyid mchis/ bod yul na mi grangs nyung nyung yin pas khang ba nam mkha' la yar brtsegs dgos pa'i dus rabs da dung slebs med/ mi grangs nyung ngur gnas pa 'dir spyi tshogs bde thang dang yul lung gtsang mar chags pa sogs dge mtshan mang po mchis/ gnad 'gag ni nga tshos thabs shes gang gis bod kyi khor yug 'di chos dang khrims lugs gnyis kyis dge mang skyon bral du bsgyur lugs skor de yin/ dpal 'byor gnyer pa'i zhor du 'tsho ba'i khor yug la do snang ma bgyis na/ nub phyogs kyi grong khyer kha shas bzhin nad yams dar ba'i yul zhig tu mi 'gyur ba'i nges pa ci yod/ nad yams zer ba yang lus tsam las klad pa dang sems la'ang phog rgyu 'dugathad 'dir phan thogs pa'i cha che shos shig ni bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i kun spyod‘‘las rgyu 'bras srung’’zer ba de yin/ ‘‘las 'bras’’tshul bzhin du srung ba ni rang gzhan gnyis kar phan pa'i khrims shig yin la/ spyi tshogs dang 'tsho ba'i khor yug gnyis kar phan pa'i goms srol yag po zhig kyang yin/ ya rabs kyi spyod lam 'di 'dra ba ni byis pa chung ngu nas bzung bslabs na rang shugs kyis kho tsho khor yug srung skyong byed pa'i dpung khag tu 'gyur srid/— 26 —

dpyadagatam/ da bsam gzhigs re byas na/ bod mi mang pos 'dab chags dang nya rigs sogs la gnod 'tshe mi gtong ba 'dis dpal 'byor thad nas glags 'ga' 'chor srid kyang / khor yug srung skyong la ni dge mtshan dpag tu med pa skrun 'dug gal te 'dam ka zhig bgyid dgos na/ dpal 'byor gong du spel ba las khor yug la nyam chag med par legs por srung thub na dga' bar sems/yang bskyar gong gi dpe las drangs na/ dpal 'byor gong spel ni lus kyi sha rgyas pa dang 'dra la/ khor yug skyon med ni lus la nad med pa dang mtshungs/'o na lus la nad med pa gtso che'am sha rgyas pa gtso che/ gnad 'gag ni nad med pa'i cha rkyen 'og nas sha rgyas na legs shos su gyur yod/ da lta nga tsho bod yul ni nad med pa'i bu chung dang mtshungs la/ nang logs dang phyi gling pa'i grong khyer rnams ni sha rgyas pa'i bu chung zhig dang mtshungs/ dpal 'byor gong spel la kha g.yar nas gter dang nags tshal la phog thug gtong ba dang /grong khyer khag tu rdzas ngan sogs spel ba byas na/ khor yug la ni gnod tshabs de las che ba gang du mchis/ las ka 'di ni mgo bo bcad nas mjug ma'i rgyan la btags pa'i dpe dang mtshungs/ zhib tu bsam na bod kyi yul lung khag na da dung khor yug de tsam skyon med par gtsang mar mchis pas der srung skyong byed rgyu 'u cag gi 'gan du snang / lta rgya thos rgya che na khor yug la gnod 'tshe thebs pa'i gyong gud tsam shes rjes rang shugs kyis dpal 'byor gong spel ched du nags tshal sogs gcod pa'i las rnams mtshams 'jog par sems/ 'khyams po nga ni thos rgya de tsam med kyang grong khyer kha shas la 'grim skyod byung rjes/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'dun lam yangs po ni nged cag mtho bod la yod snang 'char/ ham sems can 'ga' res sgor mo kha shas 'gro gron du khyer nas bod kyi shes rig dang gter kha rnams tshong khrom dpal 'byor la —— 27 ge

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/spel brtsis 'dug pas mtshang skyon shin tu che/ gal srid khor yug la phog thug gtong dgos na'ang rang re'i yul lung ni nga rang tshos bzo bkod bgyid na legs te/ lag pa 'tshig pa'i khar rdza ma chag pa'i dpe la 'dzem 'tshal/rgyal khab srid gzhung nas kyang gnod tshabs de rnams mthong rjes bod kyi shing nags sogs la da nas bzung rang dgar phog thug gtong mi chog pa'i bka' khrims bsgrags zin pas/ khrims lugs de ni rang gzhan kun gyis brtsi srung bya rgyu gnad shin tu che ba nges/ /(2000lo'i rda5ba'i tshes4nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/ )srol rgyun ngan pa ste gtes rtsod las 'phros pa'i gtam/bsam 'grub tshe ring/'brog pa rnams ni rang gshis bzang zhing 'dris thag ring ba soṭa rang bzhin gyi yon tan du ma ldan pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang 'brog mi gcig gam mi sde'i shog khag gang rung zhig la 'khon rtsod kyi gzhi che phra ci yang rung ba zhig shor nas rtsod gzhi de snang chung du bzhag pa yin na‘‘gyod ma 'grig gtes rtsod’’ces 'brog pa'i 'khon rtsod tshabs chen po zhig tu 'gyur nyen yod pa red/ /de yang dper na 'brog mi su yang rung ba zhig la yul de'am/ yul tha — 28 —

dpyadagatam/ da wadad pa'i mi gcig gam mi sde'i shog khag gang yang rung ba zhig gis mtsher sa dang/ rgyu nor dang/ bza' thor sogs kyi rtsod gzhi che phra ci rigs la brten nas phan tshun 'khon 'gal de dag rang gnongs su blangs pa yin na/ 'khon gzhi gang la byung ba'i mi de'i nang mi dang/ mi de'i nye tshan rnams dang/ mi de dang de'i nye tshan gyi mna' ya tshang ma phyogs bsgril te shog khag gcig tu gyes shing/ shog khag des rtsod gzhi'i thad rgyal kha 'thob pa'i ched du 'thab 'dzings mi rabs nas mi rabs kyi bar du byed srol yod pa red/ de yang dper na gtes rtsod kyi nang du rtsod mkhan gang rung zhig gis mi 'ig bsad pa yin na/ bsad shor ba'i shog khag des gsod mkhan lag dmar te bsad ma thub pa'i bar du 'grig thabs dkon/ de ltar res 'khor gyis mi rabs ha cang mang bo'i ring la'ang rdzogs su med pa'i mi sha'i rtsod ga'i tshabs chen po 'byung gi yod pa red/ mi sde'i lhan skyes kyi lta ba la'ang / gal te dgra zhig gis mi tshang zhig gi pha bsad pa yin na/ de'i bus pha gsod lag dmar de bsad thub dgos pa ni bu rang gi las 'gan gyi gtso bor chags pa dang/gal te shul du bu med pa'i mi zhig bsad pa yin na/ mi de'i mna' ya dag gis lag dmar gyi srog len thub dgos pa de las 'gan zhig tu chags pa dang / gal te bu'am mna' ya de dag gis dgra sha len ma thub na/ de dag ni yul mi tshang mas brnyas shing smad par bya ba red/ 'brog yul rnams su lo grangs brgya lhag gi dus nas byung ba'i gtes 'khon rtsod gzhi da lta'i dus su 'phro bskyang ba'ang mang du snang/'brog sde kha shas ni gtes rtsod kyi dka' ngal la brten nas rang yul du chags ma nus shing/ de dag gi grogs po dang mna' ya sogs yul ga'an du yod pa la brten nas sa thag ring zhing 'grul bzhud dka' ba'i gnas rnams —— 29 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/su spo sdod byas 'dug mi sde de dag yul gzhan zhig tu sdod gnas gtan khel ba nas bzung lo ltar dbyar dus su sngar gyi 'khon 'gras shog khag de'i thog tu gtes rtsod byed du 'gro zhing/ de dag gis rgyu nor 'phrog bcom byed pa ma zad/ mi sha'i rtsod gzhi gsar ba'ang mang du spel gyi yod pa red/'brog yul du gtes rtsod kyi rigs mi 'dra ba che phra mang du yod na'ang/'brog pa rnams kyis gtes rtsod 'khon gzhi 'dzuṭa pa la ha cang 'jiṭa snang dang dogs zon byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ gang byung du gtes rtsod byed mi 'os pa dang/ gal te gtes rtsod pa'i gzhi 'dzuṭa dgos byung na de'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'jigs su nung ba dang gtes rtsod kyi las ni nyes che ba zhig yin par shes shing/ gtes rtsod 'byung bar dogs pas phan tshun rtsod gzhi phra mo'i skor gnongs rang len gyis 'dum sla bor len srol yod pa red/gong gsal gyi srol rgyun ngan pa ther 'don dang nan tan sgos spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khrims lugs slob gso ma byas na/ gtes rtsod las byung ba'i don rkyen dper na/ 〈gnyan po g.yu rtse'i ri 'dabs kyi bo'u skad〉las brjod pa lags bzhin/1999 lo'i zla 11 pa'i tshes1 nyin gnyan po g.yu rtse ri 'dabs kyi gcig sgril rdzong thog tu nyes gyod 'di khrims thag bcad/a ho/ gtes rtsod kyi srol rgyun ngan pa 'dis lcags chab dgu yi ched du pho gsar dgu btson du 'dug dgos pa dang mi drug tshe phyi mar brdzangs pa dang rang gzhan mi bcu gcig la rmas skyon btang ba ma zad/ da rung pha bu kha bral dang bza' tshang yugs sar bskyur dgos byung/soms dang/ gtes rtsod kyi gna' srol rnying ba 'di 'dor bar slob gso dang rgya che ba'i 'brog pa mang tshogs la rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang bca' — 30 —

dpyadagatam/ da wa khrims dril bsgrags slob gsor shugs snon dang/ rang ngos nas kyang rnying ba thams cad lha yi srol du mi 'khyer bar dus rabs gsar ba'i gom stabs gsar bar snyeg ste nub rgyud gsar spel gyi go skabs bzang bo 'di dam 'dzin byas nas phyug 'gyur gyi thabs lam 'tshol bar 'bad rigs//(2000zla6pa'i tshes26nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)'phrong gi gtam rgyud yang bskyan gleng /so nam pa/gor mo grong khyer gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i khu nu ri rgyud kyi 'brong lung ni sngon chad 'brong khyu mi chung ba yod sa zhig yin pa dang / mis gnod 'tshe btang ba dang khor yug gi cha rkyen rim bzhin je ngan du song bas/ mi lo bcu phrag 'ga'i ring la 'brong lung zhes pa ming tsam las 'brong ni mthong dkon par gyur/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i sngon/ rgyal khab kyis 'brong ni kha 'dag par nye ba'i srog chags su brtsis shing srung rim dang po'i gras su bkod pa dang /srung skyong bya gzhag dngos 'bebs byas par brgyud/ 'phel ka mngon sum du je mthor song bas/ de ga'i 'brog pa rnams kyis rgyun du mthong thub pa ma zad/ phyugs zog skyong ba la'ang stabs mi bde ba bzos/ da lta de ga'i 'brong gi mgo grangs phal cher stong tsho yas mas su bud yod/—— 31 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/2001lo nas bzung / 'brong re gnyis sam du ma tshur 'brog pa'i ru 'dabs su yong ba dang / ka to ra rdung nas 'drogs bslangs na bral 'gro ba red/ de ltar lan mang po byung ba na/ goms 'dris su gyur nas 'drogs mi langs pa dang / yun gyis nor khyur 'dres pa dang nor khyu'i sna drangs nas ri la shor zhing / nor khyu bkar mi thub pa dang phyi ru 'gug dka' bar gyur/'brong g.yag gi gnod skyon thebs par 'dzem pas/ 'bri rnams bzho ba dang dkar chu'i las kun kyang bya thabs bral ba red/ da lo 'brog pa tshe ring rdo rje tshang gi nor gnyis rmas pa dang gnyis ru thur du drangs nas bsad song zer/gor mo grong khyer nags las spyi bde cus kyi cus krang rdo rje lags kyis gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri dang len byed dus bshad pa ste/ 'brong ni rgyal khab kyi rim pa dang por tshud pa'i srung skyong ri dwags yin pas 'brog dmangs la gnod pa thebs pa'i thad 'dir thabs bkod 'tsham po zhig btsal dgos 'dug nged nags las spyi bde cus kyis mi sna sgrig 'dzugs byas nas 'brong khyu rgyang du ded pa dang gong rim la yar zhu byas thog 'brog dmangs la sems gso'am 'os tshod kyi rogs ram byas mod/ da dung yun ring bor go chod pa'i thabs shig 'then ma thub zer/'jig rten srid par ci yang srid ces pa nang bzhin/ srung skyong nan bstar byas pas na/ nye ba'i lo shas ring nyin zha hos rigs rang skyong ljongs kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i mi nyag glang rir(‘‘glang’’zhes pa rgya skad du sgra zur chag nas hi lang hran du 'bod) 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i ri dwags gna' ba 'phel drags pas/ rdza 'dabs kyi grong ba mi nyung ba'i zhing kha'i lo tog la gnod pa byung phyir/ khor yug srung skyong thad kyi mkhas pa'i gros tshogs lan du mar bsdus nas thabs bkod 'then yang / la las 'os tshod tsam bsad na — 32 —

dpyadagatam/ da wa'agrig tshul dang / la las yul gru de'i gna' ba'i kha gnon te spyang ki bsad tshar ba'i rkyen gyis skye khams do mi mnyam par gyur pa yin pas de gar spyang ki bskor nas dar bcug na 'grig tshul dang / la las rdza rgyud de yongs su lcags dra bskor nas gna' ba phyi la 'bud mi thub pa bzo 'os tshul sogs thabs gang 'os kha mi 'cham pa'i tshod du 'dug rgyu mtshan ni 'os 'tsham tsam gsod par rgyal khab kyi chog mchan thob dka' ba dang / skyang ki basmor na gna' ba gnon thub kyang mtha' 'khor gyi phyugs zog gam tha na grong mi la'ang gnod pa 'ong bar dogs pa dang / rdza rgyud yongs su lcags dras basmor na rang byung khams nyid do mnyam po yong bar gnod pa yid las 'das pa bzo ba'am yang na 'gro sgo che drags pa dang yong khungs med pas khag 'di lta na mi'i rigs kyis rang byung khams la the gtogs byas nas tshad las 'angs na/rtswa gzan rigs la'ang 'di 'dra'i 'bras bu ngan pa smin 'jug pa rtogs thub la/ mi'i 'dun pa kho nas rang byung khams kyi dngos po yongs su bkod sgrig byed 'dod pa ni byis blo'i dri ma dang ldan pa zhig yin tshul yang shes thub pa red/ des na mi'i 'dun pa de rang byung khams kyi chos nyid dang mthun pa'i ngang lag len 'debs rgyu ni ngos zin gal che ba zhig tu snang ba dang / 'di la bod mi rgan rabs pa'i‘‘rang byung dgra de rang byung thabs kyis 'dul ’zhes pa'i man ngag 'phrod 'dug pa red/ gtam dpe las/ nor khyu la 'brong 'dres na nor g.yang 'khror ba dang lug khyu la gnyan 'dres na lug g.yang 'khor zer ba nang bzhin/ phyugs zog khrod du 'brong tsha dang gnyan tsha 'phel na phyugs rgyud bzang du 'ong srid/ spyir mis bkol spyod byas shing rgyud yag shos 'dzin pa la do snang ma byas pa'i dbang gis dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byas ma thag de dus skams kyi sha khog gcig — 33 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/la rgya ma chig stong lnga brgya longs pa dang sha gzan gyi sha khog gcig la rgya ma chig brgya lnga bcu longs pa yod srid mod/ da lta skams ni rgya ma lnga brgya'i dman dang sha gzan ni rgya ma lnga bcu'i dman las mthong dkon/ sngon du 'brog pa'i nor pa'am ru ba'i ru 'gro mtsher spo la srid 'dzin mnga' khongs kyi tshod bzung med pa dang / dus bzhi'i rtswa sa 'tsho res bskor ba'i shong khongs yod phyir/phyugs rgyud mi nyams par rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen ldan 'dug de 'dra yin na'ang da dung rigs mtshungs ri dwags dang g.yung dwags kyi rgyud sdeb par ha cang gtsigs chen byed srid/ thabs kyi gtso bo ni‘‘mig 'tsho’’zer ba yin/ nor khyu gang zhig 'brong khyus dkris song na rgyang nas mig 'tsho byas nas mtha' kha'i lhung ba dang / brag tu 'gril nas rmas pa dang / gcan gzan dang khram rkun lta bur gzon pa las/ dus yun nges can gyi dkar chu la blta ba ma red/gong gleng 'brong lung du 'brong 'phel nas 'brog pa'i phyugs skyong ba dang 'tsho ba la dka' khag nges can bzos pa der gzhigs na/ gcig tu srung skyong byas par grub 'bras smin pa'i tshul zhig yin pa dang / gnyis su 'brog dmangs la bzang gtad na bzod thub thabs shig dgos pa dang / gsum du rkyen bzang de ji ltar bed chod pa'i thabs shig ldan dgos/des na srung skyong thabs jus sngon bzhin rgyun skyong ba la blo g.yo sems khral mi byed pa'i gzhi nas/ yul gru de'i phyed che tsam 'brong srung skyong tsam gyis mi tshad par rang byung srung skyong khul du bsgyur 'os pa dang / phyed chung tsam rang sa'i phyugs rgyud legs sgyur rten gzhi zhig tu bsgyur 'tshal/ de 'dra'i rmang gzhi thog tu rang byung khor yig srung skyong byed pa dang / spyang ki lta bu 'brong gi kha gnon rigs de bas srung skyong bya 'tshal/ yul de'i phyed chung tsam du shang de'i 'brog dmangs u yon lhan tshogs kyi hre so so res mo byas — 34 —

dpyad gtam/ r+hanas so sos bzung yod pa'i rtswa sa phan tshun lo gnyis ring brjes pa'i tshul gyis mi dang phyugs zog gi mgo grangs 'os shing 'tsham pa'i tshod cig bsdad bcug na/ shang yongs kyi nor rgyud bzang du 'gyur ba'i rkyen bskrun pa dang / rtswa sa brjes nas dka' las myangs pa'i yon du phyugs rgyud legs 'gyur las yod pa ma zad/ pho mor ma ltos par 'brong tsha yongs su rgyud spel byed du chog cing /sa phyogs gzhan la btsongs na brin nges pa red/ 'di ltar 'khyongs pa rmi yul gru de'i srid gzhung dang 'brog dmangs kyis 'bad brtson brgyud nas byung pa'i rkyen bzang gal chen zhig yin pas/ bed yag po chod par da dung 'bad dgos/ gal te phyugs rgyud legs sgyur rten gzhir 'brong yong na/ g.yung dwags dang rgyud sdeb pa'i cha rkyen gang 'tsham bsgrigs pa las gzhan/ bod mi'i srol rgyun du rang byung khams la tshad yod ngang the gtogs byed pa'i lhams myong de shin tu gces/ de la rgan rabs rnams kyis‘‘mi len pa min yang len mkhas gtso’’zhes pa'i man ngag de 'phrod pa yin/ ci zhe na/ ri skyes rtsi shing dang srog chags gang yin yang rung bar 'os tshod re bed spyod rung ba la go'os tshod ces pa 'brong lta bu'i steng du lag bstar byed tshul ni/ kha mtho dang 'brong be'u 'brong shad nang gi shed ngan gras rngon chog pa zhig yin/ deng sang rgyal khab phyi na bzhugs pa'i sku zhabs nam mkha'i nor bu lags kyis1953lor brtsams pa'i〈byang 'brog gi lam yig〉nang du 'di skor khong yod/phyugs rgyud legs sgyur rten gzhir yong ba'i 'brong kha mtho dang kha chung shed ngan bed spyod par rang sa'i khrims bzhengs par brgyud/ 'char gzhi yod pa dang rang byung chos nyid dang mthun pa dang lag bstar len tshul sogs gtan khel byas nas/ de gar yong ba'i 'brong nye logs kyi srung skyong sa khul bar log yong gnyi ga bde ba'i thabs ldan zhing / phyugs rgyud legs sgyur la'ang — 35 —
