gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mngon gsal gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ba zhig yin dgos/(2004lo'i zla11pa'i tshes8nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)bod srol sa gdan gyis mngan lam gsar ba 'dong yong rngoso/so nam pa/bod lug gi bal gong dma' ba dang bod lug skyong ba'i rong 'brog pa'i yong sgo dma' ba/ 'di ni dus yun mi thung ba'i nang mi rnams kyis sems khral byed sa zhig tu gyur yod/dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu ba'i stod/ rgyal spyi'i tshong khrom du bod lug gi bal las 'thag pa'i sa gdan brin pa'i skabs der/ bod lug gi bal gong yang mtho ba'i gnas tshul byung ba dang / bod bal 'khel 'thag gi lag rtsal dbyibs sgyur thad nas 'phel lam zhig rnyed song 'dod pa dang /cha rkyen zhan pa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mtsho lho dang mtsho byang sogs sa khul nas kyang sa gdan sbyor bzo'i khe las 'bring gras su tshud pa du ma byung mod/'on de mdzangs mi dkon drags pa dang 'jon mi nyung ba'i gnas tshul 'ogalag rtsal gyi gsar spel thad nas mu 'brang thub min/ khe las nang khul gyi do dam tshags zhib min dang yun ldan min/ khe las phyi rol du tshong khrom rgya — 36 —

dpyadagatam/ ——da bskyed thub min dang brtan po yong thub min bcas phyogs gang mang nas 'gran btsugs yong bar ma bzod phyir/ bod bal sbyor bzo'i khe las rmams ni grang ngar khrod kyi myu gu bzhin mu 'brang nas nyams song / mtsho shar khul gyi sa gdan khe las la las rgyu cha'i gong dma' song ba'i cha rkyen spyad nas bod srol sa gdan sbyor bzo'i phyogs su gom kha bsgyur kyang / gnyer sprutshong dang dngul rtsa sgril ba sogs thad nas khe las rang gi spus zhan pa'i rkyen gyis ma 'khyongs ba red/nye ba'i lo gnyis nang / sngon du sa gdan gnyer 'tshong gi g.yul sa chen por zhugs nas sbyong brdar thob pa'i 'jon thang can rnams 'dus pa dang /bod srol thags ris dang khyad chos thad nas jus 'god mi sna hrag sgrig dang /dbul skyor ma dngul sdud sgril bed spyod kyi thabs lam dag la brten nas/mtsho sngon bod lugs sa gdan kung zi ste bod srol sa gdan phyogs kyi dbu gtso'i khe las de skyed sring 'tshar longs byung bar brten/ na ning rgyal khab phyi la btsongs tshad me sgor bye ba gcig gi gnyer 'tshong grub 'bras blangs tshun/da lo'i zla9ba'i mjug bar me sgor khri942longs tshad btsongs thub song / de lta na sngon lo'i dus mnyam las35lko'aphel ba dang / lo re'i thon skyed nus tshad mus gru bzhi ma khri50ru bslebs/ da lo mtsho sngon bod srol sa gdan rgyal spyi'i 'grem ston tshogs 'du bsdus nas bzang tsam 'khyongs pas/ bod srol sa gdan thon las kyi 'phel rgyas la 'tsho stobs gsar ba bsnan/ snye lam zhing chen 'brel yod sde khag gis blang bya bton pa ste/ bod srol sa gdan6‘lnga bcu gcig’’'phel rgyas 'char gzhir 'god dgos pa dang / khe las dang rong 'brog dmangs la yid rton ma dngul gyi gtong stangs thad nas gsar gtod yong ba dang / ma rtsa 'debs pa'i gzhi khyon rgya bskyed par ga'igs te/ — 37 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/zhing las phyogs bsdus gsar spel khongs kyi las gzhir brtsis nas rgyal khab kyi ched dmigs rgyab skyor ma dngul brtson len bya ba dang / bod srol sa gdan skor gyi dbu gtso khe las la srid jus dang ma dngul thad kyi rgyab skyor stobs shugs je cher gtong dgos tshul bcas brjod yod pa red/ jus chod 'di 'dra byung ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen la gzhigs na/ na ning nas da lo'i zla bcu ba'i zla 'go tsam bar/ zhing chen yongs nas dbul skyor ma dngul bye bar nye ba btang ba dang / sa gdan bzo khang81bskrun pa de bsnan phyin/ mig sngar zhing chen yongs kyi sa gdan bzo khang123la longs bcug cing / las kar tshud mi8000lhag tu bslebs pa'i nang du/ grong rdal dang zhing grong gi ngal rtsol pa7000lhag bkod sgrig thub yod/ mi de tsam las kar tshud pa dang bal tshong brin pa dang / thon las can du 'gyur bar bgrod lam gsar ba zhig btod pas/ dpal 'byor phan yon dang spyi tshogs phan yon gnyi ga'i cha nas dga' 'os pa zhig tu snang /bod lug gi bal kha bal rigs gzhan las rtsub la ldem sha ldan pa zhig yin pas sa gdan 'khel 'thag gi thon khungs kyi drags cha zhig tu gyur pa dang / bod srol thags ris la rig gnas steng nas mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pas rig gnas thon khungs kyi drags cha zhig tu gyur pa dang / jus 'god dang do dam thad nas 'jon mi'i cha rkyen ldan song ba dang / rgyal spyi'i tshong khrom du 'jug par gnyer 'tshong gi nus pa ldan song ba dang / gzhi 'di nas dmangs phan gyi dge mtshan ldan 'dug phyir/ srid jus dang ma dngul gyi rgyab skyor thob pa bcas mthun rkyen gtso shos phal mo che ba ldan gyur pas/bod srol sa gnad thad nas thon las shig tu 'gyur ba dang / 'gyur rim de nas sngon bas yangs shing yid du 'ong ba'i mdun lam zhig 'ding yong nges — 38 —

dpyadagatam/ d+nghad+nghared/bod srol sa gdan gyi 'das dang da lta'i gnas tshul las nga tshor bsam blo gtong sa mang tsam bton pa ste/ gtso shos tsam gleng na/ bod srol sa gdan du dgos pa'i lug bal gyi rgyu cha dang rang byung tshos mdog gi rgyu cha dang mi rigs khyad chos ldan pa'i thags ris bcas dus snga mo zhig nas grub yod kyang / nye 'khor gyi tshong khrom chung shos tsam las blo ngor ma yong tshe/ thad de'i thon skyed kyang khyim tshang gi gnyer ba'am nye du'i mnyam las bzo khang tsam las 'phel ma thub pa red/ der gzhigs na thon khungs ci 'dra bzang ba dang lag rtsal ci 'dra byang gyur kyang / thon las su bsgyur ma thub na de'i thon skyed nus shugs kyang bskyed mi thub pa red/ thon las su bsgyur na gnad 'gag cig ni 'jon thang ldan pa'i mi yod dgos pa 'di mthun rkyen gzhan las gco che/bzo las spyi tshogs kyi 'jon mi ni lag pa'i bzo rtsal ldan pa tsam 'ig ga la yin/ de ni dus rabs gang du bab pa'i sngon thon rig gnas dang yo byad la byang cha ldan pa dang / rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs las yol bar mthong ya ngas la rig ldan thabs mkhas shig yin dgos/ de lta bu'i 'jon mi la ga'an pas gtsigs 'dzin byed pa'i srid jus kyang srid 'dzin mnga' khongs gang la gang mkho tshul du yod pa red/ 'jon mi'i 'byung khungs ni slob gso la re bcol yod pa ste/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dal ba'i yul gru dag gi slob gso'i sgrig srol de spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho dang bar thag ring ba'i zhan cha yod srid pas/spyi tshogs kyi 'gran rtsod khrod du rjes lus tshul du bskyur 'dug des na slob gso'i sgrig srol steng nas rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi g.yul sa gtso shos la gzu bor kha gtad thub min ni yul gru gang de'i da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam la thad kar shan bzo ba'i gnad cig tu nges/ de yang / khyim — 39 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshang khri 'bum gyi khyim sgo nas thon pa'i thar thor du gnas pa'i thon khungs la brten nas thon las su bsgyur dgos na/ nges par thar thor du 'tshar longs byung ba'i 'jon thang can rnams sgril thabs shig yod dgos/ myong grub ltar na/ tshong khrom che tsam gyi dgos mkhor bstun nas dbu gtso khe las chags par brtson pa ni gnad dam pa red/ dbu gtso khe las chags par srid gzhung gi khrid ston dang ram 'degs ni gal los che mod/ 'on te ‘‘lpags kyang mi 'dug pas ni spu ni ga la rten’’zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ rmang gzhi ni dmangs khrod 'jon mi'i 'ding yong bar re ba yin/ 'jon mi la brten nas rgyal spyi'i tshong khrom gyi cha 'phrin gang mkho 'dzin thub pa dang rgyal spyi'i tshong khrom 'byed nus pa/thon khungs tshong khrom gyi cha 'phrin gang mkho bed chod pa dang thon khungs bdag 'dzin nus pa/ thon khungs dang tshong brong gtad yul phyogs gnyis kyi tshong khrom nas dngul rtsa sgril par mkhas pa/ 'di dag la byang cha ldan pa'i khe las byung ba na/ da gzod jus 'god dang lag rtsal dang do dam thad kyi 'jon thang can 'bor chen bed spyod thub pa red/ 'di lta bu'i dbu gtso khe las ni tshong zong btsong sa'i tshong khrom 'byed pa dang thon khungs nyo sa'i tshong khrom 'byed pa/ mu rgyud ldan pa'i tshong zong sbyor bzo thub pa bcas phyogs du ma nas dbu 'dren dang 'khor lte dang dbang tshor sogs kyi yon tan 'don thub pa zhig tu snang / dbu gtso khe las kyi grub tshul yang sngon ltar sbyor bzo tsam gtso bo byed pa zhig ma yin te/ sbyor bzo gtso ba'i khe las kyi grub tshul dper na shing tog tshi gu'i gzugs ji bzhin/ lto ba(sbyor bzo)che la sne gnyis chung ba can yin tshe yun ring du brtan mi thub pa red/ nges par rgyal spyi'i tshong khrom la mkhas shing de'i 'byed spel dang de nas dngul rtsa sgril bar 'jon pa dang / thon khungs kyi tshong khrom la mkhas shing de'i 'byed spel dang de nas — 40 —

dpyadagatam/ da wadangul rtsa sgrig bar 'jon pa yin thog sbyor bzo dang ma dngul spyod par mkhas pa zhig yin dgos/ 'di la deng gi dpal 'byor rig pa'i gzhung las dpe 'jog tshul mi 'dra na'ang / don gyi snying bo ni 'bu grog ma'i gzugs dbyibs ji bzhin/ khog stod khog smad gnyis che ba ste/ khog stod rgyal spyi'i tshong khrom la gtad yod kyang / khog smad thon khungs tshong khrom la gtad pa dang / rked pa ldem myur che la brkyang skyung ldan pa zhig tu snang / de 'dra'i dbu gtso khe las 'byung re yod pa na/ da gzod srid gzhung phyogs nas srid jus dang 'char gzhi dang ma dngul bcas thad nas rgyab skyor 'thob par re che la phan yang che ba yin/ mdor na 'jon thang can dang de bed spyod pa'i dbu gtso las khe las yod pas na/ srol rgyun gyi thon skyed chung ngu pa'i tshul nas deng rabs kyi thon las shig tu 'gyur bar rten gzhi ldan pa yin la/ yun gyis 'byor phyug skrun pa'i shing rta chen por gyur nas thon las kyi lam srol zhig btod yong ba red/ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi bde ba kho nar sems phyogs pa'i tshags par 'ig gi cha nas bshad na/ nga tshos mtsho sngon bod lug sa gdan kung zi de tshong brom gnyis la dbang mnga' zhing / ming don mtshungs pa'i dbu gtso khe las su 'gyur ba dang / bod bal gyi 'khel 'thag thad nas rong 'brog mi dmangs 'byor phyug tu yong bar byas rjes chen po 'jog par smon/(2004lo'i zla11pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/skya thig 'di ltar phab yod/gtsags drub khab skud rgyus dang /so nam pa/rang re'i rgyal khab 'di yongs su spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi dus su zhugs pa dang / dpal 'byor thad 'dzam gling gcig 'gyur yong bzhin pa'i sgang 'dir/ rang sa'i gnas skor thon khungs ji ltar bed chod pa dang tshong khrom ji ltar 'dzin pa/ gnas skor thon las 'phel bar brten nas rang sa'i dpal 'byor gong du spel ba dang / gzhi de nas yul dmangs kyi yong sgo brtan 'phar yong 'jug pa ni bshol gzur mi rung ba'i don chen zhig tu gyur yod/nye lam mtsho sngon zhing chen gnas skor gong spel yongs 'gril khyab stangs zhes pa mngon par bsgrags/ de la bsdus tshul du‘‘gcig gnyis gsum bzhi drug dgu'i khyab stabs’’zer ba dang / yang na‘‘lte ba gcig dang spel gnad gnyis dang chas rtags gsumadang sa khul bzhi dang lam thig drug dang bzo 'god dgu'i khyab stangs’’zer 'dug lte ba gcig ste/ zi ling grong khyer ni zhing chen yongs kyi gnas skor gyi 'khor lte lta bur gtong ba/ spel gnad gnyis te/ gor mo grong khyer ni yul khongs nges can gyi 'doms mdo ru gtong ba dang / skye rgu grong rdal ni gnas skor gyi brdol khung btod sa zhig tu — 42 —

dpyadagatam/ — jo'adzin pa bcas la go ba yin/ chas rtags gsum ste/ mtsho sngon gyi khyad chos mngon par mtshon pa'i gtsang po 'byung yul de rtse rim chas rtags su 'khrog pa dang / 'thus tshab snang brnyan du rung ba'i mtsho sngon po ni mtho rim chas rtags su 'jog pa/ mi rigs yul srol dang chos lugs rig gnas ni gtsigs 'dzin chas rtags su 'jog pa bcas la go ba yin/ sa khul ba'i ste/rma tsong(rma chu dang tsong chu)gnas skor sa khul/ mtsho sngon po gnas skor sa khul/ gtsang po rma 'bri rdza gsum 'byung yul gnas skor sa khul/ khu rmi rdza rgyud rig gnas gnas skor sa khul bcas la go ba yin/ rab 'byor lam thig drug ste/ mtsho sngon por skor ba rgyag pa'i gnas skor lam thig dang / 'dzam gling sgal tshigs yul gru'i myul dpyad gnas skor lam thig(mtsho bod lcags lam rgyud) thang bod gna' lam(khongs su mtsho bod yun gsum cher bskyed btang nas sems kyi nyi zla yul gru 'du 'jug pa)gnas skor lam thig rma chu stod rgyud kyi brag dmar zhing chu dwangs pa'i yul gru'i gnas skor lam thigadamangs srol dang chos lugs rig gnas kyi gnas skor lam thig srin dar tshong lam lho ma'i(mā khu po lo lam yang zer)gnas skor lam thig bcas la go ba yin/ spus legs gnas skor sa khul gyi bzo 'god chen po dgu ste/ zi ling sa khul phul byung gnas skor grong khyer du gsar gtod byed pa'i bzo 'god dang / mtsho sngon po'i mtha' 'khor gyi spus legs gnas skor las ga'i 'byed spel bya ba dang mtsher ba ri'i bya gling gi skye khams khor yug phyogs bsdus bcos skyong bzo 'god/ sku 'bum byams pa gling 'dzam gling rig gnas bskyur nor du chog zhu dang phyogs bsdus bcos skyong bzo 'god/ rma chu stod rgyud brag dmar zhing chu dwangs pa khul gyi gnas skor 'byed spel dang srung skyong babro 'god/ gtsang po rma 'bri rdza gsum 'byung yul gyi skye khams sanas skor — 43 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dpe ston khul gyi bzo 'god/ khi ni rdza rgyud rig gnas spus legs gnas skor khul gyi bzo 'god/ krung go'i hor rigs yul sde'i spus legs gnas skor khul gyi bzo 'god/ tsha mtsho'i bzo las spus legs gnas skor khul gyi bzo 'god/ rgyal khab kyi gangs rir 'dzeg pa'i myul dpyad gnas skor rten gzhi'i bzo 'god bcas 'dus yod pa red/yongs 'gril khyab stangs kyi jus bkod ltar na/ mtsho sngon gyi gnas skor 'byed spel de ltad mo lta ba rmang gzhi byed pa dang / skye khams gnas skor dang gung gseng gnas skor dang mjal 'grim gnas skor sogs gnad du 'dzin pa dang / rir 'dzeg gnas skor dang mi rigs yul srol gnas skor dang myul dpyad gnas skor dang bzo las gnas skor dang rig gnas gnas skor dang tshan rig khyab gdal brtag dpyad gnas skor gyis khyad chos thon pa dang / zong nyo zas spyod gnas skor dang lus po'i bde thang srung ba'i gnas skor dang tshogs 'dur 'tsham pa'i gnas skor sogs kyis ram 'degs thon pa zhig red/ 2003lo nas2005lo bar/ mtsho sngon po'i chas rtags de gnad du bzung nas mtshams sbyor byed pa dang / 2006lo nas2010lo bar/gtsang po rma 'bri rdza gsum 'byung yul dang khi ni rdza rgyud dang mtsho sngon po sogs chas rtags can du spel ba gnad du bzung nas mtshams sbyor byed pa'i mnyam du/ mtsho bod lcags lam dang ang214pa'i gzhung lam la gzhi rten nas/ chas rtags su bskrun pa de gsum dang bod ljongs kyi gnas skor khul star du brgyus nas 'dzam gling sgal tshigs yul grur skor ba rgyag pa'i rab 'byor gnas skor lam thig cig tu bsgyur rgyu red/dus yun 'bring tsam dang ring tsam gyi dbang du btang na/ mtsho sngon gyi gnas skor 'di gting zab par 'byed spel dang bdag gnyer byed po sna mang — 44 —

dpyadagatam/ da wazhugs thub pa'i phyogs su bsgyur dgos shing / rim pa bzhin du reb kong gna' rdzong gnas skor khul dang / mdo la ring mo gnas skor khul/ a chen gangs ri'i rdza rgyud gnas skor khul sogs 'byed spel byas par brgyud/ 'ing chen mnga' khongs las yol ba'i gnas skor lam thig bskrun pa dang / gnas skor lam thig gi dra ba chags par brtson pa bskyed rgyu red/gong gleng ltar na/ mtsho sngon nas gnas skor gnyer skyong 'di thon las shig tu bsgyur bar skya thig cig phab zin pa mtshon la/‘‘bdag gnyer byed po sna mang zhugs thub pa'i phyogs su bsgyur cing’’ces pa'i byed phyogs dbang du song na/ rgya che ba'i yul dmangs la rtsal/ sprugs pa'i rten gnas chen po 'ig 'don nges/ gal te rten gnas de rgyu spus bzang ba'i dar ling zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang na/ de gar yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gtsags drub cig 'god yong nges red/ gnas skor las rigs 'di la ngal rtsol pa 'bor chen dgos pa dang / ngal rtsol pa'i spus mtshag kyang mtho tsam dgos pa yin pas/ nam zla'i kha ngor bltas nas 'brog thang du phyugs 'tsho ba dang rdza 'dabs su zhing 'debs pa'i rjes lus kyi thon skyed byed stangs thad nas legs sgyur 'byung ba'i go skabs 'chor mi rung ba zhig red/ da ni ji skad du‘‘rnyab par lag pa gang mgyogs dang gcod par gri chung gang rno’’blta ba'i skabs su bab yod/de yang rnyab mkhas yong thub pa ni phyod yon grub 'bras gang 'dra 'byung ba'i gnad ka yin pas cung zad spro 'os/ thon skyed byed stangs bsgyur bar thad kar phan thogs shing thon las shig tu gtong bar med mi rung la rmang gzhi gnyom pa'i dbang gis 'khyongs kyang dka' ba zhig ni 'jon thang can gyi mi 'bor chen skyed sring dgos pa 'di red/ dper na/ mgron khang dang za khang dang chang khang dang rol rtse khang dang 'grem ston khang dang rang sa'i khyad chos — 45 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/ldan pa'i tshong brong thon skyed thad kyi bdag gnyer la mkhas pa'i mi 'bor chen zhig dgos pa dang / rlangs 'khor dang gru gzings dang gangs shud dang rkyal rtsal dang gnag g.yag rta drel sogs 'grim 'grul rol rtsed la mkhas pa'i mi 'jon thang can skyed sring sbyong brdar byed pa ni las rigs su ran pa'i ngal rtsol pa'i mthun rkyen gal che ba zhig red/ 'di ni phal cher khyim tshang ltar bdag gnyer byed bde ba'i dbang du yin/ des na da nas bzung khyim tshang res mi re las kar 'dzud tshod tsam longs dgos la/ rgyu mtshan ni phyis su khyim tshang dang grong ba'am ru skor dang sde ba gtsos pa'i shang ngam rdzong lta bu'i srid 'dzin mnga' khongs ltar lag bstar byed dgos te/ lag bstar byed stangs kyang lag len dngos la brgyud nas 'khyongs dgos pa zhig red/gnas skor gyi ngo bo nyid ni rang byung snod bcud dang sgra yangs 'jug gi rig gnas rnam mang can la brten pa'i las rigs shig ste/ rnam mang can ni rang sa'i khyad chos 'dzin la gzhan du longs spyod yong dkon pa'i rnam pa ldan pas gnas skor pa'i myong snang du rnam pa mang ba mngon/ des na gsham gsal gnas gsum la nges par blo sgrim dgos/dang po ni srol rgyun gyi rig gnas tshogs bsags skyong spel dang yul sde'i khyad tshos ldan pa'i rig gnas gsar spel te/ dper na/ glu gzhas dang zhabs bro dang zlos gzhas dang zlos gar dang 'cham/ras pa dang 'bras dkar dang rtsed rigs/ mgur sgrung dang srid pa 'ded pa dang lde'u skul/ g.yang 'bod dang bla 'bod dang bya 'bod/ sho dang sbag dang mig mangs/ thang ga dang 'bag bzhengs dang gtsags drub/ dpar shing dang bod shog dang gna' gshis dpar rtsal/ shing brkos dang rdo brkos dang / brag brkos/'thag chas dang sles chas dang mgar chas/ rta thog spo lo dang dar thog spo lo — 46 —

dpyadagatam/ da dang chur rtsed spo lo/ yul srol g.yos sbyor dang gzim khang brgyan bgro dang nyal chas 'dem bkol/ skra ston dang bag ston dang gya ston/ skyes skar dang 'das skar dang mdzad pa'i rjes dran dang dus ston/ mdor na ga'an du dkon zhing ltad mo bya yul du 'gyur bar rung ngo cog gi longs spyod sngog 'don dang bed spyod dang dar spel nus na/ gnas skor gyi nang don dang btsong byar 'gyur nges pa red/gnyis pa ni yul gru gzhan du btsal rgyu nyo rgyu med la/ bed spyod dang dran rten dang khyim gyi rgyan nor du 'gyur rung ba'i gnas skor tshong zong sbyor bzo byed pa ni de bas gal che/ gna' rabs su bod las thon zhing grags che ba'i seng ldeng ḍa ru be shing sga sde dge dri bu mi nyig gri/ spang rtsi rong gi shing chas dngo / rgyal rtse khog gi ra khul phrug ces pa nang bzhin/ deng gi dus la ran pa'i spus legs phul byung tshong zong sbyor bzo thad nas 'bad 'tshal ba red/gsum pa ni gnas skor gnyer skyong las yong sgo btsal ba tsam gyis ma zad par/ gnas skor gyis tshong dpon bkug yong bar brten/ yul sde gzhan du mthun rkyen 'dzoms dka' ba'i khyad ldan thon las gnyer bar brtson pa ni ma dngul 'bor chen 'gug nus shing / rang sa'i dpal 'byor de rtsa ba nas 'gyur ldog 'byung 'jug pa'i gnad dam pa yin pas de bas blo sgrim dgos/ dper na/ 'bri g.yag gi sha khrag rus rwa ko khul rtsid la sogs mu rgyud ldan pa'i sbyor bzo tshong gnyer thon las su 'gyur ba dang / bod 'u ga gi sha khrag rus rwa bal pags nang tshol la sogs mu rgyud ldan pa'i sbyor bzo tshong gnyer thon las su chags 'jug pa dang / mi'i thabs kyis gla ba gso ba dang gla rtsi len pa dang rtsi sman sbyor ba/ mi'i thabs kyis gong g.yag dang bya dbang — 47 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/(wang 'jug srol yod)dang nags 'tsho de pho gso ba dang sgro len pa dang sgro chas sbyor ba dang sman sbyor ba/ mi'i thabs kyis nyi nya(nya khye'u skad can yang zer)gso ba dang 'grem ston dang sman sbyor ba/ rgyud dag pa'i khyi la bo dang sha khyi dang ha khyig gsos nas khyi 'gran pa dang khyi dpyad pa dang gces zog tu btsong ba/ 'brong rgyud las 'brong tsha dang gnyan rgyud las gnyan tsha blangs nas 'grem ston dang rang sar 'phrod pa'i phyugs rgyud spel ba/ ser sha dang sa skra(sa bdag skra lud kyang zer)dang spang tshil(sbal snabs kyang zer)dang gro ma dang dbyar rtswa dang rdza yungs dang srin yungs dang mog ro sogs tshad zab pa'i sbyor bzo tshong gnyer byed pa lta bu mang ba red/ spyir gangs can yul gru'i sa gshis dang gnas gshis dbang du byung ba'i thon khungs khyad par can bed spyod par tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi 'du shes ldan tshe/ rkang ba'i bcags sar gter dang lag pas reg sar gser gyi dpe ltar 'gyur nges/ mdor na/ khor yug srung skyong ma lhod par/ 'jon thang ldan pa'i mi skyed sring byed pa de rig gnas tshogs bsags skyong spel dang spus legs phul byung tshong zong sbyor bzo dang khyad ldan thon las spel ba sogs brgyud nas ma lag chags tshe/ rang re'i yul sde dag tu ming don mtshungs pa'i gnas skor thon las 'phel yong la/ thon las 'dis thon skyed byed stangs dang 'tsho ba rol stangs kyi rting rim nas yul mi 'bum phrag longs pa bcings 'grol byed nges red/ (2004lo'i zla12pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)— 48 —

dpyadagatam/ da da ‘‘'bu’’brko ba'i skal ba thems stangs/khrims mthun lugs mthun dgos chul/so nam pa/dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brko rgyu yin na/ sang lo'i zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas bzung / mtsho sngon khongs yongs nas 'thog sgrug dpang yig 'thob dgos pa'i lam lugs lag bstar byed rgyu red/nye sngon〈mtsho sngon zhing chen dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu 'thog sgrug do dam thad kyi skabs thog lag bstar thabs bkod〉mngon par spel zhing / dbyar rtswa'i thon khungs lugs mthun sgos bed spyod dang srung skyong bya bar tshad ldan yong ba'i lugs yod song /〈thabs bkod〉nang nas blang bya bton pa ste/ dbyar rtswa'i thon khungs rgyal khrims kyis srung skyong byed pa yin la/ zhing chen dang yang na dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug yul gru'i khul dang rdzong gi zhing phyugs bdag 'dzin sde khag gis gnas tshul dngos la brten nas rim pa tha dad du dbyar rtswa'i thon khungs srung skyong 'char gzhi bsgrig dgos pa dang / dbyar rtswa'i thon khungs khyab gnas dang rgya khyon dang sgrug par ran pa'i yul khongs bcas gtan 'khel gsal bo yong dgos/ skye khams khor yug zhan pa'i rtswa thang la dbyar rtswa sgrug par bkag rgya bzhag nas 'thog sgrug 'gog thabs spyad dgos pa dang / rtswa sa'i bed spyod — 49 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dbang cha thad nas rtsod gleng du tshud pa'i sa khul yang bkag rgya bzhag sa dang 'dra mtshungs ltar byed dgos/ dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug yul gru'i rdzong rim pa'i zhing phyugs bdag 'dzin sde khag gis 'char bkod la gzhi brten par/ lo de'i dbyar rtswa'i thon khungs yongs bsher thon pa'i gzhi nas lo 'khor de'i 'thog sgrug 'char gzhi bzos te gtan 'khel byed dgos/ lo 'khor ltar bzos ba'i 'char gzhi nang du tshan rig sgos sam lugs mthun sgos dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug chog khongs dang 'thog sgrug rgya khyon dang 'thog skrug mi grangs dang 'thog sgrug dus bcad dang yang na bkag 'gog sa khul sogs gtan khel byas pa'i mnyam du spyi tshogs la khyab par bsgrag dgos/〈thabs bkod〉las gtan la phab pa ste/ dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug bya bar nges par 'thog sgrug dpang yig len dgos pa dang / 'thog sgrug dpang yig steng du dpang yig 'dzin pa po dang 'thog sgrug yul khongs dang go chod pa'i dus yun dang thon khungs srung skyong la sogs pa'i nang don tshang dgos pa yin/'thog sgrug dpang yig gnang grangs ni dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug gi lo 'khor 'char gzhi ji bzhin gtan khel byed dgos pa dang / 'thog sgrug yul gru'i rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung ngam des dbang gnang ba'i sde khag gam las khungs kyis spyi la gsal ba dang spyi la snyoms pa dang spyi la gzhungs pa bcas kyi rtsa don brtsi srung byas thog re zhu'i snga phyi ji bzhin zhib bsher brgyud nas gnang dgos la/ dpang yig dpar yon bsdu mi chog pa yin/ rtswa sa 'gan gtsang len byas yod pa'i mi la mtshon na/ rang nyid kyis 'gan gtsang len byas shing gnyer skyong byed bzhin pa'i yul khongs de'i nang / dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug bya bar sngon thems kyi dbang cha yod pa yin/〈thabs bkod〉las gsal ler bstan pa ste/ dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug mi — 50 —

dpyadagatam/ da da sna la rtswa thang gi skye khams khor yug dang rtswa thang skyong byed sgrig bkod rigs srung skyong byed pa'i 'os 'gan yod cing / rtswa thang gi sngo bklubs la gtor brlags btang ba'i tshul du gnas tshang phub mi chog pa yin/ tshom skyes glang spen sngog gcod dang spang shun rko ba dang rka gshag rgyu sogs mi chos cing ri skyes rtsi shing dkon gras dang rlung 'gog la bye ma 'dzin pa'i rtsi shing rko sngog mi chog pa dang / khrims ltar srung skyong byed bzhin pa'i ri skyes srog chags kyang 'dzin gsod mi chog pa yin/ gtan phab dang 'gal nas rtswa thang gi sngo bklubs la gtor brlags bzos mir dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug yul gru'i rdzong rim pa yan gyi rtswa thang skul gnyer las khungs kyis khrims ltar bkas skul btang nas sngo bklubs slar gso byed 'jug pa dang / yang na rtswa thang skul gnyer las khungs kyis kho'i tshab tu slar gso byed cing der dgos pa'i 'gro gron 'gan yod mi de rang nyid kyis 'khur dgos pa yin/'thog sgrug dpang yig ma thob pa'am gtan phab nang bzhin 'thog sgrug ma byas pa'i mi la〈thabs bkod〉nang du 'di ltar bton yod de/ dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug yul gru'i rdzong rim pa yan gyi zhing phyugs srid 'dzin bdag 'dzin sde khag gis khrims ltar khrims dang 'gal bar 'thog sgrug byas pa'i dbyar rtswa dang khrims 'gal yong 'bab gzhung bzhes byed pa'i mnyam du/ khrims 'gal yong 'bab kyi ldab bcu man gyi dngul chad gcod chog pa dang/ 'thog sgrug dpang yig yod pa'i mi yin na dpang yig de nus med du gsub chog pa yin/ 'thog sgrug dpang yig rdzus bzo dang log 'tshong dang ga'an thems btang mi la dbyar rtswa 'thog sgrug yul gru'i dpang yig gnang ba'i las khungs kyis khrims ltar 'thog sgrug dpang yig phyir sdud dang khrims 'gal yong 'bab gzhung bzhes byed pa'i mnyam du/ sgor khri lnga man gyi dngul chad gcod — 51 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/chog pa yin/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu 'thog sgrug yul gru'i mi dmangs srid gzhung ngam 'brel yod sde khag dang las khungs kyis khrims dang 'gal bar 'thog sgrug dpang yig gnang nas phyi 'bras ngan pa bzos pa la〈thabs bkod〉las 'di ltar bton yod de/ mngon sgron skyon rjod dang bkas skul ltar yo bsrang dang 'gan khur pa gtso bo'i srid 'dzin 'gan 'khri bsnyeg rgyu yin/ 'brel yod las byed mi snas bya log spyod log dang sger gnyer 'gan 'dzol byung yang nag nyes ma longs na khrims ltar srid 'dzin chad pa gcod chog la/ nag nyes su grub na khrims ltar nyes khrims 'gan 'khri bsnyeg rgyu yin tshul sogs kyang gsal bar nan ston thon yod/gong zhus tsam nas〈thabs bkod〉kyi rtsa gnad phal cher chad lhag med par rtogs thub nges red/ des na tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba la kha tsam min par snying thag pa nas dang len byed rgyu yin na/ gsham gsal don tshan du ma 'dug pa ni gleng rin med pa zhig min tshod lags/dang po/ khrims srol 'dzugs par brten nas thon khungs srung skyong byed pa ni bstud mar 'phel 'thus pa'i spyi gnad dang 'brel bcas shing kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur yod pa'i don chen zhig tu snang/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring/dbyar rtswa'i rin gong yang dang yang du je mthor song bas/ khe phan gyis bskul zhing ded par brten/ rtsa chen po dbyar rtswa'i thon khungs la gnod skyon chen po btang ba'i zhor du/ rtswa thang gi sngo bklubs dang de la rten pa'i srog chags la'ang gegs rkyen sna tshogs bzos byung bas/ 'di lta ba'i thabs bkod cig mi bzo thabs med kyi tshad du son yod/ da lta bca' khrims su nges pa'i thabs bkod 'di lag bstar byed nye ba bzang song ba dang/ 'di ni rang sa'i — 52 —

dpyadagatam/ da wanges pa can gyi khrims srol zhig yin pa'i cha nas bshad na/ khrims 'dzugs pa'i thad nas rang sa'i dpal 'byor gong spel la zhabs phyi byed pa'i rnga dpe zhig tu'ang brtsi rung/ 'on te gangs can yul nas ma gtogs mi skye ba'am gzhan du skye yang sman nus 'di gar skyes pa la mi do ba'i sman rtswa rtsa chen nga nung mang ste/ dper na rdza yungs dang srin yungs dang lcum rtsa sogs 'dzam gling yongs nas shin tu dkon/ lo mang po'i ring rko log spyod log byas pas/ da lta gangs can yul gru'i thon khungs kyang 'dzad par nye ba'i nyen kha 'byung 'dugaspyir rang re'i rgyal khab mnga' khongs kyi grangs nyung mi rigs rang skyong sa char srid 'dzin mnga' khongs gzhan las khyad par can gyi dbang cha zhig yod pa ni/ rang sa'i mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyis rang sar 'tsham pa'i khrims 'dzugs chog pa 'di lags/ dbang cha 'di mtsho sngon khongs nas da snga da rung bed spyod byung tshul mi 'dang ba red/ de yang krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab tshugs tshun gyi dus yun mi thung ba'i nang/ bar chad 'dra min sna tshogs kyi dbang du spyi tshogs ring luṭa lam lugs steng du bca' khrims bzhengs 'dzugs bya ba de 'phyi 'gyangs shor ba dang/ sngon du rang sa rang yul nas byung ba'i yul khrims dag bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi gzhi nas byung ba yin par ngos bzung zhing/ gral rim 'thab rtsod thal che ba'i g.yon lhung spyi tshogs khor yug de 'dra nang/ spyi tshogs lam lugs gang dang gang du'ang mi'i spyi tshogs dang rang byung khams kyi 'brel bar gzhigs pa'i khrimasasrol nang don yod sha stag yin pa'i cha 'dir mthong chung shor ba dang/khrims lugs ni gral rim 'thab rtsod las thon pa yin snyam pa'i don dngos las thal che la skyon 'dres pa'i 'du shes 'di mkhregs 'dzin byas pa red rgyu — 53 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mtshan 'di dag dbang gis thon khungs srung skyong dang lugs mthun sgos bed spyod pa'i thad 'dir bca' khrisam kyi stong cha mang tsam gnas shing/ 'di la ngos 'dzin yag po yong thog rdzong rim pa yan nas thon khungs srung skyong skor gyi rang sa'i khrims srol 'dzugs par do snang byed pa dang/ shang rim pa man gyis lag len nyams myong gzhir bzung nas mkho che ba'i yul srol dmangs 'cham 'jog par gtsigs 'dzin byed pa dang/ 'brel yod mkhas pa dang srid jus zhib 'jug tshan khag gis lo rgyus ring mo'i mthong khyon dang 'dzam gling yongs kyi mthong khyon nas gna' bzang deng spyod dang snyigs 'dor bcud len gyi byed phyogs ji bzhin rang sa'i khrims 'dzugs las don la zhabs phyi thon na/ dbyar rtswa tsam gyis ma tshad par rtsa che ba'i thon khungs kun gyi srung skyong la 'tsham pa'i khrims srol cha tshang ba 'dzugs pa'i las 'gan 'di rim bzhin 'grub yong nges red/gnyis pa/ khrims lugs slob sbyong dang bed spyod yag po yong rgyu ni dmangs spyi'i 'phral phug gnyis kyi khe phan srung skyong byed pa'i don chen zhig tu snang/ 〈thabs bkod〉nyid la bltas pa tsam gyis dbyar rtswa dgun 'bur dmigs yod kying/ don du rgyal khab kyis bzos shing gtan la phab pa'i〈rtswa thang bca' khrims〉dang〈ri skyes srog chags srung skyong bca' khrims〉sogs lag bstar byas mur byung ba yin phyir/ de dag la gzhi brten yod pa dang rang sa'i gnas tshul la de bas 'tsham pa zhig kyang red/ des na spyi don dmangs don bsam pa dang rang don sger don de mthar gtug na spyi don dmangs don la phugs bcol yod pa rtogs pa'i mi zhig yin pa na/ 〈thabs bkod〉la go ba bzang po chags 'jug pa dang/ de'i ched du da nung 'brel yod bca' khrims gzhan dag rgyus lon pa la'ang gtsigs 'dzin byed par — 54 —

dpyadagatam/ da wabargyud/ khrims srol la dpa' dang blo brten nas rang gzhan 'phral phusas kyi khe phan srung skyong byed par mkhas pa zhig yong rgyu gal shin tu che snyam/ nga tshos rgyun du mthong thub pa ltar/ la la zhig gis mig mdun gyi khe phan chung ngu tsam gyis blo bslus pa mi tshor bar sde dmangs kyi khe phan che shos de dang brje ba red/la la zhig gis ngo shes pa'i kha ngo tsam la bltas nas gang cis khe phan 'thob ched khrims 'gal lugs 'gal tshul du khor yug la gtor brlags btang yang/ ma shes ma go'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa dang yang na gsang 'gebs byed pa dang/ tha na rang yang las der kha the nas khyi rkun 'o zangs kha nas mthun pa'i ngang tshul thon pa red/ khrims 'gal nag nyes can la srung 'gebs byas na rang la'ang srung 'gebs kyi nag nyes 'khor yong bar go rtogs mi ldan pa red/de yang/ sman rtswa 'thu bar kha g.yar ba'i khram pa dag gis rta brkus nor ded lta bu'i gyod don bzos tshe/ sdug la skyo la zhes smre sngags bgrang ba tsam las/dpa' dang blo sgo khrims srol la brten nas rgyu 'bras rkyen gsum la dpyad cing khrims spyad nas rang gi khe phan srung skyong mi nus pa'i tshod du gnas/ 'di dang 'di bzhin rang byung khor yug la gtor brlag byed pa dang spyi tshogs khor yag la gtor b.rag byed pa gnyis kyi bar na rnam dbye zhig mi 'dug nga red/༄༄ 9pa/des na rang gis lcogs tshod kyis khrims lugs la slob sbyong byed pa'i mnyam du/khrims lugs rogs skyor 'thob pa'i 'jug rim dang/ gzu mkhan beng spyod pa'i 'gro lugs/ khrims lugs rgyus smed kyi cha rkyen bed spyod tshul sosas la nges par dgos pa'i shes bya'am nyams myong tsam ldan par kun gyis mthong chung mi rung ba zhig tu snang /gsum pa/ sa cha so sor khrims bstar sde tshan dang dpung khag 'dzugs rgyu ni lhod mi nung ba'i gnad ka zhig tu snang/ rten sa khrims yodze+e pa 5spyang rjong

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/nyid khrims la cha rgyus yod pa/ 'di ni gal che la yun ring du bsten dgos pa zhig ste 〈thabs bkod〉lta bu gsar du gtan la phab pa'i khrims srol zhig gi cha nas bshad na/ lag bstar byed nye la gra sgrig thad nas da rung mi 'dang ba dang lag bstar byed pa'i dka' khag mi nyung ba yod srid pas/ da nas bzung ste gnad 'gag dag la blo sgrim 'tshal/ gang zhe na/ dgun khom gyi dus 'di spyad nas dus thung ba'i sbyong grwa ci lcogs kyis bsdus te dar gzhon gtso ba'i sde dmangs la khrims lugs thad nas gso sbyong 'thob 'jug pa dang/ rdzong dang shang rim pa'i rtswa thang skul gnyer las khungs sam dpung khag med pa la gsar 'dzugs dang yod pa la zab sbyong hrag sgrig byed pa dang/ rang sa'i dbyar rtswa'i thon khungs la yongs bsher byed rgyu dang sang lo 'thog sgrug dpang yig ga tshod gtong 'os pa'i 'char gzhi sgrig par gra sgrig byed dgos pa yin/(2004 lo'i zla12 pa'i tshes14 nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)gtsang po 'byung yul gyi las dbang/ 'brog dmangs 'byung 'gyur gyi mdun lam/so nam pa/spyi'i rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma sum 'bum lhag yod pa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs kyi gtsang po gsum gyi 'byung yul ni 'dzam gling spyi la grags che ba'i — 56 —

dpyadagatam/ da gtsang po rma 'bri rdza gsum mngal du sbrum sa yin la/ rang re'i rgyal khab kyi gangs ri dang mtshe'u dang na 'dam dang chu mgo sogs mang po yod pa'i ches che ba'i brlan 'dzin sa cha zhig kyang yin/ nye ba'i lo ngo bcu phrag lhag ring/yul gru der phyugs zog mang bas rtswa sa'i theg tshod las yol drags pa dang/thon khungs tshad las yol drags par bed spyod byas pas/ rtswa thang 'ums dmas su 'gyur ba dang spang sha nags tshal bye sag tu 'gyur ba dang gangs kyi chags mtshams yar bshol dang 'khyags klung chen po 'ju ba dang brlan sa chung du 'gyur ba sogs skye khams khor yug ngan 'gyur 'byung tshul tshabs che bar snang/ de ga'i skye dngos rnam mang can gyi ma lag srung skyong dang 'brog dmangs 'byor 'bring phyogs su 'phel bar bgrod lam dog pa'i gnas tshul rtsa ba nas bsgyur ched/ mtsho sngon zhing chen gyis gtsang bo rma 'bri rdza gsum 'byung yul nas phyugs bshol rtswa skyong bzo 'god spel 'go tshugs pa dang/'char gzhi ltar na lo ngo lnga tsam gyi dus mun spyad nas sa mu'u dung phyur phyed gnyis longs khongs nas phyugs bshol rtswa skyong bya rtsis yod/ gtsang po 'byung yul gyi khor yug srung skyong bya ba'i gzhi rtsa'i gzhigs lam la gnad ka gnyis 'dug ste/ dang po ni grong rdal du 'gyur ba'i gom stabs dang grong rdal chung gras kyi 'phel rgyas je mgyogs su gtong ba dang/ 'brog pa skor 'ig 'brog sa nas phyi la 'bud cing gzhis spo bar 'khrid 'dren bya ba dang/ kho tsho thon las gzhan pa gnyer bcug par brten/ rtsa ba nas rtswa sa'i khag khur zhi lhod du gtong rgyu dang 'brog pa 'byor 'bring du 'phel lam dog pa'i gnad 'gag bsal ba/ gnyis pa ni‘‘rtswa sa'i tshod kyis phyugs grangs gtan 'bebs dang/rtswa sa dang phyugs grangs do mnyam yong ba'i’’rtsa don la brten thog yul gru de gar sngar bzhin 'tsho ba rol ba'i 'brog dud kyis phyugs grangs nyung dbri dang/— 57 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/rtswa sas phyugs zog sos tshod nang bzhin nan 'jun bya rgyu red/ 2003 lo'i zla8 pa'i nang zhing chen srid gzhung gis thag bcad pa ste/gtsang bo 'byung yul nas 'brog sa bskyur nas rang 'dod ngang grong rdal du gzhis spar te gtan chags yong ched/ 'brog sde bub tu spo ba dang thar thor du spo ba dang spos zin zhing khyim gzhis btsugs tshar yod pa bcas gnas tshul sna gsum la so sor 'tsham pa'i rgyab skyor srid jus gtan khel byas/ 'brog sde bub tu spo ba ni ji srid du phyugs 'tsho rgyu gtan 'gog dang/ rgyal khab kyis dud tshang rer khyim gzhis 'dzugs pa'i gron dngul sgor khri8 dang/ gzan rtswa gzan chag thad kyi skong rogs dron dngul lo rer sgor8000 dang/ bstud mur lo lnga ring skong rogs bya rgyu red/thar thor ngang spo ba'i dud tshang dag gzhis spor skabs so sor sgor khri tsho4 re'i gzhis 'dzugs gron dngul yod pa dang/ lo rer gzan rtswa gzan chag thad kyi skong rogs gron dngul sgor6000'thob rgyu yod pa dang/ lo ngo bcu'i ring mtsher sa der phyugs 'tsho rgyu dgagaspos zin pa'i dud tshang zhes pa ni srid jus 'di mngon bton sngon du snga 'phro phyi 'brangs ngang 'brog sa dang bral nas grong rdal du gzhis spar ba'i dud tshang la go ba yin zhing/ khyim gzhis btsugs par skong rogs gron dngul sgor khri2dang/ lo rer gzan rtswa gzan chag thad kyi skong rogs gron dngul3000'thob rgyu yod/ sngon mus su rang rang gi mtsher sa rtswa sar bsdad pa'i dud tshang rer 'dzug skrun sgron dngul sgor khri2 re ster rgyu yod cing/ rtswa sar lcags dra dang phyugs khang bskrun chog 'on te rtswa sa'i theg tshod las yol ba'i phyugs grangs nyung dbri dgos pa yin/srid jus 'di lag bstar byas pa nas bzung/ 2004 lo'i zla11 pa'i bar/ dud tshang7366 dang 'brog pa33567 longs tshod nyams dmas su — 58 —

dpyadagatam/ r+had 'gyur tshabs che ba'i gtsang po 'byung yul nas phyi la spar ba dang/ rtswa sa mu'u1706tsam la rtswa bkag phyugs bshol mngon 'gyur byung ba dang/ phyugs zog ci rigs lug gi thob gnas ltar brtsis na/ 89155longs tshod nyung du phri ba mngon 'gyur byung zin/ gzhan du'ang grong rdal chung gras kyi 'dzugs skrun dang 'phel rgyas la stobs dang ldan pa'i srid jus kyis skul ma thebs pas/mgo log khul gyi dar lag dang dga' bde dang rma stod/ yul shul khul gyi rdza stod dang 'bri stod dang chu dmar dang yul shul/ rma lho khul gyi rtse khog dang hi nan sogs rdzong khag khongs las gzhan/ gdang la 'dabs kyi sa cha bcas su grong rdal chung gras gsar du chags pa dang sngon yod rgya bskyed byung ba red/'di dang mnyam du lam dang glog dang rang 'bab chu sogs thad kyi 'dzugs skrun stabs bde la grub 'bras bzang bar gyur cing/ 'brog dmangs kyi 'phrod bsten sman bcos dang rmang gzhi'i slob gso dang rig gnas 'tsho ba sogs kyang gzhi khyon ldan la spus dag 'khyongs pa'i lam sne brnyed song bas/gzhis gsar nang du bde zhing skyid par 'tsho ba rol 'go tshugs pa'i 'brog pa phal mo che ba'i 'dzum mdangs dang spobs pa rgyas ba'i nyams las kyang kho tshos srid jus 'di la lta tshul ji 'dra bzung yod pa shes 'dugasnga lo'i rmang gzhi steng da lo'i 'char gzhi ltar na/ rma 'bri rdza gsum 'byung yul nas rtswa sa mu'u khri tsho1000 longs khongs la phyugs dgag rgyu dang/mu'u khri tsho200 longs khongs la dus yun nges can nang rtswa kha slar gso bya rgyu dang/ gnas gzhan du mi 'bor11000longs tshod gzhis spo rgyu red/ gtsang bo 'byung yul gyi skye khams ma lag srung skyong dang de ga'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas bar gyi 'gal ba sdum thabs ched du srid jus 'di 'dra zhig lag bstar byas pa ni bstud mur 'phel 'thus pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba'am tshan rig dang mthun — 59 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba lag len dngos 'bebs byed pa'i ma dpe zhig tu 'dod chog cing/ 'chor mi rung la lo rgyus su nges 'gyur ba'i go skabs gal chen zhig kyang red/ gtsang bo 'byung yul gyi ma 'ongs pa'i las dbang ci zhig yin pa dang/ de ga'i 'brog dmangs kyi ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam ci zhig yin pa'i gnad 'gag zin yod pa'i srid jus 'di la go ba bzang bo len pa dang lag len mthar phyin 'khyongs pa'i sems thag kyang chod dgos pa yin/de yang/ spyi tshogs kyi sgyur 'god gang dang gang yin yang ma lag dang ldan pa'i bzo 'god chen po zhig yin pas/ gtsang bo 'byung yul gyi phyugs bshol rtswa skyong ngam brlan sa srung skyong dang grong rdal chung gras kyi 'dzugs skrun brgyud rim nang/ gzhis spo ba ni 'go bzung ba tsam las mtha' chod par da rung las 'gan ha cang ljid/ 'brog thang gi phyugs las de zhor du ra ba nas gso ba'i phyugs las su bsgyur bar ngal rtsol pa'i spus mtshag la sngon bas mtho ba'i blang bya yod pa ma zad/ grong rdal du 'tsho ba rol na 'brog thang gi phyugs las nas zhabs phyi las rigs su bsgyur ba'i dbang gis thon skyed byed stangs sam thon las rnam pa'i thad nas ba sgyur ba zhig yin pas/ ngal rtsol pa'i spus mtshag thad bton pa'i blang bya de bas mtho ba red/ des na sde ba rim pas dma' rim slob chung spus dag par skyong ba dang/ shang rim pas cha tshang slob chung spus dag par skyong ba/ rdzong rim pas dma' rim slob 'bring spus dag par skyong ba/ khul rim pas cha tshang slob 'bring dang bzo rtsal slob grwa spus dag par skyong ba la sngon bas gtsigs 'dzin byed pa gal che ba ma zad/grong rdal chung 'bring kun nas brnyan 'phrin dang tshags par dang dus deb dang dpe cha dang glog klad sogs spyod bde ba'i rig gnas khor yug yag po zhig bskrun rgyu dang/ rig gnas dang lag rtsal sbyong bde ba'i cha rkyen bskrun — 60 —

dpyadagatam/ da wa nas dar ma rnams kyang 'jon thang can du 'gyur bar sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa rab dang rim pa spel rgyu'ang shun tu gal che/ 'di lta bu'i mthun rkyen ma ldan na/ mi ni phyugs la brten pa dang phyugs ni rtswa la brten pa'i thon skyed byed stangs nas mi ni lag rtsal la brten pa dang lag rtsal ni mu mthud pa'i slob sbyong la brten pa'i thon las gnyer stangs su 'gyur ba'i brgyud rim nang der phyin log 'gal rkyen shin tu mang ba red/ de 'dra'i dbang gis srid gzhung dang mgo khrid las byed pa tsam gyis ma tshad par/ gtsang bo 'byung yul gyi las dbang dmangs la'ang rag las pa dang/ 'brog dmangs kyi mdun lam rang rang la'ang rag las pa'i 'du shes chags thog dpa' ngar dang bcas par dpal 'byor thad kyi bcings 'grol lan gsar ba zhig 'thob par brtson pa skyed cig gu /(2005 lo'i zla1 pa'i tshes1 nyin gyi par ngos gcig par gsal/)

'phrin gsar/mtsho sngon zhing chen skabs dang po'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom chogs 'du chab cha nas bsdus pa/rdo rje rin chen/ krung go'i rtsom pa po mthun tshogs mtsho sngon yan lag tshogs pa dang bod yig dus deb〈sbrang char〉rtsom sgrig pu'u〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉rtsom sgrig pu'u bcas kyis mnyam du bsdus pa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi skabs dang po'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom tshogs 'du de nye char mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi lte gnas chab cha grong brdal du gzab rgyas ngang bsdus shing /rang re'i zhing chen gyi khul dang tis/ rdzong so so'i bod kyi rtsom rig bya ba byed mkhan dang dpe skrun rgyang bsgrags bcas sde khag gi 'gan khur blo mthun sogs mi brgyad cu lhag tshogs 'dur zhugs yod/zhing chen tang u'i rgyun las u yon nam zhing chen tang u'i dril bsgrags pu'u'i pu'u krang khrin yun h+phin dang zhing chen tang u'i dril bsgrags pu'u'i pu'u krang gzhon pa'am zhing chen rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lhan tshogs kyi kru'u zhi skal bzang rdo rje bcas dang / ched du gdan drangs pa ltar tshogs 'dur phebs pa'i kan su'u zhing chen rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lhan tshogs dmangs khrod rtsom — 62 —

'phrinagasar/ da wa rig zhib 'jug khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'am ming du grags pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan yi dam tshe ring / nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i ca'o hrig gzhon pa dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chem mo'i zhib 'jug mkhan nam bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po don grub dbang 'bum sogs dang / mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul tang u dang khul mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang/ khul srid gros/ khul srid gzhung bcas kyi mgo khrid blo mthun rnams tshogs 'dur zhugs yod/ tshogs 'du'i skabs su mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul tang u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa'am khul dpon blo mthun pad mas dga' bsu'i zhu tshig phul ba dang blo mthun skal bzang rdo rjes zhing chen tang u'i dril bsgrags pu'u zhing chen rtsom rig sgyu rtsal lhan tshogs/ zhing chen grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig gsar rtsom u yon lhan khang bcas kyi tshab byas nas gtam bshad/khos bshad don/ bod rigs ni lo rgyus yun ring ba'i mi rigs zhig yin zhing / rang re'i spyi tshogs ring lugs mes rgyal khyim chen nang gi khyim mi gtso bo zhig red/ lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring la/ las la brtson 'ing dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bod mi dmangs kyis rang nyid kyi shes rab dang blo gros la brten nas gzi dpal gyis snang ba 'dzin mar khyab pa'i rig gnas gsar skrun mdzad de/ krung hwa mi rigs kyis rig gnas bang mdzod nang gi grub cha khyad par can du gyur/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun du/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang rig rtsal srid jus lag len mthil phyin dang dngos 'bebs dang bstun nas/ rang re'i 'ing chen gyi bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad dbyar mtsho rgyas pa lta bu'i dge mtshan byung ste/— 63 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom mi sna ni char rjes kyi smyug gsar bzhin 'tshar longs 'byung bzhin yod/bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan yi dam tshe ring gis bshad don/ khrang pe ri bo'i rgya stag dmar pos nga ro sgrog cing / nang sog spang ljongs kyi rta mchog gis bang rtsal ngoms pa dang / rang re'i gangs can bsil mo ljongs kyi gangs seng dkar mos kyang gnam sa g.yo ba'i ngar sgra sgrog 'go brtsams byung /blo mthun khrin yun h+phin kyis mtsho sngon zhing chen tang u'i tshab byas nas tshogs chen la rten 'brel zhus par ma zad/ da dung khos‘‘bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom tshogs 'du ched du bsdus pa ni rang zhing la mtshon na thengs dang po red/ reb 'di'i tshogs 'du ni rang zhing gi bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed pa'i thad nyams myong spel res dang gros bsdur skul 'ded gtong ba bcas kyi tshogs 'du zhig red/ gros tshogs nas sngar las lhag bzang gi sgo nas deng skabs kyi bcos sgyur dang sgo 'byed pa'i gnas tshul gsar ba'i 'og tu/ rang rtogs sgos deng rabs kyi 'du shes la brten nas 'tsho ba'i nyams myong len pa dang / phyogs so'i thad nas bod mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i nyams 'gyur mtshon pa byas te/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang dus rabs kyi snying stobs ldan pa'i brtsams chos sngar bas mang ba zhig gsar tu brtsams te/ mtsho sngon gsar gtod dang 'dzugs skrun/ rang re'i zhing chen gyi bod kyi rtsom rig las don 'phel rgyas su gtong bar byas rjes 'jog dgos’’zhes pa'i gtam bshad gnang /(1986lo'i zla9ba'i tshes20nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal/)— 64 —

'phrinagasar/ r+ha—bod skor sde bas zhing las 'phrul chas can du gom pa dang po spos te/sa zhing gi gzhi rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun rgya cher spel nas grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs pa/gsar 'god pa/ sha bo tshe ring /thun rin rdzong tho rgya shang bod skor sde bas zhing sde'i bcos bsgyur gting zab tu gtong ba dang zhing las 'phrul chas can du bsgyur nas tshan rig gis zhing las gong du spel bar/ nye ba'i lo gnyis kyi nang du sa zhing bi ga'i rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun rgya cher spel bas/ da yod kyi zhing las 'phrul chas bed spyod tshad dang tshan rig gis zhing 'debs pa'i chu tshad mthor 'degs che tsam byung bas/ngal rtsol nus shugs bcings 'grol byed par nus pa chen po bskyed cing /dpal 'byor gyi phan 'bras dang spyi tshogs kyi phan 'bras mngon gsal thob/bod skor sde ba ni mi grangs lnga brgya tsam dang sa zhing mus bdun brgya dang bzhi bcu yod pa'i chu ma sa khul zhig red/ sa 'di'i sa gshis gshin po yin pas sde ba 'di gtso bo zhing las la brten nas 'tsho bzhin 'dug yin na'ang 'debs rgya cung chung zhing ha cang mi snyom par them rim mang ba'i sa khul zhig yin pas/ zhing las 'phrul chas dang sngon thon gyi tshan rig lag rtsal bkol nas zhing las 'phel bar bkag rkyen du gyur 'dug 1982lor sa 'ing khyim da 6ze ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshang gis 'gan gtsang len byas rjes mus re'i thon tshad rgya ma bdun brgya dang drug cur zin nas lo rgyus kyi ches mtho'i thon tshad bskrun mod/ 'on kyang /de'i rjes kyi lo 'gar zhing las thad ngal rtsol nus shugs mang snon byed pa kho nar brten pas/ mu'u re'i thon tshad rgya ma drug brgya dang lnga bcu yas mas su sor gnas tsam yin/ gnas tshul 'dir gzhigs nas1987lor sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci sangs rgyas dang sde dpon khyi gu thar gnyis kyis gros bsdur dang mang tshogs kyi bsam 'char sdud len byas pa brgyud de shang srid gzhung la sa zhing bde snyom bya rgyu'i re ba zhu ba'i zhu yig phul/ kho tsho'i re 'dun de shang tang u dang srid gzhung gis gtsigs su bzung ba dang / rdzong srid gzhung gis shugs chen pos rgyab rogs byas 'og tho kya shang gis 'char gzhi ldan pa'i sgo nas sa zhing bde snyom bya rgyur gcig gyur sgos bkod sgrig byas/ yin na'ang lo mang por gsos pa'i sa bcud de gting 'brad byas na lo du mar 'bru rigs thon tshad la gnod nges dang / gzhan yang gcig gyur sgos bde snyom byas pa'i rjes su sa zhing phyir khyim tshang re rer bgo dgos pa dang der yang zhing tshigs las pa dang chu rka brko ba sogs las tshegs che bar skrag ste sde ba gzhan dag gis yi rang dang dang len mi byed pa dang / sde ba 'di'i mang tshogs nyung shas shig la'ang bsam tshul de 'dra byung / shang dang sde ba'i mgo khrid blo mthun gyis gnas tshul 'dir gzhigs nas bsam blo'i slob gso spel ba dang / spyi tshogs la zhing las thon rdzas kyi mkho ba mu mthud nas je cher gyur cing / tshan rig lag rtsal gong du 'phel ba dang de bed spyod byed par bstun/ zhing las de rags las tsam nas zhib las kyi phyogs su spel dgos shing / de ltar byas na da gzod sa zhing gi tshad yod pa dang spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho nyin re bzhin 'phar ba'i bar gyi 'gal ba thag gcod thub pa'i chos nyid sogs mang tshogs — 66 —

'phrinagasar/ da wal gsal bshad gang legs byas nas bsam blo gcig gyur byas/ nge'i rjes su mang tshogs kyis sa zhing bde snyom byed pa dga' spro'i ngang dang len byas par ma zad/ mang tsam bde snyom bya rgyu'i re ba kun nas bton pas sa zhing bde snyim byed 'go brtsams/1988lo dang1989lo gnyis su rgyal khab kyi sa zhing mus rer ma dngul sgor chig brgya rtsa dgu re dang mang tshogs kyis ngal rtsol nyin grangs nyi shu re dang ma dngul 'os 'tsham re btang ste/ ston mjug gi zla gnyis re'i ring du 'phrul chas dang mang tshogs tshang mas mnyam rub dmag 'thab byas pa brgyud de bsdoms pas sa zhing mus drug brgya lnga bcu bde snyom byas shing / der spyi'i rmo zhing gi brgya cha'i brgyad cu yan zin pas/ zhing las 'phrul chas can du bsgyur pa dang tshan rig gis zhing las gong du spel bar rmang gzhi bzang po 'ig btings/ der brten/ khul dang rdzong gi 'brel yod mgo khrid pas las yul dngos su phyin te grub 'bras la gdeng 'jog chen pos gzengs bstod byas par ma zad/ da lo'i zla dang por rdzong gis bod skor sde ba ni sa zhing bde snyom byed pa'i sngon thon sde bar bdams nas bya dga' ang dang po gnang ste rdzong yongs kyi dpe mtshon byas/ de dang bstun nas tshan rig gis las gnyer dang bdag skyong byed thabs dar spel dang / lud dang lud rdzas mang snon bcas kyi bya bar shugs bsnan phyir/ 1989lor thon 'phri ma byung ba ma zad/ lo gnyis sngon gyi1987lo'i mus re'i cha snyoms thon tshad las brgya cha'i bcu gsum dang grangs chung dgu 'phar stabs/ mang tshogs kyi brtson sems lhag par bskul/zhing las 'phrul chas can du sgyur ba dang tshan rig gis 'ing las spel ba'i thad la sde ba'i mgo khrid pa dang mang tshogs la bsam blo'i ngos zin nges can zhig yod pas/ snga gzhug tu rlangs 'khor gnyis dang 'drud 'then — 67 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'khor lo lnga/ lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo nyer gnyis/ rol 'debs 'phrul chas lnga/ g.yul gcog 'phrul chas bco lnga/ 'bru 'phyar 'phrul chas lnga sogs nyos yod par bstun/ zhing las 'phrul chas kyi rmang gzhi nges can zhig 'dzoms yod/ da lo'i dpyid 'debs skabs su da yod kyi zhing 'debs 'phrul chas steng shang srid gzhung gis rol 'debs 'phrul chas bcu bkod sgrig byas nas 'phrul chas kyis rol 'debs byas tshad brgya cha'i go lngar slebs khar/ sngon chad zhing 'debs par nyin bco lnga nas zla gcig gi dus yun dgos pa de da lor khyim tshang gcig gis nyin phyed gnyis dang yang na nyin gnyis kyis sa zhing yongs su btab zin/ de ni lo rgyus steng gi myur tshad ches mgyogs pa'i lo zhig red/(1990lo'i zla4tshes18nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)— 68 —

'phrin gsar/mi rabs rjes mar bde skyid bskrun/ sa gzhi chen mon gos ljang bzo yul shul khul du 'bri chu 'bab rgyud kyi nags skrun 'gog skyong ar las kyi las 'go chugs pa/ —gsar 'god pa/ tshe mgon/rgyal khab kyi 'bri chu 'bab rgyud kyi nags skrun 'gog skyong ar las kyi ches stod phyogs su gnas pa'i yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul gyis sdong 'dzugs nags skrun gyi las 'go btsugs/'bri chu'i stod dang bar rgyud kyi nags skrun 'gog skyong ma lag ni rgyal khabakyis‘‘byang gsum nags skrun 'gog skyong ar las’’kyi rjes mthud nas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i nags las babro skrun chen mo zhig kyang yin/ nags skrun 'gog skyong gi ma lag de'i nang du zhing chen dgu'i rdzong khag brgya dang zhe bdun 'dus yod/ rang zhing du mgo log khul gyi pad+ma rdzong dang yul shul khul gyi yul shul rdzong dang khri 'du rdzong bcas 'dzugs skrun ma lag de'i nang du zhugs yod/da lo ni 'bri chu'i stod dang bar rgyud kyi nags skrun 'gog skyong ma lag ar las dngos su lag bstar byed pa'i thog ma'i lo red/ zla bzhi ba'i zla dkyil nas bzung rim pa so so'i mgo khrid kyis mthong chen byas pa dang mang — 69 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshogs rnams skul slong byas pas/ khul yongs kyi las byed pa dang bzo pa/zhing 'brog mang tshogs/ dmag dpung / drag chas nyen rtog pa/ slob ma/dgon pa'i grwa ba/ sger tshong ba sogs mi khri tsho gcig lhag nags skrun du zhugs nas/las nyin khri tsho300lhag bkol te mis bzos nags sa mus4700lhag bskrun/ ri bkag nags srung mus khri tsho70lhag lag bstar byas zin pa/ sdong bo che chung khri tsho200btsugs/ lcags dra'i ra ba mus khri tsho6lhag bskor/ mus150yi sa ru sdong myug btsugs/ da dung skye rgu grong rdal nas 'bri chu'i zam pa'i bar gyi gzhung lam spyi le brgyad kyi 'gram gnyis su sdong bo4000lhag btsugs/mtsho ngos las mtho tshad mus3800yan du gnas pa'i khri 'du rdzong ni ar las 'di'i ches yar stod du gnas pa'i rdzong zhig yin/ rdzong 'dis‘‘lo dang por rmang gzhi 'ding ba dang / lo gnyis par thog ma'i gzhi khyon ldan pa/lo gsum par sa stong yongs su sdong bo 'dzugs pa/ lo bzhi bar sdong myug 'dzugs skyong bya ba/ lo lnga bar rdzong mkhar yongs su sngo ljang du bsgyur ba'i’’skul ma bton te zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer dgu nyin nas zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi bar rdzong yongs kyi las rigs khag gi mi sna1600lhag skul slong byas nas sdong bo mus1200lhag tu btsugs/ ri bkag nags gso mus khri tsho30lhag dang /'gram bzhi'i sdong 'dzugs khri tsho2btsugs pa dang lcags dra'i ra ba mus khri tsho3bskor/ sdong myug khri tsho30btsugs/ sdong shing sna tshogs khri tsho50lhag btsugs/khul dang rdzong dang shang rim pa so so'i nags las bdag 'dzin las khungs dang byed sgo las khungs kyis nags skrun ar las kyi spus ka gtsigs su bzung / dus mnyam du phyags las sa khul du nor lug mang ba'i gnas tshul — 70 — ༄

'phrinagasar/ da waltar/ sdong bo btsugs te sa gang du thon tshe lcags dra ra ba sa der 'then nas thon pa dang / bdag gnyer mi sna myur du sa der dngos 'bebs byas/ khul yongs su 'bri chu'i 'gog skyong nags skrun bdag gnyer mkhan60lhag yod/kho tsho la nags srung dpang yig byin nas gcig mthun gyi dpang rtags btegs te nyin mtshan bar med du sdong 'dzugs nags skrun gyi do dam spus ka khag theg byas pa red/(1991lo'i zla6pa'i tshes2nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)rma d+dha khul mi rigs glu gar tshogs pas/mi rigs kyi khrad du 'phags pa'i rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum thad grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs yod/gsar 'god pa/ dpal chen rgyal/rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul mi rigs glu gar tshogs pas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gnyis kyi 'dzugs spel la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i kha phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ mi rigs kyi phul du byung ba'i rig gnas gong spel dang gzhi rim gyi rig gnas 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs par gtong ba/ mi rigs so so'i mang tshogs kyi sgyu rtsal thad kyi dgos 'dod skong thabs byed pa de rang nyid kyi las 'gan bla na med par brtsis nas grub 'bras mang po blangs — 71 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/pas/ thengs mang por rgyal yongs dang zhing chen yongs kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal bya ba'i sngon thon thun mong du bdams shing / da lo'i zla10bar glu gar tshogs pa der yang‘‘rgyal yongs rig gnas bya ba'i sngon thon thun mong’’ zhes pa'i mtshan snyan gnang ste/ rig gnas pu'u dang mi don pu'u yi gzengs bstod dang bya dga' thob/rma lho khul mi rigs glu gar tshogs pa de 1965lor btsugs pa yin/skabs der 'khrab ston gyi cha rkyen ha cang zhan pa'i gnas tshul 'og tu/ mi bcu drug tsam las med pa'i rig gnas las byed ru khag des dka' khag sna tshogs khyad du bsad de/ 'grim 'grul mi bde ba'i rong 'brog phyogs su song nas dus rabs gsar ba'i nyams 'gyur dang ldan pa'i glu gar gyi rtsed mo lta mkhan tsho'i mig gi dga' ston du phul/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun du/ 'khrab ston dpung sde je cher song ba dang bstun nas/ glu gar tshogs pa des mi rigs kyi nyams 'gyur mtshon thub pa dang mtho sgang gi mi rigs kyi nyams 'gyur mtshon thub pa dang /mtho sgang gi mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba gsar bar bstod bsngags byed pa'i rig rtsal rtsed mo gsar rtsom dang 'khrab ston byed par gtsigs 'dzin byas pas/ mi rigs dang sa gnas kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig rtsal las don gong du spel ba'i thad gom pa gsar ba zhig mdun du spos pa red/1980lor/ glu gar tshogs pa des zhib 'jug nan tan byas thogasems thag gtsang bcad kyis mi lo nyi shu lhag la bkag sdom byas pa'i bod kyi srol rgyun zlos gar gar stegs su 'khrab ston byed rgyu'i thag bcad/ skabs der kho tsho'i mdun du dka' khag ha cang mang po zhig yod na'ang/ gong go khrid dang 'og blo mthun tshang mas mi rigs kyi glu gar las don myur mor — 72 —

'phrinagasar/ da wa darargyas su gtong ba'i spobs sems bcangs nas 'bad brtson chen po byas mthar/ lo gcig tsam gyi dus yun nang du bod kyi zlos gar dang po ste〈rgyal sras nor bzang〉gsar rtsom dang 'khrab ston byas nas yongs 'grub byung bas/tshang mar skul ma chen po thebs/ de nas cang ma 'gyangs par kho tshos 'khrab ston byas pa'i bod kyi zlos gar〈yid 'phrog lha mo〉sngar las lhag pa'i yongs 'grub chen po byung ste rgya che'i lta mkhan tsho'i dga' bsu chen po thob/ zlos gar de rjes su rgyal yongs kyi zhing chen dang grong khyer brgyad dang 'ang kang du 'khrab ston byed skabs 'brel yod ched mkhas mi snas de ni‘‘mtho sgang gi gangs rgyan pad ma lta bu dang/ bod mi dmangs kyi sems khong gi snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i klu dbyangs shig lags’’zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang dang yang du gtor/ 1987 lo'i tshun du/ kho tsho'i mu mthud du 'bad brtson chen po byas te〈gzigs kyi nyi ma〉dang〈btsan po'i pho nya〉zhes pa'i bod kyi zlos gar gnyis gsar rtsom dang 'khrab ston byas te sngar bzhin yongs 'grub byung zhing dga' bsu thob pa red/bod kyi zlos gar chen po de dag 'khrab ston byas pa'i dus mtshungs su/kho tshos mu mthud du‘‘gzhi rim phyogs nas rong 'brog pa mang tshogs la zhabs 'deg zhu ba'i’’kha phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ lo re rer 'khrab ston byed bde ba dang rong 'brog mang tshogs lta 'dod che ba'i rtsed mo skor 'ig gsar rtsom dang nang sbyong byas nas gzhi rim du 'khrab ston byed kyin yod/ de'i phyir lo mang po'i ring la rma lho khul mi rigs glu gar tshogs pas zlos gar gsar ba gcig rjes gnyis mthud du mi rnams kyi mig gi dga' ston du phul ba brgyud de/sgyu rtsal gyi thog tu nyin re bzhin byang tshad mtho ru phyin pa'i dpung sde 'ig sbyong brdar dang skyed sring byas pa dang/ mi rigs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i rig — 73 d+ngha—

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi kha phyogs rgyun 'khyongs dang las khungs nang khul gyi do dam bya ba dang/ gsar rtsom mi sna 'tsho ba'i nang zab zhugs/ mi rigs mthun sgril gyi lam du 'gro ba rgyun 'khyongs byed pa bcas phyogs mang po nas dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras blangs stabs/ 1981 lor‘‘rgyal yongs rong 'brog phyogs kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal bya ba'i sngon thon sde tshan’’du bdams pa dang/ de'i phyi lor‘‘mtsho sngon zhing chen rong 'brog khul gyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal bya ba'i sngon thon sde tshan’’du bdams/ 1983 lo dang1984 lor mthad de lo nyi ༄ga tsho sa la zhing chen dang khul gyi mi rigs mthun sgril gyi sngon thon thun mong du bdams/ na ning rig gnas pu'u yis rma lho khul glu gar tshogs pa la‘‘bcos sgyur dang gsar gtod rgyun 'khyongs byas te bod kyi zlos gar gyi sgyu rtsal dar rgyas su btang ba'i do dam sngon thon gyi sgyu rtsal 'khrab ston tshogs pa’’zhes pa'i mtshan snyan gnang zhing/ da lo'i zla10 bar yang‘‘rgyal yongs kyi rig gnas bya ba'i sngon thon thun mong’’zhes pa'i mtshan snyan blangs te/ rig gnas pu'u dang mi don pu'u gnyis kyi gzengs bstod dang bya dga' thob pa red/(1992lo'i zla1po'i tshes14nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal/)

'phrin gsar/khu byug sngon mo'i snyan dbyangs sgrog dang lhan/ bod kyi glu yang gar yang gang sar khyab/zi ling du bod kyi‘‘drug pa'i glu rol’’spro tshogs rgya chen po bsdus pa/gsar 'god pa/ tshe gzungs/zla7pa'i tshes5nyi zi ling mkhar shar spyi gling du ras gur ni skar tshogs nang bzhin bkra ba dang dga' spro ldan zhing bkra shis pa'i rnam pas khyab 'dugazi ling sa khul gyi bod rigs spun zla4000lhag sa de ru dga' 'dzoms byas nas lo rer thengs re yin pa'i‘‘drug pa'i glu rol’’tshogs/zhing chen sgrig u'u hru'u ci rdo bha dang zhing chen srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa bkra shis rnam rgyal dang dkon mchog de min zhing chen rgyang bsgrags brnyan 'phrin thin dang mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ mtsho sngon nyin re'i gsar 'gyur khang / zhing chen spyi bde thin/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang la sogs pa'i las khungs kyi 'gan khur blo mthun glu rol la zhugs/glu tshogs thog tu gnyer skyong las khungs kyis bod rigs mi dmangs kyi gus srol ltar glu tshogs su zhugs pa'i 'brel yod mgo khrid pa dang lo na drug cu yan chad lon pa'i rgan po dang phyi rgyal pa rnams la kha btags phul 'ing bdud rtsi drangs/da lo'i glu rol bya 'gul la sngar las brjid nyams che zhing yid dbang — 75 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'phrog pa dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang dus kyi khyad chos ldan 'dug/ glu tshogs su las khungs so so'i las zhor 'khrab ston pa rnams kyis phun sum tshogs shing yid dbang 'gug pa'i rig rtsal le tshan bstan/ lhag par du mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma tshos mi rigs kyi shom gos gon nas zhabs bro bstan pas tshogs zhugs rnams kyi dga' bsu dang gzengs bstod thob phyi dror las khungs khag gis so sor mnyam spro'i bya 'gul spel/ mtsho sngon nyin re'i gsar 'gyur khang gi rol cha'i ru khag gis tshang mar rol dbyangs kyis ram 'degs byas 'og bro la dga' mi rnams zhabs bro'i dpal la rol/bod mi rigs kyi phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang dus skal gsar ba'i rig gnas las don phun tshogs su gtong ba/ spyi tshogs ring lugs bsam pa'i dpal yon sngar las dar du 'jug pa/ mi rigs mthun sgril je dam du gtong ba/ mi rigs snying stobs skyed cing spel ba bcas la mtshon na‘‘glu tshogs’’ni dge mtshan dang ldan pa zhig red/ (1992lo'i zla7pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal/)

'phrin gsar/thun rin rdzong gi grong gseb mnyam las thebs rtsa tshogs pas dpal 'byor gong du spel ba'i thad phan nus bton pa/gsar 'god pa/ stag lha/rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul thun rin rdzong gis grong gseb mnyam las thebs rtsa tshogs pa gong du spel te rdzong yongs kyi zhing las ma dngul mi 'dang ba'i gnad don thag gcod pa'i thabs lam gal chen zhig tu gyur/ mi sngar/ rdzong yongs kyi shang dang grong rdal9ru mnyam las thebs rtsa tshogs pa btsugs pa dang / mnyam las thebs rtsa sgor khri175tsam yod/grong gseb mnyam las thebs rtsa tshogs pa ni/ 1989lo nas bzung rong bo grong rdal du thun mong ma dngul nang khul 'khor rgyug tshod lta byed pa'i rmang gzhi steng btsugs pa red/ thebs rtsa'i ma dngul yong khungs gtso bo ni sde ba dang hre thun mong gi gsog 'jog dang phyir bsdus pa'i khyim tshang dang las khungs gzhan pa'i chad dngul/ sa zhing gzhan spyod gsab dngul/ 'khor rgyug bed spyod bya chog pa'i thun mong gi 'then 'jog sogs red/ mnyam las thebs rtsa sde bar dbang ba dang shang gis do dam dang rin yod bed spyod byed pa red/ gtso bo 'debs gso las rigs dang zhing las zhabs phyi ma lag — 77 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'dzugs skrun byed pa dang / sde ba dang hres gcig gyur bdag gnyer gyi rnam grangs dang de min phan 'bras mtho ba'i shang grong khe las thad spyod pa red/grong gseb mnyam las thebs rtsa tshogs pa btsugs pa des/ ma dngul gyi 'khor rgyug phan 'bras je mthor btegs pa dang grong gseb dpal 'byor gong du 'phel bar skul 'ded nus ldan byas pa ma zad/ da dung thun mong gi dpal 'byor nus shugs je drag tu btang zhing zhing pa mang tshogs kyi khur bo je yang du btang / na ning / shang dang grong rdal so so'i thebs rtsa tshogs pas 'debs 'dzugs las rigs thad ma dngul sgor khri80tsam btang ba dang /mang tshogs kyis rdzas 'gyur lud spyi rgya khri24tsam dang son bzang spyi rgya khri30tsam nyo bar rgyab rogs byas/ gso skyong las rigs thad ma dngul sgor khri50tsam btang ste mang tshogs kyis lug 554dang rmo phyugs dang bzhon ma116nyos/ grong sdes bsgrubs pa'i khe las thad ma dngul sgor khri11 3btang /rdzong yongs su btang ba'i ma dngul lo der thon rin sgor khri320bskrun pa dang khe spogs sgor khri80mngon 'gyur byung ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog grong gseb mnyam las thebs rtsa tshogs pa'i yong 'bab rkyang rkyang sgor khri 30tsam du bslebs/(1993lo'i zla8pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)

'phrin gsar/zhing las la mu mthud du shugs snon rgyag dgos/nga chen dmangs 'thus skabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba'i gnas tshul rags bris/gsar 'god pa/ dpal chen rgyal/nyin 'ga'i ring la/ zhing chen dmangs 'thus skabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi bar zhugs pa'i 'thus mi tshos hrin krang then khrin phen gyi snyan zhu la spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas gros bsdur nan tan byas/hrin krang then khrin phen gyis tshogs chen la phul ba'i snyan zhu'i nang du zhing las 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i gnad don skor gleng bar yig 'bri mang po med na yang 'thus mi mi nyung ba zhig gi do snang thob yod/ mtsho shar gyi 'thus mi ma tsi yon gyis bshad rgyur/ 'das pa'i lo 'ga'i ring nga tshos brnyan 'phrin dang dzags par steng nas‘‘zhing pas 'bru rigs btsong dka' ba'i’’gnas tshul rgyun par mthong zhing / nye ba'i lo 'gar 'bru rigs thon skyed bstud mar mar chag pa'i gnas tshul las gnad don ci zhig lhang la bud pa gsal bor shes su bcug mtsho shar sa khul ni rang zhing gi 'bru rigs thon khul chen po yin pa dang / 2010lor zhing chen yongs kyi 'bru rigs thon tshad bsdoms 'bor spyi rgya dung phyur13 5la bsleb rgyu'i spyi'i las 'gan khrod du/ mtsho shar gyis spyi rgya dung phyur8 5zin yod pas/ de ni phyogs che sa zhig red/ de'i — 79 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/phyir nga tshos du son pa gsum bton pa 'di lta ste/ zhing las sa khul chen po nas zhing las sa khul stobs ldan can du son pa dang / zhing las dpal 'byor sa khul nas bzo las dpal 'byor sa khul du son pa/ kha rgyab tsam thag gcod pa nas 'byor ba 'bring tsam ldan par son pa bcas yin/ de yang nga tshos phyogs bsdoms byas pa'i phyogs bdun gyi mthun rkyen la bltas na/mtsho shar gyi zhing las la sbas shugs chen po sngog 'ardon byed rgyu yod stabs/snyan zhu'i nang bton pa'i dmigs 'ben mngon par bsgyur bar yid ches yod chog pa yin/zhing las la tshan rtsal gyi 'gro gron gtong ba'i shugs tshad che ru phyin pa dang bstun/ ma dngul 'don sprod dkon pa ni sngar bzhin da lta dang phyin chad kyi 'gal ba gtso bo yin pas/ rgyal khab kyi ma dngul brtson len byed pa dang /zhing chen nor srid sngon rtsis kyi ma dngul dang yid rton dngul bun gyi ma dngul las gzhan/ nges par du zhing pa rang steng nas ma dngul gtong ba 'di sngar bas kyang gsar spel byed dgos/ gnad don 'di thag gcod na mgyogs shing nus pa ldan pa'i sgo nas zhing pa'i yong sgo 'phar snon dang zhing pa'i khur po je yang du gtong ba/ thon skyed rgyu chas kyi rin gong 'phar nas zhing par mnan shugs thebs pa de je yang du gtong dgos/ shang grong khe las ni zhing par khe phan bzo ba dang phyir 'khor nas zhing las la ma dngul gtong thub pa'i thabs lam mdun lam che ba zhig yin gshis/ nges par du rgyun 'khyongs dang 'phel rgyas su btang thog tshan rtsal mtho gras kyi 'gro gron gtong rigs dang /nga tshos snang med du bskyur mi rung ba'i phyogs gzhan zhig ni/ zhing pa'i yong sgo 'phar snon gyi thabs lam nus ldan zhig tu gyur pa'i zhing las sa khul gyi phyugs las de yin la/ de shang grong khe las dang bsdur na da dung khyab tshad de — 80 ge

'phrinagasar/ da da bas kyang rgya che ba dang 'gro gron nyung ba/ phan nus mthong mgyogs pa bcas kyi dge mtshan du ma ldan pas/ zhing las sa khul du phyugs las gong spel du gtong ba de shang grong khe las don du gnyer ba ltar bsgrubs te/ rim ba'in du rang rang so so'i khyad chos ldan pa'i tshong zong thon skyed kyi gnas gzhi 'dzugs dgos/ zhing pa'i yong sgo thabs brgya jus stong gis 'phar snon byed pa ni zhing las la 'gro gron gtong ba'i dgos mkho yin pa ma zad/ lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'gag sgo rtol ba'i 'gro lam ldog tu med pa zhig kyang yin zer ba 'di ni 'thus mi'i yongs khyab kyi bzhed dgongs yin/hrin krang then phen gyi snyan zhu'i nang‘‘'bru rigs kyis phal cher rang tshim mngon 'gyur byed par dka' khag yod la cha rkyen yang yod/ phyogs so so'i byed thabs nus ldan yin na/ 'bru rigs rang tshim gnad don thag gcod pa de dpe mi srid pa zhig gtan nas min’’zhes pa'i nang don la 'thus mi mi nyung ba zhig gis yid ches byed 'dug(1996lo'i zla4ba'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/yul shul mi rigs lcags rigs bzo grwas rang sa'i rtswa thang gi‘‘sdeb bzhi’’'dzugs skrun thad byas rjes bzhag pa/gsar 'god pa/ mkha' mtsho/yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul yul shul rdzong mi rigs lcags rigs bzo grwas rang sa'i rtswa thang gi‘‘sdeb zhi’’'dzugs skrun la dmigs nas/thon rdzas spus legs can dang btsongs phyi'i zhabs phyi yag pos rgya che ba'i 'dzad spyod mkhan bkug pa dang / yul shul sa khul gyi rkang 'dzin khe las shig la gyur/yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul yul shul rdzong mi rigs lcags rigs bzo grwa ni1995lo'i zla5bar krung gung krung dbyang gzhung las thin gyi rogs skyor tsho chung dang po dang khul u/ khul srid gzhung bcas kyis rgyab skyor shugs ldan byas 'og btsugs pa'i gtso bo‘‘lha glang’’rtags can gyi lcags dra thon skyed byed pa'i bzo grwa zhig red/ dang thog kho tshos ma dngul sgor khri200tsam gsog pa dang dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas nas sa khyon mus gru bzhi ma2280zin pa dang las bzo pa220yod pa'i mi rigs lcags rigs bzo grwa btsugs/ de'i nang du zi ling sogs sa khul nas lag rtsal mi sna20gdan — 82 —

'phrin gsar/'dren byas pa las gzhan las bzo pa tshang ma ni rang yul gyi dbul phongs khyim tshang gi bu rgyud red/ 1995lo'i lo mjug nas lcags dra thon skyed tshod lta byas pa dang1996lo'i zla3pa nas dngos su‘‘lha glang’’rtags can gyi lcags dra thon skyed byas/ kho tshos dka' ngal mang bo bsal nas zhin cang dang then cin/nang sog hri ca krong sogs sa khul nas ma bcos rgyu cha nang 'dren byas nas/spus tshad 'dra ba'i gnas tshul 'og tu zi ling sogs sa khul las3lkonas5citsam dma' ba'i rin gong gis khul yongs kyi 'brog pa khyim tshang4760la lcags dra 'don sprod byas nas/ yul shul khul gyi rtswa ra'i thon khungs dang‘‘sdeb bzhi’’'dzugs skrun legs sgrub dang sa gnas mi rigs bzo las gong 'phel du gtong ba/ rang sa'i nor srid yong sgo je mang du gtong ba/ las sgug mi snar las zhugs thabs lam 'tshol ba bcas kyi phyogs su byas rjes bzhag pa ma zad/ da dung 'grim 'grul stabs bde min pa'i sa thag ring nas lcags dra nyos yong na ma rtsa mtho ba dang khag khur ljid pa/ ‘‘sdeb bzhi’’'dzugs skrun stabs mi bde ba bcas kyi gnad don thag bcad/1996lor yong sgo sgor khri60bskrun pa dang dpya khral sgor khri25sprad/da lo lcags dra mus khri600la bslebs thub pa dang thon rin gyi sdom grangs sgor khri2600mngon 'gyur byed thub rgyu red/(1997lo'i zla11pa'i tshes4nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'tsho dpal ldan pa'i mtsho sngon bal 'jam lugagasar 'god pa/ g.yang pa/mtsho sngon po byang 'gram gyi rkang tsha rdzong na ru gong ma rtswa thang du gnas pa'i mchin khug gzhung lug rgyud spel ra ni rang zhing gi btsugs snga ba'i lug rgyud spel ra zhig red/ 1976 lor lug rgyud spel ra des thog dang por rang zhing nas bal sha gnyis spyod kyi bal 'jam lug rgyud gsar ba zhig gi rgyud spel nas legs grub byung ba dang rang zhing gi bal 'jam lug rgyud kyi gso spel rten gzhir gyur de rang zhing dang nye 'dabs zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs 'ga'i lug rgyud legs sgyur thad byas rjes bzhag —bal 'jam lug rgyud gsar ba de ni ma rgyud ni bod lug dang pha rgyud ni sngon su'u len ka'o ca so ri khul gyi bal 'jam lug yin la/ mtsho ngos las cha snyom mus3200 yan gyi yul gru nas sdeb sbyor rgyud spel byas pa yin phyir/grang ngar thub la bal sha gnyis spyod sogs kyi khyad chos ldan pas rang zhing dang bod ljongs/ kan su'u/ nyin zha sogs sa khul gyi 'brog pa'i dga' bsu thob/da lta'i bar du lug rgyud spel ra des bsdoms pos spyi tshogs steng bal 'jam son lug khri20 lhag 'don sprod byas pa dang / de'i nang du rang zhing la 'don sprod byas pa'i bal 'jam lug spyi'i mkho tshad kyi40lko zin/ tshan zhib grub 'bras de la mtsho sngon tshan rtsal grub 'bras kyi bya dga' thob cing lug rgyud spel — 84 —

'phrin gsar/rade yang rgyal khab zhing las pus rgyal khab rim pa'i gnad sa'i phyugs rgyud spel rar bkod/yin na'ang bal 'jam lug rgyud de nam yin yang rgyal bo'i sras mo ltar bag mar slong mkhan yod med la sems khral rgyag mi dgos pa zhig ga la yin/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul gsar ba'i nang/ lug rgyud de yang re zhig tshong mi brin par gyur nas nyo mkhan je nyung dang rin gong je dma' red/ gnas tshul de la dmigs nas lug rgyud spel ra des rgyun chad med par gzhi rtsa'i sgrig bkod kyi 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon pa'i dus mtshungs su/ gom gang mdun spos kyis lug rgyud de'i gzugs dbyibs dang bal gyi thon tshad dang spus ka mthor 'degs byed pa'i tshan rtsal 'char gzhi spel te lug rgyud rdzogs pa'i gom stabs je mgyogs su btang/ lug la khebs rgyag pa dang khyad par du lug rgyud de la yo rob gling me le no lug rgyud dang sdeb pas/ gzugs dbyibs dang bal gyi ring tshad dang thon tshad dang spus ka bcas mthor 'degs mngon gsal byung/bcar 'dri byed skabs nam zla ston mjug gi skabs su bslebs 'dug lug rgyud spel ra de'i da lo btab pa'i gzan rtswa gzan chas phal cher brnga bsdu byas tshar nas shul du lug 'tsho bzhin yod/ mu mtha' mi mngon pa'i sog ma'i nang du che chung mi 'dra ba'i lug khyu yis khengs 'dug lug re re'i rna rtags steng bkod pa'i rigs rgyud dang lo tshod ltar khyu bgos yod la gang la gang 'phrod kyi 'tsho skyong byed thabayokyang yod/ gzugs dbyibs che ba'i lug rnams kyi rgyab la khebs brgyab pa dadza bal lug thong ba rnams phar lding tshur lding byas nas rol rtsed byed bzhin yod/ lug rgyud spel ra de'i khrang kung gzho na pa rta mgrin gyis nga tsho la gnas — 85 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshul mtshams spyor byed skabs bshad rgyur/ lo ngo bcu phrag 'ga'i 'dzugs skrun dang dar spel brgyud nas da lta lug rgyud spel ra 'di la tshan rig dang mthun zhing tshad ldan yin pa'i lug rgyud gso spel gyi ma lag cha tshang zhig chags yod la rmang gzhi sgrig bkod legs bcos mngon gsal byung yod/ lo rer spyi tshogs steng bal 'jam son lug khri1 3 'don sprod byed thub pa'i nus shugs ldan pas rang zhing mtsho shar zhing las sa khul gyi bal 'jam lug sa ya las brgal ba gso rgyu'i bzo 'god rnam grangs kyi rgyud spel rten gzhir gyur yod/ /(1997 lo'i zla12 pa'i tshes22 nyin gyi par ngos par gsar)gegs gnod las rnam par rgyal de bdag dam la shuṭa bsnan pas/mgo log khul gyi phyugs las thon skyed la lo legs 'byung re yod/'phrin gtong ba/ sung dbyi me'o/da lo'i tshun/ mgo log khul gyis thon skyed byed thabs sna tshogs nan tan gyis dngos 'bebs byas pa dang/ phyugs zog 'tsho skyong dang do dam byed par shugs bsnan pas gnod skyon chen po byung ba'i lor phyugs las thon skyed brtan brling ngang gong 'phel byung/zla6 pa'i zla mjug bar/ khul yongs su bsdoms pas phyugs phrug sna — 86 —

'phrinagasar/ —da da ————tshogs khri60 83btsas pa dang khri47 90gson zhing gson tshad78 8la/ bslebs/ che phyugs khri10 81 gyong gud byung ba dang gyong gud byung tshad4 22red/ na ning dgun dang da lo'i dpyid kar mgo log khul gyi rdzong5dang shang26la gzhi khyon chen po'i ngang gangs/ gnod byung ba dang/ gangs gnod byung rjes khul yongs kyi gong 'og tshang mas bsam pa gcig sgril gyis gnod 'gog phyugs skyobs kyi las ka dam 'dzin byas shing/ gtso bo byed thabs bdun spyad pa ste/ gcig nas las gnyer tshan chung89dang mi thengs2100rtsa 'dzugs byas pa dang/ rim pa so so'i tang srid las byed pas sne khrid byas te gnod 'tshe thebs sar thengs16longs tshad du zab zhugs byas nas mang tshogs la shātshams 'dri dang gnod 'gog gnod sel bya bar mdzub ston byas/ gnyis nas sgrig lam nan 'dzin byas/ gnod 'gog byed pa'i khrod du rdzong dang shang gi mgo khrid pa gtso bo dang60lko yan gyi las byed pa tshang mas gnod 'gog gnod sel gyi las gnas gtan srung byas/ gsum nas las byed pa gzhi rim du mngags nas 'khyams 'thor byung ba'i 'brog pa mang tshogs 'tshol bar phyin zhing/ 'khyams 'thor byung ba'i 'brog khyim94 dang mi548la 'brel gtug byung thub pa ma zad/ kho tsho'i thon skyed dang 'tsho ba bkod sgrig byas/bzhi nas sman bcos du khag rtsa 'dzugs byas pa dang gnod thebs sa khul du zab zhugs byas te mang tshogs la sman bcos rims 'gog byas/ lnga nas las byed pa dang las bzo ba rtsa 'dzugs sgos gangs brkos nas gnod 'gog gnod sel byed par lam phud pa/ drug nas mi mngags pa dang yang na glog 'phrin gyi thabs spyad de khyim mtshes zhing chen dang khul la 'brel gtug byas nas rin gong dma' ba'i dngos rdzas nyo ba dang rtswa sa bkol spyod byed pa sogs bhe 87 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/thad mthun sbyor byas/ bdun nas rlangs 'khor (thengs) 170 lhag rtsa 'dzugs byas te gnod 'gog gnod sel dngos rdzas tun800 lhag skyel 'dren byas/gong gi byed thabs de dag spyad rjes khul de nas gnod chen byung lor phyugs zog gson mang shi nyung gi gnas tshul bzang bo byung zhing/ phyuṭa las thon skyed thad 'phel rgyas kyi gnas bab bzang po rgyun srung byas yod phyir/ da lor lo legs 'byung bar re ba yod/ /(1998 lo'i zla8 tshes14 nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal)yul shul khul gyis ljang mdog gi lcags ri ring po skrun bzhin pa/gsar 'god pa/ gangs dpal/lo8kyi ring la yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi mang tshogs dang las byed pa gong 'og gcig gyur ngang 'bad 'bungs hur thag byas pas/'bri chu'i 'gog srung nags tshal bzo skrun la 'gag brtol gyi 'phel rgyas thob/da lta'i bar khul yongs su rgya khyon ldan pa'i ljang sgyur gnas gzhi7 dang ljang mdog srung skyong ra ba21000 btsugs pa dang/ btsugs nags mus khri5dang ri 'gog nags gso byung sa mus khri160 lhag tu bslebs pas/ rgya khyon — 88 —

'phrinagasar/ da wa chenawos sa mtho'i ljang sgyur dang sa chu shor ba sgyur bcos byed par bom pa gsar ba spos pa red/'bri chu'i 'gog srung nags tshal gyi bzo skrun ni rgyal khab rim pa'i gnad che'i bzo skrun zhig yin/ khyad par du 'bri chu 'byung gnas su yod pa'i yul shul khul gyi 'gog srung nags tshal gyi 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs ni mi'i rigs kyis 'dzam gling gi yang rtse nas skye khams khor yug bsgyur bcos byed pa'i bya spyod gal chen zhig yin/ gnas 'dir sa mtho zhing grangs ngar che ba/sa chu shor ba'i gnas tshul tshabs che bas/ nags skrun ljang sgyur byed pa ni dka' tshad shin tu che ba zhig yin mod/ yin yang khul 'di'i rim pa so so'i srid gzhung gis rang sa'i cha rkyen dngos la dmigs te ri 'gog nags gso dang 'dzugs skrun zung du sbrel ba'i byed phyogs gtan khel byas shing / phyogs mang po nas ma dngul brtson len dang bsdu gsog byas te rgyal khab kyis ma dngul sgor khri304 btang ba dang sa gnas kyis sgor khri200 lhag bsdus te btang/ bzo skrun 'di lag len bstar ba'i go rim du mang tshogs rnams la dril bsgrags dang skul slong byas thog 'gog srun nags tshal skrun pa de mang tshogs kyi bya spyod du 'gyur bar byas shing/ mgo khrid la shugs snon pa dang rtsa 'dzugs dang do dam sgrig lam 'dzugs pa'am 'thus sgo je tshang du btang/khul gyi sde tshan dang 'brog khyim gyi ljang sgyur tho 'god lam lugs dang nags tshal dbang ba'i lam lugs sogs btsugs shing don thog tu 'khyel te/ rdzong dang shang rim pa'i nags las sa tshigs12 btsuṭa/ khul dang rdzong shang rim pa so so'i mgo khrid pa rnams kyis sne khrid de sdong bo btsugs pas/ mang tshoṭa kyis 'gog srung nags tshal skrun par skul ma thebs te/ lo rer rong 'brog pa khri3 lhag sdong 'dzugs nags skrun gyi bya 'gul nang zhuṭa/ dgon pa'i grwa — 89 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/btsun rnams kyang bya 'gul de'i nang du zhuṭa pa dang/ rin chen dgon sogs ljangasgyur grub 'bras bzang ba'i dgon pa skor zhig byung/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la/ sdong myug ra ba mus2000 bskrun pa dang naṭa tshal 'gog srung gi lcags ra mus khri30 bskor ba/ rdo ra mus khri2 bskor pa/ chu rka mus khri lhag 'dzuṭa skrun byas/ sdong bo'i gson tshad80lko yan yin pa dang ri 'gog nags gso khul gyi naṭa rtswa'i khebs tshad1991 lo'i10lko nas da lta'i80lkol 'phar snon byung/khul des rgya khyon chen po dang mang tshogs gyi 'gog srung nags skrun byed pa'i dus mtshungs su ma dpe'i nus pa la mthong chen byas te dpe ston khul btsugs nas khul yongs kyi sdong 'dzugs nags skrun la skul khrid byas/ dpe ston khul gyi bya shul thang dang khra la thang mus khri can gyi sdong 'dzugs ra ba mang po ljang thang thang gi yul gru zhig tu gyur 'dug skye rgu'i shar ri phyogs yongs nas 'gog srung byas pa dang nags rtswa'i khebs tshad90lko yan la bslebs/'bri chu kha nas skye rgu grong rdal bar gyi spyi le26 yod pa de'i gzhung lam 'gram gnyis su btsuṭa pa'i sdong bo tshang tshing du 'khrug pa'i nags tshal du gyur cing/mtha' 'khor du lcags ras bskor ba dang chu rka'ang las yod pas yul ljongs gsar ba zhig tu gyur 'dug(1998lo'i zla9 tshes28 nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)
