'phrin gsar/spre'i nag shang tang us tang gi gzhi rim rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'dzugs skrun dam 'dzin byas pa/gsar 'god pa/ g.yang pa/mtsho lho bod rig rang skyong khul gung hi rdzong spre'u nag shang tang us rgyun chad med par tang gi gzhi rim rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'dzugs skrun la shugs bsnan nas tang yonarta rnams kyi rgyu spus mthor 'degs byas shing/ gzhi rim tang kri pu'u bya ba thams cad lam lugs can du bsgyur/spre'u nag shang tang us tang u rang nyid kyi 'dzugs skrun la do snang byas nas/ rang nyid kyi las skyong nus shugs dang mgo khrid chu tshad mthor 'degs byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u rnams kyis 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon pa de gros rim gal chen zhig tu bkod nas dam 'dzin byas/ da lo'i zla6par shang tang u'i mgo khrid la shugs snon dang gcig mthun gyis 'char bkod byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng / shang yongs kyi sde ba'i tang kri pu'u6nang gi rim pa dang po'i kri pu'u srangarkan dang rim pa gnyis pa'i kri pu'u dag ther mthor 'degs byed pa'i bya 'gulasmrel/ bya 'gul nang du thog mar shang tangagi slob grwa nas sde pa6gi kri pu'u uyon30rtsa 'dzugs byas te tin zha'o phen gzhung lugs dang〈tang gi sgrigayige〉yang na tang dang rgyal khab kyi skabs thog srid jus gsar ba rnams slob dzi / cirjes su shang yongs kyi tang yon — 91 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshan khag gnyis su bgos te so sor nyin7ring gso sbyong byas/ gso sbyong byed skabs tang yon tshos gtso bor tin zha'o phen gzhung lugs dang〈tang gi sgrig yig〉 〈mar khe si ring lugs kyi mi rigs lta ba〉 gong rim 'brel yod sde khag gi yig cha sogs slob sbyong nan mo byas/ shang yongs kyi tang yon188gso sbyong la zhugs shing tang yon yongs kyi97lkuzin/ tang yon gso sbyong byed par bstun shang tang us da dung dus thog tu 'brog pa mang tshogs nang gi tang la blo dkar zhing tang nang du zhugs pa'i re ba bton pa/ tang yon gyi tshad gzhi dang mthun pa'i mi sna12tang nang du bsdu len byas pa dang spyod yon gnyis ldan gyi rtsa don dang tshad gzhi ltar tang yon nang gi phul byung can rnams kri pu'u khongs mir 'dams bkod byas nas dngos gnas las 'dod med pa dang nus pa zhan pa'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci1dang sde dpon1tshab brje byas/tang kri pu'u dang 'brog u so so'i gnas tshul dngos dang 'brel nas〈kri pu'u khongasamis don chen gros mol lam lugs〉dang〈tang yon tshogs 'du lam lugs〉 〈'brog u yis don dag gros mol sgrig lam〉 〈'brog dmangs kyis don dag gros mol lam lugs〉 〈nor don khyab bsgrags lam lugs〉sogs 'thus sgo je tshang dang gsar du gtan 'bebs byas nas tang kri pu'u dang 'brog u yi las don thams cad la sgrig lam yod du bcuga'adi dag brgyud nas sngon gyi rim pa dang po'i tang kri pu'u yin pa'i dkar la sde ba'i tang kri pu'u sngon las 'tsho dpal ldan par gyur nas/ sde ba yongs kyi tang yon dang 'brog pa mang tshogs khrid de phyugs las thon skyed spel ba'i mnyam du dbul skyor byed shugs je drag tu btang / da lor tang kri pu'u yis yang bskyar tang yon dang mang tshogs skul slong byas te ma dngul dang dngos rdzas bsgrigs nas sde ba nang gi dbul khyim12la khang ba las rogs byas — 92 —

'phrin gsar/shing dbul khyim6la dbul skyor byas te dbul phongs las thar du bcug sngon gyi rim pa gnyis pa'i tang kri pu'u yin pa'i zhing mgon sde ba'i tang kri pu'u thengs 'di'i dag ther brgyud nas rim pa dang po'i tang kri pu'u gyur/ da lo'i phyugs las thon skyed nang tang kri pu'u des tang yon rnams kyi sne khrid dang mig dpe'i nus pa 'don gang thub byas nas phyugs phrug gi gson tshad dang phyugs dar ma'i sha shed rgyas tshul sogs shang yongs kyi ang dang por gyur/ mig sngar tang kri pu'u des da lo'i phyugs las thon rdzas kyi rin gong mar chag pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs nas phyugs zog gi gso kha nas 'bud tshad dam 'dzin byas te sde ba'i mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo na ning las mi nyung 'phar du 'jug par brel/tang us dus rgyun du lhod yangs med par na gzhon tshogs pa dang bud med lhan tshogs kyi las la thugs khur dang rgyab skyor pa der do snang byed bzhin yod/ rtsa 'dzugs de gnyis kyang shang tang u yis khrid ston dang rgyab skyor byed 'og bde blag ngang spel pa dang shang yongs kyi phyugs las dpal 'byor dar spel dang bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi 'dzugs skrun la ram 'degs chen po byas/da lo shang de'i 'brog pa na gzhon phul byung can mi16gung gzhon tshogs pa nang du zhugs pa dang bud med mi (thengs)498gso spel las rigs dang dngos phan lag rtsal gyi slob sbyong thob pa dang / yig rmongs sel ba sogs bya 'gul la zhugs/(1998lo'i zla10ba'i tshes26nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)

gom stabasadang zhabs rjes/rmang gzhi sra brtan du btang ba dang tshan rtsal khyab spel dam 'jin byas nas/ske mtsho lho khul gyis da lo yang zhing phyugs las thad lo legs blangs pa/gsar 'god pa/ g.yang pa/khul yongs nas phyugs phrug sna tshogs khri 117 6gson pa dang gson tshad89lkol bslebs pas na ning las brgya cha'i grangs1 66mthor 'degs byung ba dang / khul yongs kyi 'bru rigs dang snum tog spyi'i thon tshad spyi rgya khri13502 5la bslebs pas lo rgyus steng ches mtho ba'i chu tshad bskrun/mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyis da lo zhing phyugs las thon tshad 'phar ba dang rong 'brog pa'i yong sgo 'phar bar khag theg byed pa de dmigs tshad du bzung nas/ ma dngul je mang du btang ste rmang gzhi sra brtan du btang ba dang tshan rtsal khyab spel dam 'dzin sgos zhing phyugs las dar 'phel byas pas/ na ning lo legs thob pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng da lo yang lo legs thob/da lo nas bzung mtsho lho khul gyi rim pa so so'i tang u dang srid gzhung gis krung dbyang dang zhing chen gyi zhing sde las don gros tshogs kyi dgongs don lag bstar dngos 'bebs nan tan dang rong 'brog khul las ka mgo khrid par shugs snon byas nas/ zhing phyugs las kyi rmang gzhi'i 'dzugs skrun thad da 94 da

'phrinagasar/ da wa —da wa ma dngul mu mthud nas je mang du btang ba dang / shugs chen gyis sngon thon dngos phan gyi lag rtsal sna tshogs khyab spel dang zhing phyugs las kyi tshan rtsal chu tshad mthor 'degs byas nas/ zhing phyugs las thon skyed kyi gom stabs brtan por 'phel bar skul 'ded chen po byas/ khul yongs nas phyugs las thon skyed thad ma dngul sgor khri1757 06btang ba dang de'i nang du 'brog pa rang gis bsgrigs pa'i ma dngul sgor khri1467 76la bslebs/ 'brog pa khyim tshang774yis gtan sdod khang ba las pa dang rtswa ra mus khri66 56bskor/tshad gzhi mtho ba'i phyugs zog drod khang623las te mus gru bzhi ma khri6 82la bslebs/ mi'i thabs kyis gzan rtswa mus khri15 87btab pa dang rtswa sa mus khri176 9steng gi a bra bsad/ de yang zhin he rdzong gis ho kha shang du sman rdzas gsar bas dug rtswa 'joms par tshod lta byas nas phan 'bras mngon gsal blangs/ kos nan rdzong gis phan 'bras mtho ba'i phyugs las/ phyogs bsdus lag rtsal gsar gtod zhib 'jug rnam grangs lag bstar byas pa dang / thun te dang gung hi rdzong gnyis kyis 'brog khul phyugs las deng rabs can du gsar gtod dpe ston rnam grangs lag bstar byas nas/ phyugs phrurga/ len snyor dang phyugs nad 'gog bcos/ nor lug tsho gso/ gnod 'gog phyugs skyob sogs phyogs so so nas phan 'bras mngon gsal blangs/ mig snga'i bar du khul yongs nas phyugs phrug sna tshogs khri117 6gson du bcug pa dang gson tshad89lhul bslebs pas na ning las brgya cha'i grangs1 66mthor 'degs byung / phyugs dar ma shi tshad2 33lkobar tshod 'dzin byas pa dang na ning las brgya cha'i grangs0 11chag pa red/zhing las thon skyed thad khul yongs nas ma dngul sgor khri/ 6024 6dngos 'bebs byas pa dang na ning las sgor khri286 6'phar bas thon skyed —— 95 da

da wa gomastabasadang zhabs rjes/byed thabs sna tshogs spol bar khag theg byas/ spyi'i 'debs rgya mus khri70 66nang du lo legs 'char gzhi mus khri35dang ri zhing mus khri8spel 'debs la skyar 'debs mus khri2 24dngos 'bebs byas shing‘‘stusari zhing gi than 'gog’’mus khri3 11khyab spel byas/ khri ka rdzong gis rma chu bzhur rgyun du dgun gro 'debs par rgya mus khri2 3khyab spel byas pa dang cha snyoms mus re'i thon tshad dpyid gro las spyi rgya75'phar/ zhin he rdzong gis‘‘son bzang bzo 'god’’dam 'dzin byas nas zhing las thad gnod skyon tshabs chen thebs pa'i gnas tshul 'og dga' 'os pa'i lo legs byung / thun te rdzong gis thang rgan dang mgo mang shang gi mtho grang 'brog khul nas chu shog 'og tu zhog khog 'debs pa tshod lta byas nas thon tshad la mthor 'degs chen po byung / sa gnas/ so sos da dung tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul ltar/ 'debs/ 'dzugs sgrig sro la la legs sgrig 'os 'tshams byas te thon tshad mtho ba'i gro dang snum tog gi rgya je cher btang / sdom rtsis ltar na/ da lo'i khul yongs kyi 'bru rigs snum rdzas kyi spyi'i thon tshad spyi rgya khri13502 5la bslebs pa dang lo legs byung ba'i na ning las spyi rgya khri322 7'phar bas lo rgyus kyi ches mtho ba'i chu tshad gsar skrun byas/ 'bru rigs/ dang snum dzas kyi mus re'i thon tshad kyang na ning las so sor spyi rgya2 3dang spyi rgya9 5'phar/(1998lo'i zla12pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)

'phrinagasar/ da da mtsho nub khul gyi dbul skyor thad grub 'bras mngon gsal byung ba/don grub tshe ring /mtsho nub khul u dang srid gzhung gis dbul skyor la do snang chen po byas te phan 'bras mngon gsal blangs/na ning gnas spos zhing ba khyim tshang4436gi mi20193gyi kha rgyab thad kyi gnad don thag gcod gang legs byas thog da lor yang khul gtogs rgyal dbang zhing ra5yi khyim tshang1666gi mi7520dang 'brog khul gyi phyugs nyung ba dang phyugs med 'brog khyim670yi mi3552bkod sgrig gang legs byas ce khul yongs kyi dbul khyim kha grangs zhib bsher byas pas/ dbul rkyen gnas tshul la brtag dpyad rgyus lon dang gom gang mdun spos kyi khul yongs kyi dbul skyor 'gag brtol bya ba bsgrub par tshan rig gi khungs lung 'don sprod byas/1997lor bsdoms pa'i dbul skyor ched dngul sgor khri400dang skyed ka med pa'i dngul bun sgor khri200btang zhing dbul khyim800gnad sar bzung nas khyim rer sgor5000re bgos te 'debs rigs dang gso rigs spel bar rogs skyor byas/ da lo yang mtsho nub khul zhing las dngul khang dang bor mo grong khyer zhing las dngul khang gnyis kyis mnyam 'brel sgos bsdoms pa'i dngul bun sgor khri400dang skyed med dbul bun sgor khri200btang nas dbul khyim957la gso spel dang 'debs spel las rigs/ 'ing phyugs zhor — 97 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/thon dngos rdzas sbyor bzo byed par rogs skyor byas/ 1997lo nas1998lo'i nang bsdoms pa'i dbul khyim1758la rogs ram byas/na ning khul yongs su tshan rtsal mi sna rtsa 'dzugs byas te dbul bo sde bar tshan rtsal shes bya'i gso sbyong 'dzin grwa thengs23gnyer nas dbul khyim310yi zhing ba mi stong phrag lhag la tshan rtsal gso sbyong thob/ da lo yang khul zhing phyugs tshan rtsal sa'o yis zhing chen tshan rtsal gso sbyong lte gnas su gso sbyong 'gro gron sgor khri4lhag brtson len byas te zhing ba dngul khyim gyi mi1200la gso sbyong byas/1998lor khul yongs kyi gnas spos sde ba12gyi slob grwar rgyal khab kyi ma dngul sgor khri131brtson len byas te gnas spos sde bar slob grwa rgya cher btang ba dang slob khrid cha rkyen legs bsgyur byas/mtsho nub khul srid gzhung gi dbul skyor ched dngul do dam bya bar shugs snon byas pa dang rgyal khab kyi gtan la phab pa'i dbul skyor srid jus lag len mthar phyin byas te 'debs rigs dang gso rigs/ sbyor bzo las rigs/ khyad dbul khyim tshang / 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye dbul khyim sogs la 'thung chu dang glog dang / 'gro lam dang bye 'gog nags tshal gyi rmang gzhi sgrig chas yang na slob gso/ rig gnas/ 'phrod bsten sogs spyi phan gnad don thag gcod byas/ da lta dbul khyim la las bzhon ma gso ba dang 'gyig shog tshod sle las pa/ la las phag lug gsos te gso spel khyim chen du gyur yod/ gnas spos zhing bas khor yug legs 'gyur bya ched nags mus510bskrun zhing sdong phrug khri10lhag btsugs/ rgya che'i mang tshogs dbul thar phyug 'gyur gyi lam du bgrod pa'i spobs sems je cher gyur/(1998lo'i zla12pa'i tshes24nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)— 98 —

'phrinagasar/ —da wayul shul gyis rmang gzhi'i 'dzugs skrun la shugs bsnan nas dbul skyor thad skul 'ded byas pa/gsar 'god pa/ blo bzang /zhing chen tang u dang zhing chen srid gzhung gis thugs khur byas 'ogardzong6gi nang rgyal khab kyis gtan khel byas pa'i dbul phongs rdzong4yod pa'i yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul gyis thog mtha' bar gsum du rtswa thang gi rmang gzhi 'dzugs skrun gtso bor bzung nas dbul skyor bya ba dam 'dzin byas/1994lo nas da lta'i bar khul yongs kyi dbul phongs mi grangs mi khri18 6nas mi khri5 5ru je nyung du song / dbul phongs rdzong gi rong 'brog pa mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo rkyang rkyang sgor505 7nas sgor736 8la 'phar/phyugs las gtso ba dang zhing phyugs zung 'brel gyi grangs nyung mi rigs 'dus sdod sa khul nas te yul shul khul nas rtswa thang gi rmang gzhi sgrig chas zhan zhing rang byung gnod skyon 'gog pa'i nus pa med la/ gnod skyon 'byung sla ba dang gnod skyon mang bas sa de'i dbul phongs khyim tshang je mang du gyur/de'i rkyen gyis yul shul khul u dang khul srid gzhung gis rmang ga'i sgrig chas la shugs snon pa gtso bo byas te/ 'bad brtson gyis mang tshogs kyi thon skyed cha rkyen dang skye khams khor yu/ga legs bcos sgos rang nyid 'phel rgyas kyi nus pa mthor 'degs btang / 1996lo nas bzung khul yongs kyis bsdoms pas —— 99 da

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/skyed yod dngul bun dang rgyal khab kyis rgud gsab las sprod ma dngul sogs ma dngul sna tshogs sgor dung phyur1 32btang ste/ rtswa thang gi‘‘cha sdeb bzhi'i’’gnod 'gog rten gzhi 'dzugs skrun thad bkol/ lo3nang du 'brog pa khyim tshang7660yis‘‘cha sdeb bzhi’’mngon 'gyur byas shing / bsdoms pas rtswa sa mus khri123la lcags dra bskor ba dang drod spyil mus gru bzhi ma khri37 6las/mus khri33lhag la gzan rtswa btab/ gtan sdod can gyi khang ba byed sa mus gru bzhi ma khri22 5las/ yul shul dang nang chen rong ma 'brog rdzong gnyis kyi dbul phongs mi grangs rgya che ba'i dngos gnas la dmigs te/ sa de ru zhing las phyogs bsdus gsar gtod rnam grangs skor3lag bstar byas shing / ma dngul sna tshogs sgor khri899btang bar/ 'bru rigs spyi rgya khri200'phar snon byung ba dang / rnam grangs khul gyi zhing ba'i mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor1000yan dang / mi re'i cha snyoms 'bru rigs thon tshad rgya ma 1000la bslebs/1995lor khangs gnod chen po byung ba'i rjes su phyugs zog nyung zhing yang na phyugs zog med pa'i khyim tshang skor zhig gis mgyogs myur ngang thon skyed slar gso byed thub ched/ kho tshos snga gzhug tu phyugs zog nyo ba'i ma dngul sgor khri7700btang ste/ thon skyed dang 'tsho bar spyod pa'i phyugs zog khri17 9nyos par/ khyim tshang khri1lhag dang mi khri5 4yi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i gnad don thag bcad/ de min hur thag gis zhing phyugs thon sbyor bzo las gtso ba'i dbul skyor rtsa 'dzugs btsugs/ bsdoms pas dbul skyor rtsa 'dzugs kyi rnam grangs108bkod sgrig byas la ma dngul sgor khri 1100lhag btang /1996lo nas da lo'i zla6pa'i zla mjug bar khul yongs kyis bsdoms ge 100 —

'phrinagasar/ da wad sngu da pas dbul skyor ma dngul sgor dung phyur1 56bkod sgrig byas par khyim du 'byor 'ing / dbul phongs khyim tshang khri2 8la khebs/ mig sngar yul shul dang nang chen/ 'bri stod/ rdza stod sogs rgyal khab kyis gtan khel byas pa'i dbul phongs rdzong gi mi rer cha snyoms su phyugs zog sna tshosas thob pa1994lo'i17 1nas19 4la 'phar/ yul shul dang nang chen rdzong gnyis kyi mi res cha snyoms su 'bru rigs thon skyed byas pa spyi rgya 101 4nas spyi rgya386 6la 'phar/(1999lo'i zla9ba'i tshes28nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)rma lho'i‘‘gser chu brgyud lam’ridu 'od 'cher mu tig star la brgyus pa/khul yongs su chu glog sa chigs12btsugs dang 'dzugs bzhin pa dang spyi'i glog 'don tshad chan wa khri1 45la bslebs/gsar 'god pa/ gangs dpal/na ning zla9bar rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rgya khyon ches che ba'i chu glog sa tshigs te ma dngul bsdoms pas sgor khri 3800btang ba dang glog 'don tshad chan wa450yod pa'i thun rin bos ba chu glog sa tshigs dngos su ba tsugs nas glog 'don 'go brtsams pas/ rma lho khul du chu'i thon khungs —— 10/ —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gsar spel byed pa'i tsha rlabs 'phyur pa mtshon/ mig snga'i bar du rma lho khul gyis chu glog sa tshigs bsdoms pas12btsugs dang 'dzugs bzhin pa dang /spyi'i 'phrul chas kyi glog 'don tshad chan wa khri 1 45dang lo 'khor gyi glog 'don tshad chan wa chu tshod khri1 12la mthor 'degs byung /rma lho khul gyi khongs su chu bo che chung60lhag yod pa dang rgya khyon chen po'i ngang gsar spel byas pa ni rong bo'i dgu chu dang gcan tsha rdzong khongs su bzhur ba'i rma chu gnyis yin pas/ de ni zhing chen yongs su ma zad rgyal yongs la mtshon na yang ming grags ldan pa'i ‘‘chu yi gter mdzod’’ du gyur 'duga'abrel yod ched mkhas pas tshod rtsis byas pa ltar na chu glog gi sbas shugs so sor chan wa khri36 8dang chan wa khri241yod pa red/ ‘‘glog shugs ni rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi yin pa dang glog shugs gong du spel tshad de dpal 'byor gong spel gyi myur tshad la reg las yod par bstun/ rma lho khul u dang khul srid gzhung gis gnas tshul 'dir dam por dmigs nas’’‘‘chung ba nas che ba dang / sla ba nas dka' ba/ brtan po'i ngang skul 'ded’’bcas kyi byed phyogs ltar phyogs so so nas ma dngul gsog nas chu glog sa tshigs 'dzugs skrun byas/ lo rabs70par 'phrul chas kyi glog 'don tshad chan wa2050yod pa'i the bar chu glog sa tshigs dang dgu rong mthil chu glog sa tshigs gnyis 'dzugs skrun byas/ lo rabs80pa nas bzung ste 'dzugs skrun gom stabs je mgyogs su btang nas snga gzhug tu 'phrul chas kyi glog 'don tshad chan wa3000yod pa'i chu khol chu glog sa tshigs dang 'phrul chas kyi glog 'don tshad chan wa1880yod pa'i sgo dmar chu glog sa tshigs/ 'phrul chas kyi glog 'don tshad chan wa5000yod pa'i g.yu rgan nyin chu glog sa tshigs/ glog 'don tshad chan wa2000yod pa'i hi nan rdzong mkhar gyi chu glog sa tshigs — 102 —

'phrinagasar/ da da sogs 'dzugs skrun byas/ glogs shugs can gyi 'dzugs skrun dang grong gseb kyi glog dra 'dzugs skrun byas pa brgyud de glog sgyur khang6dang glos sgyur tshad chan h+phu an9910la bslebs/ chan h+phu35can gyi glog skyel skud lam/ spyi le224 99'then pa dang chan h+phu10can gyi glog sgyur skud lam spyi le274'then nas shang dang sde bar glog 'byor tshad so sor100lhudang87lkol mthor 'degs byung / sa gnas kyi glog dra 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i rgya khyon rim ba'in je cher song ba dang bstun nas byang phyogs nas zhing chen gyi glog dra chen mo thun rin la son pa dang / lho phyogs nas zhing chen gyi glog dra chen mo rtse khog la son zhing / so sor spyi'i glog sgyur tshad chan h+phu an63000(3150022)can gyi glog sgyur khang gcig dang chan h+phu35can gyi glog skyel skud lam spyi le40 3dang chan h+phu10can gyi glog skyel skud lam spyi le33 6'then nas lho byang gi glog dra chen po gnyis 'brel mthud byas pas/ gzhi khyon che ba'i sa ga/nas glog dra stunog 66gabasdo/dus dang mnyam du rgyal khab kyi gnad sa bzo skrun sngo kyā 'gag chu glog sa'i tshigs las gzhan brag khang sna kha dang khang yang chu glog sa tshigs gnyis da lta 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa dang / sngo kyā 'gag lon kon khug chu glog sa tshigs dang nag kya chu glog sa tshigs/ gcan tsha san to pan chu glog sa tshigs sogs kyi rnam grangs da lta 'dzugs bzhin pa'i sgang red/(2000lo'i zla2pa'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/ rta'u rdzong gi 'pho 'gyur la mig zhags tsam 'phangs pa/gsar 'god pa/ dpal chen rgyal/ston rlung bsil mo dal bar ldang ba'i dus su/ nga rang rgyal yongs zhing ljongs lnga'i bod yig tshags par gyi rogs las gros tshogs thengs gnyis pa'i 'thus mi zhig gi ming thog nas/ rgyang ring si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul du phyin nas nyin 'ga'i ring slob sbyong dang lta skor byas/lugs gsar gyi zla9ba'i tshes 'gor/ gros tshogs kyi bkod sgrig ltar nga tsho rlangs 'khor la bsdad de rta'u rdzong la lta skor byed du song / rdzong gi mgo khrid rnam pas nga tshor sne len bzang bo byas shing / rdzong de'i gnas tshul mtshams sbyor byas/ lo na gzhon pa'i rdzong dpon gzhon pa lis phin gyis nga tshor bshad pa ltar na/ rta'u rdzong ni sa'i rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi7546yod pa dang / mi grangs bsdoms 'bor khri4 5yod la/ de'i nang bod rigs mi grangs kyis87lkozin yod/ mnga' khongs nang du mtshe'u dang chu tshan mang po yod cing / gsar spel ma byas pa'i rang byung yul ljongs dang mis bzos yul ljongs/ skye khams yul ljongs bcas yid du 'ong zhing thun mong ma yin par snang / bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byas tshun/ rta'u rdzong u dang rdzong srid gzhung gis gong rim gyi yang dag pa'i mgo khrid 'og skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pas gtan la phab pa'i byed phyogs — 104 —

'phrinagasar/ —r+ha——da da wasrid jus sna tshogs lag len dngos 'bebs nan tan byas pa dang / tang gi tshogs chen bco lnga ba'i dgongs don dang tang gi skabs bco lnga ba'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i chod don tan tig gis lag len du bstar nas/ rdzong yongs kyi dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang spyi tshogs las don sna tshogs hur thag 'bad thag gis gong du spol bas/ gong spel thad grub 'bras che tsam thob pa 'di lta ste/ 1990lo'i 'gyur med rin gong ltar brtsis na/ 1997lo1980lo dang bsdur na rgyal nang thon skyed spyi'i rin thang359 3lko'aphar ba dang / nor srid yong 'bab664 7ཿ'phar ba/ rong 'brog pa mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo467 4lko'aphar yod/ rdzong gi ma/nga' khongs kyi gzhung lam ang gu317pa'i spyi le150la snum snyigs btings pas/rlangs 'khor chung ba'i rigs nyin gcig tsam gyi nang du rdzong thos nas khrin tu'u ru 'byor thub par gyur cing / 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren gyi mgyogs tshad dang nure4 shugs che cher mthor 'degs byung / rdzong yo/ngas kyi mang(re khongs nang gi shang dang grong rdal gtso bo dag la 'od khrid skud lam 'then yod cing /de las rgyal yongs su thad kar kha par rgyag thub pa dang / lag thogs kha par lo 'di'i nang du mngon 'gyur byed thub pas/ 'phrin gtong sgrig bkod thad 'pho 'gyur chen po byung yod/ rdzong yongs su‘‘kha rim gnyis pa'i’’tshad gzhir bslebs/ pa la rdzong mi dmangs sman khang1yod pa dang / chus 'dro da bsten khang5dang / shang 'phrod bsten khang20 de min 'phrod bsten rims 'gog sa tshigs/ dang ma bu bde srung sa tshigs gcig re dang / 'char ldan btsa' skye mdzub ston sa tshigs1dang / gzhan da dung khe don las sde tshan so so'i sman gso khang bcas yod pas/ rdzong dang chus/ shang / sde ba bcas/ kyi sman bcos dra ba chags zin pas/ sman bcos stabs bde yin pa'i cha rkyen ga'i da 105 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/rtsa'i cha nas 'dzoms yod/lo rabs70ba'i tshun/ rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang gnad che sa'i 'dzugs skrun la rgyab rogs byed ched/ rta'u rdzong gis nags las thon khungs 'bel bor brten nas rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang nags las 'dzugs skrun la byas rjes chen po bzhag lo ngo20lhag gi ring du rta'u rdzong gis rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang gnad che sa'i 'dzugs skrun la shing cha mus rgya dpang gru bzhi ma khri380lhag 'don sprod byas/ rdzong rang nyid kyang ljong shing gcod par brten nas skyel 'dren dang sbyor babro gtsos pa'i nags las dpal 'byor gyis sne khrid pa'i‘‘shing cha'i nor srid’’rdzong nang gses kyi dpe mtshon can du gyur cing / las don sna tshogs kyang nags las dpal 'byor gyis sne khrid 'og gom stabs brtan po'i ngang yar 'phel rnam pa yag po shar/ nags las 'phel rgyas byung ba des rta'u rdzong gi 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren dang thon las gsum pa gong du 'phel bar skul 'ded chen po byas/ sngon chad shing cha mod po bcad pa de gzhung lam nas yul gru gzhan la skyel 'dren byed dgos stabs/ rdzong de'i sger gnyer skyel 'dren rlangs 'khor ha lam800la bslebs pa dang / de'i nang nas shing cha kho na skyel 'dren byed pa'i rlangs 'khor gyis99 21ཿ zin/ lo rer nags tshal skyel 'dren kho na'i yong sgo sgor khri3000lhag tu bslebs/ dus mtshungs su ljon shing gcod pa dang / sbyor bzo/ skyel 'dren/ phyir 'tshong bcas kyis tshong las dang bza' btung / 'grul khang las rigs la sogs pa'i thon las gsum pa 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar bskul te/ tshong zong 'khor rgyug je mgyogs su song ste tshong ra'ang dar rgyas byung /deng phyin gyi dpal 'byor gong spel gyi kha phyogs skor gleng tshe/ rta'u rdzong — 106 —

'phrinagasar/ brad wagi 'brel yod mgo khrid pas bshad rgyur/ rang rdzong gi rang byung yul ljongs dang mis bzos yul ljongs/ skye khams yul ljongs ni ha cang phun sum tshogs po zhig yin/ der brten rang rdzong gi rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi 'char 'god nang du'ang 'grim skyod gnas skor las rigs gsar spel gyi nang don ni kha gsal po'i sgo nas bris yod pa ma zad/ blo rtsa brtan po'i ngang nas‘‘'grim skyod gnas skor dpal 'byor la brten nas rdzong dar rgyas su gtong ba'i’’bsgrags tshig bton/ da lta snga rim gra sgrig gi 'go tshugs zin/(2000lo'i zla2pa'i tshes22nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas〈snyan zhu〉la gros zhib byed pa/nga chen dmangs 'thus skabs bdun pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba'i zur bris/gsar 'god pa/ dpal chen rgyal/nyin 'ga'i ring la/ zhing chen mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen skabs bdun pa'i kros tshogs thengs bzhi bar zhugs pa'i 'thus mi rnam pa tshos hrin krang cin ci phin gyis phul ba'i srid gzhung las don gyi snyan zhur gros 'ib nan tan byas/ kho tshos bltas na/ snyan zhu'i nang‘‘lnga bdun’’skabs kyi las don la phyogs sdom dang‘‘lnga brgyad’’skabs kyi las kun bkod sgrig byas pa tshang ma/ da 1()7 — —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dngos thog bden 'tshol yin pas/ rang zhing gi gnas tshul dngos dang mthun pa red snyam/ phyogs bzhi'i bya ba nan gyis 'dzin dgos/rma lho khul 'thus mi tshogs pa'i 'thus mi sangs rgyas kyis cin hrin krang gi srid gzhung las don snyan zhur dpyad pa zhib mo btang rjes bstan don/zhing chen yongs kyi‘‘lnga brgyad’’'char gzhi'i dmigs 'ben mngon du bsgyur na/ nges par du phyogs bzhi'i las ka legs sgrub byed dgos/ gcig ni gom gang mdun spos sgos bsam blo bcings 'grol btang nas/ dpal 'byor 'phel tshad rjes lus yin pa'i sa khul la gnas tshul dngos gzhir bzung ste srid jus je lhod du gtong dgos/ gnyis ni gom gang mdun spos sgos gsar gtod yar brtson gyi snying stobs je cher btang nas rgya che'i las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyis dka' spyad 'bad brtson byed dgos/ gsum ni gom gang mdun spos sgos 'jon thang can gso skyong byed par gtsigs chen byas te/phul du byung ba'i mi sna yar 'then byed pa de don chen zhig tu brtsis nas 'dzin dgos shing / rnam pa sna mang spyad de mi 'jon po dang lhag par du lag rtsal mi sna skyed sring dang nang 'dren yang byed dgos/ ba'i ni gom gang mdun spos sgos gzhi rim rtsa 'dzugs 'dzugs skrun byed par shugs bsnan nas tang gi lam phyogs dang byed phyogs/ srid jus bcas lag len dang dngos 'bebs byed par khag theg byed dgos/ rīslob gso legs 'dzin bya rgyu ni rim pa so so'i srid gzhung gi las 'gan gal chen zhig ded/zla4ba'i tshes27nyin gyi snga dro/ ma/go log khul 'thus mi tshogs/ pas srid da 108 da

'phrin gsar/gzhung las don gyi snyan zhur gros zhib byed skabs/ 'thus mi bsod nams tshe ring gis bshad rgyur/ mgo log dang yul shul khul gnyis zhing chen yongs kyi sa cha gzhan dang bsdur na dmigs bsal gyi sa khul zhig yin pas/ dmigs bsal gyi srid jus dang byed thabs kha shas yod pa byas nas sa khul de'i dpal 'byor gong du 'phel bar rogs skyor bya dgos/ dper na las byed pa brje res dang shes ldan mi sna skyed sring byed pa sogs kyis thad du bod ljongs kyi byed thabs kha shas la zur blta byas na/ mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor da gzod brtan brling ngang gong 'phel du gtong thub/ zhing chen gyis slob gso'i thog ma dngul sgor dung phyur gsum bkod sgrig byas yod pa de dgos mkho shin tu che sar spyod thub min ni gnad don chen po zhig red/ da lta dge rgan kha shas kyi byang tshad mi mtho bas nyi ma gtong thabs byed pa'i snang tshul gnas 'dug de'i stabs kyis 'dir rim pa so so'i tang u dang srid gzhung gis slob gso las ka mgo khrid la shugs bsnan nas/ ngo mas slob gso go gnas gal chen du bzhag nas 'dzin dgos par snyam/lag len gyi khrod du nyams myong phun sum chogs por gtong dgos/yul shul khul 'thus mi tshogs pa'i 'thus mi kru'u chin men gyis cin hrin krang gi srid gzhung las don gyi snyan zhu gros zhib byed skabs bshad don/snyan zhu'i nang du bshad pa'i‘‘nges par bcu’’ni rang re'i zhing chen gyi spyi'i phyogs sdom zhig red/ dus skabs shig gi ring la nga tshos sa khul gzhan pa dang / tha na rgyal khab gzhan pa'i nyams myong slob sbyong byed dgos tshul nan bshad byas pa mang drags pa dang / rang zhing gi las gnyer nyams myong phyogs sdom byed par do snang ma byas pa red/ deng phyin lag len gyi khrod du rgyun chad — 109 —d+ngha

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/med par nga tsho'i nyams myong phyogs sdom byas te phun sum tshogs por gtong dgos/ srid jus gtan 'jags yin dgos pa dang las gnyer thog rgyun mthud yod dgos/ lhag par du rang zhing gi gnas tshul ngos zin tshad gom gang mdun spos sgos gong 'degs byas te/ nan nan bcags bcags kyis thog ma'i dpyad gzhi byed thub pa byas na/ da gzod las ka legs sgrub byed thub pa red/(1991lo'i zla5ba'i tshes4nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)yid mthun spyod mthun gyis gros gzhi bzang po mnyam 'don byed pa/nga chen dmangs 'thus skabs bdun pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba'i zur bris/gsar 'god pa/ dpal chen rgyal/nyin 'ga'i ring la/ zhing chen dmangs 'thus skabs bdun pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi bar zhugs pa'i 'thus mi rnam pa tshos rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi las don la ha cang 'gan khur ba'i bsam pa bcangs nas/ srid gzhung dang 'char gzhi dang nor srid sogs gtso ba'i snyan zhu sna tshogs slob sbyong dang gros bsdur byed skabs/ rang rang gi bsam tshul lhag bsam zol med kyis lhug por bshad de/ bsam 'char bzang po mi nyung ba zhig bton pa — 110 —

9bzhiX/cadathanazlas/shā se/ ————red/rma lho khul gyi khul u'i hru'u ci'am 'thus mi sangs rgyas kyis rma lho khul gyi gnas tshul dngos gzhir bzung ste/‘‘lnga brgyad’’'char gzhi don thog tu dngos 'bebasabyed pa'i thad‘‘'brel ba bzhi’’thag gcod bzang po byed dgos pa dang /‘‘gcig gyur gsum’’lag len du bstar dgos pa/‘‘gnad che sa bzhi’’'bur du thon 'jug pa bcas re re bzhin bshad pa red/ mtsho lho khul gyi khul dpon nam 'thus mi pad+mas〈srid gzhung las don gyi snyan zhu〉yi nang kha gsab rgyag dgos sa gnyis yod pa'i skor bshad rjes bshad don/ gom gang mdun spos sgos bsam blo bcings 'grol btang nas/ srid jus lhod de hur por gtong ched/ zhing chen srid gzhung gis 'brel yod sde khag rtsa 'dzugs byas te rang zhing gis sngar las lhag par lhod por btang nas hur por 'gyur ba'i srid jus zhib 'jug gtan khel byas te/ tang krung dbyang si/sa rang re'i mi rigs sa khul du byin pa'i srid jus bed spyod gang legs byas nas rang zhing gi dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi gom stabs je mgyogs su gtong dgos zhes zer/mi rigs slob gso las don gong spel byed pa de ni 'thus mi mi nyung ba zhig gi brjod bya red/ mtsho byang khul 'thus mi tshogs pa'i 'thus mi sgrol ma dang len hru'u krang gnyis kyis bshad rgyur/ khul mi rigs/ dge thon slob grwa btsugs tshun/ khul dang rdzong la dge rgan ha cang mang po skyed sring byas/mig snga'i gnas tshul la bltas na/ khul dang rdzong la slob chung gi dge rgan gyis ha lam 'dang yod pa dang / dma' rim dang 'bring rim ched las lag rtsal mi sna skor zhig dgos mkho shin tu che bas/ shes ldan mi sna dkon pa'i gnad don thag gis gcod ched khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwar ched las da 111 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'dzin grwa gzhan pa 'dzugs rgyur zhing chen srid gzhung gis khas len gnang rgyu dang / dus mtshungs su khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwa'i nang du slob grwa chen mo'i ched sbyong 'dzin grwa btsugs nas/ khul dang rdzong gi slob 'bring la slob khrid mi sna skor zhig skyed sring byas te slob khrid kyi spus tshad gong 'degs byed rgyu'i gros gzhi bton/ 'thus mi me tog tshe ring gis gzhi rim gyi mi rigs mtshan 'dug slob grwa'i gnas tshul gleng skabs/ mi rigs slob gso las don gong spel ba'i khrod/ mi rigs mtshan 'dug slob grwas rmang gzhi'i las ka 'bor chen bsgrubs na yang / nye lam lo 'ga'i ring dngos gong je mthor song ba'i gnas tshul 'og mtshan sdod slob grwa'i slob ma'i 'tsho ba'i kha gsab rogs dngul da lta'i bar du je mthor ma btang bas/ 'brog dmangs kyis bu phrug slob grwar skyel ba'i brtson sems la gnod pa thebs yod pas/ zhing chen 'brel yod sde khag gis mi rigs mtshan sdod slob grwa'i slob ma'i 'tsho ba'i kha gsab rogs dngul je mang du gtong rgyu'i gros gzhi bton/rma lho khul 'thus mi tshogs pa'i 'thus mi ma kos lan gyis da lta gzhi rim gyi slob gso'i khrod du gnad don mi nyung ba zhig gnas pa dang / 'bur du thon pa ni gron dngul dkon pa de red/ dus mtshungs su slob chung gi slob deb nang du yig cho/ra mang ba dang nang don gcig mthun min pa'i gnas tshul yang yod pas/ slob khrid la shugs rkyen ngan pa bzos pas zhing chen gyi 'brel yod sde khag gis der gtsigs chen byed dgos zer/mtsho byang khul 'thus mi tshogs pa'i 'thus mi mus tun hrin sogs 'thus mi bco lngas mnyam 'brel sgos mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi chos lugs do dam khrims srol gtan khel bya rgyu'i skor gyi gros gzhi bton/ kho tshos bltas na/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum — 112 —

'phrinagasar/ ——rnge d+nghapa'i tshun/ tang dang rgyal khab kyi mi rigs dang chos lugs srid jus lag bstar dngos 'bebs ha cang bzang po byed thub pa byung ste/ chos dang mang tshogs kyi lugs dang mthun pa'i chos lugs bya 'gul la srung skyong thob nga/ dang /mi rigs so so'i bar gyi mthun sgril rgyun chad med par je dam du song yod pa'i dus mtshungs su/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i tshun du sa khul kha shas kyi mi nyung shas shig gis chos lugs bed spyad de srid 'dzin dang slob gso dang / khrims 'dzin sogs la the gtogs byas pa'i snang tshul mang po byung zhing / bsdu cha brgyab pa tshabs chen yin pas mang tshogs kyi khur po je ljid du btang ba dang /dbyi si lan chos lugs nang grub mtha' je mang je mang yin zhing / grub mtha' so so'i bar gyi 'gal ba nyin re bzhin tshabs chen du 'gro bzhin yod stabs/ zhing chen srid gzhung gis rang zhing gi gnas tshul dngos ga'ir bzung nas/ chos lugs khrims srol gtan khel byas te/ chos lugs kyi do dam de khrims lugs kyi 'khor lam nang du 'jug rgyu'i blang bya bton pa red/(1991lo'i zla5ba'i tshes6nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)go skabs gsar bas 'bod 'gug byed kyin yod/da wazhing chen gyi‘‘tshogs gnyis’’'go brtsams pa'i zur bris/gsar 'god pa/ dpal chen rgyal/dpyid kyi sgeg mo'i gom 'gros dang bsdebs par zhing chen mi dmangs — 113 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'thus mi tshogs chen skabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba dang zhing chen srid gros skabs bdun pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba gzab rgyas ngang tshogs 'go brtsams zin/zla4ba'i tshes6nyin gyi snga dror/ zhing chen yongs kyis dmangs gtso tang khag so so dang / mi dmangs tshogs pa dang rim gras so so nas 'ongs pa'i zhing chen srid gros kyi u yon rnams kyis ma 'ongs pa'i mdun ljongs la re snyeg byed pa dang yid ches kyis khengs pa'i gom stabs sgyur bzhin mdzes shing brjid nyams che ba'i mtsho sngon gros tshogs lte gnas su phyin/ da ni khong rnams kyis zhing chen yongs kyi dmangs 'thus tshogs chen skabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba'i 'thus mi rnams dang lhan du rang nyid kyi thabs jus lhug par brjod nas/ rang zhing gi deng phyin dus skabs shig ring gi thabs jus thag gcod pa/'i 'char gzhi chen mo ste/ 〈mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi rgyal dmangs dpa' 'byor dang spyi tshogs gong du spel ba'i‘‘lnga dgu’’'char gzhi dang2010lo'i rgyang ring dmigs 'ben gyi rtsa gnad〉gros zhib nan tan byed rgyu red/zla4ba'i tshes8nyin ni zhing chen mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen skabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba tshogs 'go rtsom pa'i nyin mo yin la/stod 'brog khul gyi phyugs las 'thab phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i 'thus mi yin na 'dra/ smad rong phyogs kyi zhing las sa khul nas phyin pa'i 'thus mi yin yang 'dra/ de min bzo gter khe las sam tshan rig zhib 'jug dang slob gso 'phrod bsten la sogs pa'i 'thab phyogs nas yong ba'i 'thus mi su dang su yin rung / tshang ma'i gdong la dga' ba'i 'dzum rgyas shing zhing chen yongs kyi mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyi re ba chen po yid la bcangs nas/ kha ba'i me — 114 —

'phrinagasar/ —stuthor+ha rter+hatog lhab lhub tu 'bab pa'i dwangs gtsang gi mkha' dbugs 'byin rngub byed ba'in/ gros tshogs lte gnas kyi them skas re rer 'bas zung gi ri mo bkod nas/ ma 'ongs pa jus 'god byed pa'i tshogs khang brjid nyams che ba'i nang du phyin/da reb kyi tshogs chen 'di gnyis gros tshogs gzhan dang mi gcig sa gangayin zhe na/ da lo ni‘‘lnga brgyad’’kyi grub 'bras thog nas‘‘lnga dgu’’'char gzhi lag len du bstar nas2010lo'i rgyang ring dmigs 'ben mngon du 'gyur bar rmang gzhi 'ding ba'i lo dang po yin pa de red/ phyi rol yul gyi gnas tshul dang mthun zhing lag len du bstar 'thus pa'i 'char ga'i ya/ga po zhi/ga gtan la 'bebs rgyu ni gal 'gangs che ba smos ci dgos/ de'i phyir da reb kyi gros tshogs chen po 'di gnyis ni rang zhing gi‘‘lnga dgu’’'char gzhi lag len du bstar ba dang2010lo'i rgyang ring dmigs 'ben mngon du sgyur bar cha mtshon na‘‘snum snon sa tshigs’’dang rgyug 'gran 'go tshugs sa gsar ba zhig yin pa 'thus mi dang u yon rnam pas mkhyen gsal red/de yang brjid rngam ldan pa'i rgyal rtags dang logs gnyis su bstar pa'i dar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i kru'u zhi stegs bu na zhing chen tang srid dmag gsum gyi mgo 'dren rnam pa dang kru'u zhi tshogs pa'i khongs mi rnams bzhugs yod cing / zhing chen dmangs 'thus rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin dpal 'byor tshe ring gis gros tshogs 'go brtsams pa khyab bsgrags pa dang /zhing chen srid gzhung gi hrin krang then khrin phen gyis tshogs chen la〈mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi rgyal dam/ngas dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs gong du spel ba'i‘‘lnga dgu’’'char ga'i dang2010lo'i rgyang ring dmigs 'ben gyi rtsa gnad skor gyi snyan zhu〉phul bar/ 'thus mi dang gros tshogs su zur zhugs/ byas pa'i srid da 115 da

— gomastabasadang zhabs rjes/gros u yon dang bcas pa tshang mas thal mo yang yang brdabs nas dga' spro dpag med skyes pa'i bsam tshul mngon par bstan/ma 'ongs pa'i mdun ljongs la bcangs pa'i re ba'i lcags kyu yis dus nam yang mi'i yid sems kyi a long 'dren par byed la/ ‘‘lnga dgu’’'go rtsom pa'i dus nas bzung / rgyal khab kyis sngar las lhag par nub rgyud sa khul 'phel rgyas su gtong bar rgyab skyor mdzad de/ shar rgyud dang nub rgyud sa khul bar du gnas pa'i gong spel gyi bar thag je nyer gtong bar phan pa'i srid jus rab dang rim pa lag tu bstar rgyu yin zhing / da lta rang re'i mtsho sngon ni sngar ba'in gong spel du gtong ba'i gnad sar gnas yod rkyen/ thon khungs kyis phyug pa'i nub rgyud kyi 'i/nga chen rtsis che'i go gnas bzung ba'i rang zhing gis 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i go skabs dkon po 'di 'chor du 'jus/ mi rung ba ni tshogs zhugs 'thus mi dang u yon yod do cog gi gcig gyur kyi shes rtogs red/mtsho sngon 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i go skabs bslebs byung / mdun lam ni 'od gsal ldan pa zhig yin zhing / bgrod lam ni kyag kyog che ba 'ig kyang yin/ deng 'dir nga tshos dpyid kyi sgeg mo'i 'jam yang gom 'gros dang bsdebs nas go skabs kyi a long la dam por 'ju thub par gyis shig(1996lo'i zla4ba'i tshes12nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)

'phrinagasar/ da wa dril sgrog 'du long nyin mo/da wa zi ling sa khul gyis srang lam nas mi rigs sam chos lugs srid jus dril sgrog bya 'gul spel ba'i gnas tshul zur bris/gsar 'god pa/ g.yang pa/rang zhing gi zhing chen rim pa'i las khungs dang zi ling sa khul nas spel ba'i mi rigs sam chos lugs srid jus dril sgrog bya 'gul gting zab tu 'phel bar 'gyur la/ zla9ba'i tshes12nyin/ zhing chen rim pa'i las khungs dang bca' sdod dmag dpung / slob grwa chen mo'am ched sbyong slob grwa/ sman khang / zi ling grong khyer gyi thad gtogs las khungs dang / mkhar shar/mkhar dkyil/ mkhar nub/ mkhar byang chus sogs kyi las khungs dang sde khag130lhag zi ling gi srang lam gtso shos rnams la song nas rgya che zhing sazab rgyas ldan pa'i dril sgrog bya 'gul thengs shig spel/ston dus kyi zi ling grong khyer ni mkha' dbyings g.ya' dag cing srang lam che chung 'gram gyi ljon shing dang skyed tshal/ thog khang tshang ma dag bkrus byas pa ltar gtsang zhing yid du 'ongs/ nyin de gza' spen pa ste ngal saso'i nyin mo yin rung / rgyun dang mi 'dra bar nangs snga mo nas rgya srang che gras rnams kyi gnyis 'gram du dril sgrog bya 'gul la zhugs pa'i mi rnams rim bzhin 'dus te/ tshang mas 'gel yig dang dril sgrog ri mo 'gel bar brel/—— 117 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/snga dro'i chu tshod10yas mas su bslebs dus/ nub srang chen mo'i glog brnyan brnyan 'phrin lte ba nas shar srang chen mo'i mi rigs mgron khang bar gyi srang lam dang rgyang bzhud rlangs 'khor sa tshigs/ lnga bzhi srang chen/ zha'o cha'o srang chen/ byang srang chen mo sogs la dril sgrog byed du yong ba'i las khungs dang sde khag rnams gcig 'phro gcig tu bsgrigs shing / rgya bod yig rigs gnyis kyis bris pa'i 'gel yig dang 'grem ston shing leb dang dril sgrog ri mo star du bsgrigs/ so so'i nang don gtso bo ni tin zha'o phen gzhung lugs dang tang gi tshogs chen bco lnga ba'am zhing chen tang gi tshogs chen thengs dgu ba'i dgongs don slob sbyong lag bstar byed pa dang sbrags nas/ tang gi mi rigs sam chos lugs srid jus kyi don snying 'bur du thon zhing mtsho sngon gyi khyad chos ldan la las khungs dang sde khag rang gi don dngos dang yang sbrel/ 'thab phyogs gcig 'gyur pu'u'i pu'u krang blo bzang / zhing chen tang u yi rgyun u'am dril sgrog pu'u'i pu'u krang then yon/ hrin krang gzhon pa ma'u tung hrin sogs mgo khrid blo mthun rnams kyang srang bar du yong nas 'tshang kha shig shig ngang 'grem ston la blta ba dang dril sgrog bya 'gul du zhugs pa'i mi rnams la 'tshams 'dri zhu bar bslebs/ khong tshos 'grem ston ri mor zhib mor lta dang dril sgrog byed pa'i gnas tshul la'ang zhib bka' 'dri byas/ zhing chen grangs nyung mi rigs tshan rtsal khyab gdal ru khag gi dril sgrog byed sa nas/ mgo khrid blo mthun rnams kyis ru khag de'i tshan rtsal khyab gdal thad kyi 'dra par la zhib mor bltas pa dang / ru khag de'i mgo khrid pas yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul khri 'du rdzong gi sprul sku rin chen tshe ring gis mang tshogs la tshan rig ltar zhing 'debs par skul slong dang rgyab skyor byas pa'i gnas tshul yar zhu la nyan rjes/ hru'u ci gzhon pa ya'o shang khrin gyis dga' spro'i ngang / 'di — 118 —

'phrinagasar/ da wani shin tu bzang ba'i gnas tshul zhig red/ 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul bzang bo dril sgrog byed shugs da dung mu mthud du je cher gtong dgos zhes bshad pa red/mgo khrid blo mthun rnams kyis chu tshod gnyis lhag gi ring du nub srang chen mo dang shar srang chen mo'i dril sgrog gnas tshul la lta zhib byas rjes/zhing chen tang u'i rgyun u'am 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u'i pu'u krang blo bzang gis bshad don/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis nam yin yang mi rigs chos lugs las don dang mi rigs sa khul gyi dar rgyas la do snang chen po byed bzhin yod tshul sogs dang sbrel nas srid jus lag bstar thad yid ches yod 'dug zer/(1998lo'i zla9ba'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)'di las tang gi thugs khur zab mo mchon pa/da wa krung dbyang brnyan 'phrin khang gi sems dang sems sbrel sgyu rtsal tshogs pas rang zhing du 'tshams 'dri 'khrab ston byas pa'i brnyan 'phrin la bltas pa'i zur bris/gsar 'god pa/ krang zha'o me/zla8pa'i tshes19nyin gyi dgong mo'i chu tshod8dang skar ma11thog krung — 119 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dbyang brnyan 'phrin khang gis‘‘sems dang sems sbrel’’sgyu rtsal tshogs pas mtsho sngon du 'khrab ston byas pa'i gnas tshul bstan byung / gsar 'god pas sngon du kha chad byas yod pa'i zi ling gi bod rigs bza' chas srang lam du mgron khang gnyer ba'i a ma tshe mo skyid tshang du bcar 'dri byas/ a ma tshe mo skyid ni lo 'ga'i sngon du them chen rdzong gi tshong las sde khag nas las 'khyur ngal gso byas pa'i las byed pa rgan pa zhig yin pa dang / da lor mo lo63red/dgong mo der mo'i bza' mi che ma chung gsum brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas kyi mtha' nu bskor nas‘‘sems dang sems sbrel’’sgyu rtsal tshogs pa'i 'khrab ston gnas tshul ston rgyur sgug pa dang / ston 'go brtsams pa dang chabs gcig tu thog mar kho tsho'i mthong lam du shar ba ni mtsho sngon po'i 'gram ngogs su btsugs pa'i tshogs ra gtso bo'i rngam brjid dang ngang tshul dga' spro 'khol ba de dag red/ char ba babs rjes kyi mtsho sngon po ni de bas mdzes sdug dang de bas nyams dga' ba zhig red/ 〈dga' spro'i ngang lhan du 'dzoms byung〉zhes pa'i glu dbyangs khrod glu ba glu ma skad grags can lis ku'u dbyi dang li'u hon ma dang / sun tsu'u dbyin sogs rtar bzhon nas tshogs rar yong dus/rigs so so'i ltad mo bas kho tshor bkra shis pa'i mtshon byed kha btags dkar po phul ba mthong rjes/ a ma tshe mo skyid bza' mi gang bo'i sems khong du bde skyid dang dga' spro ldan song /brnyan 'phrin las glu ma lis ku'u dbyi dang rgya mo skyid gnyis kyis glu len dus/ a ma tshe mo skyid kyis brtse dung zab mos bshad don/ ‘‘glu ma rnams kyis krung dbyang gi thugs khur dang du blangs te mtho sgang du dbyang dbugs mi 'dang bar ma 'dzems par brtse dung zab mo'i ngang nga tshor 'khrab ston byas pa 'dir nga tshor sems 'gul chen po thebs/ kho tshos da rung spyi le800yod pa'i — 120 —

'phrinagasar/ da gor mo grong khyer du song ste mtsho bod lcags lam gyi las bzo par 'tshams 'dri 'khrab ston byas pa dang mtsho byang bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi gser ngangul thang du song ste 'brog pa mang tshogs la 'khrab ston byas pa 'di tshang ma tang krung dbyang gis nga tsho mtsho sngon gyi rigs so so'i mi dmangs dang‘‘sems dang sems sbrel ba’’mtshon pa dang / 'di ni mi rigs mthun sgril gyi 'du tshogs gzab rgyas shig yin pas/ ngas nub rgyud gsar spel chen po nang nas mang tshogs la zhabs zhu yag po bya rgyu yin zer/brnyan 'phrin las 'khrab ston pa tsho mtsho byang du 'byor ba mthong rjes mag pa blo rgyal tshe ring gis bshad don/ ‘‘sems dang sems sbrel’’sgyu rtsal tshogs pa thengs 'dir mtsho sngon du 'khrab ston la yong bar ma zad/ zhing chen gcig gi nang du tshogs ra gtso bo gcig dang yan lag tshogs ra gnyis btsugs pa 'di thengs dang po red/ 'di las tang gis mtsho sngon gyi rigs so so'i mi dmangs la sems khur mdzad pa mtshon/‘‘sems dang sems sbrel’’sgyu rtsal tshogs pa'i 'khrab ston la bltas rjes/bu mo chung ba lha mo sgrol mas bshad don/ ‘‘sems dang sems sbrel’’sgyu rtsal tshogs pa mtsho sngon du yong nas 'khrab ston byas pa 'dis phyi phyogs la mtsho sngon gyi bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed dang deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun dang / de min skye khams khor yug srung skyong thad kyi 'dzugs skrun dang nub rgyud gsar spel chen po'i khrod kyi mtsho sngon gyi go gnas gal chen dang mtsho sngon la yod pa'i thon khungs/ zhing chen yongs kyi rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyis mthun sgril 'bad brtson dang / gsar gtod yar rgyas brtson len byed pa'i snying stobs bla na med pa dril bsgrags dang / mtsho sngon gyi yun ring bo'i lo rgyus dang mi rigs rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa yod par dril bsgrags byed pa bcas la nus pa da 121 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gal chen thon thub pa red/(2001lo'i zla8pa'i tshes22nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)ya mtshan ltad mo 'di na mchis/da wa zhing chen gyi grangs nyung mi rigs srol rgyun las rtsal 'gran tshogs skabs gnyis pa'i zur bris/gsar 'god pa/ nyi ma/thengs 'di'i 'gran tshogs nang zhugs pa'i sa gnas so so'i 'thus tshab tshogs pa'i lus rtsal pa bsdoms pas mi543yod pa dang / gzhan rtsa 'dzugs pa dang ram 'degs zhabs bro pa sogs mi2000las brgal/ 'go brtsams pa'i mdzad sgo'i steng / khul dang sa gnas so so'i 'thus tshab tshogs pa tshogs ra'i nang du gral bsgrigs nas yong dus/ mtsho byang gi zhabs bro dang rma lho'i rnga 'cham/ mgo log gi gzab gos dang mtsho nub gi sog po'i gyal pa/gzhan rgya rigs kyi dbyang ko zhabs bro dang gzi brjid rnga sbubs sogs ni rang rang gi thog ma'i gtam gleng tshul du gyur cing / 'gran tshogs kyi rgya khyon che ba ni der 'dus mgron po tshang ma'i bsam yul las 'das/lus rtsal 'gran tshogs ni spyir mi rnams kyi sems rtsa g.yo bar byed pa'i bya 'gul zhig yin rung / grangs nyung mi rigs kyi srol rgyun gyi lus rtsal 'gran tshogs ni lhag par du snying chung kha ru bton pa zhig 'dug rta thog nas — 122 —

'phrinagasar/ da da kha btags len pa'i 'gran bsdur nang / mtsho byang gi lus rtsal pa 'ig ni mi rta bar du g.ying 'dug pa ltar/ lus g.yas su 'gyu na g.yas sa'i kha btegs re lag tu blangs pa dang / lus g.yon du 'gyu nas g.yon zur gyi kha btags blangs par lta skabs ltad mo ba rnams kyis rta ba rta thog nas lhung bar ngogs te kha nas ha ho sna tshogs byung / yul shul gyi lus rtsal pas zur gcig gi kha btags mang tsam blangs nas yar rta thog tu 'bud dus rta yi gom pa 'khyol tsam byung bas kyang ltad mo ba rnams had sang nger btang /zi ling lho sgo gnyis pa'i lus rtsal khrom du spel ba'i rkang gcu dang sbe ga 'gran bsdur ni de las kyang dza drag che/ skyes pho rgod ni rtsal dang lus stobs la mos pa che bas der ltad mor yong ba mang shos skyes pa red/ sbe ga zer ba ni bod lugs kyi shed shugs 'gran bsdur yin la de ni dpung ba'i shed dang lus shugs kho nar brten nas gzhan de sar rgyag pa las rkang gcu rgyag mi chog de ni 'gran bsdur gyi dus yun thung yang lus rtsal pa'i stobs shugs yongs rdzogs cig car du bton pas dza drag shin tu che/'gran tshogs 'dir yong ba'i lus rtsal pa mang che ba ni rgyun du 'ing phyugs gang rung gi las ka las pa'i mi ser dkyus ma sha stag red/ the ped kyi ang dang po len mkhan ta thun ru khag gi ye kran te ni rgyun du lus rtsal gyi rnam pa der dga' bar ma gtogs 'thus tshang ba'i sbyong brdar thengs gcis kyang thob ma myong ba zhig yin par brjod/ yul shul nu khag gi skal bzang zla ba dang tshe ba gnyis kyis rta thog nas kha btags len pa'i 'gran bsdur gyi ang gnyis pa dang gsum pa blangs kyang / rgyun du dus chen dang lo gsar gyi skabs las 'di 'dra'i rtsal sbyong ba'i dus tshod ye nas med zer/mgo log ru khag gi lus rtsal pa rnam rgyal ni da lor lo14las son med/'on kyang ru khag de'i lo ches mtho ba'i lus rtsal pa ni da lor lo52la lon yod — 123 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/zer/ byis pa rnam rgyal ni mi la kha brda byed dus ngo gnong ba'i nyams tshul mang po bstan yang / 'do ba rta yi rgyab nas rta rtsal la byang chub pa dang spobs pa ldan pa zhig 'dug/(2001lo'i zla8pa'i tshes24nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)tshan rig dang slob gso ni mtsho sngon dar rgyas su gtong ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin pa/da wa ‘‘tshogs chen gnyis’mikyi 'thus mi dang u yon gyis tshan slob skor gleng pa'i zur bris/gsar 'god pa/ tshe dpal rgyal/nub rgyud gsar spel chen po'i 'thab jus lag tu bstar dgos na tshan rtsal dang slob gso ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin pas/ ‘‘tshogs chen gnyis’’kyi skabs su hrin krang kra'o li ci yis phul ba'i srid gzhung las don skor gyi snyan zhu yin na'ang 'dra/ 'thus mi dang u yon rnams kyis thabs bton jus 'bul yin na'ang 'dra/ tshang mas‘‘tshan slob la brten nas mtsho sngon dar rgyas su gtong ba'i’’'thab jus la thugs khur byed bzhin yod pa ngang ngam shugs kyis rtogs thub/ yin na'ang / sa khul kha shas dang sde khag la la'i bsam pa'i ngos zin da rung mi 'dang ba dang zhan sa gang mang yod/ de'i — 124 —

khuraXnyezugab/skyu bsdo/ da wa phyir/ ‘‘tshogs chen gnyis’’la zhugs pa'i 'thus mi dang u yon rnam pas tshan slob thad la rang rang gi lta tshul dang byed thabs lhug por brjod/u yon grub mchog gis bshad rgyur/ ‘‘snyan zhu’’las bton pa'i dmigs 'ben dang las 'gan legs 'grub byed dgos na dmangs yongs kyi slob gso khyab gdal thad shugs snon pa dang / tshan rig zhib 'jug gi dpung sde'i byang tshad mthor 'degs/ mgo khrid las byed pa'i tshan rtsal 'du shes je drag tu gtong ba bcas kyi phyogs gsum nas bzung ste/ nub rgyud gsar spel chen po dang/510nang zhugs pa'i go skabs gang legs sgos bed spyad nas mtsho sngon gyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang spyi tshogs phyogs yongs nas yar thon yong bar skul 'ded byed dgos/'thus mi kun g.yang gis bshad rgyur/ slob gso ni dpal 'byor dang las don sna tshogs 'phel rgyas su gtong ba dang / 'brog dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad je mthor gtong ba'i gnad 'gag cig red/ mgo log gi dpal 'byor ltos bcas kyis rjes lus yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni slob gso rjes lus yin pa dang shes ldan mi sna dkon zhing / tshan rig lag rtsal gyi 'dus tshad dma' ba'i rkyen red/ tshan rtsal dang slob gso'i sgrig gzhi bcos— bsgyur byed pa dang rang zhing gi dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs kyi gong 'phel ji ltar zung 'brel dam po byed pa/ tshan rtsal yar thon dang shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed pa don thog tu 'khyol ba sogs kyi phyogs su nga tshor bye brag can dang phan nus ldan pa'i byed thabs dkon pa red/'thus mi nor bu dang dpa' thul gnyis kyis bshad don/ 'bros khul gyi dmangs sgrub dge rgan khongs mi ngo mar gyur pa dag ched las blang bya chu tshad du son dka' zhing 'brog pa sa cha'i slob gso mar 'grib kyi rnam pa mngon — 125 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bzhin yod/ rang sa cha'i slob grwa chen mo ba dang ched las slob grwa las mthar phyin pa'i slob ma sa cha gzhan du phyin pa'i gnas tshul cung zad tshabs chen yin zhing / yon tshad mtho la nus pa ldan pa'i shes ldan mi sna 'brog pa sa cha nas chags dka' ba red/ da lta 'brog khul gyi kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur pa'i gnas tshul zhig ni slob lo ran pa'i byis pa mang po slob grwar 'grim dka'/rgyu mtshan gtso bo zhig ni dbul phongs khyim tshang skor zhig la slob yon sprod rgyu med pa'i rkyen red/ de'i phyir/ zhing chen tang u dang zhing chen srid gzhung gis dmigs bsal gyi srid jus gtan 'beb byas te nor srid dang ched spyod ma dngul/ dmangs khrod thebs rtsa sogs phyogs mang po las ma dngul bsdus te mtsho sngon lho rgyud 'brog khul du slob gso'i ma dngul gtong ba'i shugs tshad je cher gtong dgos/'thus mi kra'o khrin zhin dang skal bzang gnyis kyi bsam par spyi tshogs yongs kyis slob gsor do snang dang slob gsor ma dngul btang nas rgyab skyor byas na rang zhing gi slob gso da gzod gong 'phel chen po 'byung nges/shes ldan mi sna gso skyong dang bsdu len/ bkol spyod bzang po bcas byed pa ni 'thab jus las 'gan gal chen zhig yin te/ slob gso ni shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i rmang gzhi yin pas gong spel chen po 'ong dgos/ slob grwa'i rmang gzhi sgrig chas kyi 'dzugs skrun de gzugs brnyan bzo bkod gal chen zhig tu brtsis te slob grwa'i sgrig gzhi legs sgrig dang stobs shugs yod tshad kyis myur mkho'i shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed dgos snyam/u yon gcod pa don grub kyis bshad rgyur/ spyi tshogs gong 'phel du song bar bstun/ mi rnams kyis rig gnas 'tsho ba'i thad la re ba chen po bcangs yod/ rig gnas 'tsho ba'i spus tshad dang nus pa sngar las je cher — 126 —

'phrinagasar/ da wa'agro bzhin yod pas mi rigs skad yig las ka shugs snon byed dgos/ khos bsam par/ nye ba'i lo 'gar rang zhing gi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad rigs dang yi ge la mthong chen byas pa mi 'dang zhing / mi rigs sa khul gyi yig rmongs pa je mang du 'gro bzhin yod la mi rigs skad yig gi khyab bongs je chung du 'gyur bzhin yod pas/ rjes phyogs su mi rigs kyi skad rigs dang yi ge la shugs snon byas te grangs nyung mi rigs las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyi tshan rig rig gnas byang tshad mu mthud du mthor 'degs byas te spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun gyi dgos mkho dang 'tsham pa byed dgos/(2002lo'i zla1po'i tshes26nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)rkyang sul shang gi deng rabs phyugs las kyi dpe ston rten gzhi/gsar 'god pa/ rgya mtsho/gung ho rdzong rkyang sul shang ni mtsho sngon po'i lho 'gram gyi phyugs las shang zhig yin/ mtsho bod gzhung lam shang de'i dgun sa nas brgyud pas/ 'grim 'grul dang cha 'phrin gyi cha rkyen cung zad bzang ba dang / 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod thad kyi 'dzugs skrun brtson sems dang tshong khrom 'du shes kyang sngon thon yin phyir/ gtan chags khang gzhis sogs cha — 27 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/sdeb 'dzugs skrun byed snga shos kyi gras yin/ 2000lor mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung gis shang de'i rmog ru gong ma sde ba deng rabs can gyi rtswa thang phyugs las dpe ston rten gzhir 'dzugs rgyu gtan khel byas rjes/ rong 'brog pa mang tshogs hur brtson gyis 'dzugs skrun nang du zhugs/deng rabs can gyi rtswa thang phyugs las dpe ston rten gzhi ni cha sdeb bzhi mngon du bsgyur ba'i rmang gzhi nas gsar du lag bstar byed bzhin pa'i las gzhi zhig yin la/ der gnyis spyod phyugs khang dang rtswa thang du chu gtong ba bcas 'dus/ lo 'ga'i nang zhing chen dang khul gyi 'brel yod sde khag gis mdzub ston dang rogs ram 'og shang des tshad mtho'i drod srung phyugs khang86ste mus gru bzhi ma14000las/ der rtswa mdzod khang dang phyugs ra dang dra bskor rtswa ra bcas sdeb sgrig byas pas/ phyugs zog la dgun brgal gzan rtswa 'dang tshad yod pa ma zad/ da dung gnod 'gog phyugs skyob la yang cha rkyen bzang bo zhig bskrun/dus mtshungs su rtswa sar chu gtong ba dang mi phyugs gnyis kyi 'thung chu'i bzo skrun lag tu bstar nas/ rtswa'i skye tshad mthor 'degs dang rtswa sa ngan 'gyur 'gog bcos/ sa chu srung 'dzin/ khor yug bcos skyong bcas la cha rkyen bskrun/ mig snga'i bar/ chu tun500shong ba'i chu mdzod cig las te chu sbug dang chu gtor mchu to dang chu gtong sa sogs sdeb sgrig byas yod pas/rtswa sar chu gtong rgyu de stabs bder bzos/ da lta mus re'i rtswa thon tshad sngon chad las ldab2 5mthor 'degs byung ste mus rer rtswa spyi rgya233thon thub/ mi phyugs kyi 'thung chu'i bzo skrun nang du/ chu tun30shong ba'i chu mdzod cig dang chu sbug mus8100dang chu len sa5bcas kyi sgrig bkod mngon 'gyur byas — 128 —

'phrinagasar/ da yod pas/ khyim tshang45ru chu yong ba dang phyugs zog gi dgun chu'i gnad don thag bcad/ rmang gzhi de nas2002lo nas da lo'i bar yang rmog ru zhol ma sde bar tshad mtho'i gnyis spyod phyugs khang40las pa dang / gtan chags khang gzhis dang phyugs dang rtswa ra bcas sdeb sgrig byas pa dang gzhis spyod phyugs khang la'ang chu dang glog 'then yod/mig snga'i bar deng rabs rtswa thang phyugs las dpe ston rten gzhi'i thad ma dngul sgor khri702 4btang ba dang / mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen je legs su gyur/ 'brog khul gyi 'byor 'bring spyi tshogs khyon yongs nas 'dzugs skrun byed par ma dpe yag po bzhag pa red/(2003lo'i zla9ba'i tshes18nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)rmog ru zhol ma sde ba'i bkra shis/gsar 'god pa/ ban de tshe ring /nga tsho gsar 'god pa'i tsho chung rkyang sul shang gi rmog ru zhol ma sde ba'i gsar du 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa'i 'brog grong der thon/ 'brog grong de ni gzhung lam109yi byang ngos kyi mtsho sngon po sbra gur mgron khang si nye gam du chags yod/ nga tsho gnas der thon skabs su khyim tshang20yi ar 'dam dang so phag gis grub pa'i khang ba 'grub la nye zhing / de dang cha 'grig pa'i tshad da 29 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gzhi mtho ba'i go nyis chod drod khang dang tshod ma 'debs sa'i drod khang dang lug ra sogs yongs su 'grub yod par ma zad/ khyim rer gzan rtswa mus30re yod pa'i skye tshul ha cang bzang / rgyus lon pa ltar na/ 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa'i khang ba dang drod khang sogs ni las gzhi'i rnam grangs su gtogs pa dang / cha snyoms byas na khyim re'i mi khang la mus gru bzhi ma135yod pa dang go nyis chod drod khang la mus gru bzhi ma225dang lug khang la mus gru bzhi ma150bcas kyi tshad longs pa las yod par ma zad glog dang rang 'bab chu sogs 'then yod/ khyim tshang res bsdoms pas ma dngul sgor khri12lhag btang la de'i nang du50lkorgyal khab kyis btang ba yin zer/ nga rang go nyis chod drod khang dang tshod ma 'debs sa'i chu shog khebs bya re rer blta ru 'gro ba'i skabs su 'brog pa zhig gis rang 'bab chu drangs nas tshod mar chu gtong bzhin yod pa mthong / kho dang kha brda byas pa brgyud nas kho'i ming la bkra shis zer ba dang kho tshang la bza' mi bdun yod pa shes/ khos bshad pa ltar na las gzhi 'di brtson len byas rjes sde ba'i mi rnams las ka'i nang zhugs par rang 'dod kyis ming bkod cing ming bkod pa'i snga gzhug ltar bgos pa red/ nged tshang gi dpal 'byor cha rkyen de 'dra bzang rgyu med na'ang rgyal khab kyis ma dngul 'di 'dra mang po zhig gtong bzhin yod pas 'di lta bu'i srid jus bzang po zhig gang na yod/ khang ba sogs las pa ngo mas bzang 'dug rang gis lus tshegs dang sems tshegs byed mi dgos par shang srid gzhung gis gcig gyur 'char 'god byas nas las bzhin yod pas rang nyid nang du 'bab rkyang red/ da lta nga tsho sde ba'i khyim tshang mang po zhig gis las gzhi 'di brtson len byed kyin yod zer/ khos da dung dngul khang nas sgor mo cung tsam bskyis te khang ba gsar ba'i nang cha 'grig pa'i ca lag — 130 —

'phrinagasar/ da da nyo rtsis yod pa dang khang gsar la ca lag rnying ba bzhag na yag po min tshul dang rta khug kyang sga ma khug pa'i dpe ltar gzhan gyis 'phya dmod kyang byed srid tshul/ yang na kho tshang la lug400lhag dang nor50lhag yod pas lo rer sgor khri3lhag gi yong sgo yod pa dang rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen 'di 'dra bzang bas nor lug tsho gso byas te phyir btsongs na yong sgo je mang du 'gro thub tshul sogs lhug par bshad/ rmog ru zhol ma sde bar mtshon na khyim tshang phal che ba'i cha rkyen 'os 'tsham zhig red/ phyugs las kyi zhor du sa zhing 'debs pa dang tshong gnyer ba sogs byed bzhin yod pas sde ba yongs kyi mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor4300lhag la bslebs pa dang de'i khar las gzhi 'di lta bu brtson len byas pas na 'brog pa rnams kyi cha rkyen mgyogs myur ngang je mthor 'gro nges/(2003lo'i zla11pa'i tshes28nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)thun te rdzong gis kher sger gnyer khe las shuṭa chen pos 'phel rgyas su btang bas grub 'bras mngon gsal thob pa/gu grags rgyal/thun te rdzong gis ma dngul gtong ba'i khor yug legs bcos byas te/phyi'i tshong gnyer mkhan‘‘rkang 'dzugs par’’nang 'dren dang / sa gnas rang da 131 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gi kher sger gnyer khe las brtan brling ngang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar skul 'ded byas/sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/ na ning gi lo mjug bar du/ rdzong yongs kyi kher sger gnyer bzo tshong khyim tshang710la 'phel rgyas su song ba dang / ma dngul sgor khri1200tho 'god byas la/ lo 'khor gyi tshong gnyer ma dngul sgor khri3412yin/ thon rin sgor khri243bskrun nas sa gnas rang la yong sgo sgor khri138'phar snon byas/ sger gnyer khe las khyim tshang15yod la/ ma dngul sgor khri386tho 'god byas yod pa dang / lo 'khor gyi las gnyer ma dngul sgor khri409dang / thon rin sgor khri290bskrun pa dang / khral dngul sgor khri30phul/ da lo yang thun te rdzong hong ta so phag tshad yod kung zi dang thun te rdzong rig he tshad yod kung zi2la khe las gsar ba'i tho 'god byas/ kher sger gnyer khe las rnams khor yug legs po'i khrod rgyun chad med par 'phel rgyas dang stobs ldan du gyur la/ thun te rdzong gi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang rong 'brog khul gyi ngal rtsol pa lhag ma dang mkhar grong gi las rkang nas babs pa yang bskyar las kar tshud pa'i phyogs su nus pa mngon gsal bton/ na ning kher sger gnyer khe las kyis las rkang nas babs pa'i las bzo ba so sor mi43dang54bsdu len byas la/ mkhar grong babro tshong khyim tshang gi skul khrid 'og rong 'brog pa'i tshong gnyer dpung sde khyim tshang95dang mi 120la bslebs/sger gnyer khe las kyis da dung spyi tshogs la yod tshad phul ba dmigs yul byas te/ hur thag gis dbul skyor dka' sel dang ma dngul zhal 'debs su phul ba sogs kyi bya 'gul nang zhugs nas/ ma dngul sgor21000zhal 'debs su phul bas/ spyi tshogs steng yongs khyab kyi bstod bsngags thob/(2004lo'i zla7pa'i tshes8nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)— 132 —

'phrinagasar/ r+had bkag lug skyong bar mkhas pa'i sgrol ma skyabs/gsar 'god pa/ phag mo tshe brtan/sa bab mtho ba'i hi nan rtswa thang du dpyid ka'i gnam zla tsam mthong mi thub pa ma zad/ da rung kha ba lhab lhub 'bab kyin 'dug kha ba bu yug khrod du phyugs rdzi 'ga' shas gsar 'god pa'i mig lam du snang la/ 'di 'dra'i nam zla'i nang nor lug gi rjes bsnyegs mi dgos par rdzong mkhar du drod bang nang nas bkag lug gso ba'i 'brog pa ste sgrol ma skyabs zer ba 'ig yod pa shes nas nga tsho bsam bzhin du kho btsal nas song /lo ngo12kyi sngon la sgrol ma skyabs kyis hi nan rdzong brag dmar shang kyu rim sde ba nas rdzong mkhar du gnas spar nas skams lug tsho gso byed pa'i lam la zhugs/ mus gru bzhi ma200can gyi drod khang nang du sha shed rgyas pa'i 'brog lug100phrag longs pa bag yang ngang nyal 'dug sgrol ma skyabs kyis gsar 'god par bshad rgyur/ 'di ni ngas gsos pa'i 'brog lug yin la/mi 'gyangs par btsong chog lug gcig btsongs na khe spogs nyung na sgor50dang mang na sgor70nas80lhag lon srid pa dang skor thengs 'di btsongs na khe spogs rkyang ba sgor7000lhag yod nges/ lo rer ma mtha' yang thengs gsum nas bzhi ru tsho gso byas nas btsong thub song na yong sgo sgor20000nas sgor30000len thub pa red/— 33 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gsar 'god pas sgrol ma skyabs la rtswa thang nas rdzong mkhar du spar nas skams lug tsho gso byas na dge mtshan gang dag ldan zhes dris tshe/ khos bshad rgyur/ ‘‘gcig ni phyugs las thon las can du bsgyur bde ba ste/ sngon chad ston dus kho nar btsongs pa de da lta dus tshigs bzhi bor btsong chog pa'i phyogs su gyur yod/ gnyis ni rdzong mkhar du bsdad na rang nyid kyi mthong rgya dang thos rgya'ang bskyed thub pa las gzhan 'tsho ba'i thad ha cang stabs bde yin/ gsum ni rtswa sa bye thang du 'gyur bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir rtswa sa'i gnon shugs je yang dang skye khams thad srung skyong byed par yang phan/’’lo ngo12kyi yar sngon du sgrol ma skyabs tshang ni nor lug gnyis ka400ma gtogs med pa'i 'brog pa dkyus ma zhig yin la/ da lta khos rdzong thog tu sgor68000btang nas khang gsar las yod pa las gzhan/ bu dang bu mo rdzong thog gi slob grwar bskyal nas/ mkhar grong gi byis pa dang 'dra ba'i slob gso myong bzhin 'dug de'i skor gleng skabs/ kho'i gdong la bcos min gyi dga' nyams shig shar yong zhing / de ni kho'i mi tshe 'di'i ches don snying ldan pa'i grub 'bras shig tu brtsi bzhin yod pa shes thub/de snga hi nan rtswa thang gi 'brog pa dkyus ma zhig yin pa'i sgrol ma skyabs ni da lta hi nan rdzong 'brog pa'i mthun tshogs nang skams lug tsho gso byed pa'i 'gan khur yod pas/ rgya che'i 'brog pa mang tshogs 'byor 'bring gi lam du bskyod pa'i sne khrid lta bur gyur yod/(2004lo'i zla9ba'i tshes20nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)

'phrinagasar/ da byis pa'i mdun lam bsams nas mkhar grong du yong ba/gsar 'god pa/ phag mo tshe brtan/thun rin rdzong chu khog shang dgon shul sde ba nas thun rin rdzong thog tu yong nas tshong gnyer ba'i tshe ring skyid ni da lo lo37yin/ mo tshang la kho bza' zla gnyis dang bu gcig dang bu mo gnyis bcas bza' mi lnga yod/ ‘‘mi sum cur bsam pa sum cu dang mdzo sum cu ra kha drug cu’’zhes pa'i dpe bzhin/ mi rnams mkhar grong bsnyegs pa'i dmig yul yang mi 'dra/ lo bcu'i yar sngon du mos pha sa drin mo che rgyab du bskyur nas rdzong thog tu khyim gzhi spar te/ byis pa rnams slob grwar bskyal ba dang/ dus mtshungs su 'tsho ba rol ched da yod kyi tshong khang de gnyer 'go brtsoms/ gsar 'god pa mo tshang gi 6‘dgon shul 'bri mar ba mar sna mang tshong khang’’du thon skabs/ tshong bdag tshe ring skyid kyis brel 'tshub che ba'i ngang nyo mkhan rnams la dngos rdzas 'tshong bzhin pa'i sgang red/ gsar 'god pa'i mo la bcar 'dri byed par sgug pa'i skar ma bcu yas mas su mos ma mtha' yang 'bri mar rgya ma sum brgya tsam brtsang tshar ba dang/ mo'i gdong la 'dzum gyis khengs bzhin gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri dang len byas/ gsar 'god pas tshong bdag la mkhar grong du yong ba'i brgyud rim skor 'dri skabs mos bshad rgyur/ ‘‘ dang thog mkhar grong du yong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang rang nyid chung dus slob grwar ma song bas yi ge gcig kyang — 135 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mi shes la/ da lta'i dus rabs 'di 'dra zhig gi nang du las gang gtad kyang yi ge ma shes na mig med pa dang 'dra zhing mi'i gral du'ang tshud dka' ba'i gnas su lhung 'dug de'i phyir rang gi byis pa rnams la yon tan sbyong du 'jug ched/ ngas dgon shul sde ba nas rdzong thog du gnas spar ba dang/dus mtshungs su tshong khang 'di gnyer/ da skabs bdag gi dmigs yul yang 'grub bzhin yod/ bu chung bas thun rin rdzing mi rigs slob 'bring du slob sbyong byed bzhin yod pa dang/ bu mo gnyis ka mtsho sngon sgyu rtsal slob grwar 'gro bzhin yod la kho tshos sbyangs 'bras kyang bzang tsam blangs yod zer/dang thog tshong khang gnyer dus tshe ring skyid la ma dngul sgor6000 tsam las med kyang/ lo ngo du ma'i ring dka' spyad 'bad brtson dang gron chung spyod shes byas mthar/ da skabs gtan 'jags ma dngul sgor 40000nas50000bar bsags yod cing 'khor skyod ma dngul sgor30000yas mas dang nyin rer yong 'bab rkyang ba sgor50 nas60 bar yod/ lo rer yong 'bab rkyang ba sgor20000 yod pa'i tshong khang zhig tu gyurayod/ gsar 'god pas kho mo'i tshong khang nang zhib lta zhig byas pa na/ tshong khang nang du rong 'brog mang tshogs la mkho ba'i zhing las 'phrul chas kyi lhu lag dang/ 'bri mar ba mar/ chur ba/ rtsam pa/ gro ma/ mi rigs mkho chas sogs gral dag cing go rim ldan pa'i ngang bshams yod pa mthong/bcar 'dri mjug rdzogs la nye skabs/ tshe ring skyid kyi khyo ga'ang tshong khang du thon/ de nas gsar 'god pas kho gnyis la ma 'ongs par 'char gzhi ji 'dra yod pa dris skabs/ bza' zla gnyis kar spobs pa dang yid ches kyis khengs nas bshad rgyur/ ‘‘byis pa gsum po slob chen nas mthar phyin du 'jug rgyu ni dmigs bya gtso bo dang/ de las gzhan pha yul dgon shul sde ba — 136 —

'phrinagasar/ da waru yod pa'i gzhung gi chu mdzod de 'gan gtsang len byas nas/ de'i mtha' skor gyi sa rgod dang ri rgod du nags btsugs nas ljang mdog gi yul khams shig tu bskrun 'dodari’zer/ kho tshang gi bsam don rim bzhin 'grub yong ba la nged cag kyang dga' spro skyes byung ba red/(2004lo'i zla9ba'i tshes28nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)dkar yol btsongs nas phyug por gyur/gsar 'god pa/ klu rgyal/dpyid kyi kha char 'dres mar babs pa'i nyin zhog gsar 'god pa rong bo grong rdal bcings 'grol lho lam g.yon phyogs kyi tshong khang dang po ste‘‘reb gong hor kyā'i dkar yol tshong khang byang sras g.yang gi bang mdzod’’du bcar 'drir phyin/ tshong khang gi gnyer bdag la stag bha zer/pha yul rong bo grong rdal hor kyā nas yin pa'i stag bha ni da lo rang lo38la bud yod pa dang/ kho tshang la gza' mi bzhi yod cing bu dang bu mo gnyis ka da lta rdzong mkhar gyi slob chung du 'gro bzhin yod/ khos thog mar dkar yol gyi tshong rgyag pa'i skabs su rgya srang du thang la bshams te btsongs pa dang/ de nas rim bzhin mgo log dang mtsho lho sogs su song ste btsongs pas yong sbo je mang du song/ lo ngo du ma'i hur brtson la brten nas2002 lor dkar yo/la — 137 — —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshong khang 'di phyes/ tshong khang 'di ni rong bo grong rdal gyi dkar yol btsong sa nyag gcig yin pa red/ tshong khang du bod kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dkar yol che chung sna tshogs las gzhan/ gter bum dang bum pa dang rdza las grub pa'i lha sku dang chang dkar dang sder ma sna tshogs yod cing/ de dag gi steng du bod rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i ri mo sna tshogs phab 'dug gsar 'god pas 'di ga'i tshong zog gang nas blangs pa'i skor dris tshe/ stag bhas bshad rgyur/ ‘‘cang zhi cin te krin ni rgyal yongs kyi ming du grags pa'i dkar yol dang rdza chas bzo sa yin pas 'di ga'i tshong zong mang shos de nas len bzhin yod/ dper na gter bum lta bur mtshon na/ thengs gcig la khri gcig re'i thams bzhag nas nyos pa dang/ tshong khyer yong dus cin te krin nas zi ling bar du me 'khor thog bskyal ba dang/ zi ling nas reb gong bar du rlangs 'khor thog dbor yong ba yin’’zer/da lta gtan 'jags ma rtsa sgor khri28 longs pa'i stag bha'i dkar yol tshong khang nas nyin red sgor600da 700 yis rin gong longs pa'i dkar yol 'tshong bzhin yod/ khyad par du bod zla11 dang12 pa'i nang du nyin rer sgor4000—5000btsong thub zer/ 'di gar tshong len du yong ba'i mi gtso bo reb gong las gzhan/ da dung rtse khog dang hi nan/ kan lho/ bla brang sogs nas yong gi yod pa dang/ sil 'tshong dang sdeb 'tshong zung 'brel tshul bu gnyer bzhin 'dug ma 'ongs pa'i 'char gzhi'i skor gleng skabs/ stag bhar spobs sems kyis khengs te bshad rgyur/ ‘‘spyir reb gong nas dkar yol bzo grwa zhig 'dzugs grabs yod kyang/ da dung chog mchan ma thob pas gnas skabs su 'dzugs thub ma byung bas/ si khron nas dkar yol btsong sa'i yan lag tshong khang zhig 'byed rtsis yod pa dang/ yul gyi bza' mi rnams — 138 —

'phrinagasar/ da wakyang khul srid gzhung yod sa 'dir yong ste 'tsho ba rol ba dang mnyam du/byis pa rnams la slob gso bzang po zhig myong du 'jug rgyu yin zer/ des mi tshad stag bhas hor kyā ru ma dngul sgor khri135btang ste so phag bzo grwa zhig btsugs yod pa dang / 2003lo'i zla2pa'i tshes11nyin nas bzung thon skyed byed 'go tshugs nas da lta'i bar du lo gcig 'gor yod/ grong sde nas yong ste thog mar dkar yol btsongs pa nas 'go brtsams te/ da lta mkhar grong du gzhis chags shing sgor sa ya longs pa'i phyug po ru gyur pa'i stag bha la bcar 'dri byas pa brgyud/ nga tsho la blo skyed cig thob pa ni khos nga tsho dang kha gyes khar brjod pa'i gtam ste/ tang gi tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi srid jus bzang po la brten nas rang nyid kyi lam rang nyid kyis gtod dgos zhes pa de lags/(2004lo'i zla10ba'i tshes8nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)bkur 'os pa'i sman pa bzang bo—'gyur med rdo rje/gsar 'god pa/ phag mo tshe brtan/sman pa 'gyur med ces pa'i skyes pa zhig gi mtshan snyan chab cha grong rdal du rlung ltar ldang bzhin 'dugakho bo ni da lor lo40la son pa'i sman pa zhig ste/ gung hi rdzong 'khyil khug shang grog kha zhol ma sde bar skyes pa yin zer/ 'gyur med rdo rje lo8la da 139 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/son skabs kho rang slob grwar bskyal na'ang pha ma gnyis lo na bgres shing na tsha mang ba dang/ khyim na las ka las mi med pa'i khar sa zhing khyim tshang la 'gan len du 'jug pa'i dus skabs dang 'phrad pas/ 'gyur med rdo rjes slob gnyer gyi go skabs mi bskyur ka med byung/ yin na'ang khos khom skabs dang bstun nas〈rgyud bzhi〉thengs gang mang la bklags pas sman pa zhig byed 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag tu skyes/ dus kyi 'phel 'gyur dang bstun nas phu nu ming sring rnams nar son pa dang khyim tshang gi cha rkyen je legs su song bas kho rang la yang bskyar slob sbyong byed pa'i go skabs thob ste mtsho lho khul las rigs slob 'bring gi bod sman gso sbyong 'dzin grwar rgyugs 'phrod/ lo gnyis kyi rjes su 'gyur med rdo rjes g.yur du za ba'i sbyangs 'bras blangs nas slob mthar phyin/'gyur med rdo rje bod sman la dga' zhen che ba'i blo 'dun brtan po des mtsho lho sa khul gyi ming du grags pa'i sman pa chos skyong thar dang 'kho bha sogs kyi yid sems rab tu bkug ste/ kho slob mar len par khas blangs pa ma zad rang gi tshe gang bor bslabs pa'i nyams myong dang sman rdzas tshang ma slob sbyong la mos pa'i na gzhon 'dir bstsal pa red/ rig gnas lag rtsal gyi mtsho mo las lo mang bor rkyal ba'i 'gyur med rdo rje sems su/ gso ba rig par rgyus lon zhig byed dgos na dpe deb steng gi nad gzhi khong du chud pa tsam gyis mi chog par/ ches gal che ba ni nad thog nyams myongs phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos par snyam ste/ sman khug khur nas zhin he dang kos nan sogs 'brog khul du song nas nad kyis zin pa'i nad pa rnams la nad bcos byas/ yun dar shang gi bud med nad pa zhig la mchin nad phog nas lo mang por 'gor ba dang/ sman pa mang por bsten kyang phan — 140 —

khur13zudab/thagabasdo/ da wa ma thogs par yod pa der 'gyur med rdo rje srol rgyun gyi sman thabs la brten nas sems zhib mos sman bcos byas te/ lo na49la son pa'i bud med de'i gdong la yang bskyar 'dzum mdangs rgyus su bcug nad thog nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa zhig thob pa dang/ spyod pa bzang po yang ldan pas nad kyis zin pa'i nad pa mang po zhig 'chi bdag gi zhags pa las thar du bcug cing/ sman pa 'gyur med kyi snyan grags phyogs bzhir khyab/'gyur med rdo rjes rang nyid kyi mig snga'i grub 'bras la yid tshim nas ma bsdad par/ yang bskyar mtsho lho khul 'phrod bsten slob grwa'i grong gseb sman pa'i gso sbyong 'dzin grwar rgyugs sprad/ g.yur du za ba'i sbyangs 'bras kyis nub lugs gso rig gi 'bring rim ched las kyi thob thang blangs r+shang/ de'i rjes bod sman ched sbyong rang sbyong gi rgyugs blangs par zhugs te/ 2002 lor bde blag ngang ched sbyong gi mthar phyin 'dzin yig blangs/ de nas rim bzhin khos slob ma bsdu 'go brtsams shing/ khos slob ston 'og mi sum cus bod sman sbyangs mthar phyin nas/ nad ston par yong mi thub pa dang sman thob dka' ba'i nad pa mang bo'i dka' khag thag gcod byas/ 2000lor las rdon dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyas pa'i 'gyur med rdo rje ma rkang mnyam las lam lugs rnam pas sger gnyer khe las te ‘‘kun phan rten dar 'gyur med gling sna 'dzoms zhabs zhu sde tshan’’btsugs nas mkhyen spyi'i 'gan khur/ zhabs zhu sde mtshan khongs gtogs su bod nub sgo bsten khang dang mgron khang/ tshong khang/bzo khang/ bod lwa bzo khang sogs yod pa dang/ las gnas nas bud pa dang las kar sgug pa'i na gzhon50 lhag la las gnas bkod sgrig byas/kho'i sne khrid 'og zhabs zhu sde tshan gyis rin mi len par gso sbyong 'dzin grwa sgrub pa brgyud/ spyi tshogs steng la bod lugs sman pa30dang bod lwa bzo ma khan— 14/ ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/100la nye ba tsam skyed sring byas/ 'gyur med rdo rjes rgyun du slob ma rnams la rang tshugs kyis las gnas gnyer ba dang / bdag gnyer rgya bskyed nas spyi tshogs la sngar las mang ba'i las gnas 'don sprod dang / spyi tshogs kyi 'gan je yang du gtong dgos tshul thad nas skul slong byas/ 'gyur med rdo rjes sman pa'i las ka gnyer ba nas bzung khos nad pa'i lag nas tho 'god 'gro gron dang brtag dpyad 'gro gron sogs bsdus ma myong la/ slob ma rnams kyi lag nas slob yon bsdu ba phar zhog da rung slob ma rnams la gzhi rtsa'i 'tsho ba'i 'gro gron byin nas slob sbyong byed pa'i dus yun gyi 'tsho ba khag theg byas pa dang/ gzhan yang sa phyogs yar mar du song nas nad par sman sbyin btang ba dang/ da rung mtsho sngon dmangs khrod dge las skyob rogs mthun tshogs dang mtsho lho khul 'phrod bsten slob grwa dang mtsho lho bod yig slob 'bring bcas kyi slob mar zhal 'debs phul/ kho ring snga gzhug tu sngon thon sger gnyer pa dang lnga bzang sger gnyer bzo tshong khyim tshang dang sngon thon tshong khang bcas la bdam myong/'gyur med rdo rje la phugs 'dun zhig yod pa ni chab cha grong rdal nas sger gnyir bod sman khang zhig btsugs te sngar las mang ba'i nad par phan thogs rgyu de yin la/ mig sngar khos rang nyid kyi 'dun pa de mngon 'gyur byed ched hur brtson byed bzhin pa'i sgang red/(2004lo'i zla11pa'i tshes6nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)

'phrin gsar/ lha mo sgrol ma'i 'dzum las/gsar 'god pa/ dpal chen rdo rje/zla9 ba'i zla mjug tu nged cag kha ba lhab lhub tu 'bab pa'i khrod rta bo grong rdal du 'byor/ tshong khrom du nyul skabs khang ba nyis brtsegs can zhig gis nga tsho'i mig dbang drangs shing/ de ni lha mo sgrol ma tshang gi‘‘dngos grub shugs 'byung gling’’zhes pa'i za khang dang nang ma khang red/lha mo sgrol ma ni mo lo33 la son zhing dga' bde rdzong kho chu grong rdal gyi 'brog mo zhig red/ kho mo tshang la kho bza' zla dang byis pa gnyis bcas bza' mi bzhi yod/ ngas kho mor tshong gnyer ba'i lam du bskyod pa'i gnas tshul dris dus/ kho mos bshad rgyur/ gom pa'i 'degs 'jog la cung tsam rang tshugs thub pa nas bzung be'u rdzi dang lug rdzi byas nas/ skyid cing ngo mtshar ba'i byis pa'i dus skabs de rtswa thang gi ri lung nas yal/ stabs legs pa zhig la thengs shig a pha zi ling du 'gro zhor du kho mo'ang khrid pa dang/ grong khyer gyi ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa mthong bas yid smon skyes/ ma 'ongs par yin gcig min gnyis grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba rol dgos pa'i 'dun pa chags byung /de'i skabs nas bzung a phas mtshams rer byin pa'i sgor mo dang rang gis dbyar khar dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brkos pa'i sgor mo gsog 'go brtsams/ mo lo bco lngar bud na zas ma la mi slong ba dang pho lo bco lngar bud na blo pha la mi — 143 —

gomastabasadangazhabasarjes/ da 'dri zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ 1996 lor kho mos lo lnga drug tsam la gsog pa'i sgor mo1000 lhag yod pa de bzung nas rta bo grong rdal du yong/ de nas cog gzhongs spo lo zhig nyos shing der brten nas 'tsho ba rol khul byas/ skabs der nyin rer sgor30 nas40 yi yong sgo yod rung khang gla dang zas rin sprad rjes lhag rgyu mang po med cing/ rang gi phugs bsam ltar yin pas sems pa sngon las skyid/ tshong de lo gcig la gnyer bas sgor2000 tsam gsog thub song/ de nas tshong de mtshams bzhag nas zi ling du song ste dkar yol dang byis pa'i rtsed chas sogs kyi tshong zong rta bo grong rdal du drangs nas thang la bsham pa'i tshul du lo gnyis ring la btsongs bas sgor7000 gsog thub song/de'i khar gzhan la sgor5000 bskyis te tshong khang chung chung zhig gnyer/ de ni sngon las tshong brin zhing nyung mthar yang nyin rer sgor200yi yong sgo yod pas/rim bzhin kho mo tshang rta bo grong rdal du gzhis chags shing yul de'i phyug po'i gras su tshud/ 2003lo'i zla7pa'i nang lo ngo 'ga' la bsags pa'i ma rtsa rnams bton nas/ dngos grub shugs 'byung gling zhes pa'i 'og khang ni za khang dang thog khang ni nang ma khang yin pa de gnyer/ za khang la khang mig bzhi dang nang ma khang la khang mig7yod pa dang nyin rer sgor300 nas400 yi yong sgo len thub zer/red ya/ pha mas yang mes ring rtswa chur bsnyegs nas phyugs 'tsho ba'i 'brog mo zhig nor lug dang kha bral nas/ rang gi phugs bsam nam yang ma dor bar grong khyer du gzhis chags ched tshong gnyer lam du zhugs nas 'bad pa byas pas lo ngo mang bor rmis pa'i rmi lam de mngon 'gyur byung /(2004lo'i zla11pa'i tshes18nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)— 144 —
