'phrinagasar/ da wad wa'abrog thang gi mo tho zhig gso mkhan stag 'bum rgyal/gsar 'god mkhan/ phag mo tshe brtan/'khor lo dang 'drud 'then 'khor lo zhig gso byed sa zhes sgo byang bkal 'dug pa zhig mig lam du shar ba dang/ bod mi dar ma zhig gis/ mo tho 'khor lo mang po'i khrod wu'u dbyang rtags can gyi mo tho 'khor lo zhig 'ig gso byed bzhin pa'i sgang red/ nga tsho kho dang nye bar bcar zhing gnas tshul rgyus lon byed dus/ kho'i ming la stag 'bum rgyal zer ba shes/kho rang da lor lo32la son yod cing de snga sum mdo shang ban shul sde ba'i 'brog pa zhig red/ lo bdun gyi yar sngon stag 'bum rgyal tshang ni nor15dang lug70 ma gtoṭa med pa'i 'brog khyim dkyus ma zhig yin zer/'tsho ba'i cha rkyen de 'dra mi bzang ba'i steng/ mu ge'i steng la zla lhag ces pa bzhin/ 1998lor stag 'bum rgyal gyi sring mo 'drud 'then 'khor lo las sar lhung nas rmas skyon byung bas/ 'tsho ba'i rten gzhi ste lug70lhag dang nor15yod pa tshang ma btsongs te sring mor sman bcos byas/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og 'tsho thabs mi bsgyur ga med byung / stag 'bum rgyal gyis1999lor kho tshang la de las rin gong che ba'i rgyu rdzas med pa'i 'drud 'then 'khor lo de sgor 5000la mi btsongs thabs med byung/ de nas kho rang sum mdo shang du yong ste sgor300yis 'dug khang khang mig gsum las thing /'drud da 45 da

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'then 'khor lo dang mo tho zhig gso'i lag rtsal sbyangs shing/ rim bzhin zhig gso byed 'go brtsams/ gsar 'god pas stag 'bum rgyal la dang thog gi brgyud rim skor gyi gnas tshul dris tshe/ khos du ba rkang gcig la me sgron nas phyir 'dang zhig brgyab nas bshad rgyur/ ‘‘dang thog ngas bya mdo shang gi rdo rje zer ba zhig gi mdun nas lag rtsal 'di bslabs pa dang/ rim bzhin zhig gso byed pa'i lag rtsal sna tshogs dang nyams myong cung tsam thob rjes/ rang nyid la yod pa'i sgor1800 yis mo tho zhig gso byed pa'i yo byad nyos pa yin’’/de snga ma rtsa sgor1800 ma gtogs med pa'i mo tho zhig gso byed sa de/mig sngar gtan 'jags ma dngul sgor khri 10 yan du bslebs pa'i mo tho 'khor lo dang 'drud 'then 'khor lo zhig gso byed sa gtsos pa'i zhig gso khang dang/ mo tho 'khor lo dang rlangs snum/ mo tho'i lhu cha btsongs sa'i zhabs phyi can gyi sna 'dzoms tshong khang zhig tu gyur yod/ da lta nga tsho'i mig lam du shar ba ni zhig gso khang 'di sngon gyi sgor1800 btang nas las pa zhig red zer na yid mi ches pa'i tshul du gnas/ rgyu mtshan ni khos bshad rgyur/ da lo gcig pur mo tho60 lhag btsongs pa dang/ mo tho re btsongs na khe spogs sgor300 re yod pa dang/ mo tho zhig gso yong mi mang dus nyin re'i yong sgo rkyang ba sgor100dang / lo rer yong sgo rkyang ba sgor15000 lhag yod/lo5 lhag gi ring rang nyid kyi 'bad brtson dang gsog 'jog la do snang byas pas/ 'tsho ba'i chu tshad rim bzhin je mthor song ba dang bstun2002 lor nu bo gnyis kyang shang thog tu khrid yong nas mo tho dang 'drud 'then 'khor lo zhig gso byed pa'i lag rtsal bslabs/ lag rtsal 'di 'dra zhig bslabs na ma rtsa mang po gtong mi dgos la/ yong sgo'ang nor lug 'tsho skyong byas pa las bzang/— 146 —

'phrinagasar/ da da da deng skabs nor lug gi kha grangs je mang du song ba dang/ rtswa sa'i sos tshad las yol bas nor lug gso skyong byed pa de rtswa chu'i rjes snyeg dbos pa dang nam zlar rag las pa zhig yin pas/ de ni ha cang blo mi bde ba'i 'tsho ba rol thabs shig red/ de'i phyir bdag gis kyang nu bo gnyis kar lag rtsal zhig bslabs nas 'tsho ba rol na bzang snyam nas/ kho gnyis khrid yong ba yin da lor khos da dung mi gzhan zhig dang mnyam las byas te/ so phag khog stong ldug sa'i bzo grwa chung chung zhig btsugs yod/ so phag btsong na'ang yong sgo sgor7000lhag yod nges/ bcar 'dri mjug rdzogs skabs/ stag 'bum rgyal gyis gus nyams ngang yang nas yang du khyim du bos/ kho'i khyim du song ba na/ gral dag pa'i ca lag steng du brnyan 'phrin dang7bu7dang/ kha par sogs grong khyer dang khyad mi 'dug(2004lo'i zla11pa'i tshes20nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)kha char bu yug khrod nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i khros po/gsar 'god pa/ dpal chen rdo rje/dga' bde rdzong chags pa de mtsho ngos las mus4200longs pa'i gnas su yod cing / mtha' 'khor du ri bos bskor yod pa dang / byang ngos su kho chu zhes pa'i chu bo 'bab pa dang / srang lam du myul tshe 'brog khul gyi khyang chos — 147 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mngon par gsal/nga tsho srang lam brgyud nas 'gro skabs tshong khang zhig gi sgo kha na bod lwa gyon pa'i pho gsar dar la babs pa gnyis kyis nyi 'od 'og sram gyi spu mdog la lta bzhin tshong gtam pa mthong / tshong khang de'i sgo byang chung la gsal mi gsal ba'i‘‘gangs ljongs sna 'dzoms tshong khang’’zhes bkal yod pas nga rang bsam gzas nas de'i nang du song ba na/ khang mig gnyis kyi nang du bod lwa dang gos/ byu ru dang sram/ dngul dang gser gyi gal gdub dang sor gdub sogs sna tshogs gsham yod pa dang / nyo mi mang bar bltas na tshong khang de ni grong rdal 'di ru gzhis chags pa snga zhing tshong brin pa shes thub la/ de ni khros po tshang gi tshong khang red/khros po khong nyid pho lo43yin la bza' mi bzhi ma gtogs med cing /pha yul ni gcig sgril rdzong khang gsar shang nyin yos sde ba red/ ngas kho la tshong du zhugs pa'i gnas tshul 'dri dus/ khos‘‘1982’’lo nas bzung mgo log gi sa cha gang sar song nas dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu gtsos pa'i sman rdzas bsdu nyo byed pa'i tshong gnyer ba dang / thog mar khe spogs bzang zhing tshong brin pas ma rtsa che tsam btang nas gnyer/ lo ngo15lhag la tshong gnyer bas dar rgud kyang thengs mang byung ba dang / skabs rer rang gi kha rgyab tsam la'ang sems khral byed dgos pa'i tshod du lhung myong / de nas dga' bde rdzong du yong nas grogs po zhig la sgor200bskyis te/ snga dror 'brog pa rnams kyi lag nas ko pags dang bal khul sogs nyos nas phyi dror gzhan par btsongs nas sgor mo 'ga' bslangs par brten nas 'tsho ba rol gsog thabs byas/ lo lnga'i ring la khe cung tsam lon zhing sgor20000gsog thub song / phyugs thon dngos po'i tshong der khe spogs mi bzang rgyu med rung / de la 'gyur ldog che ba — 148 —

'phrinagasar/ da dang / de'i tshong khrom cha 'phrin dga' bde nas sngon dpag byed dka' bas/sngon gyi dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu'i tshong brgyab pa de bzhin du e 'gror 'dzem zhing /rang la gdeng tshod cung tsam yod pa'i tshong lam zhig gdam dgos bsam/ de nas mi rigs tshong zong gi tshong ni 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig red snyam/ 1993lo nas bzung / ma rtsa sgor20000yod pa tshang ma 'di'i phyogs su btang nas mi rigs tshong zong gi tshong khang 'di gnyer/ ma 'gor bar tshong ha cang brin zhing / lo gcig ring la ma rtsa'i ldab gcig gi khe spogs blangs pa dang / de nas rim bzhin mi rigs tshong zong je 'dzoms su btang ba dang mnyam du/ kho rang yang rdzong mkhar 'di nas gzhis chags shing phyug pa'i gras su'ang tshud/2001lor rta bo grong rdal 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i go skabs bzang po der dmigs nas khos kyang ma rtsa sgor khri200btang ste/ thog khang sum brtsegs can gyi mgron khang zhig las yod pa der zla rer sgor2250byas nas ga'an la glas yod pa dang / tshong khang 'di las kyang lo rer ha lam sgor30000re'i yong sgo yod pas/ nga'i 'tsho ba ha cang skyid’’ces bshad/gsar 'god pas kho'i phyin chad kyi 'char gzhi dris dus/ khronu ‘‘mi rigs tshong zong gi thad nas khyon pa'i rigs ni nga'i tshong khang du 'dzoms tsam yin la gzhan du snod ca lag dang chos lugs cho ga'i yo byad sosas kyi thad nas mi 'dzoms pas/ 'di'i phyogs nas cha tshang du gtong ba'i 'dun pa yod’’zer/(2004lo'i zla12pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal)—— 149 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/shang grong khe las pa wang khra'o zhus la bcar ba'i zin bris/rdzogasar 'god pa/ rgya mtsho/gung hi rdzong yon nyan bzo tshong kung zi'i bdag gnyer pa wang khra'o zhus ni sa de'i zhing pa dkyus ma zhig yin/ lo na61yin pa'i wang khra'o zhus sngon chad gung hi rdzong 'khyil khug shang cus hwa tha'e sde ba'i sde dpon dang kri pu'u hru'u ci sogs 'gan khur myong / 1981lor khos sde ba'i mang tshogs khrid nas lung g.yang 'gag cha glog sa tshigs su sa la las gnyer dus sems su so phag zisna yig char raX05 char chag charamir cho 05 05 chagabaza grwa zhag gnyar ba' 'dun pa skyas ta/ da' skar bya 'phrul chas kya shas bya dang nor don do dam shes bya sogs nan tan gyis bslabs rjes/ 1983lor gung hi rdzong gi sger gnyer so phag bzo grwa ang dang po btsugs/ 1998lor so phag bzo grwa 'dir lam lugs sgyur bkod byas nas dmangs gnyer khe las su bsgyur/ de nas bzung zhing pa wang khra'o zhus ni rang skya pher bar khe las do dam gyi lam du zhugs/de nas thog mar ma dngul med pa'i dka' ngal dang 'phrad/ wang khra'o zhus kyis 'bad brtson gyis rdzong zhing las dngul khang nas dngul bun brtson len byas pa dang / yang so phag bzo grwa zhig 'phrul chas rnying ba zhig nyos mur/lo gcig lhag gi 'bad brtson byas pas1984lo'i zla6par so phag sreg khung legs 'grub byung / lo der so phag khri300bsregs pa dang tshang ma btsongs — 150 —

'odiXgrinagabasdoza / da wa tshar song / de'i phyi lor khos nyams myong nyung tsam ldan pa'i rmang ga'ir brten nas zhib 'jug nan mo byas shing zla ba bdun lhag gi ring so phag khri96()thon skyed byas/ thon skyed dus yun zla gsum je ring du btang ba red/ phan 'bras dang thon skyed las phyod mthor 'degs byed ched/ wang khra'o zhus kyis lag rtsal pa gso sbyong thad nas nan gyis bzung ba dang/ snga gzhug tu sgor khri10btang nas mi24pe cin dang hrang he sogs su mngags nas slob sbyong dang lta skor byas/ da lta kung zi der lag rtsal pa32yod pa rnams kung zis ma dngul btang nas gso sbyong thob pa'i zhing pa red/ 'phrul chas can du 'gyur ba'i tshad dang lag rtsal chu tshad mthor 'degs byed par bstun/ thon rdzas spus ka dang tshong ra 'gran rtsod nus pa yang mthor 'degs byung / kung zi des thon skyed byas pa'i so phag rang sa'i 'dzugs skrun la 'don sprod byas pa ma zad/ da dung zhin te rdzong dang kos nan rdzong / yang na mgo log khul gyi rdzong dang / yang na mgo log khul gyi rdzong lnga dang yul shul khul du 'don sprod byed bzhin yod/tshong gnyer do dam lam lugs 'thus tshang yin pa dang / 'gan 'khri dang dbang cha dang khe phan sbrel dam po yin pas/ thon skyed las phyod dang spyi tshogs la byas rjes 'jog tshad lo re bzhin mthor 'degs byung / las grwa tshugs tshun nas da lta'i bar so phag dmar po khri17000thon skyed byas pa dang khe spogs sgor khri170mngon du gyur/ rgyal khab la khral dngul sgor kri23()phul/do dam byed thabs bzang ba dang thon skyed phan 'bras bzang bas/ kung zi des snga gzhug tu sde ba'i so phag las grwa zhig dang mtsho lho khul gyi so phag las grwa sogs zla sgril 'khyongs song / da lta kung zi 'dir so phag yan lag las grwa gsum dang / phyogs bsdus zhabs zhu kung zi gcig snum blugs tshigs — 151 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gcig sogs yan lag las khungs yod pas/ kung zi de 'dzugs skrun rgyu cha dang 'bru snum sbyor bzo dang tshong las zhabs zhu sogs phung bo gcig can du gyur/ dus mtshungs su kung zis lo rer ngal rtsol pa200lhag bkod sgrig byas pas/ rong 'brog pa'i yong sgo 'phar bar lam bzang btod/dpal 'byor phan 'bras dang spyi tshogs phan 'bras mi mthud du mthor 'degs byung ba dang bstun nas/ kung zi der zhing chen dang khul dang rdzong bcas kyis‘‘sngon thon shang grong khe las’’su thengs mang po bdams pa dang /1998lor zhing las pu'us spus ka'i do dam yongs bsher byas pa brgyud/bdag gnyer pa wang khra'o zhus lags zhing chen yongs kyi skabs gsum pa'i shang grong khe las pa phul byung can du bdams/(2005lo'i zla1pa'i tshes8nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/ )'brog pa nas tshong par gyur ba'i g.yang skyabs rgyal/gsar 'god pa/ phag mo tshe brtan/nga tsho kos nan rdzong sum mdo shang du thon pa na/ gral dag pa'i tshong khang phreng ltar bsgrigs yod pa'i khrod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan zhing bod glu snyan mo zhig grag bzhin par der gtad nas nang du song ba na/ tshong bdag g.yang skyabs rgyal gyis lag khyer kha par nang du tshong don zhig gleng bzhin pa'i — 152 —

'phrinagasar/ da wa sgang red/ g.yang skyabs rgyal gyi gdong la 'dzum gyis khengs te nga tsho kho'i tshong khang du yong bar bsu ba zhus shing bcar 'dri dang len byas/da lo lo46la son pa'i g.yang skyabs rgyal tshang ni de snga nor60dang lug300lhag yod cing su rig sde ba'i 'brog khyim zhig yin/ khos bshad rgyur/ lo10yi yar sngon du nged tshang yang rtswa chu ded nas nor lug gso ba'i 'bros khyim dkyus ma zhig yin pa dang / tshad yod pa'i rtswa thang du nor lug je mang dang rtswa sas sos tshad nyams zhan du 'gro bzhin pa'i dus skabs der/ bdag gis dus rgyun du rtswa chu ded pa'i 'tsho ba rol stangs 'di ni lus sems gnyis ka thang chad cing nam yang sems mi bde ba zhig yin par 'dod/ khos bsam mno thengs gang mang btang ba dang thabs lam gang mang btsal te/ rang sar yod pa'i thon khungs te nor lug gi tshong las gnyer 'go brtsams pa dang /de nas rim bzhin tshong las nyams myong dang ma rtsa cung tsam gsog 'jog byas nas/ 1998lor sum do shang thog gi tshong ra'i nang du ma dngul sgor6000btang zhing tshong khang 'di phye nas bod mir mkho ba'i rgyan cha dang gyon pa btsong 'go brtsams/ lo ngo5yi ring la 'bad brtson byas pa brgyud nas/ da lta gtan 'jags ma dngul sgor70000dang 'khor skyod ma dngu' sgor15000dang / zla re'i yong sgo sgor1700lhag dang lo re'i yong sgo sgor20000yod pa'i tshong khang du gyur yod/ da nung ce pa'o rlangs 'khor zhig kyang nyos te tshong khang gzhan pa'i nang tshong 'dren pa dang lug drud nas sgor mo btsal bzhin yod/ g.yang skyabs rgyal gyis bshad rgyur/ rlangs 'khor gyis mgo mang la lug thengs gcig drud na yong sgo sgor200yod zer/ tshong las gnyer ba'i brgyud rim khrod 'phrad pa'i dka' ngal gang 'dra byung ba 'dri dus khos bshad rgyur/ lo 'ga'i yar sngon du tshong de 'dra rgyug la skabs la lar — 153 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bdag gi sems la tshong las 'di gnyer na ha cang dka' ba dang / 'di las phyir pha yul du song nas nor lug bskyangs na bzang snyam/ 'on kyang lo gnyis gsum gyi rjes nas bdag gis 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba'i mkho chas dang yong sgo la bstun nas tshong rgyug pa'i thabs lam zhig brnyed/ lo re'i zla11pa dang zla12pi'i nang tshong chad la bzhag nas lo phyi ma'i zla4ba dang zla5ba'i nang 'brog pa rnams kyis dbyar rtswa btus rjes da gzod sgor mo blangs pa yin/ 'di ltar byas na phyogs gcig tu rang nyid kyi tshong zog rgyug par phan pa dang phyogs zhig tu mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal sel bar phan pas/ lo 'di'i 'ga'i ring bdag gi tshong khang ni sa de ga'i yul mi rnams kyis ches yid rton byed pa'i tshong khang zhig tu gyur yod/ da lta bsam na sngon chad kyi tshong las gnyer na mi bzang ba'i bsam tshul de ni nor 'khrul 'ba' zhig red/mjug mthar g.yang skyabs rgyal la ma 'ongs pa'i 'char gzhi dang re ba'i skor 'dri dus/ khos yid ches dang bcas‘‘da yod kyi tshong khang 'di mu mthud du rgya bskyed nas rdzong thog dang yang na zi ling grong khyer nas tshong khang zhig gnyer rtsis yod’’zer/(2005lo'i zla1pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)

'phrinagasar/ da wad wadagun gsum gyi grang ngar che rung sems pa me ltar dro/da wazhing chen srid gros skabs dgu ba'i gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs 'go brtsams pa'i gnas tshul zur bris/gsar 'god pa/ ban de tshe ring /zla1pa'i tshes14nyin mtsho sngon gros tshogs lte gnas su dar tshon sma lngas rgyan zhing dus chen gyi rnam pas khengs 'dug rang zhing gi sa khul so so nas yong ba'i zhing chen srid gros kyi u yon rnams dga' spro'i nyams dang bcas gnas 'dir 'dzoms nas zhing chen srid gros skabs dgu ba'i gros tshogs thengs gsum par zhugs/snga dro'i dus tshod9yi steng zhing chen srid gros kyi kru'u zhi sangs rgyas skyabs kyis gros tshogs la mgo 'dzin byas pa dang / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal glu'i dkrol ba'i khrod gros tshogs dngos su 'go brtsams/ tsha'e cu'u lo yis tshogs chen la las don skor gyi snyan zhu phul/dgu gsum pa ni grang ngar shin tu che ba'i dus yin na'ang u yon rnams kyi sems pa me ltar dro/ grogs po gsar rnying rnams mnyam du 'dzoms nas mdza' brtse'i ngang kha brda byed bzhin 'dug phyi ru grang rlung ldang zhing kha ba lhab lhub tu 'bab bzhin yod na'ang u yon rnams kyi kha brda'i nang ches mang ba ni 'phel rgyas dang spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul/ mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo bcas — 155 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/red/ bstud mar thengs lnga la zhing chen srid gros kyi tshogs chen la zhugs pa'i gzhi rim 'brog khul nas yong ba'i u yon los h+pha krung gis bshad brgyud/kru'u zhi gzhon pa tsha'e cu'u lo yis snyan zhu phul ba ngo mas bzang / lo ngo gcig gi ring la zhing chen srid gros kyis gros gzhi 'don pa dang spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul dang mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo zhus pas/ lo ngo gcig gi ring la bsdoms pas gros gzhi380'tshol sdud byas pas lo rgyus steng ches mang ba'i lo zhig yin la/ de dag chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ slob gso/ tshan rtsal/ 'phrod bsten/ mi rigs/ chos lugs sogs phyogs so sor 'brel yod pas srid gros kyis 'don 'os pa'i nus pa gang legs kyis 'don spel byas/ deng phyin kyang rigs so so dang las rigs khag gi mang tshogs la 'brel 'dris dam po byas te/ dmangs kyi 'dod blo zhu ba dang dmangs kyi rig stobs gcig bsdu/ dmangs kyi khe phan mngon du bsgyur ba bcas kyi phyogs su jus 'bul shugs 'don byas te hur thag gis zhing chen yongs kyi bcos bsgyur dang 'dzugs skrun thad 'cham mthun gyi khor yug cig bskrun par 'bad pa bya rgyu yin zer/khor yug srung skyong ni sngar bzhin u yon rnams kyi do snang byed yul gtso bo zhig red/ chos lugs khag gi mi sna bu chung 'jigs dbang gis bshad don/nam zla'i rgyu rkyen dang tshad las brgal nas phyugs 'tshos pa/ a bra'i gnod pa/mi'i gnod pa bcas las bzos pa'i sa cha bye 'gyur dang rtswa thang zhan 'gyur byung bar dmigs nas khos chu dmar leb rdzong gi skye khams khor yug legs bcos byed pa'i skor gyi gros gzhi khyer yong ba red/rma lho nas yong ba'i u yon rdo rjes bshad rgyur/ snyan zhu nang2004lo'i bya bar spyi bsdoms byas pa 'os shing 'tsham la/ 2005lo'i bya ba'i mdzub ston — 156 —

bsam blo gsal bo dang rigs lam yang dag yin la/ sridagros u yon rnams kyi sems gting gi skad cha bshad yod pas nga tsho u yon rnams ches mtho 'ing gsar ba'i dmigs 'ben du bsnyeg par skul slong byas/(2005lo'i zla1po'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gas la)

rgyas 'phrin/lus phung la skyon yod rung snying stobs mi nyams pa'i bod kyi sman pa mgon rgya mtsho/rdo rje chos 'dzin/nangs snga mo dang sa rub skabs mi rnams kyis rgyun du na gzhon 'theng bo zhig rkang lam phra mor 'gro bzhin yod pa mthong thub/ de ni hwa lun rdzong bod sman sgo sten khang gi bod rigs sman pa mgon rgya mtsho red/mgon rgya mtshos lo bcu gnyis thog nas bzung bod kyi sman pa ye shes bsten nas bod kyi gso rig slob sbyong byas pa dang / rgyun du ri chu brgal nas sman rtswa btus pa dang mang tshogs la sman bcos byed du song ba red/ lag len gyi nang nas khos gso rig lag rtsal mi nyung ba shes byung / lo bcu dgu'i thog mgon rgya mtshos mtsho ngos las mus bzhi stong sum brgya lhag yod pa'i ma dbyin ri bor sman rtswa 'thu skabs stabs ma legs par thang du 'gyel nas 'theng bor gyur/ yin na'ang kho rang yid chad ma byung bar rma kha gso zhor du slob sbyong dang nad par sman bcos byas/ lo nyi shu'i thog tu mgon rgya mtshos rang gi lus phung la skyon yod par ma bltas par sde ba'i sman pa byas/mgon rgya mtsho nad pa'i don du lo mang por sgo bsten sman bcos khang du — 158 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da bsdad nas dus chen dang gung gseng nyin la'ang ngal gso byas pa ha cang nyung /da lo'i zla4pa'i nyin gcig gi dgong mor er thang shang kho tshe sde ba'i lo bdun can gyi bu mo zhig la glo bur du nad byung nas srog la nyen kha byung / mgon rgya mtshos gnas tshul de shes rjes mi sna rtsa 'dzugs byas te chu tshod brgyad ring myur skyob byas pa dang bu mo de srog nyen las thar bar zhag gang bor lta skyong byas/phyi nyin gyi phyi dror kho rang yang khangs rlung la ma 'dzems par le bar drug gi pha rol du yod pa'i glag mang sde bar glo bur du nad byung ba'i nad pa zhig la sman bcos byed du song / phyir log skabs nam gung du son rung de'i phyi nyin sngar bzhin las la zhugs/ mgon rgya mtshos nad par ha cang sems khur byas nas/ sman gsar ba re bsdebs tshe thog mar kho rang nyid kyis 'thung nas tshod lta byed nges red/da lta'i bar du khos ha lam sman gyi sdeb kha go gsum la zhib 'jug byas yod pa dang zhing chen phyi nang gi nad pa mi thengs lnga khri tsam la sman bcos byas myong /mgon rgya mtshos bod kyi gso rig gong spel dang na gzhon sman pa gso skyong byed rgyu de rang gi las 'gan du brtsis nas/ snga gzhug tu rdzong rang dang gcan tsha rdzong la sman pa drug gso skyong byas kyang gla skar ma gang yang ma blangs par ma zad/ 'os 'gan gyis slob ma la za ma dang 'dug sa 'don sprod byas pa red/ da lta slob ma drug po tshang ma mthar phyin nas kher rkyang du sman bcos byed kyin yod/(1986lo'i zla9ba'i tshes12nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal/)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bcos bsgrun rje mgyogs dang je zab tu gtong ba ni phyugs las gong du spel ba'i gnad 'gag red/da watshogs chen bcu gsum pa'i 'thus mi'am rma stod rdzong gi tang u'i hru'u ci blo gros rab brtan la 'tshams 'dri byas pa/gsar 'god pa/ hu'u yun kha'o/zla11pa'i tshes4nyin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod gsum thog rang zhing gi tshogs chen bcu gsum pa'i 'thus mi zi ling du log nas da rnam rgyal spyi gling sne len khang du bsdad yod/nga kho rang sdod sa'i khang bar slebs dus/ khos rma stod la kha par gtong bzhin yod/ thang du sdud gsog legs po byas pa'i thum chung kha shas bzhag yod/ khos nga la khos da lta bsam pa ni myur du rma stod la log nas tshogs chen gyi dgongs don brgyud bsgrags myur du bya rgyu de yin zer/ thengs 'di'i tshogs chen gyis rma stod rtswa thang la 'phel stobs 'byung du 'jug thub par khor yig ches zab mo yod/ ngas khong la de'i thad nas rang gi lta tshul bshad rgyu zhu tshes/ khos du ba zhig la me sgron nas bshad 'go brtsams/ khos bshad don/‘‘thengs 'di'i tshogs chen gyi gros don gtso bo ni bcos bsgyur red/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi 'gro lam ni bcos bsgyur yin pa dang / nga tsho rma stod rdzong dar rgyas dang gong 'phel du gtong ba'i 'gro lam yang bcos bsgyur red/ krung u — 160 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes kyi bcos bsgyur dang sgo 'byed dang / hur por gtong ba bcas kyi srid jus kyis nga tsho rma stod rtswa thang la skye stobs ldan bcug thun mong gis phyugs 'tsho ba de sger gyis 'gan len byed par bsgyur cing / de'i rjes phyugs zog la gong bcad nas khyim tshang la dbang bar byas/ der mthud nas nga tshos phyugs khyu'i chags tshul legs sgrig byas nas sngon chad khyim tshang tshang mar zog khyu yod pa de rta nor lug gsum dang pho mo so sor dgar bar bcos/ de dag tshang mas 'brog pa'i thon skyed brtson sems ches cher bskul ba dang / thon skyed gong du spel bar yar skul byas/ da lta nga tsho rdzong gi phyugs zog gi spyi grangs lnga 'bum las brgal ba dang mi rer cha snyoms phyugs zog drug cu lhag re yod/ lo rer rgyal khab la skams lug dang nang sgos bal rgya ma bdun 'bum bdun khri sprod pa'i las 'gan lhag 'grub byed kyin yod cing / 'brog pa re'i cha snyoms yong sgo yang bcos bsgyur ma byas gong gi sgor drug brgya lhag nas na ning gi sgor dgu brgya so bdun du 'phar/ da lor sgor dgu brgya lnga bcur bsleb thub rgyu red/ des mi tshad thon skyed gong du 'phel ba dang yong sgo 'phar ba dang bstun nas/ 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba'ang legs 'gyur mngon gsal byung / brgya cha'i drug cu'i 'brog pa sbra gur dbyibs gsar du bsdad yod/ 'bras dang gro phye ni 'brog pas rgyun spyod zas rigs su gyur/ khal 'gel gtso bo yin pa'i gna' ba'i skyel 'dren yo byad de rlangs 'khor gyis tshab byed bzhin yod/ rlung shugs glog 'don 'phrul chas de rma stod rtswa thang du rtag tu mthong bas ya mtshan rgyu med par gyur/'brog pa tshos bde skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod/de yin na'ang khos bshad mtshams cung tsam bzhag nas yang bshang don/ngas bltas na bcos bsgyur la cha bzhag nas bshad na 'di mi byed 'go da 161 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/brtsams pa dang gom pa gang spos pa tsam med/ gom rim gnyis par phyugs las bcos bsgyur byed pa'i las 'gan ni thog mar gom pa dang po'i bcos bsgyur gting zab dang 'thus tshang du gtang rgyu de red/ rmang gzhi de'i thog nas da dung de dang 'tsham pa'i byed thabs 'tshol dgos par ma zad/ de brgyud de mi shugs dang / rgyu shugs sgrig 'dzugs byas te 'brog pa khyim tshang re res sgrub mi thub pa'i las don la shugs gtong de/ phyugs las kyi gzhi rtsa'i thon skyed cha rkyen legs sgyur byed pa dang / gnam la brten nas phyugs 'tsho ba'i rjes lus gnas tshul bsgyur dgos/ khos bshad don/ mi phyugs la brten pa dang phyugs rtswa la brten dgos/ mig sngar phyugs rtswa gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba mngon gsal yin pas/ 'gro lam ni rtswa thang 'dzugs skrun cher spel bya rgyu der thug yod/ yin na'ang rtswa thang 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i rnam grangs gtso bo de dper na rtswa thang chu bed dang rtswa thang gi bra gsod sogs ni khyim tshang re re'i stobs shugs la brten na sgrub mi thub/ de ni phyugs las gom rim gnyis par bcos bsgyur byed skabs bsam blo gtong dgos pa'i gnad don zhig yin pa 'dra/ gnad don de dag thag gis bcad pas na/ rma stod rdzong gi phyugs las brtan po'i ngang gong du 'phel bar brten rung ba'i rmang gzhi yod 'gro/mjug mthar khos thog mar bshad pa'i tshig la mthud nas/ ‘‘nga ni spyir btang gi bod rigs las byed pa zhig yin la/ tshogs chen bcu gsum pa zhes pa'i 'di 'dra'i gzab rgyas ldan pa'i tshogs chen la zhugs par gyur pa ni ha cang gzi brjid ldan pa zhig yin snyam zhing / nga tsho rma stod rdzong sngon thon mi rigs sa khul dang bsdur na da dung mi 'dang sa mang po yod par snyam/ 'on kyang nga la las ka yag po 'khyongs par yid ches 'dug tshogs chen bcu sdi 162 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da gsum pa'i dgongs don gyi mdzub ston yod pa dang bcos bsgyur la brtson pa'i rigs so so'i mi dmangs yod pas na/ nga tshos bcos bsgyur gyi dpyid dpal sngon bsu byed thub nges red/(1987lo'i zla11pa'i tshes20nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/ )rang rtogs dang hrar thag gis chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgrur nang zhugs dgos pa/gas chen bcu gsum pa'i 'thus mi'am rma lho khul tang u hru'u ci blo bzang la bcar 'dri byas pa/ hri hu'e khrin dang karma tshe ring /tshogs chen bcu gsum par zhugs pa'i rang zhing gi 'thus mi phyir zi ling du log rjes/ gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyis zi ling rnam rgyal spyi gling sne len khang du rang zhing gi tshogs chen bcu gsum pa'i 'thus mi'am krung gung rma lho khul tang u hru'u ci blo mthun blo bzang la bcar 'dri byas/ blo mthun blo bzang gis rma lho khul gyi las don dngos la sprel nas chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur thad kyi ngos zin bshad/blo mthun blo bzang gis bshad don/ tang gi tshogs chen bcu gsum — 63 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/pas chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur byed 'go brtsams/ nga tsho'i tang gi 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje pa rgan pas sne khrid kyi nus pa bton/khong tsho'i sems shugs da dung bzang ba'i skabs su gnas thog 'dir rang rgyal gyi chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur byed par skul 'ded kyi nus pa 'don thub par ma zad/ gung khran ring lugs kyi las don yongs rdzogs la'ang yun ring ba'i shugs rkyen 'byung thub rgyu red/chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur bya ba la thog mar tang srid logs su dgar dgos pa'i skor bshad skabs/ blo mthun blo bzang gis bshad don/khos rdzong u hru'u ci khur tshe/ mgo khrid tshan chung nang gi las don dag don med nar 'gyang byed pa'i gnas tshul tshabs chen gnas yod snyam/ gnad don de thag gcod byed ched/ khos rma lho khul tang u yi las la 'go 'dzin byed skabs/ srid gzhung gi 'gan nus kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i las kar tang u yis bdag dam mi byed pa'i re ba bton/ srid gzhung gis bsdus pa'i gros tshogs la kho phal cher mi zhugs par/ stobs shugs gcig sdud kyi tang gi las don bsgrubs/ de ltar byas pa'i dbang gis tang srid bar phan tshun don med nar 'gyang 'byung ba dang mthun sbyor med pa'i gnas tshul je nyung du song ba dang / las phyod kyang mtho ru btegs/ de'i thog nas tang srid logs su bkar na/ da gzod tang gi mgo khrid nus pa sngar las lhag par mngon du 'gyur nas/ tang gi mgo khrid chu tshad mthor 'degs byed pa dang / tang gis tang la bdag dam dang tang gi 'gan nus sngar las lhag par bzang 'don yong bar 'gan len bya thub/gom gang mdun spos sgos dbang cha ji ltar mar gtong rgyu'i gnad don skor bshad skabs/ blo bzang gis bshad don/ nga tsho rma lho la'ang gnad don — 164 —

rgyas 'phrin/'di 'dra zhig gnas yod pa ste/ shang grong rim par gcig nas nor srid kyi dbang cha med pa dang / gnyis nas mi don dbang cha med/ shang grong khe las tshang mar rdzong gis do dam byed pa dang / tha na las byed pas gnang ba zhu na'ang rdzong gis gnang dgos pas gzhi rim las byed pa'i brtson sems la shugs rkyen btang / dbang cha gcig tu sdud drags pa'i gnas tshul de las la mi phan stabs/ rim bzhin dbang cha mar gtong dgos/ yin na'ang mi rigs rang skyong sa cha dang mtha' khul du da dung las byed pa'i spus tshad dang nus pa'i gnad don la bsam blo gtong dgos shing / hur thag dang gzab nan gyis bsgrub dgos pa de bshad ma dgos pa red/ nga tsho rma lho khul gyis phyugs nad sman khang dang rtswa thang sa tshigs/ zhing las tshan zhib khang la sogs pa'i sde khag shang la mar btang nas do dam byed du 'jug pa'i gnad don la zhib 'jug byed bzhin yod/ de ltar byas na thad kar zhing phyugs las thon skyed la zhabs 'degs zhu bar phan pa yod/chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur nang ji ltar zhugs rgyu'i slor bshad skabs/ blo mthun blo bzang gis bshad don/ chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur byed par dka' ngal chen po yod/ nga tsho mgo khrid las byed pa rang nyid chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur byed pa'i 'gog shugs su mi 'gyur bar/nges par du rang dpe gzhan ston dang rbad chod kyis rang steng nas 'go btsugs te sne khrid nas tshogs chen bcu gsum pa'i dgongs don slob sbyong dang lag len mthar phyin byed par 'bad brtson bya dgos/ rang gi sa cha'i don dngos la dmigs nas/ phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi las don zhib mor sgrub pa dang / hur thag gzab nan sgos chab srid sgrig srol bcos bsgyur byed par cha rkyen bzang po bskrun dgos pa dang / dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang thengs — 165 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'di'i bcos bsgyur nang zhugs nas lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i legs 'gyur mngon du bsgyur dgos pa red/(1987lo'i zla12pa'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/)mi rigs las byed pa zhig gi brtse sems/da wadar lag rdzong tang u'i hru'u ci mkhas po'i gnas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ hu'u yun kha'omi rnams dang lab gleng lhug por byed skabs yin na 'dra/ dril bsgrags kyi las ka gnyer ba'i hru'u ci gzhon pa wang gis gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan la bsdus pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog tu yin na'ang 'dra/ mi tshang mas mkhas po ni hru'u ci bzang po zhig yin zhes bshad kyin 'dug sa de ga'i bod rigs las byed pa tshos kho la bstod don ni mi rigs rang la shin tu dga' ba dang / bod dmangs dbul phongs dang rjes lus/ tha na blun rmongs bcas yin pa'i da yod gnas tshul la yid skyo ba dang bsam blo zhib mo btang yod par ma zad/ gnas tshul 'di bsgyur bcos byed ched dka' tshegs che ba'i ngal rtsol byed ba'in pa de red/ sa cha gzhan pa nas sa der yong ba'i rgya rigs las byed pa tshos kyang kho la bstod don ni kho la mi rigs kyi phyogs lhung — 166 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ rdid+nghalta tshul med pa dang / thag ring yul nas bod yul 'dzugs skrun byed rogs byed la yong bar mthong chen dang sems khur/ gus bkur/ yid ches bcas byed pa'i rkyen gyis red/ kho tshos 'di ni mi rigs las byed pa phul byung can zhig la yod 'os pa'i brtse sems red zer/zla8pa'i tshes8nyin gyis phyi dror/ gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyis mkhas po dang kha brda yun ring zhig byas/ kho ni lhag bsam zol med can zhig red/ mi rnams kyis kho la bstod bsngags byed pa rnams khos khas mi len pa'i gtam sogs mang bo ma bshad pa red/ kha brda'i thog mtha' bar gsum du khos mi rigs rang gi mdun lam la bsam blo gtong bzhin yod/ bo ni mgo log nas skyes shing mgo log nas lag chags pa zhig red/ rma chu'i chu mgo'i sa gzhi chen po 'dis kho la smug po gdung rgyud kyi bzhin mdangs gnang ba dang sbrags/ kho la sa gzhi chen po de dang mi dmangs tshor drin lan 'jal ba'i gshis rgyud kyang ldan bcug pa red/ kho'i sems la bcings 'grol byas rjes kyi lo ngo sum cu'i ring du sa cha der ngo ma 'gyur sdog chen po byung ba dang /lhag par du lo ngo bcu'i ring gi bcos bsgyur 'dis sa cha der 'phel stobs tshad med gnang yod par bsams/ yin pa'ang dbul phongs dang rjes lus dang / blun rmongs bcas sngar bzhin sa der gnas yod pa de yang khas len 'dug kho'i sems la tang gi thugs khur dang sngon thon spun zla mi rigs kyi rogs skyor 'og tu byed thabs yod tshad 'then nas thon skyed nus shugs gong spel dang hur thag gis mi rigs slob gso spel ba/ shes ldan mi sna skyong pa/rgyal khab kyi rogs skyor dang mi rigs rang nyid kyi 'bad brtson la brten nas gom pa re re bzhin mdun du skyod rgyu ni 'gro lam kho na yin pa'i tshor shes yang skyes yod/— 167 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/rtswa thang du lag chags pa'i mi tshang ma dang 'dra bar/ kho yang chung dus phyugs rdzi byas myong mod/ mi 'dra sa ni khos phyugs 'tsho ba'i dus yun de 'dra mi ring ba red/ kho rang slob chung du zhugs myong / de'i sngon la blo sgo 'byed mkhan dge rgan zhig gis rang la khyim du slob khrid byas myong / skabs der/kho tshang gis dge rgan gyi nor lug 'tsho bzhin yod pas/ dge rgan kho tshang du yong nas kho la slob khrid byas pa red/ kho'i sems la rang nyid ci yang mi shes pa'i lug rdzi zhig nas gnas lugs cung tsam shes pa'i mi zhig tu bsgyur ba 'di ni tang gis gso skyong byas pa'i drin red bsams 'dug khong rang lo bcu drug steng gzhung las nang du zhugs shing lo nyer brgyad thog rdzong dpon gzhon pa'i 'gan khur/ da lo lo sum cu so brgyad tsam yin rung / lo nyi shu lhag ring gzhung don gnyer bar phyir 'dang brgyab na/ lo ngo sum cu so brgyad de bde blag cig min pa ste/ dga' spro dang sdug bsngal/ brtson len dang som nyi mi nyung ba zhig brgyud myong / kho ni spyi mthun rgyal khab dang mnyam du 'tshar longs byung ba yin pas/ spyi mthun rgyal khab dang mnyam du lo ngo so brgyad nang gi skyid sdug myangs myong yod pa red/kho ni1985lo'i zla4ba'i tshes 22nyin dar lag rdzong du hru'u ci'i 'gan khur du yong / kho'i bshad tshul ltar na/ dar lag rdzong la khyad chos gsum yod pa ste/ dbul phongs yin pa dang bde 'jags min pa'i rgyu rkyen mang ba/spyi tshogs kyi dar srol mi bzang ba bcas red/ de'i rkyen gyis lo ngo 'di gsum lhag gi nang du kho'i las ka'ang gnad don 'di gsum la dmigs nas bsgrubs pa yin mod/ 'on kyang khor dar lag gi don bya skyong sla mo zhig min pa'i myong tshor byung ba dang / sngon chad byung ma myong ba'i dka' khag la thugaganas lugs ltar na/ khor gzhung las kyi nyams myong sngon chad las mang mod/— 168 —

rgyas 'phrin/'on kyang las pa'i skabs su sngon chad las dka' khag che/ khos rdzong gi mgo khrid pa gzhan dag dang de min rgya che'i las byed pa rnams dang mnyam du 'bad brtson byas nas/ mtsho sngon dang si khron bar gyi rtswa sa'i rtsod gleng gi gnad don dang lo rgyus steng nas lus byung ba'i gnad don kha shas thag bcad pa dang bstun/ lhing 'jags min pa'i rgyu rkyen phal cher bsal zhing spyi tshogs kyi dar srol yang legs 'gyur mngon gsal byung / yin na'ang dbul phongs kyi rnam pa skabs shig la bsgyur dka' bar gnas dang / ha cang mang ba'i rang byung gnod 'tshe dang ches dma' ba'i thon skyed nus shugs kyi mdun du nus med du gyur/ dar lag rdzong gi rtswa thang mang po nyams rgud du gyur yod mod/ 'on kyang mi rnams kyis don der do snang mi byed cing / rmongs dad bsam blo dang goms gshis rnying ba'i stobs shugs/ dus yun ring bor mi rnams kyis mkhregs 'dzin byed pa'i zhing las chung ba'i 'du shes des sngar bzhin thon skyed nus shugs gong du spel bar bar bgegs byed bzhin yod/ mkhas pos sems su/ gnas tshul 'di bsgyur bcos dgos na/ nges par du mi rigs slob gso 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos par bsam shing / skabs 'di'i hru'u ci khur sgang du gal srid dar lag rdzong gi slob gso yag po 'grub byung na/ lo rgyus kyis bdag la sprad pa'i las 'gan 'grub song bsams/ de'i phyir/khos rgyug 'dur brgyud nas gnas tshul rgyus lon pa dang ma dngul bsdus nas slob grwa'i nyal khang zhig gso dang dge rgan gdan 'dren bcas byas te/ dar lag rdzong gi slob skyong cha rkyen bsgyur bcos dang dar lag rdzong gi mi rigs slob gso dar spel byed ched nyin mtshan med par hur thag 'bad brtson byas pa red/mi rigs slob gso bzung ba las gzhan/ khos da dung mi rigs mthun — 169 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/sgril yang gtsigs su bzung / mi rigs sa khul te dar lag lta bur mtshon na mi rigs mthun sgril legs por yong rgyu ni las 'gan yod tshad legs par sgrub pa'i rmang gzhi yin zer/ khos bltas na rgya rigs dang spun zla mi rigs gzhan dag gi las byed pa tsho mtho zhing 'khyag pa'i mtha' khul du yong nas las ka byed pa ni sla mo zhig min pas/ kho tshor lhag par mang ba'i do khur dang gus bkur dang / mdza' brtse bcas 'thob tu 'jug dgos snyam/ khos bshad don/ mthun sgril byed pa ni phan tshun gnyi gar 'brel ba'i don yin mod/'on kyang mi rigs sa khul la mtshon na/ mi rigs rang gi las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyis thog mar mdza' brtse ldan pa'i lag pa bsrings nas pha yul dang bral ba'i mi rigs so so'i spun zla rnams kyi sems dron por yong 'jug dgos bsams nas/ khos sa cha gzhan pa nas dar lag tu yong ba'i spun zla mi rigs kyi las byed pa tshor gang sa gang du do khur byas pa ste/ shang gi cha rkyen de rdzong mkhar las gzhan pas/ khos ci nus kyis rgya rigs blo mthun la rdzong mkhar du las ka gnyer bcug pa dang / nus pa cung tsam yod pa'i rgya rigs las byed pa tshang ma las rkang gal chen du bkod sgrig byas/ skabs la lar bod rigs las byed pa dang rgya rigs las byed pa'i bar 'gal ba byung na/kho rang nyid song nas thag gcod byas pa dang / bod rigs las byed par skyon brjod mang po byas/ kho rang bod rigs shig yin pas/ 'di 'dra byas na phan tshun bar gyi mthun sgril la phan pa yod par bsams/ yin na'ang mi rigs las byed pa phul byung can zhig byed na don de dag sgrub pa tsam gyis mi 'dang bar da dung ngal rtsol mang tshogs dang snying nye ba'i mi zhig bya dgos/ngal rtsol mang tshogs kyi blor babs na/ da gzod mi rigs las byed pa zhig gi go gnas 'thob thub rgyu red/ de'i phyir/ mi dmangs kyi bde sdug la — 170 —

rgyasakhudiXnyen/ da wa sems khur byed pa de rang nyid kyi g.yol thabs med pa'i las 'gan du brtsis te/ tsha dug che ba'i dbyar kha'am grang ngar che ba'i dgun kha gang yin rung /kho dus rgyun gzhi rim du song nas brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas shing / mang tshogs kyi khe phan dang 'brel ba'i don bya ba gcig gcig gnyis gnyis kho rang nyid kyis rtsad gcod byas pa red/ dper na/ las byed pa zhig gis chang 'thung rjes mang tshogs shig la rdung ba'i don rkyen byung skabs/ 'di don chen zhig min na'ang / kho'i sems nas de ha cang tshabs chen zhig yin par bsams nas las byed pa der skyon brjod nan mo byas/ las byed pa la las 'gan dbang la brten nas sger don bsgrubs te/ mang tshogs kyi rtswa sa btsan bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul yod pa shes ma thag tshang ma thag nan mo bcad/rang nyid kyis rang dpe gzhan ston dang spyod gtsang gis srid skyong / kha ngor mi lta ba bcas byas pa dang / gang sa gang du mig dpe sne khrid kyi nus pa bton pa 'di ni rgya che'i las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyis mkhas por yid ches dang gus bkur byed pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig kyang red/ kho dar lag tu song nas lo gsum lhag 'gor ba dang / rtsa 'dzugs kyi kho la ngal gso'i dus skabs thengs gsum bkod sgrig byas rung khos thengs gcig kyang ngal gso byas ma myong / da lta phyogs so so'i las don la dga' 'os pa'i 'phel rgyas byung bas/ phyir 'dang brgyab rjes ngo ma ngal dub che bar gyur/ da lo da gzod ngal gso thengs shig byas/ ngal gso byas rung sems nas da dung gzhung rdon bsam bzhin yod/ gnam ngo rub ma thag kho'i sems mi bde bar gyur/ de ni lo 'di 'gar khangs gnod kyis kho la bzos pa'i‘‘sems nad’’red/ kho'i byis pa tshos kyang khangs 'bab pa mthong na/ ‘‘khangs babs tshe/ a pha yang mi dga' bar gyur’’zer ba goms srol du song mod/ 'on kyang byis pa tshos kho mi — 171 ———

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dga' don ci yin pa mi shes/ dus rgyun du kho'i las yun de chu tshod bcu lhag yin pa dang / las don mang po khos dgong mo rang khyim nas bsgrubs pa red/kho rang rdzong tang u'i hru'u ci yin pas/ khor ngo dga' byed pa'i mi mi nyung ba zhig yod pa dang chang dang tha mag khyer yong ba dang / tha na skams lug ded nas yong ba'i gnas tshul yang byung myong mod/ 'on kyang khos gcig kyang len ma myong ba dang / rang nyid kyi gnyen nye grogs po tshor sger don yang bsgrubs ma myong / yin na yang mi gzhan par dka' khag re byung tshe khos gang thub ci thub kyis thag gcod rogs byed bzhin yod/ blo mthun la lar nad phog skabs khor brel ba ji ltar che na'ang khom long btsal nas lta ru 'gro ba red/don de dag gi thog nas mi rigs las byed pa zhig gi gshis rgyud bzang po dang blo khog yangs po re mngon par mtshon 'dug /(1988lo'i zla11pa'i tshes12nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal)gzhong sa chen po gsum gyi 'gyur ldog gsar ba/gsar 'god pa/ hu'u yun kha'o/gzhong sa chen po gsum ni men ho hos rigs hor rigs rang skyong rdzong gi shag tho thang dang krung khron dang / zha khug bcas shang (grong rdal)gsum gyi chu ma sa khul gyi bsdus ming yin pa dang / mtsho sngon dang kan su'u sa mtshams — 172 —

rgyas 'phrin/'brel sa'i rma chu 'gram du chags yod cing / mdzes shing sdug pa'i hor yul yin la/ nga tsho mtsho sngon gyi ming grags che ba'i kwa rigs dang sil tog thon sa zhig kyang red/zla10ba'i zla stod/ nga rang yang bskyar gzhong chen gsum du song dus/ngas mthong ba'i gzhong sa chen po gsum de dran pa'i nang du yod pa'i sngon gyi yul gru de gtan nas min par/ de'i 'gyur ldog ni blo yid las 'das pa zhig red/ sa khang gi 'gram du las yod pa'i thog khang yag po chung gras dang de'i nang nas grags yong ba'i rol sgra/ 'dam dang ldan pa'i thang du bshams pa'i tha'e chig stegs bu dang phyi gling pa'i lwa gyon nas spo lo rgyag bzhin pa'i gzhon nu/ ma'o tho 'khor lo bskor ba'i pho gsar dang drel gom pa can zhon pa'i na rgas rnams mnyam du zam chung steng du 'gro ba'i gnas tshul/ btsan sgrig gi gnyen don la mi 'thad par yul nas bros pa'i bu mo dang slob grwar rgyugs ma 'phrod par chur mchong nas shi ba'i 'bring rim slob grwa ba bcas tshang mas dus rabs 'di'i nang 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba mtshon 'dug pas/'gyur ldog des gzhong sa chen po gsum gyi dpa' ngar bskyed pa dang de la skul ma dang bstod bsngags kyang byed cing / sems mi bde ba dang sems khral skyes pa zhig kyang byung bcug yod pa dang / tha na ngu skad 'chor du bcug yod/'gyur ldog byung khrod du skyon cha 'byung ba ni 'gog thabs med pa zhig red/dga' 'os pa zhig ni 'gyur ldog byung ba'i nang du 'gyur mtshams bzhag med pa dang / mu mthud du 'gyur ldog 'byung bzhin pa de ni tshe srog gsar ba yin pa dang 'tsho dpal gsar ba 'byung nges pa mtshon/ de'i dbang gis mi rnams kyis sems gting nas gzhong sa chen po gsum yod/ khyod rang 'gyur ldog byung song zer ba red/— 173 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/shag tho thang ni gzhong sa chen po gsum gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi lte ba red ces bshad chogang tsho shag tho thang grong rdal du bsdad pa'i nyin du mar char yang babs pas/ shag tho thang grol rdal gyis chu 'dam khyab pa'i nang du sa cha so so'i tshong pa dang char 'bab dus nyi ma mi chod par grong rdal der 'ongs pa'i rang sa'i gzhon nu rnams skyel bsu zhu bzhin yod/ char 'bab mtshams cung tsam bzhag na/ gzhung lam 'gram gyi 'dam thang du hor rigs rgan gzhon pho mos bshams pa'i tshong zong mthong thub/ tshong zong chung chung de dag gi nang du mang che ba ni sa de'i kwa rigs sil tog dang tshod ma rdo tha'i lo bcas red/ kho tshos myur mor rang gi ngal rtsol grub 'bras rnams sgor mor brje ba'i gnas tshul de chu 'dam khyab pa'i srang lam dang lam 'gro ba'i brel myur 'degs 'jog gi gom sgra bcas bro ba sna drug tshang ba'i sbrags dkrol rol dbyangs shig tu grub yod/ 'bod sgra gsar ba dang bkag sdom rnying ba rdung kha rgyag pa dang phan tshun 'gal zla byung ba'i 'ur sgra sgrog pa dang zing slong / yid mug dang sems mi bde ba'i khrod du/ thog khang chung gras mdzes sdug can de dag la yid sems khengs pa dang 'tsher snang med tshul mtshon yod la/ ngo tsha ba dang sems mi bde tshul yang mtshon yod/shag tho thang grong rdal la kyā sde ba'i hor rigs rgan po zhig gis nye lam lo 'ga'i 'gyur ldog gleng dus bshad don/ ‘‘da skabs kyi 'tsho ba sngon chad las ha cung bzang / nga tsho la kyā sde ba'i nang sa cha gzhan par zhor las la song mi nyung mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho khyim tshang re rer sil tog ku shu'i ra ba re yod pas/ dpal 'byor yong sgo yang mi nyung / na ning nged tshang gi bza' mi gsum gyis sil tog ku shu btsongs nas sgor chig stong yas mas thob pa red/de min ngas da dung rdo tha lo ma cung tsam btab yod pas/ sgor brgya phrag la — 174 —

/gluthabakhuraXthozud/ da wa btsong thub pa dang 'bru rigs kyang 'dang nges pa zhig yod/ 'tsho ba sngon chad las ha cang bzang bar gyur ba dang / gnyid log na yang sngon chad las bde bar gyur 'dug’’krung khron shang dbyang kyā sde ba'i sil ra 'gan len pa tshos sde ba'i 'gyur ldog gleng dus bshad don/ thon skyed 'gan khur lam lugs lag bstar ma byas sngon/ kho tsho'i thon skyed ru khag la drel gcig ma gtogs med/da skabs lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo bcu lhag yod pa dang / da lo kho nar bdun brgyad tsam nyos yod/ khyim tshang mang pos brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas dang sgra phab 'phrul chas nyos yod pa dang / cha snyoms byas na sde ba yongs su khyim tshang gnyis gsum rer gcig re yod pa dang / khang ba gsar ba 'gebs mkhan de bas kyang mang /gzhong sa chen po gsum la ngo ma 'gyur ldog byung yod/ zha khug nas shag tho thang bar du rma chu'i 'gram brgyud nas song na/ lam khar tshang ma sil ra yin pa dang / mang che ba ni lo 'di gnyis kyi nang gsar du bskor ba red/ de min da dung rdo tha lo ma btab pa'i sa zhing mang po yod/ rdo tha lo ma ni gzhong sa chen po gsum gyi khyad ldan yul thon yin pa dang / zhing chen phyi nang kun tu ming grags che/ rma chu'i 'gram gyi bye thang du mi mang pos ngal rtsol byed bzhin yod pa mthong skabs/ 'gro rogs tu'u lags kyis de ni chu 'gog zhing skrun ar las shig yin pa dang / 'char gzhi ltar na lo gsum nang 'grub rtsis byas yod/ de'i rgya khyon phal cher mu'u bzhi stong yod zer/ lo tog brngos shul du ljang ldem ldem dang ser lam lam gyi nyis 'debs lo tog gis brnga bsdu byed par sgug yod/ sdong gseb tu da nung lug khyus dal mo'i ngang rtswa za bzhin yod/ ston zla bcu ba'i gzhong sa chen po gsum du bde rol las brtson gyi phun tshun tshogs pa'i rnam pas khengs 'dug— /75 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/shag tho thang grong rdal du tshong khang zhig gi bdag po dang kha brda byed dus/khos kho rang gi tshong brin pas lo rer khe spogs rkyang rkyang ches nyung na'ang sgor khri gcig gnyis re len thub pas/ kho rang gis btog cing srang lam rnying ba 'dir brtan srung byas nas sgor khri gcig gnyis longs tshod de len 'dod yod mod/ 'on kyang kho'i tshong khang 'di myur mor bshig rgyu yin pa dang /tshong khang mang po dang tshong khang min pa'i khang ba mang po bshig rgyu red/ 'di nas shag tho thang 'du khrom gsar ba zhig bskrun rgyu yin pa dang / ar las 'di sang lo'i dpyid kar las 'go 'dzugs rgyu yin pas/ 'dam mang la lam dog pa'i shag tho thang srang lam 'di gtor rgyu dang skyo ba'i sdug bsngal gyi nang du dran pa tsam la 'gyur rgyu red zer/ shag tho thang ni mtsho sngon nas kan su'u la 'gro ba'i 'grim 'grul gnad sa zhig yin pa dang / grong rdal dang thag mi ring ba'i rma chu'i steng du zam chen zhig myur mor las nas 'khor lo shar gtong byed rgyu yin pas/ de yang gzhong sa chen po gsum gyi sgo chen zhig phyi la phyes pa red/ des yang gzhong sa chen po gsum la 'gyur ldog 'byung bar skul 'ded byed thub pa smras med yin pa dang / mdzes shing sdug pa'i hor rigs yul gru ste gzhong sa chen po gsum sngon las lhag par phun sum tshogs par 'gyur rgyu yin par ngas yid ches bcangs yod/(1988lo'i zla11pa'i 18nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da mu tig gi 'od zer yul shul rtswa thang du 'cher/sgrig sgyur ba/ mkha' 'tsho/mtha' yas pa dang gshin zhing mdzes pa'i yul shul rtswa thang du chu rgyun 'phred gzhung snol mar gnas pa dang mtsho dang mtshe'u mang po ldan pa/ mkhas pas rtog zhib byed pa dang thig rtsis blangs pa ltar na chu shugs glog 'ardon gyi sbas tshad chan wa khri621la bsleb thub pa dang 'dzam gling gi chu bed kyi thon khungs ha cang mang po'i sa khul zhig yin zer/'on kyang dus yun ring bo'i nang du sa 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa'i chu bed thon khungs chu ltar bzhur song / mar zhu dang tshil zhu sgron nas 'tsho ba bskyal/ glog zer ba de bod rigs mang tshogs la mtshon na 'brug ldir dus nam mkha'i glog dmar 'khyug pa de dang mi dmangs la gnod pa skyel rgyu ma gtogs phan pa cung tsam yang med/ glog gis thon skyed gong 'phel dang 'tsho ba'i chu tshad je mtho ru gtong bar phan pa 'don thub pa gtan nas mi shes/1969lo'i zla10bar 'phrul 'khor nas bton pa'i glog shugs sdom grangs chan wa1000longs pa'i yul shul khul gyi chu glog sa tshigs ang dang po ste ton h+phang hong chu glog sa tshigs de rang skyong khul gyi grong khyer lte ba skye rgu grong rdal du btsugs pa red/ 'od mdangs gsal ba'i glog zhus bod rigs mang tshogs kyi khyim tshang du bkar dus bod rigs mang tshogs rnams ya mtshan skyes — 177 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/nas byams brtse ngang nas glog zhu la‘‘lha zhu’’zer/de'i rjes su zhing chen chu bed thin dang zhing chen tshan us rogs ram byas par brten nas/ yul shul khul gyis chu bed thon khungs la bed spyod gang legs bya rgyu dang chu glog sa tshigs 'dzugs rgyu de mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba legs sgyur byed pa'i nang don gal chen la rtsis nas bzung / thabs brgya jus stong gis phyogs mang po nas ma dngul sgor khri2000lhag bsgrigs nas khri 'du dang nang chen/ 'bri stod/ chu dmar leb sogs rdzong du chu glog sa tshigs8btsugs pas rdzong so sor chu glog sa tshigs yod par gyur/chu glog sa tshigs btsugs rjes chu glog lag rtsal dpung sde brtan po'i ngang gso sbyong dgos 'dug khul dang rdzong gi rim pa so so'i srid gzhung gis‘‘phyir mngags nas’’gso sbyong slob sbyong byed du bcug pa dang‘‘nang du drangs nas’’lag rtsal slob khrid byed pa'i byed thabs lag len byas te/ rig gnas ldan zhing brtson zhib byed thub pa'i bod rigs na gzhon60lhag zi ling dang khrin tu'u dang / hrang he sogs sa char 'dem skyel byas nas slob sbyong zab sbyong byas pa dang / da dung zi ling dang hang krig nas bzo skrun mkhan16yul shul la gdan drangs yong nas lag rtsal slob khrid byas pas/ chu glog bzo pa'i lag rtsal chu tshad je mtho ru song la rim bzhin bod rigs bzo ba gtso bo yin pa'i chu glog lag rtsal do dam dpung sde byung ba red/bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed byas pa nas bzung lhag par du zhing chen tang us mtsho sngon lho rgyud kyi las don gros tshogs bsdus rjes/ yul shul chu glog 'dzugs skrun de yang chu tshad gsar bar spel ba dang / chu glog sa tshigs 'dzugs skrun de rdzong nas rim bzhin du shang la 'phel bas snga gzhug tu khri 'du'i lab dang nang chen gyi sprel tshwa dang / spyi chu/ yul shul gyi mgron mda' — 178 —

rgyas 'phrin/sogs su shang rim pa'i chu glog sa tshigs10btsugs/ de bas dga' 'os pa zhig ni thog mar phyug por bsgyur pa'i sde ba dang hre kha shas kyis rang sis ma dngul bsgrigs nas chu glog sa tshigs btsugs/ yul shul rdzong gi byam sa sku dang khri 'du rdzong gi dga' skyid sogs sde ba 4yis ma dngul sgor khri120bsgrigs nas bsdoms pas chan wa250yi chu glog sa tshigs4btsugs/mang tshogs kyis dga' spro ngang nas bshad don/ ‘‘‘lha zhu’yang nga tsho'i dbul phongs sde bar yong nas‘khyim gzhis chags pa’red/’’mig sngar khul yongs su chu glog sa tshigs22yod cing / sgrig sbyor byas pa'i 'phrul 'khor nas bton pa'i glog shugs sdom grangs chan wa9570la bslebs pa dang lo re'i glog 'don tshad chan wa chu tshod khri250tsam la bslebs/mig sngar khul yongs su shang28yis sa ngos 'khor skar bsdu len sa tshigs btsugs pa dang / grong sde'i slob grwa32la glog yod pa dang rong 'brog pa khyim tshang6000lhag gis brnyan 'phrin lta thub 'dug(1992lo'i zla3pa'i tshes4nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/lus ngag yid gsum mi rigs slob gsor phul ba/tsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i ca'o hru'u blo bzang chos grags kyi gnas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ tshe gzungs/mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i nang du mi rigs slob gso'i 'thab phyogs thog lo ngo nyer dgu ring 'bad brtson byas shing / bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig kyi slob khrid thog byas rjes chen po bzhag yod pa'i dge rgan zhig yod pa de ni rgya bod skad yig gnyis la mkhas pa'i rgyal khab rim pa'i mkhas pa dang ca'o hru'u dang zhib 'jug slob ma'i slob dpon te mtshan dngos blo bzang chos grags zhes pa de yin/1941lor blo bzang chos grags mdo smad hu'u kru'u rdzong gi bod khyim zhig nas skyes/ rang lo bcu dgu'i thog tu khong nyid mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig ched las nang zhugs nas lo bzhi ring gi slob sbyong byas nas sbyangs 'bras rmad byung sgos mthar phyin/1964lor rang lo nyer gsum yin pa'i blo bzang chos grags kyis mi dmangs dge rgan gyi las 'gan khur du bzhes te slob gso'i don gnyer ba'i 'go brtsams/ lo ngo nyer dgu'i ring khong nyid khrid stegs nas bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig dang tshad ma rig pa la sogs pa'i gnas du ma la zhib 'jug — 180 —

rgyas 'phrin/nan mo byas pas sbyangs 'bras dang dga' rtags lan gcig ma yin par thob/1977lor mtho rim slob grwa ru rgyugs blangs nas slob ma sdud pa'i lam lugs slar gso byas pa dang sbrags slob yun lo bzhi can gyi dngos gzhi'i slob ma rim bzhin slob grwar zhugs/ bod yig ched las sde khag gi slob tshan gtso bo yin pa'i gna' rabs rtsom yig gi slob khrid de bslab deb 'thus sgo mi tshang bas/ slob khrid kyi spus tshad mthor 'degs byed pa la dka' khag mang po byung / skabs 'dir blo bzang chos grags kyis zhib 'jug slob ma bsod nams rtse mo dang mnyam du tshan rig can dang rgyud rim can/ ma dper can bcas kyi ldan pa'i bod kyi gna' rabs kyi rtsom yig bslab deb zhig rtsom sgrig byed pa de zhib 'jug gtso gnad du bzung ste/ mdo dbus khams gsum gyi dpe mdzod khang dang rgyang ring dben sar gnas pa'i grwa sa dang dgon sde gang mang du song nas/ mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung 'bum po ti chig stong sum brgya lhag la mjal nas/ 'di dag las skad grags che zhing rtsom nyams ldan pa'i brtsams chos bton nas legs par sgrig pa dang go dka' ba'i tha snyad la mchan 'grel bkod de/ lo gsum ring gi 'bad brtson byas nas〈gangs ljongs mkhas dbang rim byon gyi rtsom yig gser gyi sbram bu〉zhes bya ba bsgrigs te yongs su grub cing par du bskrun/ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog gi stong cha bskangs pa red/ da lta dpe cha de rgyal yongs kyi mi risas slob grwa chen mo so so'i slob deb byas te bed spyod kyin yod pa ma zad/ da nung a me ri kha dang h+pha ran se dang 'jar pan la sogs pa'i rgyal khab tu khyab ste/ 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams kyi dga' bsu thob/blo bzang chos grags kyis dus rgyun du dge rgan gzhan pa dang mnyam du slob khrid kyi nyams myong brje spel dang rig gzhung gi 'phel phyogs la 'ib — 181 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'jug byas pas mi tshad/ da rung na gzhon dge rgan rnams kyi slob khrid dang slob khrid gra sgrig gi gnas tshul la gzigs zhib byas pa dang sbrags kho tshor slob khrid thog thug pa'i dka' gnad thag gcod rogs byas te/ spyod yon gnyis ldan gyi dge rgan dpung sde chags pa'i ched du rang nyid kyi nus shugs yod rgu bton/ blo bzang chos grags nyid kyi rig gzhung thog gi phyag rjes gtso bo ni tshad ma rig par slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byas pa'i 'bras bu de yin/ khong gis rang nyid kyi sdug rus la brten nas/ zhib 'jug slob ma rnams la slob khrid byed pa'i dus mtshungs su tshad ma rig par zhib 'jug brtson 'grus byas te/ lo 'ga'i ring la snga gzhug tu rig gzhung gi rin thang ldan pa'i〈blo rig dang gtan tshigs rig pa〉dang〈rtags rigs la dpyad pa〉sogs tshad ma skor gyi ched rtsom drug bris shing / rgyal khab phyi nang gi rig gzhung dpyod mkhan rnams kyis do khur bya yul du gyur/sa skya'i legs bshad las‘‘yon tan chung rnams nga rgyal che/ mkhas par gyur na dul bar gnas’’zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ ca'o hru'u blo bzang chos grags kyis slob gso'i las gnas thog 'bad brtson byas par g.yur du za ba'i grub 'bras thob/ 1991lor mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling gi tang us khong nyid la gung khran tang yon phul byung can gyi mtshan snyan gnang / 1992lor rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i ched gtong gron dngul longs su spyod pa'i mkhas pa'i mtshan rtags gnang /slob gso'i 'phrin las mdzad mkhan 'di nyid kyis da lta snying rus skyed de tang gi mi rigs las don thog rang nyid kyi sems shugs dang blo gros mu mthud du 'bul bzhin 'dug/(1993lo'i zla9pa'i tshes20nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal)ge 182 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa da wa mi rnams las la brtson pas na/phyug po'i lam sne zin nges so/gsar 'god pa/ grags pa/zla11pa'i zla dkyil du nga tsho gcan tsha rdzong ma gi thang grong rngal gyi hos rigs sde bar bcar 'dri byed par phyin/ sde ba de lho phyogs su rdzong mkhar dang 'brel yod pa dang byang phyogs su rma chu kha dang 'brel yod/ sde ba yongs su khyim tshang41dang sa zhing mu'u 220yod/ khyim tshang gi sgo ra dag tu sdong bo sna tshogs btsugs yod cing / sgo khar ba mo nag khra 'ga' re gsos yod/ gyon pa spus dag khyon pa'i pho mo tshos bshad zhor dgod zhor du khyim lud brdungs nas dpyid 'debs gra sgrig byed bzhin yod/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci ma he pe'u yis nga tshor bshad don/ nga tsho sde ba'i 'gyur ldog chen po 'di gtso bo tang gi bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed srid jus la brten nas byung ba yin/ sngon chad lo rer mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor200tsam dang bza' 'bru spyi rgya200tsam las med phyir sde ba dbul bo zhig yin/ 1985lor/ gsar du bdams pa'i mgo khrid pa tshos phyogs gcig nas mang tshogs la tang gi srid jus sna tshogs dril sgrog thengs mang byas pa dang sde ba'i sgrig lam sna tshogs gtan 'khel byas/sgrig lam de dag lag bstar bya ched lta skul tshan chung btsugs nas don tshan re re bzhin don thog tu babs bcug phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'ing 'a sa dpal da 183 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'byor gong du spel/ kho tshos mang tshogs skul slong sgos sde ba dang sa zhing la gyang ra skor nas/ nang du shing chas sdong bo dang sil tog sdong bo btsugs/lo gnyis gsum nang zhing 'gram dang lam 'gram dang / chu 'gram bcas la shing sdong chig khri dang sil sdong chig khri btsugs nas cha snyoms khyim tshang rer sil sdong260lhag yod par gyur/ sil sdong de dag las1988lo nas phan 'bras byung ste zhing pa'i yong sgo lo re bzhin 'phar/gom gang mdun spos sgos bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed dang dpal 'byor gong du spel ched/ nye lam lo 'ga'i nang sde ba 'di'i mgo khrid pa tshos mang tshogs la sna mang bdag gnyer spel du bcug kho tshos las byed pa dang mang tshogs sgrig 'dzugs byas nas skor dang skor bzhin zi ling nye 'dabs kyi zhing sde dang men ho dang lo tu'u sogs rdzong du song nas de tsho'i dpal 'byor gong du spel ba'i nyams myong slob sbyong byas/ dus mtshungs su zhing las lag rtsal pa sde ba'i nang gdan drangs nas sde dmangs tshor tshan rig dang mthun par zhingu 'debs lag rtsal dang sil sdong 'dzugs rtsal dang / bzhon ma gso rtsal sogs khrid du bcug de bzhin sde dmangs tshos mthong rgya dang shes rgya je cher gyur cing / sde dmangs la las ba mo nyos nas gso ba dang la las ston bsdus rjes tshod ma 'debs pa/ la las skams lug nyos yong nas gsos rjes 'dren tshong byas/ sde ba der thon rdzas mang stabs tshong rar mkho sprod byas pa'i tshong zong yang je mang du gyur/ nye lam lo gnyis nang sde ba 'di'i zhing pa tshos gcan tsha rdzong mkhar du spyod pa'i 'o ma dang skams lug las mang shos longs pa mkho sprod byas pa ma zad/ sil tog dang tshod ma'ang mi nyung ba mkho sprod byas/sde dmangs tsho'i sgor mo je mang du song bar bstun mi la la zi ling dang nang logs su song nas tshong gnyer ba red/ sde ba'i sde dmangs gnyis na ning gi — 184 ge

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wazla dang por pe cin du song nas za khang gnyer nas zla rer khe spogs sgor khri gsum tsam babs yod zer/sde ba 'di'i mgo khrid pa dang mang tshogs tshos zhing las gnyer ba las gzhan 'bad brtson gyis sna mang bdag gnyer byas nas yong sgo 'phar/ da lta sde ba 'di'i zhing mu'u re'i 'bru rigs thon tshad spyi brgya468la bslebs lo rer mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor800la bslebs/ sde ba yongs su rlangs 'khor gnyis dang 'drud 'then 'khor lo che chung 16dang / ba mo nag khra80bcas yod/ khyim tshang yod do cog las80lhuyis khang ba gsar ba las yod/(1994lo'i zla1pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngosaganyis par gsal/)lo gzhon kha yi gtam gsar snyan/da wazhin he rdzong gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa bstan go la bcar 'dri byas pa/bkra bha/nga'i mdun gyi 'bol khri steng bag phebs ngang tsog ste lhug lhug gtam gyi sgo mo phye ba'i bod rigs gsar rgod de'i pho sgo legs shing kha lce bde/ kho'i ming la bstan kho zer la/ da lta pho lo so gcig la son pa dang / zhin he rdzong — 185 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mi dmangs srid gzhung gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa yin/ kho btsal nas gzhung las khang la yong mkhan ha cang mang bas/ snga dro gcig la bcar 'dri byed mtshams thengs bcu lhag la 'jog dgos byung / nga tshos zhing las dang bzo tshong nas 'go brtsams te/ rim bzhin dri ba dris lan gyi a long yang long la brgyus na zhin he rdzong gi thon khungs gsar gtod skor gleng skabs/ rdzong dpon bstan go'i spro snang ches cher 'phel/ ‘‘zhin he rdzong du thon khungs chen po gsum ste phyugs zog dang / gter rdzas/ chu bed bcas yod/ phyugs las kyis zhin he rdzong gi rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor khrod du go gnas gal chen bzung yod/ rdzong yongs su rtswa sa mu'u khri1950yod/ phyugs rigs sna tshogs khri86lhag yod pas/ lo rer tshong zog dang phyugs las thon rdzas kyi spyi'i rin thang sgor khri500son/ lo mang bo'i ring / stobs shugs chen pos mang tshogs la rgyab rogs byas te thon skyed cha rkyen je bzang la btang ste/ snga gzhug tu gsum 'dzoms gnod 'gog lte gnas300las pa dang rtswa mdzod ra ba mu'u khri86bskor te/ phyugs las gtan 'jags ngang nas gong 'phel du 'gro bar mthun rkyen legs po bskrun’’/der mthud nas bstan khos bshad don/ ‘‘zhin he ni mtsho sngon gyi gter kha phyug pa'i rdzong yin pa ma zad/ rgyal yongs su'ang mtshan snyan yod/rdzong yongs su gter rigs28rnyed pa dang / zangs dang zha nye/ lcags/gser sogs kyi gter rdzas phun sum tshogs/ de'i nang gser dang zangs gter ni rgyal yongs kyi zangs gter che shos su brtsis yod/’’ chu bed thon khungs gleng skabs/ bstan kho lags kyi spro snang sngar las je cher phyin/ chu bed thon khungs thad nas kyang zhin he ha cang phyug zhing chen chu bed thin gyis chu sngon chu bo'i bzhur rgyud la rtog zhib byas pa ltar na/ chu bo — 186 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa 'di gcig pu'i steng nas glog 'don sa tshigs bzhi 'dzugs skrun bya chog zer/(1994lo'i zla1pa'i tshes22nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)rdo bzo lha lung thar/lha 'brug tshe ring /sngon chad skad grags med pa'i men ho rdzong zhin er lung ba'i bod rigs shang lon hri thug sde ba'i sde dmangs lha lung thar gyi ming de nye lam lo 'ga'i ring shang de'i phyogs mtshams kun tu khyab 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ gcig ni khos rdo bzo'i lag rtsal phul byung la brten nas rdo ril dang rdo gzhong / rdo zam bcas bzos nas phyug 'gyur gyi thabs bkod ldan pa dang / gnyis ni kho rang gi khyim tshang phyug por gyur pa las yid mi tshim par slob phrug la lag rtsal bslabs nas yul mi tsho yang lto gos 'dzoms pa'i lam du bskyod par rogs byas pa'i rkyen gyis red/tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi rlabs rgyun chen mo'i khrod/ lha lung thar grags 'gul med par 'dug ma 'dod par rig pa gcig sgrim gyi sgo nas rdo bzo'i lag rtsal slob sbyong byas/ khos rdo btsal ba dang dge rgan la bsten nas lag rtsal sbyangs shing / dka' ngal grangs med myangs mthar kho rang yul gru de'i lag shes mkhas par gyur/ khos bzos pa'i rdo ril dang rdo gzhong gi bzo — 187 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dbyibs legs shing spus ka bzang ba'am che chung tshad 'os pa'i khar zhabs 'degs zhu stangs kyang yag pas rgya che'i spyod mkhan rnams kyi dga' bsu thob/rdo yi rgyu chas tshong brin zhing dpal 'byong yong sgo bzang ba der mi rnams yid smon 'chor ba zhig red/ 1988lo nas da lta'i bar du khos rdo ril900lhag bzos nas sgor khri4tsam gyi yong sgo thob cing / rdo gzhong200bzos pa dang rdo zam mus1300bzos nas bsdoms pas sgor khri6lhag gi yong sgo thob pas kho tshang gis so phag dang shing las grub pa'i khang shar gnyis bkab cing / sdeb 'grig khyim chas dang tshon ldan brnyan chas/ sdeb 'grig sgra skyed 'phrul chas sogs skabs bab dar srol khyim chas nyos yod/nye lam lo shas ring du lha lung thar tshang la yong nas kho la dge rgan bsten pa'i mi ha cang mang / lha lung thar gyis‘‘yul mi rnams la lag shes bslabs nas phyug 'gyur gyi byed thabs blo bkod 'then rogs byed pa ni nga'i phugs 'dun yin’rizhes bshad/ rang yul dang gzhan yul gang rung gi zhing ba kho tshang la rdo bzo'i lag shes slob tu yong tshe/ khos tshang mar lhag bsam rnam dag sgos sne len byas shing kho tshor lag rtsal dmar khrid byas par ma zad/da rung thag ring sa nas yong ba'i slob bu la rin ma blangs par za ma'i mthun rkyen dang nyal sa 'don sprod byas/ da lta lha lung thar gyi slob bu zam mi 'chad par je mang du 'phar zhing / khos bslabs pa'i slob bu mang che bas rang tshugs 'dzin thub pa dang rdo bzo'i lag rtsal byang chub pas/ dpal 'byor yong sgo yang mang po thob pa red/(1994lo'i zla6pa'i tshes4nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal kyi)— 188 —

rgyas 'phrin/brtse sems pha yul laphul ba'i bod rigs bud med sman pa/da wa yul shul khul mi dmangs sman khang mo nad btsa' skye tshan khag gi kru'u rin ma hrin zhug gi gnas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ mkha' 'tsho/dpyid dpal rgyas shing lta na sdug pa'i me tog rnam pa sna tshogs spang ljongs su bzhad pa'i dus bzang du/ nga rang yul shul gyi 'brog pa mang tshogs dang las byed pa rnams kyis gzengs su bstod pa'i bud med sman pa ma hrin zhug la thug nas ngo shes song /skyid chu 'gram du ngas mo rang rgyus lon zhing mo rang la gus sems kyang skyes/ lo bco lnga'i sngon du ma hrin zhug mtsho sngon gso rig slob gling du slob mthar phyin zhing / mtsho sngon gso rig slob gling zur gtogs sman khang du las ka'ang bkod sgrig byed rtsis byas/ de ru las gnyer dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen bzang zhing khor yug skyid po'ang yin pas mo spro snang skye myong mod/ 'on kyang rang gi pha yul yul shul na sman pa dkon la sman rdzas kyang nyung bas yul mi rnams na sdug gis mnar ba dang / lhag par du pha yul gyi bud med tsho phru gu skye khag las shi ba dang phru gu'ang shi tshad mtho ba de yid la shar dus/ mo'i blo sems mi bde par gyur cing / mo gso skyong byas pa'i rtswa thang dang yul mi spun — 189 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/zla tsho brjed ma phod pas/ mos mgo khrid dang blo mthun rnams la bka' drin che zhus rjes/ lo mang por bslabs pa'i lag rtsal dang rtswa thang la bcangs pa'i brtse dung zab mo dang bcas phyir rang gi pha yul du bslebs/yul shul la bslebs rjes/ sgrig chas rjes lus dang lag rtsal stobs shugs zhan pa'i dbang gis/ nad pa kha shas kyis na sdug myangs nas zi ling sman khang du 'gro ba dang / nad pa kha shas lam thag ring bas 'gro 'khom med par shi ba'i gnas tshul byung dus/ mo sems khra' gyi g.yengs su lhung / rjes lus kyi gnas tshul bsgyur bcos byed ched/ mos dus tshod dam 'dzin byas te lag rtsal slob sbyong dang 'bad brtson gyis las ka legs par gnyer/lo 'ga'i sngon gyi ston mjug gi mtshan mo zhig la/ nyin dkar nas 'bab pa'i kha ba je cher song zhing rlung chen gyis 'tshe rogs byas/ mtshan gyi chu tshod bcu gnyis yas mas su mo tshang gi sgo rdung byung bar/ skyes pa zhig gis‘‘sman pa lags/ khyed kyis mi srog bskyab rogs gnang’’zhes 'bod sgra btang /ma hrin zhug gis mgyogs myur du gyon chas gon pa dang sman sgam khur zhing glog zhu khyer nas sgo phyir bud/ khangs rlung nang du sems khral gyis mnar ba'i 'brog pa zhig langs 'dug khos bshad pa ltar na/ kho'i ming la tshe ring phun tshogs zer ba dang / kho'i chung mar phru gu skye khag byung bas dbang bo shor song /chung ma'i srog skyob ched sman pa khyed ka 'bod du yong ba yin zer/ khangs rlung nang du mo dang tshe ring phun tshogs thang la 'gyel bzhin du sbrum ma'i gam du bslebs/ sbrum ma'i gnas tshul ngan tshabasaswāche ba dang sman khang dang thag ring zhing 'grim 'grul yang stabs bde min pas/ sman khang du skyel na nyen kha ha cang che/ de bas ma hrin zhug gis sbrum ma'i khyim nas myur skyob byed thabs yod tshad bton/ mtshan gyi chu tshod gsum ring du myur skyob byas te ma bu nyis — 190 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad waka bde bar gyur/ tshe ring phun tshogs dang kho'i ma rgan sems 'gul thebs pa'i ngang du‘‘drin chen ma/ drin chen ma’’zer/ sbrum ma'i bde thang la dmigs nas ma hrin zhug gis yang sbrum mar chu tshod gnyis ring brtags phyin/mo sems bde mo'i ngang tshe ring phun tshogs tshang nas phyir 'gro dus ri mgo la nyi rtse phog nye tshod red/mo phyir khyim nang du 'gro 'khom med par drang mor sman khang du song /sman khang gi nad pa bcu phrag gis mor sgug yod pa dang / lhag par du sbrum ma zhig la mos lhag par sems khral byas yod/ sbrum ma de'i phru gu gnyis ma skye sngon du mngal nas shi bas/ da thengs sbrum mar sems khur che zhing bza' zla gnyi gas phru gu thob pa'i re ba yod tshad ma hrin zhug la bcol yod/ mo sman khang la bslebs ma thag tu las res sman pas sbrum ma de'i gnas tshul bzang mi 'dug zer/ de'i skabs su mos ngal dub yod tshad brjed nas nad khang du song nas sbrum mar dngos su dpyad rjes/ de 'phral‘‘gshags bcos byed dgos’’zer/ sbrul ma der sems 'gul thebs te mo'i lag par 'jus nas‘‘khyed kyis nga'i byis pa'i srog skyob rogs gnang’’zer/ mos sbrum mar‘‘sems bde mo byos/ byis par skyon mi 'dug’’ces sems gso byas/gshags bcos byed dus sbrum ma dbang bo shor bas dka' khag mang por thug mos lag rtsal byang chub pa bton nas ljid tshad rgya ma bdun tsam gyi bu phrug cig 'jig rten 'dir bsus pa dang sbrum ma'ang nyen kha las thar/gal srid gshags bcos 'di chu tshod phyed ka tsam 'gyangs par btang na ma bu gnyi ga'i srog skyob dka' ba red/ sbrum mas skad gdangs dma' mos‘‘sman pa lags/ nga'i byis pa ’’zhes dris dus/ mos ngag 'jam ngang8‘byis pa'i gnas tshul bzang po red/ khyod la bu zhig thob yod’’ces lan btab/— 191 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/yul shul khul mi dmangs sman khang mo nad btsa' skye tshan khag gi kru'u rin nam bod rigs sman pa zhig la mtshon na/ mo'i khur bo ha cang ljid mo red/ mos mo nad sna tshogs gso bcos byed dgosas pa ma zad/ da dung 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye thad kyi byed phyogs lag tu bstar ched/ dmigs bsal can gyi khor yug du dka' spyad sgos 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye thad kyi dril bsgrags kyang bya dgos/lo bcu lhag gi ring / mos khyim tshang gi dka' ngal bsal te sman sgam khur ba dang rtar zhon nas nad pa8000lhag gi na tsha bsal ba dang skye rgyun gcod pa'i gshags bcos12000byas pa las chag sgo thengs gcig kyang byung ma myong / 'brog khul gyi sman bcos slob gso gong 'phel du gtong ched/mos 'os 'gan du khul de'i 'phrod bsten slob grwa dang rdzong so so'i sman khang dang ma bu bde srung sa tshigs kyi sman bcos mi sna tshor slob khrid byas pa dang lag rtsal khrid/ de min da dung yig 'bru khri20lhag gi khrid yig dang ched rtsom bris/ mos rigs so so'i mi dmangs la dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis zhabs phyi zhus nas/ mi dmangs kyis kyang kho mor bka' drin che zhus/ da lo'i lo 'gor mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis kho mor1994lo'i zhing chen yongs kyi‘‘gsum brgyad dar dmar sgreng mkhan’’dang‘‘byas rjes bzhag pa'i bud med dpe legs can’’gyi mtshan snyan gnang / /(1994lo'i zla12pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal/)

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa khri shor rgyal mo'i 'gram ngogs kyi 'brog dud rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i dpal la ltos/ yan dang rkang tsha rdzong gnyis kyi 'brog khul du bskyod pa'i mthong thos thor bu/gsar 'god pa/ tshe dpal rgyal/‘‘khyim gyi ca lag dbyibs gsar can/ 'grim 'grul lag cha 'phrul chas can/ zas gos spyod gsum sna mang can’’zhes pa des bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed tshun chad rang zhing gi mtsho sngon po mtha' skor gyi 'brog pa mang tshogs gtan sdod byung rjes 'tsho ba'i chu tshad la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba gsal bor mtshon/gsar 'god pa nye char mtsho byang khul gyi he yan dang rkang tsha rdzong gi phyugs las gtan sdod gnad sa skor zhig tu bcar 'drir song / gtan sdod gnad sa mang che ba'i khang mig shing dang so phag gis las yod cing / gnam brgyan dang mthil shing sogs kyis khang ba'i nang mngon par spros la/ khyim tshang mang che ba'i rgya sgo'i sgo shing steng ri mo sna tshogs brkos 'dug la gzhis ma'i gyang ngos 'dam bag gis byugs te 'jam zhing bde/ khang ba'i nang gi sgrig chas dag la bltas na 'bol khri dang / mdun cog dang / khyim spyod glog chas sogs gang la blta dgos mi shes/he yan rdzong mtsho sngon po shang bal dkar sde ba'i khyim tshang130la tshang — 193 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mar glog 'then zhing brnyan 'phrin gyi khebs tshad 60lkoyan chad zin/ shang srid gzhung gi las byed pa dkon 'brug gis nga tsho thog mar blo bzang tshang la khrid/ rgya sgo nang la 'dzul dus 'phrul chas shig gi 'ur sgra rna lam du son/ nye bar bltas tshes blo bzang bi/ bu mo sgrol ma 'tsho yis gos 'khrud 'phrul chas kyis gon rgyu 'khrud kyin 'dug khyim bdag ma bsod nams sgrol mas nga tsho 'grul khang nang du drangs/ yod do cog ni ji 'dra'i ngo mtshar zhing gral 'grig po zhig red ang / 'brug mo'i mdzes 'don byug rdzas te dri zhim byug chu dang /mo si/ ya chan sogs spyod kyin yod pa shes la/ mdzes 'don byug rdzas de dag grong khyer bu mo'i ched spyod tsam min pa kho mo'i lus steng las mtshon thub/rkang tsha rdzong mtsho 'khyil shang nya nag so ma sde ba de mtsho sngon po'i mtsher ba ri dang 'dres nas 'dug la/ mtsho byang khul du ches snga bar gtan sdod byung ba'i phyugs las sde ba zhig red/ nga tsho sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci bla ma tshang nas sgug 'dug dus/ kho rdzong thog nas ma'o tho 'khor lo'i steng la zhon nas sngo tshod bkal te mda' bzhin phyir log skabs der/ mna' ma dpal mo'i ngo la 'dzum langs shing / mos sgyug po'i lag gi sngo tshod tshur blangs te myur mo ja khang nang du 'dzul/ skar ma20'gor rjes tshod ma sna kha brgyad brngos 'ongs shing / 'bras dang gor re ci dgar spyod chog 'brog khyim nas dri zhim la mig tu yag pa'i kha zas 'di 'dra zhig longs su spyod pa gal te mig gis ma mthong na mi su yis yid rton rung / 'brog u yi rtsis gnyer pa btsun kho ni lad mo dang kha mtshar la dga' ba zhig red/ lo 'di 'ga'i ring khos dbyibs gsar cha 'grig khang bzang mang po mthong stabs na ning rang gi khyim las‘‘bzo skrun ru khag’’cig btsugs te sngon chad kyi sa khang de shing dang so phag gi khang mig tu bsgyur/ yangs shing 'od gsal ba'i 'grul khang las mu — 194 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa da wamed rtswa thang dang chu khri shor rgyal mo'i mdzes mdangs gsal ler mthong 'dug(1996lo'i zla5pa'i tshes4nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)'byor phyug lam gyi sne 'dren pa/da wathun rin rdzong smad pa shang khyung bo sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yi ga/nas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ tshe dpal rgyal/khyung bo sde ba de rong bo dgu chu'i 'gram du chags yod cing / khor yug dang gnam gshis cha rkyen bzang bas sde ba de thun rin rdzong gi 'bru mdzod ces grags/ sde ba der da lta gung khran tang yon50yod 'dug sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis tang gi dmangs phyug srid jus nan tan gyis lag bstar byas shing tang yon tshos mang tshogs khrid nas zhing las dang bzo las tshong las/phyugs las/ nags las/ zhor las sogs kyi las rigs mnyam du 'phel rgyas su btang / 1995lor sde ba yongs kyi yong sgo sgor khri97 5la kho na slebs pa dang mi rer cha snyoms sgor780zin/ sngon chad sgor mo bkol na skyi dang za ma za na phye kho na pa'i dbul phongs sde ba des da lta lto rgyab kyi gnad don thag bcad par ma zad/ 'byor phyug lam du bgrod 'go brtsams/ khyung bo sde ba'i tang kri pu'u thun rin rdzong dang rma lho khul gyis thengs mang por sngon thon tang — 195 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/kri pu'u la bdams/‘‘'bru rigs thon skyed brtan brling dang lo tog grub cha legs sgrig byas te dpal 'byor nags ra dang gso spel las rigs/ zhing zhor thon rdzas sbyor babro/ 'grim 'grul las rigs/ bza' btung zhabs 'degs las rigs/sdong 'dzugs nags skrun’’bcas ni sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i dpal 'byor dar rgyas su gtong ba'i rigs lam yin/ kho tshos btang lhod med par 'bru rigs thon skyed de dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi rmang gzhi byas te sde dmangs tshor tshan rig ltar zhing 'debs pa dang lud bkol bar khrid ston byas shing / zhing las tshan rtsal mi sna gdan 'dren byas nas dngos bkol lag rtsal spel du bcug1995lo sde ba'i yongs kyi 'bru rigs spyi'i thon tshad spyi rgya khri54la bslebs/ ‘‘smad pa'i chang ba li’’thun rin sa khul du ming grags che bas/ sde ba tang kri pu'u yis bab bstun sne khrid ltar chang ba li 'dzugs pa'i rgya khyon je cher btang / de dang lhan du hur brtson sgos chu shog drod khang las nas sngo tshod rten gzhi btsugs/ zhor las de gnyis kyis khyung bo mang tshogs la dpal 'byor khe phan yag tsam bzos/ tang kri pu'u des da rung phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bru rigs thon khungs kyi gnas bab bzang bor brten nas1993lor ma dngul sgor khri20btang ste thun rin rdzong du thon mong gis bdag gnyer byed pa'i bag phye sbyor bzo bzo grwa btsugs te lo'i thon skyed nus tshad tun500la bslebs/ kho tshos thon skyed byas pa'i bag phye spus ka legs shing rin gong ran pas rong bo dang hi nan dang rtse khog bla brang sogs sa khul du brin pa dang lo'i khe spogs sgor khri5lhag bskrun/ da lo sde ba des sngon chad phag mi gso ba'i goms gshis bsgyur nas phag gso las rigs spel ba dang gzan chas sbyor bzo bzo grwa rnam grangs de 'dzugs grabs yod/— 196 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad ‘‘lo brgya'i jus chen slob gsor brten/ri’ khyung bo sde ba tang kri pu'u yis gnas lugs de mngon par rtogs/ 1995lor tang kri pu'u des ma ngangul sgor khri3bsdus /nas khyung bo slob chung gsar du las shing slob khring mkho chas nyos/ dge rgan dus chen thengs re rer tang kri pu'u yis dbe rgan rnams la 'tshams 'dri byas/ da lta slob grwa de'i dge rgan dag gis sems bde slob brid byed bzhin pa dang / slob mas brtson pa lhur len gyis slob sbyong byed kyin 'dug slob lo ran pa'i zhugs tshad9skyelko dang brtan tshad99lko yan la bslebs/ /(1996lo'i zla9ba'i tshes22nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)pad ma 'di la dri bzang mnga'/da wamachin khug gzhung gi rgyud lug phyugs ra'i pad ma skyid kyis sanas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ rig mdzod skyid/dpyid kyi bdag mos spro ba'i bzhin nyams shar ba'i dus bzang du 'phrad kyang / mtsho ngos las mus3200lhag mtho ba'i mchin khug gzhung lug rgyud phyugs ra gnas sa'i na ring rtswa thang la da dung lhags pa dgun ltar che ba dang rlung 'tshub kyis mi ded nas rang lcogs mi tshugs pa'i tshul snang la/da 197 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bdag gis pad ma skyid rang khyim du log zin pa go nas bcar 'drir phyin/mthong lam du gyo mog dmar pos brtsigs pa'i khang ba zhig shar/ sgo khar son nas lam ston pas pad ma skyid ces bos pa na/ / ya lan ster mi ma byung / sgo khyis mi cha med mthong nas bdag por mgron bsu bya rgyu'i brda brgyab/cung zad 'gor tshe bgres mo lo brgyad cur nye ba zhig sgor bud nas nga tsho khyim du bsus/ nang du bu mo slob lor ran ma thag pa zhig gis 'tshab 'tshub ngang gad dag byed kyin 'dug de las chung ba'i bu mo zhig 'dug pa de sngangs skrag gi nyams tsam mngon te glo sgo nas khang ba gzhan nang byol song / rgya lo'i tshes brgyad yin rung / dud tshang der gyang ngos kyi ri mo gsar ba 'ga' las lo gsar gtong skabs kyi rnam pa ci yang mi snang /khyim der bsdad nas phyi dro'i chu tshod drug la nye bar son pas/ bdag gis glo bur tsam gyis‘‘pad pa skyid zog rdzi nas da dung mi yong ba 'di ci'i phyir yin nam’’zhes dris pa na/ bgres mo na re/ ‘‘dus tshod snga bas zog phyir log pa'i skabs ma lon pa red/ khyod tshor don brel mo yod na nga 'bod du 'gro’’zer/ bdag gis bgres mo de 'dra zhig mngag rgyu sems nas ma bzod mod/yin na'ang zhing chen yongs kyi‘‘las rkang steng gi skar chen brgya’’zhes pa'i gral du yar 'bul byas yod pa'i bud med de'i nyams 'gyur dngos su mthong ba dang khong rang ngos nas gnas tshul rgyus len ched du/ kho mo tshang gtogs sa'i ru chen dang po'i ru chung gsum pa'i phyugs sman tshang du mo'i gnas tshul rgyus lon byed zhor du sgug nas bsdad/ phyugs brog sman pas mtshams sbyor byas pa ltar na/ mo nyid1968lor phyugs ra de'i 'brog pa dkyus ma zhig tshang du skyes/lo na ma son gong nas mo'i a zhang ngam rgyal yongs kyi ngal rtsol dpe legs — 198 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ r+had da wacan bla rgan gyi rjes bsnyegs nas phyugs 'tshos pas nyams myong mang po bsags/ 1984lo'i lo 'gor/ pha jus bu mos 'dzin pa ltar phyugs ra de'i rdzi mo phal ba zhig tu gyur/mchin khug gzhung rgyud lug phyugs ra ni zhing chen phyugs las thin du gtogs pa'i bal 'jam rgyud lug gtsos pa'i phyugs ra zhig yin 'ing / mtsho sngon bal 'jam lug rgyud kyi 'byung yul red/ phyugs ra des zhing chen yongs la lug rgyud spus bzang 'don sprod byed pa'i las 'gan khur yod la/ mtsho sngon gyi phyugs las thon skyed la byas rjes chen po bzhag myong / mtsho sngon bal 'jam lug rgyud ni zhin cang bal 'jam lug rgyud drangs te bod lug dang bsdebs nas mi rabs du mar hur brtson byas pa'i 'bras bu red/ der bzang cha mang na yang / btsas ma thag pa'i lu gu ni dmar rjen yin pas bu phrug ltar snyor skyong dgos pa dang / gso/ kha ha cang dka' bas rdzi bo'i 'gan shin tu ljid/ pad ma skyid ni las rka/ra zhugs nas lo bcu gsum ma gtogs 'gor med pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig yin la/ nye ba'i lo lngar thon skyed ma mo 'tsho ba'i 'gan blangs yod pa dang / mtsho sngon bal 'jam ma mo bsdoms pas1040'tshos te/ spus legs kyi bal 'jam spyi rgya7902'gong sprod byas/ lo rer cha snyoms lu gu81 3lhusos pa dang / lug che chung gnyis kyi shi grangs1 35lkonang du tshod bzung ba red/ 1995lo'i lug gi gson tshad brgya cha'i brgya yin pas/ zhing chen phyugs las thin khongs gtogs kyi ngal rtsol 'gran sdur khrod du gzi brjing ngang bal 'jam lug gi gson grangs longs tshad kyi dang po blangs shing / bstud mar lo 'gar grub 'bras de 'dra legs po blangs pa ru chung bco lnga yod pa'i nang du ha cang dkon pas phyugs ra de'i sngon thon pa la thengs du mar bdams/ da lo yang phyugs ra de'i 'thus tshab byas nas — 199 ——
