gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/ zhing chen bud med lhan tshogs kyis sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i‘‘las rkang steng gi skar chen brgya’ril gzengs bstod 'thob mir 'dem rgyur sgug 'dug pa'i sgang yin/tsher mo'i lu gu gson du 'jug rgyu ni rdzi bo rnams kyi shes pa ltar ches dka' ba'i las ka zhig ste/ 1994lor 'tshos pa'i thon skyed ma mo'i khyu der tsher mo 228yod cing / tshang mas 'go lug btsas pa yin pas80lkoyan gyi ma mos lu gu gtan nas mi len/ skabs der mos nyin dkar zas brjed pa dang mtshan mor gnyid bcag pa'i sgos ma bu nor med du ma'u 'phrod par byas pa dang / zog khang la dug sel dang skam bsro/ lu gur dus ltar 'o ma ldud pa dang drod srung ska regs bzos nas bskon pa sogs thabs brgya jus stong spyad de snyor skyong byas pas/ tsher mo'i 'go lug gi 'tsho khyu kun las rtse mor gyur pas bya dga' blangs/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i nang char chu nyung bas rtswa skyes 'phyi ba dang / lu gu btsa' dus ma mor nu rgyu med pa rgyun ldan du mthong ba yin/ gnas tshul der gzhigs nas gzhon nu ma des lu gu bkar te sems zhib mos snyor skyong dang /rang gis bzhon ma'i 'o ma 'thung mi bra bar shed zhan pa'i lu gur blud pa dang /rang gi bza' 'bru yang zog chas byas thog nangs snga langs dang dgung 'phyi nyal gyis mo phyugs kyi 'tsho skyong la 'bad pa dang khengs skyung sgos tshan rig slob sbyong sogs byas pas/ kho mos bltas ma thag tu lug gi nad de rtogs shing gso thabs lag rtsal la'ang byang ba na/ dus ltar nad bcos rims 'gog byed thub pas thon legs thob par khag theg byas/pad ma skyid ni hur brtson can zhig yin la byams sems can zhig kyang yin/ lo zhig la tshe lo rgyal gyis 'go lug btsa' ba'i thon skyed ma mo 'tsho dus/— 200 —

shārnyathagakhuraXthozug/ da wa ma mos lu gu mi len pa mang po byung bas skyes pa de ci bya gtol med du gyur/gnas tshul de mthong nas mos rang gi nyams myong la brten te rang 'gul sgos rogs ram tan tig byas par/ tshe lo rgyal gyis lag rtsal de khong du chung/ cing grub 'bras bzang po thob/ji skad du/ byas 'bras can la bstod bsngags me tog stor mong ba dang /spyi sems can la las 'gan khur bo gtad yong ba zhes pa nang bzhin/ da lo kho mo ni phyugs ra de'i thon skyed ma mo 'tsho mkhan bzang gras nang gi skyes ma gcig pur bzhag yod/ bdag gis mo'i lhags rlung gis dmar por bsgyur ba'i mig zung dang lus po yongs su rdul gyis g.yogs yod pa mthong rjes/khyed kyis de 'dra hur brtson bya don ci yin zhes dris pa na/ gzhon nu ma des zog yag por ma 'tshos na za ma bza' thabs mi yong zhes lan btab/ bdag gis kho mo'i lan de'i don snying la bsam blo tsam gtong tsa na/ gam du bzhugs pa'i las 'khyur las bzo pa bgres po rgya mtshos bshad rgyur/ ‘tshang mas khyod kyi bsam blo'i ltar 'bad brtson byas na/ nga tsho'i phyugs ra 'dir mdun lam yangs po 'dug’’zer/phyi nyin kho bo phyugs ra de dang bral dus/ khri shor rgyal mo'i shar 'gram du nyi gzhon dal bar 'phag kyin 'dug gser mdog zer 'od kyis sa der brjod mi shes pa'i rngam brjid kyi nyams shig gnang 'dug la/ pad ma skyid lta bu'i 'jon thang can gyis phyugs ra de'am rang re'i phyugs las sa/ khul gyi ma 'ongs pa bsu ba'i bud med mi rabs gsar ba de gang 'dra yin par myong grub kyi go ba tsam ster ba yin/(1997lo'i zla3pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/ )— 201 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bcos min brtse bas rgan mo'i sems pa bsros/sgyur ba po/ skal bzang bkra shis/1984lo'i dgun khar bsleb grabs yod pa'i mod la/ dngul rwa rtswa thang gi 'brog pa tshang mas snga mo nas dgun las brgal ba'i 'bar chas gra sgrig byas zin/ yin na'ang / lo60las yol ba'i rgan mo dbyang win h+phang tshang la mtshon na/ kha la za rgyu'i 'bru rigs dang thab la 'bud rgyu'i 'bar chas med pa'i khar/ mo'i bza' zla la grum nad dang gcin mngar nad byung nas lag tu sgor mo med pa'i rkyen gyis sman par bsten dka' bar gyur cing / ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su bcar 'dug gnas tshul 'di drag chas nyen rtog mtsho sngon spyi khyab ru khag yan lag ru khag gnyis pa'i ru 'bring drug pa'i khrid ston pa li'u yan pang gis shes rjes/ khos rgan rgon gnyis ka'i gnas tshul de ru 'bring yongs kyi dpon dmag la bshad pa dang / dpon dmag rnams kyis 'phral ma nyid du rgan rgon 'di gnyis kar 'os 'gan sgos snyor skyong bya rgyu'i bsam tshul bton/ nyin de'i snga dror/ dpon dmag rnams kyis ma skul rang 'gul sgos sgor500lhag zhal 'debs su phul te/ 'bras dang phye/ 'bar chas/ 'tsho ba'i mkho chas sogs nyos nas nyin de'i phyi dror rgan rgon gnyis kyi khyim du bskyal/— 202 —

sbyo1skyugakhuraXnyezug/ tred wa gam du bu bu mo gcig kyang med pa'i rgan rgon 'di gnyis snyor skyong bya rgyu ni dus yun ring ba'i las don zhig yin pas/ dbyang win h+phang rgan rgon gnyis kar sgor mo gsog ched/ 'thab 'dzing pa rnams kyis ru 'bring gi dmag sgar nang du gron chung sgam zhig bzhag nas gyon chas dang dpe deb/tshags par rnying ba/ sgor 'gar brje thub pa'i 'tsho ba'i mkho chas sogs sgam chung de'i nang du bsags te/ bed med dngos po bsdu nyo byed pa'i sa tshigs la btsongs pa dang / btsongs rin de dag gis rgan rgon gnyis la 'tsho ba'i mkho chas nyos/ rgan rgon gnyis ka'i 'bar chas tshar na/ dpon dmag rnams kyis khom long spyad de rtswa thang nas ong ba btus nas bskyal bar ma zad/res skor byas nas rgan rgon gnyis gyi khyim la gad dar byed pa dang / nyal thul nyal gdan bkrus pa red/ thab las pan gyis dus rgyun rgan rgon gnyis la tshod ma zhim po las nas bskyal ba dang 'phrod bsten pas kyang dus ltar rgan rgon gnyis ka'i na tshul la dpyad nas sman bskyal ba red/1985lo'i dbyar khar/ 'thab 'dzing pa rnams kyis las zhor khom long spyad nas so phag blugs pa dang shing cha nyos te rgan rgon gnyis la khang mig gnyis bkab pa'i khar/ khyim la gos sgam dang gsol lcog dang skub stegs sogs ca lag bkod sgrig byas/ zla ba gcig 'gor rjes/ dbyang win h+phang bza' zla gnyis ka spro ba rab tu rgyas te khang gsar nang du spar/lo10lhag rim gyis 'das song ba dang / dpon dmag rnams kyang thengs gcig min gnyis min du brje spor byas na'ang / rgan rgon gnyis la snyor skyong byed pa'i las 'gan de'i rgyun chad ma myong / lo10lhag ring la rgan mo dbyang win h+phang la sems 'gul thebs pa zhig ni mo dang bza' zla la nad gdon gyis 'tshe skabs/ dpon dmag rnams kyis rang gi pha ma nang ba'in kho — 2()3 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/rgan rgon gnyis la snyor skyong byas pa'i tshul de red/ kho tsho gal te gnyen nye la 'tshams 'dir 'gro ba'am sa cha gzhan du 'gro dgos byung skabs/ rgan po'i na tshul sman par bshad de sman nyo ba dus nam yin yang mi brjed pa red/1994lo'i zla3par/ pan krang wang pen gyi a mar nad ljid mo zhig phog nas pha yul hi nan du song / phyir dmag dpung du log skabs/ khos rgan po la sman yig dang rtswa sman skor zhig nyos yong / 'thab 'dzing pa gsar ba lis ba'e zi ling du don bya sgrub tu song nas rgan por sgor200lhag gis gso sman nyos yong /1995lo'i zla7par/ dbyang win h+phang gi bza' grogs kyi nad je sdug tu gyur pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten dang kha bral song / rgan mo dbyang win h+phang gis skyo ba chen po 'di ma bzod par snying nad bskyar du 'phar byung /pha'e krang yan zha'o ba'e yis 'thab 'dzing pa bzhi khrid de char ba chen por ma 'dzems par rgan mo spyi le10lhag yod sa'i thang dkar ma'i zhing ra'i sman khang du bskyal nas srog gi nyen kha las thar rjes da gzod phyir dmag sgar du log‘‘gzhan pa'i ched du byams sems phul pas na/ 'jig rten 'di ni lha yul ltar du snang /’’dpon dmag rnams kyis sems khur dang rogs ram byas par brten/ rgan mo dbyang win h+phang gis bde skyid ngang 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod/ na ning gi brgyad gcig dmag btsugs dus chen gyi snga nub/ gsar 'god pas rgan mo dbyang win h+phang la bcar 'dri byed skabs/ lo75ru son pa'i rgan mo'i lo na rgas dung lus mdangs sngar las rgyas 'dug kho mos gsar 'god pas nga rang mthong ma thag mig mthar mchi mas brlan te‘‘lo 'di dag ring / drag chas nyen rtog 'thab 'dzing pas sems khur dang snyor skyong byas pas/ nga la stobs shugs rgyas nas da lta'i bar 'tsho bar longs spyod — 204 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa byung song / de min snga mo nas 'jig rten dang kha bral te phyi ma'i lam 'phrang du 'grim bzhin yod zer/'thab 'dzing pa'i brtse sems ni dgun kha'i me tog dang dbyar kha'i chu mig tu sprul nas rgan mo la ches mkho che ba'i dri bsung dang bsil ngad bskyal yong / 'di lta bu'i bcos min byams sems dang brtse dungs zab mo las gzhan ci zhig mchog ang /(1997lo'i zla4ba'i tshes4nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal)shang tang yu hru'u ci dang dwa phrug bzhi/sgyur pa po/ mkha' mtsho/'di ni ngu shor ba'i gtam rgyud cig ste na ning gi ston kha'i nyin zhig rma stod rdzong gi chu nag shang hi ra phyugs las hre la dus chen gyi spro skyid khengs pa ltar 'brog pa rnams phan tshun ru nang du song nas 'phrin bzang zhig sgrog bzhin yod par/ mgo log khul dge thon slob grwas 'tsho skyid sdud len byas song / 'di ni skal hru'u ci'i drin yin zer/skabs 'dir mi rnams kyis 'tsho skyid bskor nas gnas tshul 'dra min dri bzhin yod/ 'tsho skyid kyi bzhin ris la dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas pa — 205 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dang mig mthar mchi mas bkang zhing lag la‘‘slob grwar zhugs pa'i brda yig’’bzung ste/ yid la sus kyang rtogs dka' ba'i dga' spro skyes 'dugad lor 'tsho skyid mi lo21la bslebs yod/ khyim tshang la chag sgo byung bas ming sring bzhi bo dwa phrug tu lus/ lo8sngon gyi dpyid ka zhig la 'tsho skyid kyi pha mar nad kyis mnar nas sngon rjes su mi yul gyi dang bral song / 'tsho skyid kyi sems la gri btsugs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung / lo tshad 13ma gtogs lon med pa'i 'tsho skyid kyis khyim kyi las ka ma las rang las byung /'on kyang gang ltar na kho mo ni lo13lon pa'i byis pa zhig red/ pha ma bu 'dzoms kyi khyim tshang zhig de zla ba gnyis kyi nang du pha ma gnyis po tshe las 'das nas kho mo dang chos mchog don grub dge rgyas bcas ming sring bzhi shul du lus pa red/ skabs der spun bzhi'i tha chung dge rgyas lo gnyis las lon med/ kho tshor pha ma gnyis kyis nad bstan pa'i sgor chig stong lhag gi bun dom de ma gtogs gzhan ci yang bzhag med/ ya nga ba'i lo rgyus dang dka' khag che ba'i 'tsho bas lo na chung ba'i 'tsho skyid kyi sems la snying rje med pa'i rdung rdeg thebs bcug ste/ mu mthud du slob grwar 'gro ba mtshams mi 'jog thabs med byung /1989lo'i dpyid kar gsar du tang u'i hru'u ci'i 'gan khur ba'i skal bzang rgyal mtshan hi ra phyugs las gzhung don ched du yong dus/ 'tsho skyid ming sring bzhi bor bgegs byung tshul thos rjes/ 'dug bzod med par myur du 'tsho skyid tshang la song / kho'i mig gis sbra gur rnying hrul dang 'tsho sa rten sa med pa'i ming sring bzhi bo mthong ba na/ mig mthar mchi mas bkang /khong hre tang kri pu'u hru'u ci tshang la song nas kri pu'u'i gros tshogs bsdus te/ tshogs thog tu skal hru'u cis sems 'tsher ba'i ngang nas bshad don/— 206 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa 'tsho skyid dang chos mchog gnyis ka mu mthud du slob grwar 'gro ru 'jus rgyu ni nga tsho gung khran tang mi'i 'gan 'khri yin/ 'tsho skyid tshang gi gong sprod las 'gan dang 'os 'gan ngal rtsol/ 'then 'jog ma dngul bcas thams cad med par gtong dgos/ khong gis bshad bzhin du sems skyo nas skad cha bshad ma thub/ de dus skal hru'u cis 'phral du khug ma nang du skor mo120yod pa blangs nas 'tsho skyid ming sring bzhi bor byin/ hre'i las byed pa rnams la'ang sems 'gul thebs nas tshang mas sgor mo byin pa red/ sprubrog pa rnams kyi gnas tshul de go rjes tshang mas rogs skyor byas/ bsdoms pas sgor1240zhal 'debs phul nas 'tsho skyid tshang gi dom 'jal ba red/mingasring bzhi bo'i 'tsho ba dang slob sbyong thad la lta rtog bzang bo byed ched/ skal hru'u ci shang du phyir log rjes dus thog tu shang tang u'i gros tshogs bsdus nas don de la gros bsdur byas pa ma zad/ gtan 'bebs sna kha gsum byas pa ste/ gcig ni ming sring bzhi bo shang gi bca' sdod slob grwa nang len pa dang / gnyis ni ming sring bzhi bor ched dmigs kyis lta rtog byed pa'i bzo ba la gan rgya ltar sdud len byed pa/ gsum ni 'tsho skyid tshang gi lug26dang nor4hre'i tang yon tshor 'gan len byed du 'jug pa bcas yin/'tsho skyid la sdug bsngal chen po thebs yod mod/ 'on kyang shang tang u'i gtan 'bebs des dwa phrug bzhi bo la mi yul gyi drod skyid myong du bcug yod/kho mo dang nu bo gnyis ka'ang dga' dga' spro spro'i sgos dpe khug khur nas slob grwar song /shang tang u hru'u ci'i las 'gan ni ljid cing sna mang ba yin mod/ 'on kyang ming sring bzhi bo'i rgyun ldan 'tsho ba dang slob sbyong gi gnas tshul blo mthun skal bzang rgyal mtshan gyi sems su bcangs yod/ khong dus rgyun du ༅nga gi — 2()7 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bca' sdod slob grwar 'ongs nas ming sring bzhi bo la lta ba dang / tang u'i gros tshogs steng du khong gis ming sring bzhi'i gnad don yang yang du gleng gi yod/ 'tsho skyid dang chos mchog la sems bde mo ngang slob sbyong byed du 'jug ched/ shang gis ming sring gnyis la dmigs bsal gyi kha gsab ste/ mi rer zla re bzhin sgor mo30byin pa red/ don 'di dag tshang mas bsam blo gtong shes pa'i 'tsho skyid la sems 'gul thebs nas kho mos slob sbyong bzang bo byas nas tang gi drin lan 'jal rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ 'tsho skyid kyis 'bad brtson dang nan tan gyis slob sbyong byas pas/ phul du byung ba'i grub 'bras kyis mgo log mi rigs dge thon slob grwar rgyugs 'phrod cing / kho mo dga' drags nas yang bskyar mig chu thengs shig shor ba red/ grub 'bras 'dis tshe las 'das pa'i pha mar bla bde bo yong ba byed thub la/ kho mo ming sring bzhi bor thugs khur gnang ba'i skal hru'u ci dang hre'i las byed pa/ shang gi bca' sdod slob grwa'i dge rgan dang yul mi bcas la drin lan bzang bo zhig kyang 'jal ba red/da lta nu bo chos mchog ni rdzong bod rigs slob 'bring gi slob rim gnyis pa'i slob ma yin pa dang / don grub ni shang bca' sdod slob grwa'i slob rim lnga ba'i slob ma dang / dge rgyal ni slob rim gsum pa'i slob ma yin/ dwa phrug bzhi bo nyin re re bzhin 'tshar longs byung ba dang go chod pa dang / bsam blo gtong shes pa bcas su gyur bas/ skal hru'u ci dang shang gi bca' sdod slob grwa'i dge rgan/ phyugs las hre'i las byed pa dang yul mi tshang ma'i gdong la dga' ba'i 'dzum rgyas yod pa red/(1997lo'i zla6pa'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/ )— 208 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ —d+ngha r+hanyin phyug rtswa thang gi hru'u ci bzang bo/ru khog rdzong nyin phyug shang brag dkar sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci dar rgyas kyi gnas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ bkra shis don grub/ hri hu'e khrin/khyod rang sbra gur dang kha ba'i khrod nas nar son la/ khyod kyis rus la gzan pa'i grang rlung char chu dang bsdongs nas rang nyid kyi yod tshad gnas de ru phul/ khyod rang mkha' mtha' gcod pa'i rgod po dang 'dra bar sngo ljang gi thang dang gangs ri la gtan nas bral ma myong /kha byang gi 'dren tshig(1)rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rtse khog rdzong gi nub rgyud zhing las sasar spel khul gyi nyin phyugs shang brag dkar sde ba ni rdzong mkhar dang thag ring la 'grim 'grul ha cang stabs mi bde ba'i sa cha zhig yin/ 1996lor sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/ de ni mi rer cha snyoms phyugs zog20la mi bslebs pa dang /yong sgo sgor300la mi bslebs pa'i dbul phongs yul sde zhig yin/ de nu dmangs la don dngos sgrub pa dang 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis bstod bsngags bgyid bzhin pa'i hru'u ci bzang bo zhig mchis/lo na57son pa'i brag dkar sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci dar rgyas tang da 209 — —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gi dmangs phyug srid jus kyis skul 'ded 'og bsam blo bcings 'grol btang zhing sa gnas rang gi sa nag thang dang sa rgod bed spyod gang legs byas te/ 'brog pa mang tshogs khrid nas zhing las phyogs bsdus las bya sgrub bzhin yod/ gnas 'di'i sa nag thang rgya che ba ma zad/ char chu yang ha cang mod pas/ dar rgyas dang 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis cha rkyen 'di la brten te/‘‘zhing phyugs zung 'brel dang zhing las kyis phyugs las skul ba'i’’'phel rgyas kyi bgrod lam zhig btod de/ 'debs 'dzugs kyi las gnyer ba dang snum btsir ba/ gzan rtswa 'debs pa/ skyel 'dren byed pa sogs 'dus pa'i zhing las phyogs bsdus kyi zhabs 'degs sa tshigs shig btsugs pa red/ khos tshigs dpon gyi 'gan bzhes nas lo bzhi'i ring la brtson 'grus lhod med byas pas/ zhabs 'degs sa tshigs la gtan 'jags ma dngul sgor khri21yod cing / lo rer pad dkar dang yug po dang / nas bcas 'debs pa'i sa zhing mu'u2000yod pa dang lo hril bor sgor khri30yod pa'i thon skyed gzhi khyon chags pa des/ dar rgyas rang nyid dbul phongs las thar ba ma zad/dbul phongs khyim tshang gi na gzhon las sgug skor zhig la'ang las ka yod par gyur/dar rgyas phyug por gyur rjes rang nyid kyis dka' spyad las skrun byed pa'i khrod/ rgyab skyor dang rogs ram byas myong ba'i mang tshogs ma brjed par dbul thar phyug 'gyur thad de tshor rgyab rogs chen po byas la/ mang tshogs dang mnyam du phyug por 'gyur rgyu ni kho'i las 'gan khur ba ches thog ma'i re 'dun yin/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring / khos rang sde dbul phongs khyim tshang gi mi13zhing las phyogs bsdus zhabs 'degs sa tshigs su las ka bkod sgrig byas pa dang / khyim tshang5la lo hril bor rogs skyor byas pa ma zad/ zla rer — 210 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ — r+hadabul phongs khyim tshang rer cha snyoms sgor150yi 'tsho ba'i rogs dngul ster ba'i sbrags su/ da rung dus dang rnam pa kun tu rogs skyor dngos rdzas ster bzhin yod pas/ dbul phongs khyim tshang kha shas kyi dka' bsngal dngos thag gcod byas/ khos da rung thabs lam sna tshogs spyad nas dbul phongs khyim tshang la 'debs 'dzugs las gnyer dang / zhing las 'phrul chas nyams gso/phyugs nad sngon 'gog sogs phyogs kyi dngos spyod lag rtsal shes bya khrid ston byas pas/ 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi zhing phyugs las kyi tshan rtsal chu tshad ma thor 'degs song ba red/ khos snga gzhug tu mang tshogs tshor thon skyed gnas gzhi thengs6la g.yar ba dang / zhing sa 'gan len byed du bcug pa/ rtswa sa glas pa sogs kyi dbul skyor byed thabs spyad pa red/(2)dar rgyas la ngos zin zab mo zhig thob pa ni/ dbul thar gyi bgrod lam de rang nyid kyi rtsol ba la brten pa las/ gzhan la brten pa dang ga'an la lag bsring na nam yang thar lam rnyed mi srid pa de red/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci yin pa'i dar rgyas kyis snying stobs 'di rgyun skyong byas nas kri pu'u'i 'dzugs skrun nan 'dzin byed bzhin gda'/ thog mar khos lam lugs gsar 'dzugs dang 'gan dbang gsal 'byed byed pa/ dus bcad gtan 'khel byas nas slob sbyong dam 'dzin byas pas/ rgya che'i tang yon gyis tang gi gzhi rtsa'i lam phyogs dang srid jus lag bstar byed pa'i rang rtogs kyi nges mthor 'degs byung ba dang / rgyun chad med par tang rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgril shugs dang 'thab 'dzing nus shugs je drag tu song ba red/ tang kri pu'u mgo khrid kyis nam yang mang tshogs kyi lam phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byed pa ngang / yod — 211 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshad mang tshogs kyi khe phan las 'go brtsams te don dngos bsgrubs pa red/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i nang / kri pu'us mgo khrid byas 'og dbul phongs khyim tshang la rogs skyor byas pa'i ma dngul sgor khri1 6dang / lug20dang nor15dang 'bru rigs spyi rgya500dang mar spyi rgya150la bslebs pas/ dbul phongs khyim tshang kha shas kyi dka' bsngal dngos thag gcod byas pa des/ gom gang mdun spos sgos las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyi 'brel ba je zab tu 'gro bcug pa red/ dus mnyam du tang yon sgrig 'dzugs byas nas dbul phongs khyim tshang la mngags te/ 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye dang slob gso dang / tshan rtsal sogs la 'brel ba yod pa'i srid jus dang shes bya dril sgrog byas nas/ 'brog pa mang tshogs la sne khrid nas mi grangs tshod 'dzin dang ngal rtsol brtson sems mthor 'degs su gtong bar khrid ston dang / sde ba yongs kyi dpal yon gnyis mnyam du 'phel rgyas su gtong bar skul 'ded btang ba red/(3)dbul phongs sa khul gyi ngo bo dang rjes lus kyi rnam pa bsgyur dgos na/thog mar slob gso gtsigs su 'dzin dgos pa de dar rgyas kyi yid ngor re khā bzhin du phabs yod pas khos slob gso'i thad la don dngos mi nyung ba zhig bsgrubs yod/ blo mthun dar rgyas kyis slob gso'i gnad don de tang kri pu'u'i nyin rgyun gyi gros rim gal chen la bzhag ste/ mang tshogs tshor slob gso'i las don la rgyab skyor byed dgos pa'i skul slong byas nas/ bu rgyud slob grwar 'gro bar lta rtog nan mo byas pas/ sde ba yongs kyi slob lo ran pa'i byis pa slob zhugs byung tshad505la bslebs pa'i dmigs tshad mngon 'gyur byas/khos zhing las phyogs bsdus zhabs 'degs sa tshigs kyi bdag gnyer yong sgo — 212 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad wal brten nas/ rang 'gul sgos nyin phyug shang gi sde ba9yi slob gso'i zur snon gron dngul khag khur byas pa red/ mig snga'i bar/ rim bsags byas nas rtsis na slob gso'i thad la phul ba'i zur snon gron dngul sgor khri22la bslebs pa red/blo mthun dar rgyas kyis 'brog pa mang tshogs rnams snga mo nas dbul phongs las thar ched/ nyin mtshan dbyer med ngang nyin phyug rtswa thang la rang gi ches rin thang che ba'i lang tsho dang yod tshad kyi yod tshad phul bas/ rtse gzhung rim mo'i rtswa thang du khong la bstod pa'i gtam gleng ga sa kun nas thos thub/(1997lo'i zla8pa'i tshes22nyin gyis par ngos gsum par gsal)me tog gangs lha'i gzi byin/khyung thar rgyal/dang po/gus pos rtsom 'di'i kha byang la me tog gangs lha zhes btags par rgyu mtshan med pa zhig ma yin te/ ji skad du/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na/'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur/ de bas rmongs pa sel ba'i phyir/mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgan ke tho — 213 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/skyabs kyi lhad med gshis ka dang mi rigs slob gso'i las don la lhag bsam zol med kyis 'jug pa'i cha nas me tog gangs lha zhes btags pa yin/ rgan ke tho skyabs ni1954lo'i zla7pa'i tshes12nyin rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rtse khog rdzong cha skor shang mgar rtse tsho ba nas skyes shing gzugs thung la nam yang grim rig rig byed pa'i mi tshags yang zhig yin par ma zad/ gzhan gyi g.yam la mi rgyugs pa dang kha yag ngo bstod kyis 'gu bar mi 'gyur ba'i gshis ka rdo 'dra ba zhig yod/dang thog khos cha skor shang rgyo wob ru chen nas dmangs sgrub dge rgan byas shing / 1970lo nas bzung ste snga rjes su stobs ldan shang dang rdo dkar mo shang / dpyi sa shang / hor shang sogasi su las gnyer nas mang tshogs dang 'brel 'dris gang bzang byung ste gzhi rim gyi las ka nyams myong gzhan las lhag par thon/ rtsa 'dzugs kyis khong nyid mi rigs slob gso'i las la snying rus dang 'jon thang ldan par shes nas1989lor rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring gi slob gtso gzhon pa dang1990lor slob gtso gtso bor bskos/ rdzong 'di ni rgyal yongs kyi dbul phongs rdzong nyer bzhi'i nang gi gcig yin la/ rdzong 'di'i rjes lus dang dbul phongs kyi rnam pa bsgyur dgos na/ nges par du mi rigs slob gsos rgyab rten yong ba 'di shin tu gal che/ rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring ni rtse khog rdzong gi rig gnas slob gso'i lte gnas te/ slob grwa 'di ji ltar legs par sgrub rgyu ni rgan ke tho skyabs nam yang gnyid mi yong ba'i gzhigs yul zhig tu gyur/khos thog mar slob grwa'i gnas tshul rgyus lon zab mo byas te/ nyin la mtshan mthud nas zas chags gnyid brjed kyis bsam blo btang mthar/ da gzod phyogs gcig nas slob ma'i 'tsho ba dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas slob — 214 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da khrid kyi spus tshad gtso bor 'dzin dgos pa shes/ yin na'ang / yid la shar ba ji bzhin legs 'grub 'byung ba'i skal ba ha cang phra bas/ khos slob ma'i mig snga'i 'tsho ba'i gnad don thag gcod byed par rang 'gu' gyis sgor100phul pa dang / slob grwa'i nang khul gyi las bzo mi snar skul slong byas nas sgor1000gi zhal 'debs bsdus pa dang / rdzong srid gzhung sogs 'brel yod sde khag la skul slong byas nas lug sha khog160dang skams sha sha khog10lon nas slong ma'i 'tsho ba'i dka' khag thag gcod 'go brtsams par ma zad/ 1990lor rdzong u'i rgyas 'dzoms gros tshogs kyi go skabs bzang po dam 'dzin byas te/ rdzong yongs kyi rgya che'i las byed par skul slong byas te bsdoms pas sgor khri3lhag gi zhal 'debs bsdus/ de'i mtshungs su ga'i rim bca' sdod slob grwa so so'i slob gso'i gron dngul gyi5lkordzong mi rigs slob 'bring la sprod pa dang / kung hre re la 'bri re bslangs nas slob grwa'i rtswa sa'i gnad don kyang thog mar thag gcod byas/lo de'i dpyid kar srid gros rtse khog rdzong u yon lhan khang gi gros tshogs shig gi steng khos slob ma'i 'tsho bar dka' khag che ba'i snyan seng zhus te zhal 'debs bslangs par dbu khrid rnams kyis bsdoms pas lug4dang zog 17gnang / gzhan yang kho rang yar rgyug mar 'dur byas te rdzong dmangs srid cus la sgor4000bslangs nas slob ma rnams kyis chu khol 'thung mi thub pa'i gnad don thag gcod byas shing / rdzong 'dzugs skrun kung zir skul slong byas nas ong khang khang mig5las/ de dang bstun nas khos slob grwa'i nyen khang sogs brnyan 'phrin dang yang na par du blangs te/ zhing chen slob gso thin dang rgyal khab slob u sogs 'brel yod sde khag la snyan seng zhus nas sgor khri30bslangs te slob grwa'i ja khang sogs gsar tu las pas mig snga'i gnad — 215 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/don mang po zhig thag gcod thub par gyur/ rmang gzhi de'i steng nas khos da gzod dge rgan dang las bzo ba'i las ka'i lam lugs cha tshang bzos nas gtan khel byas te slob khrid kyi spus tshad gnad du bzung ba red/rgan ke tho skyabs kyis rang nyid ni slob grwa 'di'i slob gtso yin la slob ma'ang yin bsam la/ do dam gyi phyogs yin na 'dra/ slob khrid kyi phyogs yin na'ang 'dra/ kho rang med sa dang the med sa nyung / nam rgyun zhogs pa'i chu tshod lnga'i steng kho rang mal las langs te slob ma tsho dang mnyam du lus rtsal la zhugs pa dang / dgong mo rang sbyong grol rjes chag bron mel tshe skor g.yengs byas te chu tshod gcig gi thog nas ma gtogs nyal mi thub/ yin na'ang / 'di ni khos rang gi 'os 'gan zhig dang bde skyid cig tu rtsis pa las sun snang dang 'khang ra gtan nas byas ma myong / lhag par du khos rgyun par dge rgan tsho'i slob khrid byed stangs dang nyams myong las bslab bya blangs te blang dor gyi cha la dge skyon brjod pa'am slob ma'i sbyang gzhir zhib lta byed pa las gzhan/ slob ma tsho dang mnyam du za ma zos te slob ma'i 'tsho ba'i thad nas pha ma las lhag pa'i sems khur byas pa red/de yang thengs shig rgyal yongs gcig gyur gyi rgyugs gzhi la mi rigs rang gi yi ge med par rgya yig kho nas rgyugs sprod dgos pas slob ma20lhag la bsam 'char bud de phyir rang rang gi yul la bros/ khos dge grogs shig dang mnyam du spyi le80la lcags rta zhon nas song ba dang spyi le15la rkang thang du song ste/ slob ma rnams la slob gso btang ste phyi nyin phyi dror tshang ma phyir slob grwa'i nang du bsdus/mtho 'bring mthar phyin 'dzin grwa zhig gis lo de'i las bzo ba bsdu len byed pa'i skabs su 'os min gyi gnad don kha shas byung phyir/ slob ma tshos — 216 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa da mnyam du nang gros byas te skor zhig lha sar 'bro ba dang skor zhig nang log tu tshong rgyag par 'gro ba/ skor zhig dgon par song nas grwa ba byed pa sogs kyi gros thag bcad pa thos pas/ khos de 'phral slob ma de rnams lhan gcis tu bsdus nas bshad rgyur/ ‘‘rang nyid rang gi mi rigs la sha tsha na/ thog mar sa gnas rang gi slob gsor brgyud pa'i rang sa'i shes yon can gyi mi rabs la thug yod/ 'jig rten 'di 'dra che bas khyod tshor 'bro sa mang na yang / kha ba'i khrod 'khyag 'dar rgyag bzhin pa'i mi de tsho ni khyod tsho'i pha ma dang ming sring yin pa yid la zungs/ pha yul mi dmangs kyi bde sdug dang rig gnas slob gso dar spel du gtong min de khyod tsho rang rang gi phrag tu babs yod pa'i las don gal chen zhig yin pa'ang ma brjed’’ces go bskon blo 'gugs byas te/ slob ma de rnams kyi blo sna bsgyur ci thub byas nas kho tshor yang dag pa'i 'jig rten lta ba dang mi tshe'i lta ba nges par byed pa la phan btags pa'ang 'di tsam gyis ga la tshad de gtan nas mi tshad/gnyis pa/de ltar phyin pas na ngang ngam du rgan ke tho skyabs kyi las ka'i grub 'bras la mang tshogs kyis bstod pa dang mgo 'dren gyis yid ches byed pa mthun gyur cing / 1992lor khong la rdzong rig slob cus kyi cus krang gzhon pa zhor khur byed du bcug pa dang / 1994lor rdzong rig slob tshan rtsal cus kyi cus krang du bskos/ khong gi 'gan khur sngar las je lcir song bas sos dal bag phebs kyis ngal gso tsam byed pa'i go skabs kyang ha cang phra bar gyur/lo de'i zla6pa'i tshes19 — 21nyin khos skor skyod thengs shig byas te slob ma'i grangs ka blangs par rdzong yongs kyi gzhi rim bca' sdod slob grwa15na — 217 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bsdoms pas slob ma447las med pas(mkhar grong slob chung 'dus med)rang nyid kyang rang la yid mi ches pa lta bur gyur/ de 'phral khos gong rim 'brel yod sde khag la snyan seng phul ba dang gzhi rim gyi 'brel yod slob gso'i sde khag so sor skyon brjod byas te/ rdzong yongs kyi slob grwar zhugs tshad mthor 'degs byed par rang nus yod tshad bton/ de'i mtshungs su rang nyid dngos su rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi khrod du zab zhugs byas nas bag 'khum tshul du gnas pa'i bza' dpon rnams la slob gso btang ste 'brog sde gang mang la rkang tshags myangs la dang lhag sems kyis 'brog pa mang tshogs sems kyi sgron me sbar/ bsdoms pa ltar na/ 1994 — 1996lo'i bar rgan ke tho skyabs gzhi rim du thengs 119la zab zhugs byas pa'i nyin grangs bsdoms pas447longs/ rdzong yongs kyi slob khrid spus tshad mthor 'degs byed par dbyar dus mnyam rgyugs blangs pa dang dgun dus rgyan rgyugs blangs nas/bzang la bya dga' dang ngan la chad pa'i lam lugs dngos su lag bstar byas/khos nam yang / mgo khrid pa zhig yin na thog mar rang nyid kyi ma dpe ston dgos snyam ste/ ches dka' khag che sa dang skyel 'dren stabs bde min sar rang nyid bkod sgrig byas pas las grogs rnams kyi brtson sems kyang rim bzhin je cher song / thengs shig la khos rdzong yongs kyi slob ma'i brtan tshad dang slob khrid kyi gnas tshul la rtog zhib byed par spyi spyod rlangs 'khor la bsdad de spyi le70lhag gi nyin shug shang la song ba dang / de nas mo tho zhig gi 'phong la zhon nas ngal gso longs med par nyin shug slob grwa gnyis par song /mtshan mo der mun pa gos su gyon te spyi le30lhag gi bar thag yod pa'i bon kyā shang cha tshang slob chung du lag skyor 'khor lo zhig glas nas 'byor bas slob grwa de'i dge rgan rnams la sems 'gul tshad med thob/ 'di bzhin du stobs — 218 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad ldan shang slob grwa gnyis pa dang gsum par lam thag ring zhing rlangs 'khor gyi gzhung lam yang chad ma mthud cig las med la char babs tshe gtan nas 'gro mi thub/ khos dbyar kha'i mnyam rgyugs kyi rgyugs shog khur te chu tshod lnga'i ring la rkang thang gis song la/ lo der 'bab zhod ha cang che ba'i rkyen gyis dkar zed chu bo brubs te dngul dkar gyi zegs ma dgung la 'thor ba byed cing /kho rang dkar zed chu bor brgal skabs shud de cung tsam min na chu bo'i klong du thom/ gzhi rim gyi slob gso'i las don la rang gi yod tshad 'bul ba'i snying stobs dang ldan pa'i rgan ke tho skyabs la rang las gzhan gtso pa dang sger las spyi gtso ba'i lhag sems yod tshul yang mi mang gis bstod yul du gyur yod/dge rgan ga ge mo'i khyim du nad tsha byung ste slob khrid la chag pas rtsa 'dzugs kyis kho la sgor1500chad pa bcad/ rgan ke tho skyabs kyis las grogs de'i yul na dka' khag yod pa shes nas bzo tshogs las sgor500dang rang sger gyi sgor100dang tha mag thum gcig byin te lcogs tshod kyis rogs ram byas/yang thengs shigarte la khos sgor mo 'ga' bsogs nas khyim tshang la dngos po rtsag rtsig re nyo bar gra sgrig byas yod dus/ skabs der rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring gis khyad 'phags dge rgan la bya dga' ster ba'i thebs rtsa 'dzugs par sgor1000gi zhal 'debs phul phyir/ rang khyim la ni zi ling gi ca lag rnying ba bcong sa zhig nas 'bol khri rnying ba cha gcig nyos nas yong bas/ las grogs 'gas tshul 'dir bltas nas kho'i gdong la skyo ba'i tshab tu mig chu yong rag bar tu bgad/ khong gis 'bad brtson byed par gong 'og g.yas g.yon gyi mthun rkyen ngang gis 'dus phyir/ 1994lo'i rdzong yongs kyi gzhi rim slob grwa'i slob ma447tsam las med pa de1996lo'i lo mjug tu1822la slebs pa nga/nga / slob — 219 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/grwar zhugs tshad ni sngon gyi14lkonas49lkol 'phar/ da lta rdzong yongs su slob lo ran pa'i byis pa4876yod pa'i nang gi2390slob grwar zhugs pa ma zad/ brtan 'jags byung tshad kyang93 8thil bslebs/ rdzong yongs kyi slob zhugs byung tshad mthor 'degs byung ba dang bstun nas slob khang dang nyal khang skor zhig zhig ral du gyur ba de la ci bya/ khong gis de 'phral brnyan 'phrin du phab pa dang 'dra par sogs kyi rgyu cha 'tshol sdud byas te zhing chen slob gso thin dang rgyal khab slob u sogs 'brel yod sde khag brgyud nas 'dzam gling dngul khang gi rogs skyor ma dngul bslangs par zhus/ skabs der zhing chen rim pa'i tshogs 'du zhig gi steng zhing chen slob gso thin gyi thin krang mgon rong dang nor srid 'char 'god khru'u yi khru'u krang phun bzhis len gnyis kyis‘‘rtse khog gis brnyan phab dang 'dra par sogs kyi gnas tshul gsal zhu byung bas/ rtse khog ma zad rang zhing la 'dzam gling dngul khang gi dbul khul thengs gsum pa'i rogs skyor ma dngul thob par nus pa chen po bton yod’’ces tshad mtho ba'i gdengs 'jog mdzad/ rdzong rang gi nor srid la dka' khag che phyir thabs brgya jus stong gis ma dngul sna tshogs brtson len byed pa ni rgan ke tho skyabs la mtshon na rang gi 'os 'gan zhig tu gyur cing /1994 — 1996lo'i bar bsdoms pas sgor khri886len thub byung ba dang /de'i nang gi sgor khri280bkol spyod byas zin la/ 'phro mas da lta 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin/gsum pa/'dzam gling dngul khang gi rogs skyor thob nas 'dzugs skrun sna tshogs la gra sgrig byed bzhin pa'i skabs su khong la zhe rtsis yod pa'i mi je mang du gyur/— 220 —

zugāthagakhuraXthozug/ da wa de rnams kyi khrod du mgo khrid pa yod la bzo skrun 'char 'god pa dang bzo sne sogs ngo shes min dang rgyus yod med ci rigs 'dug kho tshos rang rang gi dmigs yul ched du‘‘ngo chen zhu ba’’ni mi nyung ba zhig byung / thengs zhig la‘‘bzo sne’’zhig gis sram skya bzhi khyer nas yong ste thengs 'di'i 'dzugs skrun gyi phyogs nas‘‘stabs ka’’zhig sprod dgos pa'i zhu ba byas/ yin na'ang / me tog gangs lha lta bu'i rang gshis de la dri mas gos ma myong ba'i rgan ska tho skyabs kyis sram skya de dag phyir g.yugs te/ ‘‘nga mi red/ khyi ma red/ khyi la zas lhag 'phangs na rjes 'brangs nas 'gro bas khyod kyis nga rang khyi sar ma 'jog’’ces bshad/ de'i mtshungs su bzo 'god 'gan len pa du ma yong nas‘‘khyod kyis ltos dang/ deng sang gi mgo khrid pa'i nang na rang don 'khyongs med pa khyod min pa yod dam/ gzhung don gyi zhor tu sger don yang 'khyongs dgos pa red/ nga tshos khyod la spus ka bzang pa'i khang ba zhig las rgyu yi/na’’zhes bshad par/ khos de tshor ci mi snyam par‘‘nga rang gar stegs steng gi rtsed chas min/ deng phyin chad khyod tshos kyang ri dwags la rnyi 'dzugs pa lta bu'i bya spyod ngan pa 'di rigs bcos bsgyur gyis/ nga tsho tshang ma mi yin pas mi gshis ngo ma zhig ldan dgos pa red’’ces bshad/ 'dzugs skrun sna tshogs kyi 'go brtsams pa nas bzung / kho rang thengs mang por las grwa dngos su song ste/ zhib bsher byas pa dang 'dzugs skrun steng gi don bya gang zhig yin yang ched mkhas pas thag gcod ma byas na mgo khrid kyis thag gcod byed pa'i dbang cha med par byas shing / 'dzugs skrun ma dngul bkol spyod kyi phyogs nas rang dpe gzhan ston byas de/ rul sungs dang chud zos kyi snang tshul sna tshogs gtan 'gog byas pa red/ 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa'i skabs su khos sha khog6dang lug dang sgor mo1000lhag gi 'brel 'dris kyi we mig mang da 221 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/po phyir slog byas la dus gtan tu brgyab yod pa'i‘‘ltag sgo’’de sus kyang 'byed ma thub/'di'i phyogs nas kho rang nam yang phyi gtsang nang gtsang gi me tog gangs lha lta bu zhig yin pa rna thos su byung yod/ sngon chad zhig la 'brog pa zhig gis sgor1000kho'i a ma'i lag tu bzhag ste‘‘khyed la bcol rgyu'i don ci yang med la/ nga'i phyogs nas khyod kyis bsgrub dgos pa'i don yang med/yin na'ang / lag dngul 'di tsam ni khyod rang slob gso'i las don la sha tsha zhing 'gan sems yod par nga'i gus sems mtshon byed tsam yin’’zhes bzhag nas song bar/ phyi nyin khos phyir bdag po tshang la sprad pa ma zad/ ‘‘ngas khyod kyis sems de shes pa yin la/ 'di ni nga tsho rang rang gi sems nas shes rgyu zhig las dngos po'i steng nas mtshon rgyu zhig ma red’’ces bshad/ngo ma de ltar lags te/ khos nam yang rang nyid ni mi ji lta bu zhig yin pa'i langs phyogs brtan la rang gtsang gzhan phan gyi bsam pa dkar po bzung ba ni nga tshos bsngags brjod kyi me tog stor 'os pa zhig dang / mi rigs slob gso'i las don la rang gi dpral ba'i mig dang khong gi snying ltar gces pa las kyang yi rangs byed dgos pa zhig ma yin nam/ khong nyid de/me tog gangs lha ni kha ba ri ba'i rgyan du bzhad la/ nga tshor mdzes shing gtsang ba'i rang gshis kyis gzi byin 'ig ngoms bzhin mchis/(1997lo'i zla10pa'i tshes22nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)

rgyasa'aphrin/ da las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyis mnyam du dbul skyon gyi dbyangs snyan gyer ba/da wahi nan rdzong mdo gsum shang gis dbul skyor mkhregs gtor gyi gnas tshul bkod pa/sangs rgyas/na ning tshun du/ hi nan sog rigs rang skyong rdzong mdo gsum shang gis mgo khrid la shugs snon byas te/ dbul skyor mkhregs gtor byed par sems shugs chen po bton/ lo gcig gi nang du shang yongs rdzogs dbul phongs las thar ba dang mkhregs gtor 'char gzhi bde blag ngang yongs 'grub bya ched/ shang tang u dang srid gzhung gis las byed tshan chung thengs mang du sgrig 'dzugs sgos gzhi rim du zab zhugs byas te brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas/bsdoms rtsis byas pa ltar na/ shang yongs su mi rer cha snyoms sgos phyugs zog10re las med pa dang lo 'khor gyi mi rer cha snyoms yong sgor680man gyi dbul phongs khyim tshang22dang dbul phongs mi grangs125yod/ brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog gom gang mdun spos sgos dbul skyor mkhregs gtor gyi gzhig lam je gsal du btang ste/ snying stobs cher skyed dang gsar gtod brtson len byas te dbul skyor dang blo skyor zung du sbrel nas/ blo rtsal skyor ba gnad sar bzhag pa dang / rtsa lag gnyis bcos zung — 223 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/du sbrel nas rtsa bcos gnad sar bzhag pa/ phyi yis rogs ram dang nang gi stobs shugs zung du sbrel nas nang gi stobs shugs skyed pa gnad sar bzhag pa/ rgyal phyug dmangs phyug zung du sbrel nas dmangs phyug yong ba gnad sar bzhag pa bcas byas thog rgud skyob tu nges pa'i dbul skyor de gsar spel tu nges pa'i dbul skyor du bsgyur nas/ dbul bo khyim tshang la rogs skyor gang thub kyis lo gcig nang dbul thar yong ba mngon 'gyur bya rgyu de dmigs yul du bcangs/kho tshos 'brog khul gyi khyad chos ltar don dngos gzhir bzung ste/dbul skyor gyi gzigs skyong srid jus gtan 'bebs byas pa ste/ dbul khyim tshang gi phyugs las dpya khral rigs gsum sgor9700sdud len mi byed pa dang slob gso'i zur snon gron dngul dang slob grwar yod pa'i dbul khyim slob ma'i slob gron rtsag rtsig sgor6000sdud len mi byed pa/ nang 'tshong dang thun mong gi 'then 'jog mi dgos pa bya rgyu/ dbul bo khyim tshang gis dgon par 'gyed gtong byed mi chog pa/ dbul bo khyim tshang gis tshad yol 'dzad spyod bya mi rung ba bcas gtan phab byas/na ning kho tshos rmang gzhi sgrig bkod thad kyi 'dzugs skrun dang dam por sprel ba dang phyugs las thon skyed kyi gzhi rtsa'i cha rkyen bsgyur ba nas 'go brtsams pa te/ rtswa ra skor ba je mgyogs su btang ba dang gzan rtswa'i gzhi sa 'dzugs skrun byed tshad mdun du bskul thog sde ba rim pa'i las byed pa skul slong byas nas drod spyil las par sne khrid byas/ shar zla ba sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci rdo rjes mgo drangs nas gron dngul sgor6000btang ste so phag dang shing gis drod spyil mus gru bzhi ma240can zhig las pas/ dbul bo 'brog dmangs kyi tshan rtsal 'du shes je mthor gtong ba dang / phyugs las kyi rmang — 224 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da r+hagazhi sgrig bkod 'dzugs skrun je mgyogs su gtong bar skul 'deng dang dpe mtshon gyi nus pa bskyed/na ning gi zla5bar dpyid ka'i grang ngar da rung yal med pas/ re zhig tu drod babs kyang re zhig tu grang ngar ldang / shang tang u'i hru'u ci mgon po tshe brtan gyis shang yongs kyi las byed pa dang las bzo ba dang rkang 'dzin dmangs dmag dang gung gzhon tshogs mi300lhag khrid nas gzhung lam las pa'i bya 'gul spel nas shang dang sde ba'i gzhung lam re rer rlangs 'khor shar gtong thob song / snga gzhug tu shang nas sha la khug(mdo gsum nas shar zla bar)dang shang nas rma chu 'gram rgyud(rwa ring )kyi shang dang sde ba'i gzhung lam bsdoms pas spyi le22 5las/mdo gsum shang tang us las byed pa rnams la skul slong byas te mang tshogs khrod du zab zhugs byas nas/ phyogs gang ci'i thad nas dbul skyor las ka spel/ las byed pa rnams mang tshogs kyi khrod du phyin rjes thog mar rang stobs rang spel dang dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyi snying stobs bskyed pa dang brtson bsris khyim skyong byed dgos pa'i slob gso btang ste/ mang chogs kyi hur 'thab byed pa'i spro sems bskul ba dang / dbul thar phyug sgyur gyi chod sems dang yid ches je brtan du btang / dbul skyor rgud skyob dang mthun sgril mdza' mthun/ sger med skyes 'bul bcas kyi srol rgyun bzang bo shugs chen pos spel pa'i khar/ phyogs so so'i brtson sems skul slong byas te dbul skyor bya bar tshang mas sems khur dang rgyab skyor byed pa dang / mang tshogs kyi bde sdug la sems khur byed pa/ dbul bo khyim tshang la brtse sems rnal ma ldan pa bcas kyi snang tshul zhig grub pa byas/ shang gi mgo khrid pa dang las byed pa phal ba tshang mas mgo drangs nas zhal 'debs sgor4200phul ge 22ze —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/nas ha cang dbul bo yin pa'i stag lha tshang la mus gru bzhi ma120yod pa'i drod spyil zhig las rogs byas/ shang tang u'i u yon nam shar zla ba sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci rdo rjes rang 'gul gyis dbul bo khyim tshang de la lug10byin pa las gzhan/ dbul bo khyim tshang5la dus bcad med par nor55dang lug36g.yar ba dang / bgres po lha thar la lug rer sgor80yas mas kyi rin gong dma' ba'i sgo nas lug50btsongs pa dang rin pa lo gnyis kyis sprod chog pa byas/las byed pa rnams mdun du skyod pa dang dril sgrog slob gso spel thogagacig gis gcig la rogs skyor dang phyug pos dbul bor rogs skyor byed pa'i bya 'gul spel phyir/ rgya che'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi dbul skyor brtson sems ches cher bskul ba dang / nor lug phul nas dbul skyor byed pa'i tsha rlabs gcig 'phror gcig bslangs/ rwa ring sde ba ru khag gnyis pa'i lha skyabs dang ru khag gsum pa'i bkra mgon dang dbang bha bcas gsum pos rang nyid phyug por gyur rjes dbul bo yin pa'i yul mi rnams mi brjed par/'bul thengs gcig gis phyugs zog200(nor50dang lug150)phul ba dang /de'i khrod du lha skyabs kho nas phyugs zog(nor25dang lug65)90phul bas/bsdoms pas rin gong sgor40000tsam du slebs/dbul skyor rgud skyob byed pa'i dpe mtshon khyim tshang gi sne khrid 'og zla ba gcig tsam gyi ring du rgya che'i 'brog pa tshos gcig rjes gnyis mthud sgos phyugs zog phul nas shang yongs su bsdoms pas nor lug1132la bslebs shing shang yongs kyi dbul khyim22dang mi grangs125la cha snyoms sgos mi rer phyugs brog17re yod pa dang / mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor710la bslebs thub tshod byung phyir/ kho tsho lo gcig nang dbul bo las thar thabs bya rgyu'i — 226 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa da wadamigs yul mngon 'gyur byas/(1998lo'i zla1po'i tshes6nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/ )sems shugs yod rgya sde dmangs la phulab/da watho kyā shang byang chub sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci 'phags pa rgyal gyi gnas tshul bkod pa/ lha mkhar/blo mthun 'phags pa rgyal ni rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul thun rin rdzong tho kyā shang byang chub sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci rgan pa zhig yin pa dang /pha tsha bu rgyud kyi ring du gnyer ba'i las rigs gtso bo ni zhing las red/ krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun/ bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi jus legs nyi ma'i 'dzum zer mes rgyal gyi sa gzhi kun tu khyab pa'i skal bzang gi dus 'dir/ khos rang rtogs sgos re med spobs med dang / re sgug bab lta/ da yod gnas tshul la yid tshim pa sogs kyi sgyid lug bsam blo yo bsrang byas te/ ri sa'i rjes lus rnam pa bsgyur ched/ 'du shes gsar sgyur dang gsar gtod yar thon/ dka' spyad 'bad brtson bcas kyi sgo nas go chod pa'i byed thabs sna tshogs spyad de yul mi rnams la don bzang 'bor chen bsgrubs te grub 'bras chen po blangs yod pas/ mi rnams kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog bar med du stor bzhin mchis/da 227 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/da lor kho rang lo58yin pa dang slob chung gi rig gnas chu tshad las med kyang blo sgo ha cang yangs shing las la tan tig yin phyir/ 1976lor sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u cir bskos nas da lta'i bar du lo ngo20lhag 'das/ lo20lhag gi ring du tang gi srid jus rab dang rim pa slob sbyong nan tan byed pa'i sbrags su dus thog tu ji ma ji bzhin du mang tshogs la dril bsgrags byas pa ma zad/ khyad par du tang yon dang gung gzhon tshogs pa gnad sar bzhag nas sgrig 'dzugs byas te tang gi lam phyogs dang byed phyogs dang srid jus bcas slob sbyong byas nas kho tsho'i bsam blo'i chab srid las don dam 'dzin byas te/ sde ba'i don bya che ma chung gsum gang ci'i steng nas tang rtsa 'dzigs kyi 'thab 'dzing btsan rdzong gi nus pa dang gdong len mig dpe'i nus pa 'don spel gang legs byas pas/ khor1991lo nas1997lo'i bar du khul dang rdzong dang shang bcas kyis snga gzhug tu‘‘tang yon phul byung can’’dang‘‘tang kri pu'u hru'u ci phul byung can’’‘‘tang 'dzugs las ka'i sngon thon mi sna’’sogs kyi bya dga' thengs bcu lhag zhig gnang yod/ khos rgyun par mang tshogs la khrims lugs thad kyi shes bya dril bsgrags byas pa dang / lhag par du na gzhon rnams la sgrig khrims brtsi ba dang lhing 'jags mthun sgril la srung skyong / rgan bkur byis gces/ 'khon 'dzing dang rku 'phrog byed mi rung ba bcas kyi slob gso rgyun chad med par btang phyir/ sde ba de'i mang tshogs khrod du ya rab tshul ldan gyi dar srol bzang bo zhig chags shing / na gzhon khrod du khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod gcig kyang byung ma myong / 1990lor rma lho khul spyi bde khru'u dang thun rin rdzong spyi bde cus kyis khor‘‘bde 'jags srung skyong thad grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs yod’’ces pa'i bya dga' gnang /'phags pa rgyal gyis khyim tshang92dang mi grangs500lhag yod pa'i byang — 228 —

rgyas 'phrin/chub sde ba'i dbul phongs kyi rnam pa snga mor bsgyur ched/ sde ba der chu mig gcig las med pā dang dgun khar mi phyugs gnyis ka'i 'thung chu la lhag par dka' khag che ba'i gnad don la gzhigs nas/ 1985lo nas snga gzhug tu thengs20lhag la lam thag spyi le30yod pa'i khul dang rdzong gi 'brel yod sde khag la bde sdug yar zhu dang re ba phur tshugs su btabs pas/ 1988lor rdzong chu bed sde khag las ma dngul dang lag rtswal brtson len byung zhing / las kas rgud skyob tshab byed rnam pa spyad de rang 'bab chu 'dren pa'i bzo bkod legs 'grub byung ste mi500lhag dang phyugs zog2000lhag gi 'thung chu'i gnad don thag chod byung / 1990lor khos mang tshogs sgrig 'dzugs sgos spyi le brgyad lhag yod pa'i gzhung lam zhig las pa dang / dpal 'byor cha rkyen cung zad bzang ba'i khyim tshang 'gar skul slong byas te lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo gsum nyos phyir/ 'grim 'grul yo byad rta drel dang mdzo g.yag kho nar brten pa'i lo rgyus kyi mjug rdzogs/ khos tshan rtsal gyis zhing las dar rgyas su gtong bar mthong chen byas te/ 1990lo nas bzung rdzong dang shang gi 'brel yod las khungs nas tshan rtsal mi sna gdan drangs te rol 'angebs dang bsnol 'debs dang bsres 'debs bcas byed pa'i 'go brtsams nas/ mu'u re'i thon tshad mngon gsal gyis 'thor 'degs byung pas/ 1994lor sde ba de rma lho khul gyi ri khul du sran chen 'debs pa'i tshod lta'i ga'i sar bdams pa dang / lo de'i ston khar thun rin dang gcan tsha rdzong gnyis kyi 'ing las sa khul gyi lta gzigs tshogs pa yong nas bltas rjes gzengs bstod dang gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang / 1997lor khul dang rdzong gi zhing phyugs sde khag gis sde ba rer sran chen dang zhog khog bsres 'debs tshod lta byas te legs grub byung ste grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa blangs te/ 1988lo'i mu'u re'i cha — 229 sdi—

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/snyoms thon tshad spyi rgya200de1997lor spyi rgya350lhag tu 'phar ba dang / mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor400de sgor1000lhag la bslebs yod/ khos da dung mang tshogs la slob gso dang sne khrid nas bsam blo'i bkag rgya gtor te/1997lo'i zla4ba nas zla8pa'i bar sa zhing bde thang dang rgya skyed pa dang sa rgod bslogs pa bcas mu'u600la bslebs pas/ khul dang rdzong gi mgo khrid dang 'brel yod mi sna thengs mang por las yul dngos la yongs nas bltas rjes/ ‘‘tshan rig la brten nas dbul thar phyug sgyur gyi sne khrid mkhan’’zhes bsngags brjod byas/blo mthun 'phags pa rgyal gyis thog mtha' bar gsum du dbul phongs khyim tshang la ‘‘sgug brten slong’’ gsum gyi 'du shes bsgyur dgos pa dang /dka' spyad sdug rus kyis dbul thar phyug sgyur gyi thabs lam 'tshol zhib byas te snga mo nas dbul bo'i tshul nas thar thabs byed dgos pa'i slob gso btang thog 1991lor khos sde ba der phye 'thag 'phrul 'khor dang snum btsags 'phrul 'khor gcig kyang med par gzhigs nas dngul khang las skyed ka med pa'i dngul bun sgor3000brtson len byas te/ ches dbul phongs yin pa'i khyim tshang gnyis la 'phrul 'khor de gnyis re re nyo ru bcug par bstun/ khyim tshang de gnyis la dpal 'byor phan 'bras nges can thob nas da lta dbul phongs las thar yod/ 1986lo'i tshun/ khos bsdoms pas dbul skyor ma dngul sgor khri 10lhag dang / phye spyi rgya700lhag dang sa bon sna tshogs spyi rgya3000lhag dang / rdzos lud tun26lhag bcas brtson len byas thog rdzong dmangs srid cus las snga gzhug tu lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo 6brtson len byas nas/ sde ba'i mang tshogs dang khyad par du dbul phongs khyim tshang la bkod sgrig byas/ gzhan yang/ 1974lo nas da lta'i bar khos sde ba'i rkang — 230 —

rgyas 'phrin/rjen sman pa'i las 'gan zhor khur byas pas/ khos sman sbyin btang ba bsdoms pas sgor3000lhag la bslebs/ gong smras kyi don dngos 'di dag bsgrubs pa brgyud/ sde ba 'di da lta dbul phongs las phal cher thar mod/de bas so sor1991dang1998lor mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung dang thun rin rdzong u dang rdzong srid gzhung gis khor‘‘dbul skyor las don thad nas grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs yod’’ces pa'i bya dga' gnang /(1998lo'i zla5ba'i tshes8nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/ )mdun du skyod bzhin pa'i hi nan rdzong bod sman khang /cang tso con dang klu byams/rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul hi nan rdzong bod sman khang ni rdzong u dang rdzong srid gzhung / gong rim 'brel yod sde khag bcas kyis rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang bar brten/ 1986lo'i zla dang por btsugs/ lo bcu lhag ring la sman khang des dka' ngal rab dang rim pa sel nas/ rim bzhin tshad ldan can gyi sman bcos byed sar tu gyur/ da lta thog ma'i gzhi khyon grub nas hi nan rdzong gi bod kyi gso rig rgyun 'dzin dang / sngog 'don/ legs bsgrigs bcas byed pa dang / srol rgyun gyi mi rigs sman bcos mi sna skyed bsring byed pa'i rten gzhi gal chen nyag cig tu gyur yod/— 231 —

tsho gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/hi nan rdzong bod sman khang gi rgya khyon la mus gru bzhi ma41780 9yod pa dang / sman khang yongs la bsdoms pas las bzo ba42yod cing / de'i nang sman gnyer ba27dang / dka' bcu ba'i yan gyi thob thang ldan pa'i sman pa15yod pa'i nang sman rams pa'i thob thang can mi gsum yod/ da lta sman khang der sgo bsten sman bcos khang dang sdod bcos khang sogs nad bcos tshan khag bcu gnyis yod/bod sman khang des lo ngo bcu lhag tsam gyi ring la nad bcos srog skyob kyi kun spyod bzang pos phyogs bcu'i nad pa'i sdug bsngal sel zhing / rang lus rang 'degs dang rang kha rang gso byed pa'i thabs lam la brten nas/ spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor gyi phan 'bras dga' 'os pa blangs stabs/ phyogs kyi snyan cha rna ba'i rgyan du spud yod par ma zad/ rang 'dra'i las rigs gral du'ang kun la ngom du rung zhing dbu 'phang gzengs su bstad chog pa'i mtshan snyan 'thob yod/ 1996lo'i lo mjug bar du/ sman khang de'i 'khor rgyug dngul 'bor ma dngul sgor khri123lhag la bslebs/ sman khang de 'dzugs kha'i 'khor rgyugs dngul 'bor las ldab sum cu so drug 'phar ba dang /brtan 'jags ma dngul sgor khri119la 'phar nas thog ma'i brtan 'jags ma dngul las ldab gsum dang grangs chung drug 'phar/ lo ngo de tsam gyi ring la sman khang der 'phel rgyas de 'dra bzang bo ji ltar byung zhe na/ gcig ni sman khang gi thog mtha' bar gsum du las bzo ba spyi'i bsam pa'i kun spyod 'dzugs skrun dang byed sgo'i byang tshad je mthor gtong ba dam 'dzin lhod med byas te/ las bzo ba yongs kyi khrod tang gi gzhi rtsa'i lam phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byed pa dang / gom gang mdun spos sgos spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'phrod bsten las don yar skul byed pa'i thun mong gi phugs bsam brtan po zhig btsugs — 232 —

shārnya05khur13zud/ da wa nas blo gcig sems gcig gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i bsam blo'i rmang gzhi btings/gnyis ni/ sman gnyer mi sna'i las gnas sbyong brdar la brten nas/sman bcos 'phrul chas bed spyod tshad ldan can dang / sman gnyer mi sna'i byed sgo lag rtsal chu tshad je mthor gtong ched/ 'os mtshams kyis mi sna skong 'then byas nas zhing chen dang sa khul gyi sman khang dang ched las slob grwa sogs su zab sbyong byed par mngags shing / sman khang rang nas nyams myong ldan pa'i sman par slob ma skyong du bcug pa'i byed thabs spyad pa ma zad/ zhing chen phyi nang gi rang 'dra'i las rigs dang byed sgo'i bdag 'dzin sde khag dang 'brel 'dris byas nas/ nad thog sman bcos kyi nyams myong brje spol dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs zhib 'jug gi gros dpyad bya 'gul spel/ 1995lo nas bzung / sman khang de'i las bzo ba tshos rig gzhung dpyad rtsom bcu lhag spel ba dang de'i nang gi dpyad rtsom gsum la zhing chen dang khul bod sman rig gzhung zhib 'jug dpyad bsdur tshogs 'du'i thog phul byung dpyad rtsom la bdams/gsum ni sman rtswa'i thon khungs kyi drag cha bed spyad nas/ mi rigs srol rgyun gyi sman sbyor khyad chos rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel byas/ bod sman khang des1988lor/ bod kyi gso rig mkhas mchog khro du tshe rnam tshang gi slob ston dang man ngag la brten nas thog mar rin chen grang sbyor dang rat+na bsam 'phel sogs rin chen sman sna rtsa chen bdun ril bur las par legs 'grub byung bar ma zad/ de dag gi sman nus khyad par can la gzhir bzung nas/ dal 'gyangs nad rigs dang / gso dka' ba'i nad rigs/ de min ngos 'dzin dka' ba'i nad rigs bcas la btang bas/ phyogs so so'i nad pa dang ched — 233 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/las mkhas pa/ de min rang 'dra'i las rigs thad mgrin gcig tu gdeng 'jog bzang bo 'thob/ dus mtshungs su dpal 'byor gyi phan 'bras kyang mthor 'degs mngon gsal byung / da lta'i bar sman rtswa rigs sna tshogs rgya ma20000lhag btus nas sman rigs brgya dang bzhi bcu lhag bsdebs shing /rin thang sgor mo khri60lhag yod/ gzhan yang mang tshogs kyi dpal 'byor khur bo je yang du gtong ched/ sman khang btsugs pa nas da lta'i bar du bod sman gyi rin gong je mthor btang ma myong bas zhing chen phyi nang du sman rin ches dma' mo yin/bzhi ni stobs shugs yod rgus mang tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu bzhin yod/ bod sman khang des phyogs bzhi'i nad pa la rang gi zhabs 'degs zhu yul dang / bkur bsti zhu yul gtso bor bzhag nas nad bcos srog skyob byed pa'i sbrags su/ las bzo ba rnams skul slong byas te rang byung gnod 'tshe byung ba'i sa khul kha shas su zhal 'debs kyi dngos po dang sgor mo phul/ rim bsags ltar sgor mo khri1lhag la 'bud/ khyad par du sman khang btsugs pa nas bzung kho tshos spyi tshogs thog 'khor skyod tshul du sman sbyin sman bcos byed pa rgyun 'khyongs dang / gzhan yang byis pa skye len dang / skam gtsags gdab pa/ khrag gtar ba/ so 'bal ba/ rma khar sman las byed pa sogs la sman rin gtan nas blangs ma myong / 1994lo nas bzung / sa gnas rang gi gnas tshul dngos la dmigs nas/ rdzong yongs kyi mnga' khongs nas yun ring du khyim tshang ches dbul bo'i sdod bcos sman rin30lko ma gtogs mi len pa'i dmigs bsal gyi lta skyong byas/gzhan yang / kho tshos shang sde sman bcos dpung sde 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang zung 'brel byas nas/ brel 'tshub che ba'i las ka dus gseng bed spyad de/— 234 —

shārnyathagakhuraXthozug/ da wa shang dang sde ba khag nas yong ba'i mi bzhi bcu lhag bskyed bsring byas pas/shang dang sde bar sman dang sman pa dkon pa'i lo rgyus la rdzogs rtags bris/mdor na/ sman khang de'i mgo khrid pa nas las bzo ba tshang mas rdog rtsa gcig sgril dang bka' spyad 'bad brtson byas nas grub 'bras de dag blangs pas/ spyi tshogs dang 'brel yod gong rim sde khag gis kyang kho tsho'i gzengs su thon pa'i grub 'bras la khas len dang gdeng 'jog bzang bo byas/ 1996lo dang1997lor rdzong dang khul gyis dpal yon las khungs la bdams/ /(1998lo'i zla7pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)dmangs yongs kyis dpal yon me tog skyong /ba cha grong rdal gyis dpal yon grong rdal gsar skrun bya 'gul spel ba'i gnas tshul rgyas bkod/gsar 'god pa/ g.yang pa/chab cha grong rdal ni mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas bcas kyi lte gnas yin/ grong rdal de 'brog khul gyi khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi nyams 'gyur mngon gsal dod po ldan pas/mi rnams kyis de la rtswa thang gi mu tig red zer/ bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed gting zab tu spel ba dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tshong khrom dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi gom stabs je mgyogs su song ba dang bstun/ grong rdal de — 235 ge

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/khul yongs kyi dpal 'byor dar spel thad phyi la sgo 'byed pa'am tshong 'gugs dngul 'dren gyi zam par gyur/ rnam pa gsar ba 'di la 'phrod ched/ grong rdal de nas dpal yon grong dmangs byed pa dang dpal yon las khungs gsar skrun gyi bya 'gul spel 'go brtsams/dmangs yongs dpal yon grong rdal gsar skrun nang zhugs pa/chab cha grong rdal gyis na ning nas dpal yon grong rdal gsar skrun byed pa'i bya 'gul spel 'go brtsams/ mtsho lho khul dang gung hi rdzong gi rim pa so so'i mgo khrid sde khag gi rgyab skyor thob/ gung hi rdzong us bya 'gul 'dir gros rim gal chen du bkod pa dang phyogs yongs nas bkod sgrig dang mthun sbyor byas shing gsar skrun bya 'gul gyi dmigs tshad tshang ma grangs tshad du sgyur nas rim pa bzhin du dngos 'bebs byas/ 'di dang mnyam du dpal yon grong rdal gsar skrun byed pa'i dril bsgrags zla ba spel ba dang / 〈chab cha grong rdal grong dmangs kyi dpal yon spyi chings〉dang〈chab cha grong rdal gyi grong dmangs kyi bsrung bya〉gtan la phab pa dang khyab spel byas nas/ las babro ba dang grong dmangs nang du dpal yon grong rdal gsar skrun byed pa'i dgos gal dmigs tshad/ nang don/ byed thabs/ grong dmangs rang nyid kyi 'os 'gan/ 'gan khur dang kun spyod tshad gzhi sogs la dril bsgrags zab mo byas/ spyi bde dang bzo tshong / 'phrod bsten/ tshong las/ dngul rtsa/ khral don/ sbrag srid glog 'phrin/ glog shugs mkho sprod/ 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren sogs sde khag dang las rigs kyis zhabs zhu rnam 'gyur legs sgyur dang dpal yon las yul gsar skrun brtson bzhin yod/ da lta grong rdal der rigs so so'i las byed pa dang mang tshogs nang dpal yon spyi dmangs brtson — 236 —

rgyas 'phrin/len dang dpal yon las khungs gsar skrun byed pa'i tsha rlabs 'phyur kyin 'dugagrong rdal gyi rnam pa gsar ba/grong rdal ni sa cha zhig gi spyi tshogs yar thon dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang dpal yon tshad gzhi bcas mtshon pa'i‘‘sge'i khung’’red/ gsar skrun bya 'gul spel ba'i nang du chab cha grong rdal gyis gzhi rtsa'i 'dzugs skrun la shugs snon dang phyogs bsdus nus pa mthor 'degs dang khor yug gtsang sbra bcas bya ba gal chen du rtsis nas dam 'dzin byas nas/ ‘‘rgyal khab dang thun mong dang mi sger’’bcas kyis snga gzhug tu ma dngul btang nas srang lam31gi zheng je yangs su btang ba dang de'i nang gi srang lam20la snum nag dang ar 'dam btings/ rkang lam16ste mus gru bzhi ma khri12 8la ar 'dam leb mo btings/ srang lam gtso bo15la glog sgron241sgrig sbyor byas/ chu rnyog 'dren lam10la lcags mdong mus6116btings/ spyi spyod spyod khang gsar ba6las pa dang de'i nang gi chus 'khrud spyod khang2ni mi sger gyis ma dngul btang nas las pa red/ grong rdal yongs nas gad snyigs 'pho sgam che chung85btsugs/gad snyigs dang khyim lud 'drud skyel rlangs 'khor3dang chu stor rlangs 'khor1nyos nas bkol/ rmang gzhi'i sgrig chas rim bzhin 'thus tshang cha 'grig tu 'gro bar bstun/ chab cha grong rdal gyi gzhi rtsa'i sgrig chas phal cher tshang ba dang grong rdal gyi phyogs bsdus nus pa mthor 'degs mngon gsal byung yod/srang lam dang lhas ra'i ljang sgyur mdzes ba rgyan byed pa ni dpal yon gsar skrun bya 'gul 'di'i nang gi las bya gal chen zhig red/ grong rdal srid gzhung gis rigs so so'i grong dmangs la lhas ra ljang sgyur mdzes brgyan byed — 237 d+ngha

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/par skul slong byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ snga gzhug tu srang lam 'gram gyi mus11000yod pa'i gnyis 'gram gyi sbyar ba sdong bo tshang ma bcad de yo 'bog sdong bo btsugs pa dang / ljang sngo ne+e'u gsing mus4700btab/ da lo'i dpyid ka kho nar grong rdal yongs nas lhas ra'i bzhi 'gram nas sdong bo khri6lhag btsugs pa dang bde skyid thang las grong rdal du 'gro ba'i gzhung lam 'gram du nags tshul star phreng mus3000ste sdong bo khri3lhag btsugs/ de dang mnyam du nags las bdag dbang dpang yig byin nas grong dmangs la ri rgod lung stong 'gan len byed du bcug nas sdong bo 'dzugs par tshod lta byas/sngon chad shing sdong mi skye pa'i ri rgod lung stong 'ga' la da lo nas bzung sngo ljang ljang du gyur 'dug da lta grong rdal yongs la nags tshal mu'u2488yod pa dang nags kyis khebs tshad21 65la bslebs/chab cha grong rdal gyi khor yug gtsang sbra yin pa sngon chad nas mi rnams kyi bstod bsngags thob/ 1991lor zhing chen rgyal gces gtsang sbra las 'gul u yon lhan khang gis grong rdal de‘‘zhing chen yongs kyi gtsang sbra grong khyer ang gnyis par’’bdams/ thengs 'di'i gsar skrun bya 'gul nang / grong rdal des sngon gyi grub 'bras brtan srung byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng / dus rgyun du 'dzin pa dang 'phral sgrub byed pa zung du sbrel nas/ gtso bor snyigs chags zur khug gtsang dag byas/ grong rdal yongs kyi las khungs so so dang sger gnyer tshong khang dang za khang tshang ma la sgo kha'i‘‘'gan len gsum’’gyi 'gan 'khri lam lugs lag bstar byed du bcugs pa dang / gtsang sbra lta skul gyi ched las mi sna bkod sgrig byas nas bar mtshams med par lta skul byas/ grong rdal gtsang sbra ru khag gis gtso pher dmag dpung gi nus pa bton te/ mi grangs nyung ba dang las ka ljid pa'i gnas tshul 'og mtshams bgos nas — 238 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da 'gan len byas pa dang nyin rer thengs gnyis re rgyun 'khyongs byas pas/srang lam gtso bo dang rkang lam dang nags tshal bcas kyi gtsang sbra khag theg byas/ grong rdal gyi btsog snyigs tshang ma gcig sgril du do dam dang gcig sgril du 'drud skyel byed pa ma zad/ nyin re'i btsog snyigs nyin der 'drud cing sa 'og tu bcug pas phan 'bras bzang bo thob/ 1997lor grong rdal der slar yang‘‘zhing chen rim pa'i gtsang sbra grong rdal’’gyi mtshan snyan thob/dpal yon me tog 'gran rtsod ngang bzhad pa/dpal yon grong rdal gsar skrun byed pa'i bya 'gul des chab cha sa khul gyi tang srid sde khag so so dang zhabs zhu las rigs so so'i kun spyod legs sgyur dang las phyod phan nus mthor 'degs dang rang nyid kyi dge mtshan ngom pa'i go skabs bzang bo zhig bskrun/ zhabs zhu las rigs so sos rang gi las sgo'i don dngos dang sbrel nas zhabs zhu tshad gzhi gtan la phab pa dang hur brtson gyis spyi tshogs la zhabs zhu sgrub rgyu'i khas blangs shing mang tshogs kyi lta skul dang len byas pas/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis‘‘zhabs zhu bzang po byasanas las rigs kun spyod gsar ba 'dzugs pa’’dang‘‘grong khyer brgya'i tshong khang khri la tshong zong rdzun ma med pa’’ ‘‘'dzum mul ngang 'bas zhu’’sogs bya 'gul spel nas spyi tshogs phan nus dang dpal 'byor phan nus la‘ thon legs’’thob/ khul sbrag srid glog 'phrin ma lag gis shugs chen gyis nang gi rgyu spus mthor 'degs dang phyi la snang brnyan bzang bo ston pa'i bya 'gul spel nas spyi tshogs yongs kyi bstod bsngags thob pa dang / dmangs kyi 'dod min tshod len byas pa'i skar grangs1996lo'i skar ma86 3las1997lo'i93la bslebs shing / snga gzhug tu‘‘zhing chen rim pa'i dpal yon sde khag’ dang— 239 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/‘‘zhing chen rim pa'i bzo ba'i khyim tshang phul byung can’’la bdams shing / da lor‘‘zhing chen rim pa'i dpal yon mig dpe sde khag’’gi mtshan snyan thob/zhing las dngul khang gung hi yan lag khang gis bzo ba'i nang du‘‘rig gnas slob sbyong dang las rkang sbyong brdar/ ngal rtsol 'gran sdur/ na gzhon shes yon can gyi mtshan snyan brtson len’’zhes pa'i bya 'gul spel ba rgyun 'khyongs byas nas/ 1996lor‘‘zhing chen rim pa'i dpal yon sde khag’’tu bdams pa dang1997lor dngul khang de'i dngul bcol khang dang por‘‘rgyal yongs dpal yon dpe ston sge'u khung’’du bdams/ spyi bde dang bzo tshong do dam dang rig gnas sogs sde khag gis rgyun chad med par spyi tshogs bde 'jags phyogs bsdus bcos skyong dang spyi tshogs dang 'grim 'grul sgrig srol srung skyong /spyi tshogs steng gi srol ngan yo bsrang byed pa dang mnyam du las rigs kyi tshul min spyod ngan rbad de gtan 'gog byas/ kho tshos‘‘kha bshad tshig gcig las 'go brtsams te rgya che'i mang tshogs la stabs bde bzo ba'i’’skul tshig bton nas rang gi zol med rnam dag gi zhabs zhu las mi dmangs kyi mos brtsi thob/hi tung mngag gtong khang dang hi tung bzo tshong do dam khang gnyis la da lor‘‘zhing chen rim pa'i dpal yon sge'u khung sde khag’’gi mtshan snyan thob/mig snga'i bar du/ chab cha sa khul du bsdoms pas zhing chen rim pa'i dpal yon sde khag10dang khul rim pa'i dpal yon sde khag21 rdzong rim pa'i dpal yon sde khag 21 dpal yon khyim tshang 646 bde 'jags lhas ra18sogs byung ngo/ /(1998lo'i zla7pa'i tshes24nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)— 240 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ lnged+nghadus rabs kyi ras gzhi'i steng chon mdangs stug po'i pur smyug bsgrur mkhas pa'i na gzhon rtsom pa po rnam sras/gsar 'god pa/ rig 'dzin tshe ring /bod rigs na gzhon rtsom pa po rnam sras ni1957lor mtsho sngon zhing chen khri ka rdzong dkar brjid shang gi sum pa sde bar skyes shing / 1988lor nub byang mi rigs slob gling bod yig sde tshan gyi zhib 'jug 'dzin grwa nas mthar phyin cing / gna' rabs bod kyi rtsom rig thad nas hra'o hri thob thang blangs pa red/ khong da lta mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling bod yig sde tshan gyi co hra'u ba gzhon pa dang / krung go'i rtsom pa po lhan tshogs dang lo tsā ba'i lhan tshogs kyi u yon red/ 1982lo nas bzung gsar rtsom la zhugs shing / khong gis snga rjes su sgrung gtam nyi shu lhag bris pa las〈dge mtshan zil char dbab khar byung ba'i rnar gzon 'brug sgra〉dang〈mi rabs gsum gyi phrug lwa〉〈rang 'thag kha〉〈'bru bskyi ba〉〈pha yul〉sogs krung dbyang mi rigs dpe skrun khang dang mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 'dems bsgrigs byas pa'i deng rabs sgrung thung phyogs bsgrigs su bsdus pa dang / 1995lor sgrung gtam〈'bru bskyi ba〉zhes par mtsho sngon bcings 'grol byas nas lo 'khor45lon pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos phul byung can gyi bya dga' thob/ khong gi sgrung — 241 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gtam〈mi rabs gsum gyi phrug lwa〉zhes pa1987lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gsum pa'i steng bkod pa dang / 1991lor bod kyi deng rabs dpe tshogs〈gtsang bo'i pha rol〉nang bsdus yod/ sgrung gtam 'di mdo dbus khams gsum gyi klog pa po ste lhag par du na gzhon rtsom pa po'i khrod du shugs rkyen drag po thebs/ khos da dung〈ches mtha' mjug gi ri dwags brngon thengs gcig〉dang / 〈'bral kha'i brtse sems〉〈mal khang nang gi lab gleng〉bcas bod spyi tshogs dang thag nye ba'i brtsams chos khag cig spel bar spyi tshogs steng bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag yod pa red/rnam sras ni 'jon thang ldan pa'i na gzhon rtsom pa po zhig yin te/ khos gsar rtsom gyi zhor la〈bod kyi gna' rabs snyan ngag gi rtog yul mdzes pa gleng pa〉sogs ched rtsom20lhag spel ba dang / 〈rgya gar gyi rig byed gtam rgyud dang bod kyi snyan ngag bar gyi 'brel ba〉dang / 〈tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gsang rnam dang mgur glu las khong gi rgyus la dpyad pa〉zhes par/ snga rjes su‘‘mtsho sngon zhing chen mtshan nyid spyi tshogs tshan rig thad kyi phul byung grub 'bras bya dga'i rim pa thengs gnyis pa dang gsum pa thob pa red/ rig gzhung zhib 'jug thad du ma zad/ kho ni gsar rtsom la mkhas pa'i rtsom pa po zhigathog mar kho'i brtsams chos la ha cang shugs drag po'i dus rabs kyi khyad chos mnga' ste/ rtsom rig brtsams chos kyis mngon srid mtshon dgos pa ni rtsom pa po'i 'os 'gan kyang yin/ dus rabs mdun skyod byung ba gna' ba'i rol chas kyis sgra dbyangs gsar ba bkrol dka' ba red/ sgrung gtam〈mi rabs gsum gyi phrug lwa〉nang du pha rgan lhun grub kyis rang khyim gyi phrug lwa de rin bral nor bu la mthong zhing / de ni mes po gong mas tshe srog las brjes — 242 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ —da da 'ong ba ma zad/ mi rabs gsum tsam song ba dang / phrug lwa de gon nas khrom tshogs su bskyod tshe mi kun gyis yid smon pa'i ngang nas bstod brjod byed pas/pha rgan gyi sems su phrug lwa rnying thag chod na'ang de'i mtha' shan du chu sram nag pos brgyan na tshe srog gsar ba zhig thob srid snyam pa'i re bas bu sku 'bum du mngags par bu dang kho rang bsam blo gnyis kyi phog rdeb byung ba red/de lta bu'i 'gal ba'i mdud rgya las rtsom pa pos rang nyid kyi mi rigs la sems khur gyi 'du shes mngon par mtshon pa dang / sgrung gtam gyi sgrig gzhi dang byung rim sogs mis blor shong dka' ba min par bod rigs zhing ba'i 'tsho ba dngos la gzhol zhing / mtshon thabs kyi thad zur za dang 'phya smod kyi bro ba snum po sgos mi rnams la bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed byas rjes/ tang si srid jus gsar bas bod rigs zhing sde la 'gyur ldog chen po bzos 'ongs pa gsal ston byas shing / mi rabs gong 'og gnyis kyi rin thang lta ba'i he bag bkol te/ grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du'ang bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi skul 'ded 'og mi rnams kyi mi tshe'i lta ba dang rin thang lta ba/ 'jig rten lta ba/bsam blo'i rnam pa bcas phyogs so sor 'gyur ldog byung dang 'byung mus su mchis pa gsal bshad byas pa red/ dus rabs kyi khyad rtags 'di dag mngon pa las bsam blo khrid ston gyi khyad chos ldan zhing / mi rnams kyis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyal la re snyeg dang phugs bsam bden pa de klog pa po'i mdun du bshams pa red/na gzhon rtsom pa po rnam sras ni bod khul zhing grong du skyes pas༈ kho rang zhing ba'i 'tsho bar brtag mkhas shing kho'i brtsams chas nang sgang pa bod kyi rtsam dri dang mar dri thul le yod phyir/ bod rigs klog pa pos bklags tshe bag chags gting zab thebs nges/ ‘‘pha rgan lhun grub kyis skad gseng — 243 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/mthon pos/ bsod zad/ bsod zad/ ngo ma6rdo rje go khar lhung na byis pa'i rtse spyad’ces pa ci ma bden/ nga sgo me lhun grub tshang gi lha sa'i chu phrug ce na sa cha'i tshod kyi ri dwags dang bya pho'i gtsug gi ze ba lta bu yin pas/ sde yar nang mar nang gi mi tshang mas mig gor gor byas nas lta yul dang lce nar nar byas nas bstod yul du gyur yod pa gnam sngon po dang nyi ma ser po 'di gnyis la gsal/ yin na'ang / de ring kha 'khyag khyod kyis/ a hi a hi a hid / ’’pha rgan gyis phrug lwa de'i byung ba brjod de bus rin thang shes par 'khang sems skyes tshul bris pa 'di'i thog nas rtsom pa po 'tsho bar myong brgyus yod pa mtshon thub cing / 'di lta bu'i zhib 'bri yis mi rigs kyi khyad chos ji bzhin mtshon yod/ rgan po mang po zhig gis bklags na/ rang nyid bris pa min pa'i nges shes skyes mi srid/mdor na/ rnam sras kyis mdog sna phun sum tshogs pa'i tshon ris kyis bod yul gyi dkyel che ba'i ras gzhi 'di'i steng la ngo mtshar ba'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi ri mo 'bri zhing bris pa ni yid du 'ong zhing lta na sdug pa zhig red/(1998lo'i zla9ba'i tshes28nyin gyi par ngos bzhi par gsal)

rgyas 'phrin/lo ngo bcu yi dka' sprud las/'bras bu g.yur du za ba blangs/sgo khog rdzong ar las kung zi'i cin lis kro'o yon pen gyi gnas tshul bkod pa/sangs rgyas/mi lo sum bcu lhag tu son pa'i kra'o yon pen gyis cun lis kyi las ka lo ngo10la gnyer myong / 1989lor rtsa 'dzugs kyis kho ar las kung zi'i cin lis kyi bskos skabs/ kung zi der gtan 'jags ma dngul sgor khri23ma gtogs med pa dang gyong ched sgor khri9tsam yod/lo ngo10yi ring du dka' spyad las brtson byas pa brgyud nas da lta kung zi de 'gran rtsod dza drag yin pa'i ar las las rigs kyi khrod du lhing nger mngon yod pas/ 1996lor zhing chen 'dzags skrun thin gyis rim pa bzhi ༄ba'i 'dzugs skrun khe las la bdams/ ar las kung zi de mi600lhag la 'phel rgyas byung zhing / der ar las ru khag12dang ar las pa mi4dang mtho rim ar las pa mi1bcas yod pa'i khar/ gtan 'jags rgyu nor sgor khri114dang 'khor rgyug ma dngul sgor khri287yod/ lo rer thon rin la sgor khri1000dang lo rer khe spogs shor khri10re skrun bzhin yod pas/ rtse khog rdzong gi rkang 'dzin khe las kyi gras su tshud/— 245 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/1989lor/ dka' sdug myong bzhin pa'i kra'o yon pen gyis sngon chad kung zis lo re rer‘‘zangs chen gyi zas’’bza' ba dang / sgrig srol lam lugs 'thus tshang min pa/ las sgo'i do dam gzab nan min pa bcas kyi gnas tshul la dmigs te/ don dngos ltar shang grong khe las kyi nyams myong la nan tan sgos zhib 'jug byas pa'i rmang gzhi steng / snying stobs cher skyed sgos 'gan gtsang len gyi las gnyer 'gan 'khri lam lugs lag bstar dang /lam lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa nan 'dzin byas pas/ 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i lo dang por las bzo ba'i brtson sems ches cher skul 'ded byas te/spyi'i thon rim lo sngon ma dang bsdur na ldab gcig phar nas sgor khri 160la bslebs/ lo der lo sngon ma'i gyong rgud kha gsab byas pa las gzhan/ da rung khe spogs sgor khri5gong la sprad/tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'og dang 'gran rtsod drag po'i khrod du rkang 'dzugs pa dang gzhi khyon rgya skyed dang 'phel rgyas jemagyogs su gtong ba/stobs shugs je drag tu gtong ba bcas kyi thad la kra'o yon pen dang kho'i las grogs tshos khe las nang khul du las sne'i 'gan gtsang khur byed pa'i lam lugs spel ba ste/ las sne'i cun lis dang rnam grangs 'gan khur ba/ ar las ru khag gi 'gan khur ba'i khag gi bzo ba dang rgyu cha bkol tshad/ rgyu spus/bde 'jags/ ya rabs ar las bcas thad gtsang khur gyi gan rgya 'jog pa dang / rnam grangs cin lis kyis las sne'i 'gan khur pa so so'i las 'gan legs 'grub byas pa'i gnas tshul la dpyad pa ma zad/ gtan khel ltar bya dga' dang chud gcod lag bstar byas/ rnam grangs 'gan khur pas ar las rkyang ba'i rnam grangs thad bzo ba bkol ba dang rgyu chas spyod grangs kyi nyen kha'i gta' ma hril bo 'gan gtsang khur byed pa lag bstar byas shing / 'gro — 246 —

rgyas 'phrin/gron tshad las brgal na rang nyid kyis 'gan khur ba dang gron chung byas na 'then sprod byas te/ ar las rkyang ba'i rgyu spus dang bde 'jags/ 'phel tshad/ ya rabs ar las sogs kyi dmigs tshad tshang ma grangs tshad dpyad pas/ kung zis spyi'i dmigs tshad de rim pa re re bzhin sde khag dang tshan khag dang mi sger bcas la khag bgos byas te/ sde khag so sos dmigs tshad khrod kyi rang gis khur ba'i las 'gan gsal bo rtogs thub pa byas pa dang /'gan ljid mo tshang mas khur yod pa/ mi re re'i sems la dmigs tshad yod pa bcas byas/ rim pa bkar nas do dam byed pa dang 'gan dbang khe gsum phyogs gcig tu sprel pas/ rgya che'i bzo ba'i nus pa gang legs sgos 'don spel byed pa dang / nus ldan sgos 'char gzhi bde blag ngang lag bstar byas nas dmigs tshad mngon 'gyur byed par khag theg byas/rtse khog rdzong ni mtsho sngon lho rgyud du gnas pas/ dus yun ring bor so phag thon skyed byed kyin med/ kra'o cin lis la shes rtogs gsal bo zhig byung ba ni/ skad cig skad cig tu 'gyur ldog 'byung bzhin pa'i ar las tshong ra'i khrod rang nyid kyi rkang ba 'dzugs dgos na/ nges par du bzo skrun gyi rin gong je dma' ru phab nas phan 'bras mthor 'degs su gtong ba'i lam du 'gro dgos pa de yin/ sngon chad ar las rgyag pa'i dus tshigs su so phag nyo ba dang skyel 'dren byed pa'i thad mi'i stobs dang dngos po'i stobs 'bor chen btang ba dang lan rer phen an dang khri ka sogs sa cha nas nyo bzhin yod/ so phag gcig rtse khog tu drud yong tshe sgor 0 27la bslebs/1992lor kra'o cin lis kyis nan tan sgos zhib 'jug byas pa brgyud de ma dngul sgor khri100btang nas lo rer so phag khri200re thon skyed thub pa'i so phag bzo grwa zhig btsugs/ 1993lor so phag bzo grwa'i thon rin sgor khri50la — 247 ge

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/bslebs shing / lo rer so phag kho na'i ma rtsa sgor khri10nas15tsam je dma' ru btang /kra'o cin lis kyis lag len khrod du shes ldan mi sna skyed sring byas pa ma zad/ da rung sgor mo btang ste skyed sring byed 'os pa'i na gzhon bzo ba phul byung can skor zhig zhing chen ar las slob grwar zab sbyong byed par mngags/kra'o cin lis kyis da rung sgor khri50btang ste/ bzo skrun rlangs 'khor dang 'phrul chas sogs ar las sgrig chas nyos/ na ning yang dpung ring ljid 'degs 'phrul chas shi zhig nyos pas khul yongs su sgrig chas thad nas cung 'dzoms pa'i ar las kung zi nang gi gcig tu gyur yod/1997lor zhang kang ye shu'i chos lugs 'char gzhi lhan tshogs kyis 'brog pa'i gtan sdod thad la bkol bar rtse khog rdzong la sgor khri100yi zhal 'debs gnang / rdzong ar las kung zis las 'gan de phrag tu khur 'dod mod/ yin na'ang 'brog pa'i gtan sdod khang ba100bskrun rgyu de ni las sla mo zhig ma red/ 'brog khyim100shang 'ga' ru thar thor du gnas pas sdod gnas ha cang kha thor red/ thog ma'i dpog rtsis ltar na khyim tshang rer sgos khri1re bgos na mi 'dang bas ci zhig byed dgos sam/ kra'o cin lis mtshan mo 'gar gnyid ma khugs/ yin na'ang khos blo thag rbad chod sgos bzo skrun de dang len byas pa dang ar las byed phyogs gtan 'bebs byas te/ ches mgyogs pa'i ngang nas mi sna 'then nas ar las rgyag pa'i las yul dngos la song / sa cha la lar rlangs 'khor 'gro mi thub pas ar las rgyu cha khal mar bkal nas bskyal/ lo mjug tu rtsis brgyab rjes gtan sdod khang ba100bskrun pa'i thad rdzong ar las kung zis sgor khri20btangs yod pa gsal bo mtshon pas/ kra'o cin lis kyis rang nyid kyi bya spyod dngos kyis rtse khog gi — 248 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da 'brog pa mang tshogs la don bzang chen po zhig bsgrubs pa red//(1999lo'i zla4pa'i tshes2nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)paṇa chen rin po che'i sku 'khor du phyag las sgrub pa'i dus yun/chu med dang chin lha/go dgu lo'i rgya zla dgu ba'i zla stod tsam der kha chad bzhag pa ltar nged gnyis sku zhabs blo bzang byang chub kyi khyim du bcar 'dri byed par song ba yin/khong gi sdod khang ni dar mdo grong khul gyi nub ngos su gnas pa'i〈gangs dkar ri bo'i〉dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pu'u'i rtseg gong ma'i khang ba yin la/ khong gi nang du slebs dus sdod khang chung zhing rnying ba yin rung /nged gnyis kar gtsang zhing dben pa'i tshor ba zhig rang shugs su byung song /khong gi ri mo 'bri khang gi gyang ngos su bkal yod pa'i paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan sku gshegs nas lo gcig 'khor bar dran gso zhu ba'i ched du gsar rtsom byas pa dang / rgyal khab phyi nang du lan bcu phrag kha shas 'grems spel byas pa'i sku thang de sngar bzhin gsar gtsang tshul du mngon 'dug sku zhabs blo bzang byang chub bza' zlas spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nga — 249 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tshor sne len byas nas nga de snga khong gis paṇa chen rin po che'i sku drung du phyag las sgrub tshul nga tshor gleng mol byas pa red/1987lo'i zla3par/ rgyal yongs dmangs 'thus rgyun u'i u yon krang gzhon pa paṇa chen mchog gis gdan 'dren gnang ba ltar sku zhabs blo bzang byang chub pe cin du 'byor nas paṇa chen gzhung las khang du ri mo 'bri ba'i phyag las sgrub pa dang / skabs der paṇa chen rin po ches sku ngo mas mtshan rtags bkod gnang nas sku zhabs blo bzang byang chub krung go'i bod rgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gi ri mo 'bri mkhan zhib 'jug mi snar gdan drangs pa red/paṇa chen mchog gis khams pa'i pho gsar 'di la ha cang dga' zhen gnang gi yod cing / nam rgyun byang chub dang thug tshe byams brtse ngang kho'i rgya bod rig gnas 'byor tshul dang las ka gnyer tshul 'dri gnang ba red/ byang chub ni ma gzhi brtson 'grus che ba'i ri mo ba zhig yin pa dang / yang sgos paṇa chen rin po che'i gzigs mthong chen po thebs par brten khos de bas kyang 'bad brtson lhod med byas pa red/ paṇa chen rin po ches grabs gshom gnang bzhin pa'i〈bod ljongs 'phel rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs〉dang〈bod ljongs gangs can 'phel rgyas spyi khyab kung si〉de gnyis kyi mtshan rtags dang / krung go bod rgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gi mtshan rtags dang / slob deb kyi mdun shog bcas jus 'god byed ched khos rtag tu mtshan phyed bar du phyag las sgrub dgos rung / nam rgyun mtshan mo'i chu tshod bcu pa'i thog slebs dus rin po ches mi mngags nas khor mar ja nyir gang dang /chur ba rdog ma kha shas/ mngar sob bag leb sder ma gang skyel gnang ba red/zla ba lnga pa ni gna' grong pe cin du me tog sna tshogs bkra rgyas pa'i dus — 250 —

sbyo/bsdokhuraXnyezud/ da wa yun te/ ‘‘bod ljongs 'phel rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs’’kyi tshogs rtags jus 'god byed pa'i 'gran sdur gyi mdzad sgo de paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog gi pho brang du 'tshogs pa red/ kan su'u dang / mtsho sngon/ bod ljongs bcas kyi skad grags che ba'i ri mo ba tshos rang rang so sos jus 'god byas pa'i rgyan ris phul ba dang / krung dbyang mdzes rtsal slob grwa chen mo/krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i mdzes rtsal tshan khag bcas kyi ri mo mkhan tshos rang rang so sos jus 'god byas pa'i rgyan ris phul/ byang chub kyis kyang rang nyid tshogs rtags 'di jus 'god ma byas sngon du paṇa chen rin po ches khor tshogs rtags 'di'i thog nas rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rnams kyis bod ljongs kyi mi dmangs la dga' zhen byed pa'i lhag bsam dang bod ljongs gong du 'phel bar rogs ram byed pa'i don 'di 'dra zhig mtshon dgos pa dang bod ljongs mi dmangs kyis rig slob dang / 'phrod bsten las don/bod mi rigs rig gnas 'phel rgyas btang tshul yang mtshon dgos pa dang /bod mi rigs kyis kyang tshan rtsal mtho shos dang deng rabs can gyi grub 'bras thog nas 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyis sger sems med par nga tshor thugs khur dang gces skyong gnang bar drin lan 'jal ba de mngon thub dgos zhes gsungs ba ltar/ nan tan gyis jus 'god byas pa'i rgyan ris 'di phul ba red/ ched las mkhan po tshos spro sems 'khol ba'i gros sdur byas pa dang zhib tshags kyis dpyad sdur byas par brgyud/ mgrin gcig tu byang chub kyis jus 'god byas pa'i rgyan ris 'dis〈bod ljongs 'phel rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs〉kyi dmigs yul ngo ma mtshon thub yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byas nas bdams pa red/ paṇa chen rin po gtam bzang 'di byang chub la gsung skabs khos sems kyi gting nas paṇa chen rin po cher thugs rje che zhus pa — 251 —
