gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dang / de rjes paṇa chen rin po ches tshogs rtags de wu'u lan h+phu dang / hu'u chi li/ zhi grung zhun/ then ci yun sogs tang dang rgyal khab kyi mgo khrid rnam pa'i mdun sar bskyar phul mdzad/ 〈bod ljongs 'phel rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs〉'dzugs pa'i mdzad sgo'i nang / u yon krang gzhon pa paṇa chen dang de min gyi mgo khrid rnam pas thugs dgyes pa'i ngang tshogs rtags 'di bsnams nas tshogs 'du'i nang zhugs pa ma tshad/ mnyam du par bsgron nas dran rten byas pa red/ sku zhabs blo bzang byang chub kyis da lta'ang lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i par 'di nyar tshags byas yod/1988lo'i zla2par khong gis jus 'god gsar rtsom byas pa'i〈bkra shis rtags brgyad〉dang〈bkra shis rdzas brgyad〉sogs bod srol thang ga 'di dag rin po ches nyar tshags gnang / sku zhabs byang chub phyag las sgrub pa'i sos dal ba'i skabs su paṇa chen rin po ches kho bod khul gyi dgon chen bkra shis lhun po dang 'bras spungs/ sku 'bum byams pa gling / bsam yas gtsug lag khang / dga' ldan dgon/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil bcas su lta skor la khrid pa dang / byang chub kyis dgon chen de dag gi ri mo mkhan rnams la bod srol ri mo'i gzhung lugs dang ri mo 'bri stabs bcas slob sbyong byas/ de rjes paṇa chen rin po ches bkra shis lhun po dgon gyi skad grags ldan pa'i ri mo mkhan dka' chen blo bzang phun tshogs ched du gdan drangs te byang chub kyi dge rgan byas bcug par ma zad/ khor slob sbyong byed bzhin du dge rgan dka' chen dang mnyam du bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa'i paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa nas dgu pa'i bar gyi sku gdung lha khang nang gi ldebs ris 'bri rgyu'i las 'gan sprad/byang chub kyis paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs re stong zad du ma btang bar sems shugs yod rgu bton nas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma'i sku 'dra chen — 252 — —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wapo zhig bris yod pa der paṇa chen rin po ches yi rang gnang bar ma zad/rgyal yongs kyi sa gnas so so nas phebs yong ba'i sprul sku dang bla ma grags can rnams kyis bstod bsngags thob pa dang sku thang de da lta bod mi rigs kyi rigs gnas bang mdzod nang gi nor bu zhig tu gyur yod/ ldebs ris 'bri rgyu'i las 'gan grub rjes/ byang chub dar mdor log nas gung seng btang ba red/ 1988lo'i zla12pa'i nyin zhig la byang chub kyis rang gi khyim nang na ri mo zhig 'bri bzhin bsdad yod skabs/ glo bur du las khungs kyi mi zhig gis‘‘byang chub/ khyod la pe cin nas kha par brgyab byung / mgyogs por shog’’ces pos par/ byang chub lam sang gzhung las khang du rgyug song nas kha par nyan ma thag hang sang la/ de paṇa chen mchog ma red dam/ ‘‘we/ byang chub lags/ sang lo'i zla ba dang por bkra shis lhun po dgon du pakhya chen sku phreng lnga pa nas dgu pa'i sku gdung lha khang du rab gnas bya rgyu yin pas/ khyed rab gnas mdzad sgo'i nang zhugs par phebs shog’’ paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung skad thos rjes/ byang chub sems 'gul tshad med thebs nas lag pa'ang 'dar sig sig byed kyin 'dug 1989lo'i zla ba dang por pakhya chen sku phreng lnga pa nas dgu pa'i sku gdung lha khang gi rab gnas mdzad sgo de bkra this lhun po dgon du gzab rgyas ngang tshogs pa dang / mi rnams kyis pho gsar sbyang grung ldan zhing rgya bo can zhig paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gi rjes su 'brang gi yod pa mthong ba red/ yin na'ang stabs ma legs pa zhig ni/ rab gnas kyi mdzad sgo'i thog paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog glo bur du snying nad bsnyun nas sku gshegs song / skabs der gangs ris mgo bo sgur nas mya ngan zhus pa dang gtsang chus sems sdug ngu 'bod byed/ blo bzang byang chub kyang sems sdug drags nas paṇa chen rin po — 253 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/che sku gshegs pa'i don dngos der khas len byed thabs bral ba red/ khong gis mchog tu gyur pa'i tang dang rgyal khab kyi mgo khrid pa dang rgyal gces chos gces kyi rje btsun bla ma dam pa der dus gtan du dran gso zhu ched/ khong gis nang du bkal yod pa'i paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sku thang grags chen 'di gsar rtsom byas pa red/(2000lo'i zla2tshes22nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/)'od mdangs rab tu 'cher ba'i mu tig cigad wa bod kyi rdo rkos sgyu rtsal pa mgon po tshe brtan gyi gnas tshul bkod pa/ khyung thar rgyal/bod kyi rdo rkos sgyu rtsal la lo rgyus ha cang ring bo yod de/ gdod ma'i dus su brag rkos ri mo byung ba dang btsan po rnams kyi sku ring la rdo ring gi yi ge byung zhing / rjes su rdo brkos sgyu rtsal gyi gzugs ris sna tshogs byung ste/ lha sa'i lcags po ri dang 'bras spungs/ se ra/ dga' ldan rnams dang /mnga' ris kyi gu ge rgyal bo'i pho brang / lho kha'i bsam yas dgon pa/ chab mdo'i ldan ma brag lhun 'grub sogs dang / si khron zhing chen gyi ser shul — 254 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad wadang mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mgo log sogs su sa khyab tu song yod/ bod kyi sgyu rtsal mkhan po de dag sngon thon mi rigs gzhan gyi sgyu rtsal pa rnams dang 'dra bar tshags par dang brnyan deb dang brnyan 'phrin sogs kyi skar khung brgyud nas sa khul gzhan dang mi rigs gzhan la dril bsgrags byas pa ha cang nyung bas khong rnams pa 'tshol na nges par du‘‘ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi yul’’du btsal na ma gtogs mi rnyed la/ bod kyi rdo rkos sgyu rtsal pa mgon po tshe brtan yang de'i gras kyi gcig red/mgon po tshe brtan ni bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang lor (spyi lo1932)mdo smad sa yi thig le/ 'bal gyi mthon po bcu gsum gyi nang sras lung rdo rje zhes pa'i sa'i khyab khungs rong bo a myes gur gyi nye drung du skyes shing /mtshan yang rten de'i dkor gnyer me te zhes pas mgon po tshe brtan du btags/ yongs grags su mgon tshe zer/ lo chung ngu'i dus su pha ma'i rjes 'brangs nas rwa rgya dgon par mjal skor byas par/ de ga'i gtsug lag khang dang 'du khang sogs rten dang brten pa'i bkod pa khyad par can dang / gzi 'od rnam par bkra ba'i bod kyi srol rgyun ri mo dag la mjal ba'i skal bzang mngon du gyur bar brten/ mdzes ris sgyu rtsal gyi bag chags kyang snga mo nas sad par gyur/ de nas bzung kho rang rtsed mor rtsed pa tshun chad sa ngos dang rdo leb/ yang na kha ba'i nang du bya dang byi'u/ mi dang srog chags kyi gzugs ris 'bri ba'i stangs ka byed kyin 'dugarang lo bcu bzhi'i steng snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos sde hor gter ston chos sgar du tshogs la zhugs te/ yi ge 'bri klog nas brtsams te 'don chos spyod yongs rdzogs sbyangs/ snga gzhug tu khams rdo grub rnams gsum dang 'brug lo grub rgan/ gter ston rnams gnyis sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma'i mtshan snyan — 255 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/ldan pa'i bla ma du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te dbang lung khrid gsum gyi gdams pa yongs su mnos/ gzhan yang rong bo dgon pa'i dus 'khor grwa tshang gi a khu stag lha tshang dang rang dgon gyi a lags mthu stobs tshang / a khu rte'u brtan tshang / dpa' rgyal tshang sogs kyi mdun nas thun mong rig gnas dang /yi ge gzab gshar/ lan war/ sku gzugs/ dkyil 'khor sogs kyi thig rtsa'i lag len byang chub par sbyangs/ lhag par du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur khrod kyi dus 'khor dang sdom 'byung rtsa 'grel/ sha ris bu'i zhus pa/ kri ya sa mu ts+tsha/ko sa la'i rgyan sogs lha bzo rigs pa'i gzhung dang thig tshad kyi rnam bzhag gis gtsos srol rgyun rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi rgyud 'dzin byas te/ tshon sbyor dang ras 'dul/ skya thig tshos gdan/ tshon mdangs/ bcad kha sogs rim pa mang po zhig brgyud de rus tshugs dang lus tshugs/ rgyan tshugs sogs rim pa ltar bton pas khong gi thang ga sgyu rtsal la gzugs brnyan 'tsho nyams dod pa dang lus kyi stangs stabs bde zhing 'khyug pa/ brag ri dang chu rgyun rnams brjid chags shing mdzes cha ldan pa/ tshon mdangs 'jam sha dod la khams dwangs pa sogs rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig mngon par thon/gzhan yang gter ston chos sgar du ming la pad bstan zer ba'i rdo rkos pa grags can zhig yod pa de'i drung nas rdo sku rko srol sbyangs nas rmang cung tsam tshugs pa'i thog slar yang mgo log nas phebs pa'i rdo rko mkhan zhig bsten nas leb brkos 'bur ma sbyangs/ leb rkos la cung zad byang ba'i steng a lags nyin lung tshang gis rdo la 'bur gshongs btod tshul gyi mdzub khrid rags tsam gnas ba bcas la brten/ gcig shes kun grol gyis rdo rkos sgyu rtsal la thun mong ma yin pa'i blo skyed thob/kha ba can gyi gshis bzang rgyud 'jam gyi bod mi phal cher dang 'dra bar — 256 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa rdo rkos sgyu rtsal pa mgon po tshe brtan khong yang ngang rgyud 'jam 'ing las ci sgrub tan tan tig tig byed pa dang / rang nyid kyi khe grags dang yong 'bab la gtan nas mi lta ba zhig yin/ lo ngo du ma'i ring la khong gis khrag dang rngul chus bzhengs pa'i brtsams chos de dag gis nam yang nga tshor 'dzang med kyi sgyu rtsal bro ba zab mo zhig ster la/ de las khong gi mi tshe'i rin thang dang mdzes rig gi lta ba'ang mngon par mtshon yod/ yin na'ang / mi tshe zlos gar zhig dang 'dra bar las skul kyi lha mos khong la ku re mi byed ga la srid/ ltogs skom gyis mnar ba'i nga brgyad lo dang / mtshon cha rtsub mo 'bab pa'i‘‘gcig rdung gsum rgol’’gyi lo/ bcom brlag gi‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po’’sogs kyis khong gi rin thang bral ba'i brtsams chos de dag la lha 'dre gdon babegs kyi zhwa mo bskon te khong yang rgyang phud btang ba ma zad/ khong gi lus su'ang ldebs ris dang gtsags drub kyi ri mo lta bu'i rma shul mang po bzos/ de las yid skyo ba zhig la khong lo na gzhon pa'i dus su bzhengs pa'i ldebs ris dang gtsang drub/ dkyil 'khor/ tsa ka sogs brtsams chos mi nyung ba zhig kyang bdag dam ma thub par gtan yal du gyur mod/ skabs der brtsams chos de dag mthong myong mkhan rnams kyis lha ris par khas 'ches pa la sgrun du med par bshad pa yang nga tshos rlom chog pa zhig yin/skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshun/ tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus lag len du bstar bas mi rigs kyi rig gnas la'ang nyams gso byung zhing / khong la slar yang skal bzang mngon du shar/ khong gis skom pa'i chu 'dod ltar mdzes ris sgyu rtsal la nyams dpyad gnad du things pa byas te/ sa gnas kyi khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos mang po gsar rtsom byed pa'i zhor du kho bhe 257 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/tsho'i sde ba'i bod kyi zlos gar〈srong btsan sgam po'i rnam thar〉'khrab srol slar gso byas par 'khrab lwa dang ras gzhi/ 'khrab chas sogs mang po bzos te snga gzhug tu sgor khri lnga lhag gi 'gro gron btang /gzhan yang khong gis gter ston rin po che'i bka'i cod pan spyi bor blangs nas zhig ral du gyur pa'i lha khang rnying ba slar gso dang mchod rten gsar bzhengs/ grwa shag gi be rim gtan khel sogs dang / dkyil 'khor la thig rtsa 'debs pa/ lañja'i ma phyi 'bri ba sogs la zhabs 'degs ci nus byas pa ma zad/ rang dgon du lha bzo rnams kyis ldebs ris bzhengs skabs khong gis lag bstar gyis tsa ka sum brgya lhag bzhengs/ lhag par zhing chen rim pa'i rig dngos srung skyong sde khag gi chog mchan thob pa'i‘‘bka' bstan rdo brtsigs’’nyams gso bya bar lhag bsam rnam dag gis nus shugs bton/1995lor rgyal khab kyis‘‘bka' bstan rdo brtsigs’’bskyar gso byed par ma dngul cung tsam gnang zhing bskyar gso'i bkod 'doms kyi 'gan de khong gis gnang zhing / gal te phyi nas las ka pa glas na rdo khri la ar las byed dgos pas/ de ltar byas na yun brtan zhig yong dka' bar brten/ khong gis mno bsam yang yang btang mthar rdo brtsigs kyi gseb tu sa dmar gyis 'dag 'byar byas na sra zhing brtan la yun brtan yong nges zhing / phyis su brtsigs bzo'i dpe ston thub pa zhig 'ong ba bsam nas rang gi lo na mtho ba dang lus zungs zhan par ma bsams par las yul dngos su bkod 'doms dang las kar zhugs mod/ 'on kyang gla cha skar gang yang ma blangs par bod kyisrol rgyun rig gnas dang pha mes kyi shul bzhag rig gnas srung skyong byed par sha tsha tsha dang snying nye nye byas pa rgya che'i mang tshogs la sems 'gul thebs te rang 'gul gyis bskyar gso'i las kar zhugs pa ma zad/ 'brel yod sde — 258 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da khag gis las yul dngos su lta zhib byas nas khong gi bla med grub 'bras la gdengs 'jog tshad mthon po byas/'dzam gling na skad grags che ba'i rang rgyal gyi mdzes ris pa kra'u rne krin(lkoshwe1)gyis thengs shig mgon po tshe brtan gyi brtsams chos kha shas la zhib tu gzigs rjes‘khong gi brtsams chos 'di dag bod rgya zung gi sgyu rtsal gyi nying bcud kyis bzhengs snyam 'char’zhes bsngags brjod byas/ sku zhabs kra'u ne+e krin dang 'dra bar khyod kyis kyang mgon po tshe brtan gyi brtsams chos la blta skabs/ khyod rang yang 'dzad mtha' med pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams zhig tu 'khrid nges/ da lta dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa'i khong gi rdo rkos 'bur ma'i brtsams chos khrod kyi〈thang stong rgyal bo〉dang〈mthun pa spun bzhi〉〈mi la ras pa〉〈gsang bdag〉〈sgrol ljang〉〈'phags pa spyan ras gzigs〉〈rje tsong kha ba〉〈tshe dpag med〉〈rta mgrin〉〈phur ba bdud dpung zil gnon〉〈kun rig〉〈gsang 'dus〉〈'jigs med〉〈bde mchog〉〈zhi khro〉〈gu nu drag po〉〈rdor sems〉〈mkha' 'gro dpal chen〉〈gu ru drag po phur bu〉〈thugs brtson rgyal ba rgya mtsho〉sogs la gcig las gcig lhag gi nyams ldan zhing /bzhengs sku rnams kyi bzhugs stangs lhod cing byin chags pa dang / srol rgyun sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ma nyams pa'i khar rang gi blo gros kyis gsar rtsom byas pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snang brnyan zhig mngon par grub yod/ lhag par du brtsams chos de dag las rang gi bsam pa'i brtse dung de phun sum tshogs par mtshon yod pas srol rgyun sgyu rtsal gyi tshad bkag las ches cher brgal yod pa'ang shes thub/khong gi brtsams chos ci tsam yod pa dpog dka' yang / rags rtsis byas na thang ga 'bring gnyis/ tsa ka sum brgya lhag dkyil 'khog nyi shu/— 259 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/phur ba'i lder sku mi tshad tsam/ pad ma mthong grol gnyis/ snag sgrom sogs brtsams chos lnga brgya la nye ba tsam gyis bod kyi rigs gnas bang mdzod nang du 'od stong rab tu 'bar ba'i le tshan gsar ba zhig kha snon byas yod/ khong gi brtsams chos de dag mtsho sngon brnyan 'phrin khang dang krung dbyang brnyan 'phrin khang gi brgyud gtong byas pa ma zad/ krung go bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyis skrun pa'i〈krung go bod kyi rdo rkos sgyu rtsal〉zhes pa'i dpe deb du khong gi rdo rkos sgyu rtsal skor zhig bod rgya dbyin gyi yi ge las mtshams sbyor byas yod/ snga rjes su krung dbyang mdzes rtsal las rigs dang kan lho rig rtsal mthun tshogs sogs kyi ched mkhas pa dang ri mo ba/ dus deb rtsom sgrig pa/ phyi gling ba sogs thengs mang por dngos phebs bcar 'dri byas/ nye lam khong gi bsdus rnam〈krung go'i sgyu rtsal pa grags can gyi tshig mdzod chen mo〉zhes pa'i nang du bkod/khong gi bod kyi sgyu rtsal las don la phul ba'i mdzad rjes 'di rdo rkos kyi ri mo ji bzhin nam yang nyams pa med la/ khong gi brtsams chos 'di dag gis mi'i rigs kyi 'jig rten la nam yang nyams pa med pa'i lang tsho'i gzi byin ngom gyin 'dug(2000lo'i zla6pa'i tshes20nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal) — 260 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa rang lus legs par bskyangs pas mi gshis bzang bo grub pa/da wagacan tsha rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring gi slob gtso blo mthun blo bhe'i gnas tshul bkod pa/sangs rgyas/slob gtso ni slob grwa'i gnad du gyur ba'i mi yin la/ de'i spus tshad mtho dman gyis slob grwa de'i dar rgud dang rgyal pham la thag gcod pa'i nus pa thon bzhin yod/ gcan tsha rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring gi slob gtso blo mthun blo bhes rang nyid kyis slob gtso gi 'gan khur pa'i ring gi bya spyod la phyir 'dang rgyag skabs/ slob gtso bzang bo zhig byed dgos na shes yon dang nus pa sogs kyi sna 'dzoms spus tshad dang slob grwa'i rim pa kun tu sbyong brdar byas pa'i nyams myong dang gzhi rtsa'i las gzhan/ mi rnams la ches sems 'gul thebs pa'i mgo khrid pa'i kun spyod sogs yod dgos pa'i tshor ba zab mo skyes/ rang nyid kyi kun spyod blo sbyong rgyun chad med par je mthor btang na da gzod mi rnams la sems 'gul thebs srid cing slob grwa'i dge slob rnams rang gi zur du 'gug thub/ kho ni khog rgya che zhing kha khog med pa'i mi zhig yin pas kha bshad don la gnas thub/kho tshang la bza' mi5yod la khyim tshang gi 'gro song yongs rdzogs kho — 2( —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gcig pu'i zla phogs la brten yod pas 'tsho ba ha cang dka'/ kho la dka' khag che yang khos dbul phongs sa khul gyi mang tshogs dang dbul phongs slob ma rnams kyi dka' sdug mig gis mthong dus/ the tshom med par rogs ram gyi lag pa bsrings/ bsdoms rtsis byas pa ltar na1998lo nas1999lo'i bar tsam la khos gnod 'tshe phog pa'i sa khul dang dbul phongs sa khul/ slob ma dka' ngal can bcas la sgor800yan zhal 'debs su phul/ khos sne khrid pa'i 'og slob grwa'i las bzo ba tshang mang ser sna spangs te gtong phod kyi las la zhugs pas/ zhal 'debs su phul ba'i sgor grangs13215la son/‘‘spyi don sgrub na mngon gsal dang spyod gtsang yin na snyan grags rgyas’’zer ba'i dpe ltar/ slob gtso blo bhe lags kyis slob gtso zhig gi snyan grags che chung ni dbang cha che chung gis thag bcad pa ma yin par/ dbang cha bkol ba'i khrod mngon pa'i mi gshis kyis thag bcad pa yin par 'dod/ slob gtso zhig yin pa'i cha nas kho'i kun spyod blo sbyong gi nang don gtso bo ni‘‘'dod chung chog shes’’dang‘‘sger sems med pa’’de red/ gal te sger sems che drags pas spyod gtsang la dri ma gos gyur na dge slob rnams kyis mthong chung byed srid cing rang nyid kyis kyang mgo bo yar la 'degs dka' ba dang mi gzhan la do dam byed pa lhag par du dka' bar 'gyur/ ‘‘rang gi spyod pa drang na gzhan la bka' phab mi dgos’’zer ba ltar/ slob gtso byas na nges par du spyod gtsang dang rang tshod 'dzin pa de kun spyod blo sbyong dang tang gshis spyong brdar gyi nang don gtso bor gzung dgos pa dang / ral lus la dri ma mi 'gos pa'i steng nas gzhan la mig dpe ston dgos/ rang nyid kyi spyod pa gtsang na da gzod bkas mnan mi dgos par gzhan gyis gong du bkur ba'i mi gshis kyi mjug 'bras thob srid/— 262 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa da wa1997lor rdzong srid gzhung gis mi rigs slob 'bring la zla phogs spar ba'i skal gcig byin/ slob grwa'i las bzo ba kun gyi sems su slob gtso blo bhe lags ni bstud mar lan gnyis la phul byung can du bdams pa ma zad/‘‘khul yongs kyi slob gso las don gyi sngon thon mi sna'i mtshan snyan’’thob pa dang / khos mgo khrid 'og slob grwa de zhing chen dang khul gyi gco gnad mi rigs slob 'bring dang zhing chen dang khul gyi tshad ldan can gyi slob 'bring gi gral du tshud cing / 1996lor zhing chen tang u'i dril bsgrags pu'u dang zhing chen slob gso thin gyis‘‘gso skyong gsum’’gyi sngon thon thun mong gi mtshan snyan gnang bas/ cha rkyen ltar na zla phogs kyi rim pa 'di kho las ga'an la thob srid pa zhig gtan nas ma yin snyam/ khe phan spang blang byed pa'i gnad 'gag gi skabs 'dir slob gtso blo bhe lags kyis thog mar sems su 'char ba ni dka' ngal che ba'i las bzo ba red/ der brten khos tshang ma'i yar zhu bkag ste zla phogs kyi rim pa ni blo mthun gzhan zhig la thob par byas/ lo mang po'i ring kho slob grwa'i nor srid lam lugs dang gtan nas 'gal ma myong la/gzhung dngul gyis bza' btung mi byed pa dang / nor srid dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs dang mi mthun pa'i 'dzin thor khos gtan nas ming 'god mi srid/kho lo sum cu ring dge rgan byas la lo na lnga bcur son par nye/ gcan tsha rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring nang kho ni rgan rabs shig tu gyur ba'i tshul ltar na kho'i las ka cung zad yang na 'grig mod/ 'on kyang kho slob gtso bzang po zhig byed dgos na nges par du 'bad 'bungs kyis las gnas srung dgos pa shes/ nyin re re'i snga mo'i chu tshod drug nas dgong mo'i chu tshod bcu'i bar/khos dge slob rnams khrid de sbyong brdar la zhugs pa dang / slob khrid la nyan pa/ tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa/ slob grwa'i phyi nang gi bya 'gul dag la zhugs — 263 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/par ma zad/ slob ma tsho'i bza' btung la'ang rgyun du rgyus len pa dang brtag pas/ nyin rer nyung mthar yang chu tshod bcu gnyis la las ka byed pa red/1998lo'i zla9bar/ slob grwa'i slob don khru'u yis gsar du bsnan pa'i lo rim dang po'i 'dzin grwa lnga ba'i 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin med par sems khral byed bzhin pa shes rjes/ kho rang gis 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin byed pa'i re 'dod zhus/dpe 'di lta bu khul dang zhing chen yongs kyi slob 'bring khrod du'ang shin tu dkon//(2000lo'i zla7tshes28nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)thang rgod mu'u1000la gos ljang bskon mkhan/da wa zhun hwa rdzong chin hros shang zha than sde ba'i sde dmangs han bes nags bskrun pa'i gnas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ sa'o lan h+phin/ da lor lo38yin pa'i han be ni zhun hwa za lar rigs rang skyong rdzong chin hros shang zha than sde ba'i sde dmangs red/ khos nye ba'i lo 'di 'ga'i nang thang rgod mu'u1000la ljang gos gyon du bcug rang gshis 'jam la gzhung drang pa'i pho gsar der gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i mi tshe'i brgyud rim zhig yod/— 264 —

sbyo/sa'adiXgen/ da wa da wa 1997lor zhun hwa rdzong gis mi sger la‘‘thang rgod bzhi’rigasar gtod bcos skyong byed pa'i skul ma btang / han bes rang gi blo rig la brten nas sde ba'i nye 'dabs kyi thang rgod mu'u1000lhag de sde ba dang lo30ring gi 'gan len gan rgya bkod/ khos lo mang por rngul khrag bzhur ba las bsags pa'i sgor mo blangs nas thang rgod mu'u1000lhag gi steng du‘‘ljang mdog dngul khang’’bsgrubs/'gan gtsang len byas pa'i lo der rdzong nags las sde khag bi cig gyur 'char 'god dang lag rtsal slob ston 'og han bes ma dngul mang bo btang ste/sa 'ded 'phrul 'khor dang ngal rtsol pa mang po glas nas lung grog mang ba'i la rgod steng du sa zhing mu'u100lhag bde snyoms byas/ glog shugs chu 'dren sa tshigs rnying ba zhig gso byas pa dang chu rka mus350las/ 1998lor myur skye sbyar sdong nags tshal mu'u80btsugs pa dang sbyar sdong sdong phran mu'u20btsugs/ de nas khos gsar gtod nags skrun byed zhor du rgyun chad med par nags las thad kyi 'phrin brda 'tshol sdud byas pa dang nags las thad kyi shes bya slob sbyong byas nas/ nags tshal gyi sgrig gzhi legs sdeb dang sdong bo'i sna kha phun sum je tshogs su btang bas dpal 'byor nags kyi 'debs 'dzugs sdur tshad mthor 'degs byas/ de dang mnyam du khos mig rgyang ring bo dang tshan rig gi bdag gnyer 'du shes la brten nas rigs mi 'dra ba'i sdong phran gsar ba nang 'dren byas pa ma zad/ lo phogs sgor khri ltar hran zhi nas lag rtsal pa zhig gdan 'dren byas pas/ sil sdong rigs mi 'dra ba 'dzugs pa'i lag rtsal thad dus bcad ltar lag rtsal slob ston byed du bcugakhos lugs mthun ngang bdag gnyer dang tshan rig ltar do dam byas pa'i dbang gis 'gan gtsang len byas pa'i thang rgod de lo 'ga'i dus yun thung — 265 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/thung nas rdzong yongs kyi nags las tshan rtsal dpe ston du gyur/ mig snga'i bar du nags mu'u500bskrun pa dang sbyar sdong khri3dang g.yer sdong khri1 2 dang cho sil sdong khri 1 8dang khen the kham ser1500 dang a me ri kha'i tsher nag1600dang star ka200sogs btsugs/ de ma gtogs khos da dung sa bab dang rdzong mkhar la nye ba'i stabs bde cha rkyen la brten nas/ so phag sreg khung chung ba zhig las nas thon skyed byed 'go brtsams pas/ lo re'i yong sgo rkyang rkyang sgor khri1las yol/ nye 'gram du phag gso ra ba chung chung zhig las nas zhor las la brten nas nags skyong ba dang bzo las la brten nas nags las skul 'ded byas/han bes ri rgod 'gan len byas rjes rang nyid la‘‘ljang mdog dngul khang’’btsugs par ma zad/ zha than sde ba'i dbul phongs ngal rtsol pa dang ngal rtsol pa lhag ma bkod sgrig byas nas/ lo rer ngal rtsol pa de dag la sgor khri30yi zla phogs byin/ yul mi spun zla rnams la las zhugs go skabs 'don sprod byas pa dang kho tsho'i yong sgo 'phar snon byas/ de las gzhan khos da dung sde ba'i lnga skyong khyim tshang dang dbul phongs khyim tshang la dngos po dang sgor mo zhal 'debs su phul ba dang / rang gi ma dngul bkod nas mi kha shas phyir song nas tshong gnyer ba dang sger gnyer skyel 'dren las rigs sogs gnyer bar rgyab skyor byas/ slob gso sogs spyi tshogs spyi phan las don la yang sgor mo zhal 'debs phul nas yang rgyab skyor byas/(2001lo'i zla5ba'i tshes2nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal)— 266 —

rgyas 'phrin/phyug 'gyun mtsho mor skyod pa'i ded dpon/ len rdzong rdo lung shang bra sa sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yi gnas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ bla ma lha/zhing chen yongs kyi 'brog khul du sngon thon gyi ba dan g.yo myong ba'i bra sa sde ba'i tang kri pu'u la mtshon na ji ltar phyug 'gyur byed thub pa dang / thabs lam bzang bo zhig gang na yod pa bcas ni dus nam yang bsam gzhigs gtong sa zhig tu gyur/bra sa sde ba ni sog po dang bod/ rgya/ hos/ hor/ pa'o an bcas mi rigs6las grub pa'i phyugs las rkyang gnyer sde ba zhig yin zhing / mi grangs780yod/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis bsam gzhigs dang yang yang gros bsdur byas mthar/ sde ba'i phyugs las gong du 'phel bar tshod 'dzin byed pa'i 'gal rkyen gtso bo ni srol rgyun gyi thon skyed bdag gnyer byed stangs dang bsam blo rnying bar rag las pa'i shes rtogs thob/ gnad don der dmigs te sde ba'i tang kri pu'u dang 'brog dmangs u yon lhan khang gis sde ba'i las byed pa dang mang tshogs skor zhig rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ phyugs las 'phel rgyas che ba'i zhin cing dang nang sog sogs su mngags nas lta skor slob sbyong byas/gzhan gyi 'phel rgyas las kho tshos rang nyid kyi zhan sa mthong ba dang / phyugs — 267 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/las spel ba'i 'du shes je drag tu gyur/‘‘rtswa gnyer gtso ba dang rtswa chu mnyam 'dzin byed pa'i’’byed phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ kho tshos1997lo nas bzung zhing chen gyis zhing las thad phyogs bsdus gsar spel byed par ma dngul gtong shugs rim bzhin je cher btang bar bstun/ kho tshos spyi'i ma dngul gtong tshad sgor khri348yin pa'i‘‘deng rabs phyugs las kyi mtho gsar lag rtsal dpe ston rnam grangs’’brtson len byas shing / bsdoms pas sde ba rim pa'i gzhung lam spyi le150dang rlangs 'khor 'gro bde ba'i bgrod lam spyi le26las pas/ hre re rer gzhung lam dang khyim re rer rlangs 'khor 'gro thub pa'i dmigs tshad mngon du gyur/735gyi 'brog pa khyim tshang la glog 'then te khyim tshang gis glog bkol ba'i gnad don thag bcad/ gzan rtswa mu'u2118'debs pa'i las 'gan grub pa dang / lcags dra mus411788'then nas phyugs spyil mus gru bzhi ma khri2lhag bskrun/ rtswa mu'u200lhag la chu btang zhing mu'u4668la lud stor/ chu med sa'i 'brog pa la khron pa77brkos thog rtswa sa mu'u khri50lhag steng gi a bra gsod pa'i las 'gan yongs 'grub byas te/ skye khams do mnyam rgyun srung byas/ 1999lo'i bar du sde ba yongs kyis rmang gzhi'i sgrig chas thad rim bsags kyis brtsis na ma dngul sgor khri787 8btang zhing khyim tshang res cha snyoms sgos sgor khri 5 47btang / rmang gzhi'i sgrig chas 'dzugs skrun la shugs bsnan pas/ phyugs las thad kyi rang byung gnod 'gog nus pa je cher song / na ning gi lo mjug bar du sde ba yongs kyi phyugs las kyi yong sgo sgor khri199 39ru bslebs pa dang / 'brog pa mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor2284ru bslebs pas/ sde ba yongs su phal cher‘‘gtan sdod dang lcags dra/drod khang /rtswa 'debs pa/ rang 'bab chu/ glog lam’’bcas 'dus pa'i cha — 268 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa sdeb mdun mngon 'gyur byung /bra sa sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis tshan rtsal spyad de phyugs gso bar shin tu mthong chen byed bzhin yod/ kho tshos phyugs khyu'i sgrig gzhi legs sgrig byed pa gtsigs chen byas nas/ hur thag gis mo phyugs kyi bsdur tshad dang spyi'i 'phar tshad mthor 'degs byas shing / tshong zog phyugs las 'phel rgyas su btang nas mang tshogs kyi yong sgo je mang du btang / na ning mo phyugs kyi bsdur tshad68 02lkodang tshong zog btsongs tshad34lkodang gso kha nas bud tshad35 45glidang phyugs zog gi spyi'i 'phar tshad32 45lko bcas su bslebs/ nor rgyud legs sgyur byed ched/ da lo sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis rdzong gis 'brel gtug byas par brten nas zhin cang gi dbyi lis sa khul nas rin thang sgor khri18kyis ba glang ser nag60nyos shing / 'brog khyim6la bgos te nor rgyud legs sgyur gyi tshod lta byas/ mig sngar tang kri pu'u yis sne khrid de bra sa sde ba ru tshan rtsal la brten pa dang thabs lam mang po brgyud de phyug sgyur gyi lam du bgrod pa'i snang tshul mngon par 'dugasde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis slob gso spel bar gtsigs chen byed pa'i srol rgyun rgyun 'khyongs byas shing / ma dngul sgor khri30lhag btang ste sde ba'i slob chung gi slob khang zhig gso byas/ 76lkogyi 'brog pa la slob chung yan gyi yon tshad ldan zhing / sde ba dang hre'i las byed pa'i nang du slob 'bring yan gyi yon tshad ldan pa'i bsdur tshad de rdzong yongs kyi 'brog khul gyi ang dang po red/mig snga'i bar du bra sa sde ba'i slob chung gi slob lo ran pa'i byis pa slob grwar zhugs tshad95lkodang gtan 'jags kyi tshad100lkoru bslebs shing / mang tshogs kyis byis pa slob grwar skyel ba de bra sa sde ba'i rigs so so'i 'brog pa'i rang rtogs kyi bya spyod cig tu gyur yod/ da lta sde ba yongs‘‘skar bcu rim pa'i da 269 ———

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dpal yon khyim tshang’’90dang‘‘lnga bzang khyim tshang’’40yod cing / 1998lor krung dbyang rtsa 'dzugs pu'u yis‘‘rgyal yongs kyi grong gseb gzhi rim rtsa 'dzugs 'dzugs skrun bya ba'i sngon thon tang kri pu'u’’ru bdams pa dang /1996lor mtsho sngon zhing chen tang us‘‘zhing chen yongs kyi sngon thon zhing sde tang kri pu'u’’ru bdams shing / 2000lor mtsho sngon zhing chen rig gnas thin dang zhing chen lus rtsal u yon lhan khang gis so sor‘‘'byor ba 'bring tsam gyi rigs gnas sde b.ri’dang‘‘rgyal yongs kyi lus rtsal bya 'gul spel ba'i sngon thon sde ba’’yi mtshan snyan gnang ba'i khar thengs4la rdzong tang u dang srid gzhung gi gzengs bstod thob/ (2001lo'i zla7pa'i tshes12nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)rtswa thang nas dpal 'byor 'phel gnas gsar ba 'tshar longs 'byung bzhin yod pa/da wa yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul gyis tshong khrom dpal 'byor spel ba'i rnam pa mtshar/gsar 'god pa/ rgya mtsho/bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi rgyal jus lag bstar byas tshun/ yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul gyis spyi la dbang ba'i lam lugs rmang gzhi yin la dpal 'byor grub cha sna mang lhan gnas kyi dpal 'byor srid jus rgyun — 270 —

rgyas 'phrin/'khyongs byas pa dang / rang sa'i don dngos ltar skye rgu grong rdal gtsos pa dang rdzong so so'i srid gzhung chags yul gnad sar bzhag ste/ shugs chen pos tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi sgrig gzhi 'dzugs pa dang gong du spel bar skul 'ded byas pas/ khul yongs kyi kher sger gnyer dpal 'byor thad do mnyam dang skyon bral dang mgyogs po bcas kyi 'phel ba'i rnam pa byung zhing / de sa mi rigs dpal 'byor dar rgyas dang mang tshogs kyi yong sgo 'phar ba mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba stabs bde yong ba bcas la nus pa gal chen bton/bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed gting zab tu spel ba dang spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi sgrig gzhi 'thus tshang du gtong bar bstun/ gtsang bo gsum gyi 'byung yul du chags pa'i yul shul rong 'brog pa grong rdal du yong nas tshong gnyer ba'i spyi tshogs rmang gzhi bzang / nye ba'i lo shas ring / yul shul khul gyis khral bsdu dang tshong ba'i bu rgyud slob grwar zhugs pa sogs su gzigs skyong byed thabs rab dang rim pa gtan phab byas nas rong 'brog khul gyi ngal rtsol pa lhag ma grong rdal du yong nas tshong las gnyer ba'i mthun rkyen du gyur/yul shul khul gyis kher sgyer gnyer dpal 'byor spel bar skul ched/snga gzhug tu〈shugs chen pos kher sger gnyer dpal 'byor gong du spel ba'i skor gyi gros chod〉dang〈yul shul khul kher sger gnyer dpal 'byor srol yig〉〈sger gnyer khe las kyi tho 'god byed thabs legs sgyur skor gyi bsam 'char〉sogs srid jus rab dang rim pa gtan la phab nas lag bstar byas pas/kher sger gnyer dpal 'byor gong du spel ba'i srid jus thad nas khor yug bzang bo zhig bskrun zhing / 'dus grub dang ched las tshong ra 50lhag las nas‘‘tshong zong yod la khrosda ra med pa'i’’rnam pa bsgyur ba dang / tshong ra — 271 ————

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'thus tshang du btang bas rong 'brog mang tshogs grong rdal du tshong gnyer ba'i brtson sems skul slong byas/ mig sngar khul yongs nas rong 'brog dud khyim790lhag grong rdal nas tshong gnyer bzhin yod pas/ de ga'i kher sger gnyer khyim tshang gi spyi grangs kyi43 9lkozin/ yul shul rdzong dpal thang shang gi rong 'brog dud khyim300lhag sbra nang nas phyir bud de tshong rar zhugs pas/ shang de'i khyim tshang yongs kyi80ཿzin/ shang de'i khra leb sde ba'i khyim tshang60yod pa tshang ma skye rgu grong rdal du yong nas las ka las pa dang tshong gnyer bas/khyim tshang mang che ba'i lto gos kyi gnad don thag tshod pa ma zad/ yong sgo'ang ldab 'gyur gyis 'phar te phyug po'i lam du phyin/ yul shul rdzong gi 'brog pa tshe dpa' rdo rje tshang la sngon chad lug 200lhag yod pa dang / khangs gnod thengs 'gar thebs rjes mang shos shi nas thon skyed slar gso byed pa'i stobs shugs med par gyur/ 'tsho thabs btsal ched khos dngul bun sgor3000blangs pa dang bza' mi5bo khrid nas skye rgu grong rdal nas tshong las gnyer/ tshong gnyer thabs bzang ba dang brtson 'grus che bas/ tshe dga' rdo rje'i tshong mgyogs myur sgos 'phel ba dang ma rtsa yang nges can zhig yod par gyur/ da lta kho tshang gi 'tsho ba je bzang du song ba dang bstun bu mo gsum po yang snga gzhug tu slob grwar zhugs nas rig gnas slob sbyong byed pa'i cha rkyen yag tsam ldan song / skye rgu khrom ra nas tshong khang gnyer ba'i khyi dga' ni sngon chad 'brog pa lug rdzi zhig yin pa dang / lo20yi sngon du khyi dga' yis bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed byed pa'i go skabs spyad nas skye rgu grong rdal nas tshong gnyer byas/ khos gsar 'god par bshad don/ de dus kho la ma rtsa sgor2000tsam ma gtogs med/ skabs de'i tshong khang la tshong rdzas ha cang nyung / si khron dang zi ling sogs nas mang tshogs la mkho che ba'i dngos rdzas nyos yong nas — 272 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad btsongs te/ tshong brin la yong sgo yang bzang bo thob pas/ da lta ma rtsa je mang du song la tshong yang je mang du gyur zer/ ngo sprod byas pa ltar na/ da skabs khyi dga' la sgor khri50lhag gi ma rtsa yod pa ma zad/ tshong khang yang gnyis gnyer bzhin yod pas tshong brin nyin sgor mo khri2kyi tshad la bslebs/mang tshogs kyi tshong gnyer khyab khongs je cher song ba na/ dmangs khrod lag rtsal pa rnams la rang gi lag rtsal spyad nas 'byor phyug snyeg pa'i mthun rkyen yang ldan song ba red/ yul shul rdzong a 'khro shang ni mdo dbus khams gsum du ming grags che ba'i lag shes bzo rtsal pa 'dus pa'i yul sde zhirga yin/de ga'i dmangs khrod bzo rtsal ngo sprod bya ched/ yul shul rdzong gis lo rabs80ba'i dkyil char pe cin nas a 'khro bzo rtsal 'grem tshong tshogs 'du bsdus pa de nas bzung / a 'khro'i dmangs khrod lag rtsal pas dga' ba'i dpyid dpal bsus te/ lag rtsal gsar gtod dang mi rabs rjes ma bslab pa ma zad/ da dung skye rgu grong rdal sogs khrom rar bzo khang btsugs nas rgyan cha dang dmangs spyod lag cha bzos nas 'grem tshong byas shing mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu chen po byas/ rgad po a 'khro karma dang a 'jam gnyi gas chung dus nas mes po rnams la 'grogs nas gser dngul zangs sogs kyi rgyan cha rdung rtsal yag po 'byor yod/ bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed tshun du kho gnyis kas rang gi lag rtsal la brten nas rgyan cha mgar bzo byas shing / kho tsho'i lag rtsal bzang ba dang rin gong bde bas nyo mi mang la yong sgo yang bzang bas/da lta kho tshos so sor bza' tshang yongs su khrid nas skye rgu khrom ra nas rgyan cha bzos te tshong gnyer bzhin yod pa dang / cha snyoms sgos nyin re'i tshong 'bor sgor6000lhag la bslebs pa'i khar/ a 'khro karmas da dung bod ljongs nag chu sa khul du'ang tshong khang zhig phyes yod/ yul shul khul gyis kher sger gnyer — 273 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/dpal 'byor gso skyong dang rgyab skyor chen po byas pas/ khrom ra je mang du 'phar ba dang sna kha yang phun sum tshogs por gyur cing / tshong gnyer sna kha sngon chad kyi tshong zog rtsag rtsig btsongs pa nas da lta'i 'bru snum dang zhig gso/phyugs las thon rdzas nyo tshong / skyel 'dren/ 'dzugs skrun rgyan spros/ khang gzhis gsar spel/ 'debs gso las rigs sogs su 'phar/ khri 'du rdzong gi blo mthun dga' yag gis2000lor ma dngul sgor khri25btang nas gtsang bo gsum 'byung yul gyi rang byung srung skyong khul gyi nag ri thang gi sa rgod mu'u340bslogs te/ sil sdong sna kha50lhag btsugs/ dga' yag gis gsar 'god par bshad don/ ‘‘da lta sil sdong tshang ma'i skye tshul bzang zhing / lo gsum 'gor rjes sil tog thogs thub nges yin pa dang / rgun 'brum da lor 'bras bu thogs zin’’zhes ngo sprod byas/ khul bzo tshong cus kyi cus krang gser dga' yis‘‘dga' yag ni yul shul yul gyi thang rgod bcos skyong byed pa'i sne khrid pa zhig yin’’zhes gdeng 'jog byas/tshong khrom dpal 'byor dar rgyas gong 'phel du song ba las mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar stabs bde bzos shing / da skabs yul shul khul gyi rong 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis rang la mkho ba'i dngos bo dus thog tu nyo thub la/ btsong dgos pa'i zhing phyugs thon rdzas kyang dus thog tu btsong thub pas/ nyo tshong byed dka' ba dang zhig gso byed dka' ba/ 'gro 'ong dka' ba dang bcas kyi gnad don rtsa ba nas bsgyur ba'i mu la grong rdal chung ba'i 'dzugs skrun yang mgyogs myur sgos gong du 'phel bzhin yod pa dang /gtsang bo gsum 'byung yul gyi rtswa thang de gar 'gyur ldog chen po byung zhing 'byung bzhin yod/(2001lo'i zla7pa'i tshes14nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)— 274 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da na chod phra yang 'gan khur ljid/da wasrid gros u yon thu'u kwan 'jam dbyangs blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma la ched du bcar 'dri byas pa/gsar 'god pa/ tshe dpal rgyal/zhing chen srid gros skabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs lnga bar zhugs pa'i u yon gyi khrod du lo na phra ba'i u yon zhig yod pa de mi rnams kyi yid 'jog byed yul du gyur/ khong ni thu'u kwan 'jam dbyangs blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma red/ khong gis da lta hu'u kru'u hor rigs rang skyong rdzong srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang dgon lung dgon pa do dam u yon lhan khang gi bdag 'dzin gyi 'gan khur yod pa dang / zhing chen srid gros skabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba'i steng zhing chen srid gros u yon la gsab snon byung ba byas pa red/mi dkyus ma zhig la mtshon na/ lo21steng srid gros la zhugs pa ni cung snga drags mod/ 'on kyang 'di ni nga tsho tang gis tang mang mnyam 'brel gyi srid jus dang mi rigs chos lugs srid jus lag tu bstar te thun mong sgos srid zhugs srid mol dang jus gzhi gtan 'bebs byas nas dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i mtshon rtags shig red/ tshogs 'du'i gros bsdur brel ba che yang gsar 'god pas yang yang zhus par bstun khong gis bcar — 275 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'dri dang len byas te gtam gyi sgo mo phye/khong gis‘‘'di ni nga thengs gnyis par zhing chen srid gros kyi gros tshogs la zhugs pa yin/ 〈srid gzhung las don skor gyi snyan zhu〉ni mi la yid 'gul dang skul lcag thebs pa'i snyan zhu zhig yin pas snying thag pa nas rjes su yi rang bya nges yin/ chos lugs mi sna zhig yin phyir nga tshos srid gzhung la rogs rams byas te khrims ltar chos lugs las don la do dam byed rgyu ni shin tu gal che/ da lta chos lugs pa'i byang tshad yongs khyab tu zhan pas sa cha la lar sdom khrims dang 'gal ba'i gnas tshul tshabs che zhing mang tshogs kyi khrod du shugs rkyen ngan pa bzos yod/ grwa btsun khrod rgyal gces chos gces dang bca' khrims srung brtsi/ bdag las gzhan gces bcas kyi slob gso mu mthud nas spel te rang zhing gi dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang mi rigs mthun sgril dang spyi tshogs bde 'jags bcas kyi thad khor yug bzang bo zhig bskrun dgos’’zhes zer/ dbul skyor skor gleng skabs khong gis kyis bstan don/ dbul phongs bya ba de dbul skyor pa'i blo dang bstun nas spel dgos/ da lta dbul phongs khyim tshang kha shas shig la ji ltar rgyab skyor byas na de bzhin gyis dbul phongs yin pa'i gnas tshul der mthong chen byed dgos shing / srid gzhung gis yang dag pa'i sgo nas kho tshor sne khrid bzang bo byas te kho tshor 'byor phyug rgyu ni brtson pa yin pa'i 'du shes ngos zin 'jug rgyu de ni gnad dam pa red/thengs 'di'i gros tshogs la zhugs ched khong gis gra sgrig gang mang mdzad/ bod kyi skad yig la mthong chen dgos pa dang / 'brog khul nas nor lug rku ba'i gnas tshul tshabs chen yin pa/ dgon pa'i gna' rdzas srung skyong byed pa'i las 'gan lci ba/ rong 'brog pa'i yong sgo je mang du gtong — 276 —

rgyas 'phrin/dgos tshul sogs bsam 'char dang gros gzhi mang po zhig dran 'dug gsungs/ 'di dag tshang ma srid gros u yon gyi 'gan 'khri lag bstar dang mi dmangs kyi re ba stong zad du mi gtong ched du ma yin nam/(2002lo'i zla1pa'i tshes26nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/ )mang tshogs sems kyi re stos/da wakos nan rdzong sum mdo shang kha rgya sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yi gnas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ bla ma lha/ji ltar mgyogs myur ngang zhing phyugs las kyi thon tshad gong du spel ba dang 'brog pa'i yang sgo je mang du gtong ba ni lo mang po'i ring kha rgya sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis brtson skyed dmigs 'ben red/ kha rgya sde ba ni kos nan rdzong sum mdo shang gi phyugs las gtso yin pa dang / 'brog pa khyim tshang91dang mi673yod pa gnyer sde ba zhig red/ lo mang po ring la kha rgya sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis rang nyid kyi 'dzugs skrun dam 'dzin byed mur/ 'brog pa mang tshogs sgrig 'dzugs byas te ma dngul rang 'tshag dang ma dngul brtson len zung 'brel sgos phyogs yongs nas rtswa thang gi rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod kyi 'dzugs skrun byed 'go brtsams/ chu yi thigs pa nyam chung yang / mtsho dang — 277 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'dres na skam mi nus/ lo du mar 'bad brtson byas 'og kha rgya sde bar lcags dra med pa nas yod par gyur cing / rgya chung ba nas rgya che bar gyur te rtswa sar lcags dra bskor tshad100lku ru bslebs pa dang / phyugs spyil45las/'brog pa gtan sdod byung tshad85spo ru bslebs/ phyugs las kyi thon tshad gong du 'phar dgos na phyugs rgyud dang 'brel ba chen po yod pas sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis lo re'i phyugs rgyud legs bcos la shin tu mthong chen byas/ khyim tshang gang zhig gi phyugs rgyud mi bzang na kri pu'u hru'u ci tshe mgon skyabs dngos su khyim tshang der song nas gnas tshul rgyus lon dang / phyugs rgyud legs bcos kyi phan yon dang shes bya sun snang med par brjod cing bsam blo'i skul ma byas pa/ na ning kha rgya sde ba ru rdzong gis bdams pa'i lug rgyud legs bcos kyi phyogs bsdus dpe ston khyim tshang10byung / kha rgya sde ba ru zhing sa mu'u3000yod la zhing phyugs gnyis kyi bzang cha yis phan tshun kha gsab byed pa'i lam du zhugs ched/ tang kri pu'u yis sde ba nang gi 'brog pa khyim tshang phyug shos 'ga' skul slong byas te zhing las 'phrul chas che gras cha tshang zhig nyo ru bcug cing gzhi khyon ldan pa'i zhing las gnyer 'go brtsams/ 30lkoyi khyim tshang gi log dkar btab pas lo rer mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgor2000lhag tu bslebs/lo brgya'i jus chen slob gso ra brten/ tang kri pu'u tshan khag gis thog mtha' bar gsum du slob gso'i las don la mthong chen byed bzhin yod/ lo 'ga'i sngon la 'brog pa kha shas kyi sems su byis pa slob grwar bskyal na mdun lam med pa dang khyim tshang gi khur po yang je ljid du 'gro nges snyam nas byis pa slob grwar bskyal mi 'dod par gyur/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis gnas tshul de shes ma thag khyim tshang re rer song nas bsam blo'i skul ma byas mthar kho tsho'i — 278 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad wago rtogs sad pas rang 'gul gyis byis pa slob grwar bskyal/ sde ba yongs kyi slob lo ran pa'i byis pa slob grwar zhugs tshad thog mtha' bar gsum du95lkoyan rgyun 'khyongs byas/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis da dung mang tshogs skul slong byas te snga gzhug tu ma dngul sgor khri20gsog nas slob khang bskrun cing / na ning yang ma dngul sgor khri10brtson len byas nas slob grwa'i khang ba rgyas bskrun byas/skyid na mnyam rol dang sdug na mnyam khur ni sde ba 'di'i goms srol bzang bo zhig red/ sde bar don bya che ma chung gsum ci yod rung tang kri pu'u yis rtsa ba nas byol thabs mi byed/ 1999lo'i zla12par bza' mi10yod pa'i bsod mo tshang gi khang mig4dang ca lag tshang ma thol byung gi me skyon chen po zhig las tshig pas/ dang thog nas dka' khag yod pa las med po rkyang rkyang du gyur/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis phyogs gcig nas gong rim nas rgud skyob sgor2000lhag brtson len byas pa dang / phyogs gcig nas tang yon dang mang tshogs skul slong byas te 'bru rigs rgya ma1000lhag zhal 'debs su phul ba'i dus mnyam du/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u tshan khag gis sne khrid de khyod tshang gis ka ba gcig dang kho tshang gis gdung ma gnyis byas nas cang ma 'gor bar khyim gzhis bskyar gso byas/ de min sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yis mang tshogs kyi zhing phyugs las thon rdzas btsong bar tshong lam 'tshol ched yar rgyug mar steg dang / mang tshogs kyi khyim tshang nang du bza' 'khon langs na bar 'dum/mang tshogs kyi rgyu nor srung skyong byed ched rku ma bda' tshul sogs kyi byas rjes gang mang mang yod/ de'i phyir kha rgya sde ba'i 'brog pa rnams kyis‘‘tang kri pu'u ni ngo ma nga tsho'i blo gtod sa red’’ces gzengs bstod byed ba'in yod/ sde ba'i tang kri pu'u yang rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gis thengs mang por dpal — 279 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/yon sde ba dang sngon thon tang kri pu'u ru bdams/(2002lo'i zla5ba'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/ )gnya' nag sde ba na klu dbang rgyal zer ba zhig yod/gsar 'god pa/ mkha' 'tsho/lo na36la son pa'i klu dbang rgyal ni rkang tsha rdzong mtsho 'khyil shang gnya' nag so ma sde ba'i 'brog pa zhig yin/ kho rang la ma mo200lhag dang rtswa sa mu'u200lhag tsam las phyugs las kyi cha rkyen bzang rgyu med/ 1997lor khos rang gi lug dang rtswa sa mi gzhan la bdag gnyer byed du bcug ste/ rang gis‘‘zha lis’’rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor chung ba zhig nyos nas gla gtong ba'i tshul du gnyer zhing yong sgo je mang du song ba dang / bza' mi4yi 'tsho ba'ang nyin re bzhin je bzang du gyur/ 1999lor khos ma dngul sgor khri8btang ste mtsho 'khyil shang thog nas so phag khog stong bzo grwa zhig btsugs pa dang / yun spyod bzo ba4dang skabs 'phral bzo ba3yod/klu dbang rgyal so phag khog stong bzo grwa ma btsugs pa'i sngon du/ shang dang sa de ga'i nye 'dabs kyi 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis gtan 'dug khang ba las dus zi ling dang mtsho lho sogs sa cha nas so phag khog stong nyo dgos/1999lor klu dbang rgyal mtsho lho dang mtsho nub sogs sa khul du song nas rtog — 280 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da zhib dang slob sbyong byas pa dang / phyir log rjes dus thog tu grong gseb yid rton mnyam las khang nas dngul bun sgor khri5blangs pa dang rang gis ma dngul sgor khri3bsags nas so phag khog stong bzo grwa btsugs te/ lo der so phag khog stong khri5tsam thon skyed byas/ sa mtho sa'i gnam gshis kyi rkyen du lo re'i thon skyed dus yun ni zla ba4tsam ma gtogs med/ da lo'i zla dang por klu dbang rgyal gyis yang grong gseb yid rton mnyam las khang nas dngul bun sgor khri4blangs nas so phag bzo pa'i rgya khyon je cher btang / sngon rtsis byas na lo rer so phag khog stong khri12yan thon skyed byed thub/klu dbang rgyal la lo re'i yong sgo ci tsam yod ces dris dus/ kho dgod bzhin‘‘yong sgo bzang gi zer/ da lor khos mtsho 'khyil shang gi nye 'angabs nas mus gru bzhi ma300la nye ba'i so phag drod srung dang shel gyis bcad pa'i khang ba gsar ba zhig las tshar/ khang nang du tshon ldan brnyan 'phrin chen po dngamyopya('phrul chas/ 'khyags sgam sogs ca lag rtsa chen phal cher tshang ba dang‘tung h+phinari’rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor che ba zhig kyang nyos yod/ klu dbang rgyal rang nyid phyug por gyur rung dbul phongs khyim tshang la rogs ram byed pa de brjed med/ lo 'ga'i nang khos snga rjes su dbul phongs khyim tshang dang phyugs med phyugs nyung khyim tshang la gtan 'dug khang ba las rogs byas/da lo'i zla4ba'i nang lo na70la bslebs yod pa'i rgan po bsod bha bza' zla gnyis kyis khang ba las nas dka' sar thug yod pa shes phyir so phag khog stong400rin ma blangs par byin/ na ning gi zla5bar phyugs nyung khyim tshang chos grags tshang gis khang ba las dus ar 'dam gyi rin ma gtogs las gla sogs ma blangs par so phag1300btsongs/ na ning gi zla8par them chen rdzong them 'phongs shang gi phyugs med khyim tshang tshe brtan rgyal tshang gis khang ba las dus — 281 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/rin ma blangs nas so phag800byin/ lo 'ga'i nang du sde dmangs kyis so phag khog stong bkol nas rin chad la bzhag pa rim rtsis byas na sgor khri4lhag tu bslebs/ sde ba'i kri pu'u hru'u ci ge khod kyis klu dbang rgyal gyis so phag khog stong bzo grwa btsugs nas rang la phan thogs shing 'brog pas khang ba las par stabs bde bzos yod pa ma zad/ da dung tshang ma'i tshong gnyer 'du shes je mthor gtong ba dang mthong rgya je cher gtong ba/ phyogs so so'i 'phrin gsar bsdu len byed pa sogs thad mig dpe bzhag yod ces bshad/(2003lo'i zla6pa'i tshes18nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/ )mkhar grong du mngon pa'i mig gi bdud rtsi/da wa zi ling du bsdus pa'i mgo log mi rigs gzab gos 'khrab ston ru khag gi mthong thos/gsar 'god pa/ bla ma lha/zla8pa'i tshes19nyin gyi phyi dror/ gna' mkhar zi ling rig gnas spyi gling ji 'dra'i mdzes pa la ang / lhang lhang du 'bab pa'i mis bzos rbab chu/ljon pa las mtho bar gtor ba'i gyen 'phyur chu rdzing / logs gnyis su mtsho sngon gyi lo rgyus ring mo mtshon pa'i 'bur ris brkos pa'i rdo brkos bzhengs — 282 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da yod pa dang / dkyil dbus su nub rgyud kyi glu dbyangs rtsom mkhan sku 'bas wang la'o pen gyi sku brnyan bzhengs yod cing / byang 'dabs ni sgor dbyibs can gyi klad khebs min pa'i zhabs bro 'khrab ra red/ dus tshod kyi skar mda' skad cig nyid la'ang sos dal min par 'da' bzhin yod cing / gzab gos 'khrab ston ru khag 'di'i sne khrid pa mgo log khul rig gnas cus yi cus krang gzhon pa sung zha'o chin gyis mtshams sbyor byas pa ltar na/ mgo log khul gyis rang zhing gi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi srol rgyun lus rtsal 'gran tshogs skabs gnyis pa bsdus pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas mgo log khul phyi phyogs la dril bsgrags dang khyad par du mgo log gi bod kyi srol rgyun khyad chos ldan zhing shom che ba'i gzab gos mtshams sbyor 'khrab ston byed rgyu de yin/ gzab gos 'khrab ston ru khag 'di la mi35yod pa dang / de las gzab gos 'khrab ston pa21yod cing mang shos ni 'brog pa red/ da thengs kyi gzab gos dang 'dogs cha tshang ma 'khrab ston pa rang nyid kyi yin pas/ mgo log sa khul gyi gzab spras legs shos da rung 'dus med kyang / rin thang phab rtsis byas par mang na sgor khri20lhag dang nyung shas la yang sgor khri5las yol/phyi dro'i chu tshod4thog tu 'du 'dzi che ba'i mi tshogs glo bur du khu sim par gyur cing / mgo 'dzin pa pho mo gnyis kyis res mos kyis shis tshig brjod pa dang gzab gos 'khrab ston byed 'go brtsams pa bsgrags/gzab gos 'khrab ston ni thog mtha' bar gsum du snyan 'ing 'jebs pa'i glu dang 'gyur khugs ldan pa'i dbyangs kyi ram 'degs 'og lan rer pho mo mnyam 'gro dang lan rer pho mo dbye nas mnyam 'gro/ yang bar bar du pho mo cha 'gro dang bzhi 'gro/ drug 'gro bcas byas la/ dbyangs rta'i dal mgyogs ltar lan re ldem shugs ldan pa'i stangs stabs mngon pa dang / yang — 283 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/ na bod kyi srol rgyun gar stabs dang gdong la 'dzum gyis khengs nas lta bas chog shes med pa'i gzab gos dang rgyan cha thun mong ma yin pa ci dgar ston thabs byas pas/ zi ling gi rigs so so'i lta mkhan stong phrag 'ga'i thal mo rdeb sgra yang dang yang du thob/ lta mkhan 'gas gzab gos 'khrab ston lta zhor du/ ‘‘gzab gos 'khrab ston pa ched las can gyi chu tshad yod pa 'dra’ri‘‘ltos dang / deng sang gi 'brog pa ngo ma phyug po red’’ces gleng mol byed kyin 'dug mgo log gi skyes pas rgyun du 'phying zhwa'am wa zhwa gon pa dang / wa zhwa'i phyi mar 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rgyan ris kyis spras yod cing / skra'i lan bu 'jog mos pa dang tshar bu dmar po dang ba so'i a long gis spras pa red/ byu ru'i phra brgyab pa'i rna rgyan 'dogs pa dang mde'u sgrog 'ching zhing / gri ring dang glo gri 'dogs pa/ me cha dang dngul sdeb/ ga'u bcas 'dogs pa/ rkang mgor hom lham gon pa dang gzab gos kyi 'dabs la sram dang gzig pags kyis brgyan/ bud med kyi gyon chas dang rgyan cha la brgyan srol yod de/ lwa ba'i 'dabs kyi zheng la li mus10yan yod pa'i sram pags kyis brgyan pa dang sku'i lan bu slas shing g.yas g.yon gnyis su phye nas rgyab tu 'phyang yod/ byu ru brgyus pa'i rna tshar dang skra'i lan bu 'brel cing / byu ru rdog po chen po'i ske rgyan 'dogs dga' zhing bar du dngul gyi ga'u btegs yod/ dar babs bud med kyis da dung dngul gyi chab ma bcings pa dang / mdun du da dung ga'u gsum sgrom 'dogs pa sogs red/ rgyan cha 'di dag las gzi chung chung zhig gi rin thang nyung na'ang sgor stong brgyad dgu'i yan du yod pa dang / mgo log pas dus chen du gon pa'i gzab gos dang rgyan cha yi rin thang mang nyung gis mi rnams la khyim tshang de'i 'byor ba mngon pa red/— 284 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad wa(2001lo'i zla8pa'i tshes22nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal)char dus phrad na smyug gsar spro/da waskabs bzhi ba'i‘‘mtsho sngon nyo 'tshong ngo 'phrad gros mol tshogs 'du’risteng nas bod rigs rang skyong khul 'ga' shas kyi mthong thos/gsar 'god pa/ nyi ma/skabs bzhi ba'i‘‘mtsho sngon nyo 'tshong ngo 'phrad gros mol tshogs 'du’’zi ling grong khyer gyi mkhar lho grong gsar du gzab rgyas ngang bsdus rjes/ rgya che'i bod rigs klog pa po tshos tshogs 'dur zhugs pa'i rang zhing gi bod rigs rang skyong khul dag gi 'thus tshab tshogs pa'i gnas tshul la do snang bya srid par snyam nas/ gsar 'god pa ched du tshogs pa 'di dag gi 'grem ston khang du blta ru song / dga' 'os pa zhig la da lo'i tshogs 'du 'di'i steng rang 'ing gi bod rigs rang skyong khul rnams kyis 'du shes gsar ba bcangs te/ rang nyid kyi khyad chos dang khyad ldan thon khungs dril bsgrags byed pa ga'ir bzung nas zhing chen phyi nang gi mgron po rnams kyi yid dbang bkug pa red/rang zhing gi khul dang rdzong rnams kyi 'grem ston khang tshang ma gas ra du grub pa'i‘‘mtsho sngon 'grem ston lte gnas’’kyi‘‘mtsho sngon 'grem gnas’’su bkod sgrig byas 'dug mgo log khul gyi 'thus tshab tshogs pa'i 'grem ston — 285 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/khang ni khyad chos mngon par gsal ba zhig 'dug bod kyi khang khyim gyi khyad chos ltar bzo dbyibs yag cing brkos ris rnam par bkra ba'i sgo chen gyi ngos su‘‘mgo log mi dmangs kyis khyed la dga' bsu zhu’’zhes pa'i rgya yig bris pa dang / sgo yi g.yas g.yon du bod chas gzab mchor spras pa'i gzhon nu ma gnyis kyis 'dzum gyis phyogs bzhi'i mgron po bsu ba byed bzhin mchis/yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'grem ston khang gi steng du‘‘rma 'bri rdza gsum’’zhes pa'i rgya yig bris 'dug brnyan 'phrin nas yul shul gyi glu dbyangs snyan mo grag pa'i khrod nas khams pa'i rgyan gos gyon pa'i mgron bsu ba gnyis kyis 'gro 'ong kun la ngo sprod yig cha ster bzhin 'duga'adi dag ni phyi tshul gyi ltad mo tsam las ma 'das te/ zhib tu rgyus blangs na/ tshogs 'du 'dir zhugs khar rang zhing gi bod rigs skyong khul dag gis 'di ni rang khul gyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la gshog pa btsugs pa'i go skabs bzang po red snyam nas mthong chen byas shing sta gon gang legs byas yod/ tshang mas〈tshong 'gug rnam grangs rags bshad〉dang〈dngul gtong phyogs ston 〉sogs yig cha sna tshogs gra sgrig byas 'dug mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong rang khul gung hi rdzong sogs rdzong nyung shas kyis da rung kher rkyang du rdzong rang gi〈dngul gtong phyogs ston〉par yod pa mthong /mtshobyang bod rigs rang skyong khul gyis thengs 'dir‘‘mtsho sngon zhing chen nub mtsho rdo sol las rigs 'phel rgyas tshad yod 'gan khur kung zi’’sogs tshong 'gug dngul 'dren khe las gtso bo4dang/ ‘‘chi len ri bo rmu ri gter kha dang po’’sogs tshong 'gug dngul 'dren rnam grangs gtso bo34gra sgrig byas yod/ de dag las rnam grangs ches chung ba yi dngul gtong 'char gzhi ni sgor khri40yin la/ ches che ba yi dngul gtong 'char gzhi sgor dung — 286 —

sdormithabakhuraXnyezud/ da wa phyur11 8yin/mgo log bod rigs rang skyong khul dpal 'byor nyo 'tshong u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin tshe ring rdo rjes bshad don/ ‘‘nga tshos da lo'i zla4ba nas bzung ched du gra sgrig byas pa yin/ bar du sa si glo tshad kyi rkyen gyis cung zad chad kyang zla6pa nas bzung sgo kun nas gra sgrig gang legs byas shing / 'ing chen phyi nang kun la mgo log dril bsgrags byed pa gtso bor bzung nas/phyugs las thon rdzos dang chu glog rgya lugs dang bod lugs sman rdzas/gnas skor/ gter rdzas bcas phyogs5nas rang gi gnas bab legs po'i khyad chos gsal mtshon byas/ tshogs 'dur yong khar srid gzhung gis ma mthar sgor khri1000yan gyi gan rgya 'jog thub dgos pa'i las 'gan sprad pa de yongs su grub pa ma zad da lta sgor dung phyur2las yol/ 'dir bltas na nga tsho na ning tshogs 'du 'dir ma zhugs pa ni gyong gun chen po zhig red/ rgyal khab kyis nub rgyud gsar spel chen po'i 'thab jus lag tu bstar cing je zab tu btang bas rang zhing gi bod rigs rang skyong khul rnams la smyug gsar char gyis bskul 'dra'i go skabs bzang po gnang ba red’’zer/(2003lo'i zla7pa'i tshes22nyin gyi par ngos bzhi bar gsal/)

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/yon spun sde ba'i mthong snang /gsar 'god pa/ ban de tshe ring /gser dngul rtswa thang du song myong ba'i mi zhig yin na gnas de'i mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i mdzes ljongs dang ngo mtshar yid dbang 'gugs pa'i gtam rgyud mang po zhig mig gi dpal dang rna ba'i bdud rtsi ru gyur yod nges/ar cen shang yon h+phun sde ba ni sa cha de'i shar byang phyogs kyi spyi le30lhag gi mtshams su gnas shing sog po gtsos la bod rgya mi rigs mnyam gnas byas yod pa'i sde ba zhig red/ nga tsho sde ba de'i 'brog pa lha mo don 'grub tshang la 'byor ba na/ kho tshang gi phyogs gsum la gral 'grig pa'i so phag dang shing chas grub pa'i khang ba gsar ba'i mthil du so phag dkar rtsi ma btings yod la bar khyams yongs su ngar lcags dang shel sgos bcad yod pas nang la 'dzul ma thag gsal yangs drod dang ldan zhing nyams dga' ba'i snang ba zhig ster srid/ da dung ma'o tha'o 'khor lo dang tshon ldan brnyan 'phrin/ 7bukhyi'aphrul chas/ 'khyag sgam sogs deng rabs kyi khyim spyod 'phrul chas sna tshogs tshang 'dugalha mo don 'grub tshang ni sde ba de'i 'brog khyim dkyus ma zhig yin zhing /bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed byas pa'i tshun dang lhag par du nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring gi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed thad kyi 'gyur ldog skor gleng skabs khos bshad rgyur/ da — 288 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da lta'i 'tsho ba 'di lta bu zhig sngon chad yid la'ang 'khor ma myong / tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ sngon chad 'brog khyim tshang ma sbra gur yin la dbyar char nang dang dgun tsag nang du rtswa chur bsnyegs nas phyugs 'tsho bzhin yod/ de nas rim gyis gtan 'dug byed sa'i sa khang re gnyis las 'go brtsams/ rtswa sa'i 'gan gtsang len byed skabs sde ba 'di'i mi rer cha snyoms byas na nor lug30tsam dang dgun dpyid kyi rtswa sa mu'u133las med/ yin na'ang rtswa sa 'gan gtsang len byas rjes sde ba'i mgo khrid pas 'bad pa byas pa dang gong rim 'brel yod sde khag gis rogs ram dang rgyab skyor byas 'og gtan chags khang ba las shing rtswa sar lcags ra bskor ba/ gzan rtswa 'debs pa/phyugs zog gi khebs bya las pa sogs rtswa thang gi rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod phyogs kyi 'dzugs skrun la shugs bsnan pas/ sde ba yongs su khyim tshang 102dang mi grangs477yod pa yongs kyi mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor2900lhag la bslebs yod zer/ khos ku re'i tshul gyis da lta nga tsho 'brog pa rnams kyis kyang grong khyer gyi mi'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod zer/ kho tshang gi phan nus mtho ba'i khebs bya dang lug ra/ gzan rtswa 'jog sa dang rang 'bab chu bcas la lta skabs/ lha mo don 'grub kyi chung mas bshad rgyur/ da lta khyim tshang phal che bas sa mu'u50la gzan rtswa btab nas gzan chas gra sgrig byas yod pas khangs gnod dang than pa 'byung bar skrag mi dgos la/ lu gu'i gson tshad kyang mngon gsal gyis je mthor song yod pa'i khar/ lu gu btsa' dus rang nyid kyis 'bad par snyor skyong byas na gson tshad99lkobaslebs thub zer/ da lta'i dus 'dir las ka thams cad yag po zhig 'khyongs thub min rang nyid kyi rtsol bar rag las shing / rang nyid kyis 'bad pa byas na dpal 'byor dang 'tsho ba yar rgyas yong mi thub zer ba dngos gnas rdzun gtam kho na red/— 289 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/sngon gyi‘‘go kha bu yis bkang/ sgo kha phyugs kyis bkang’’zhes pa'i 'du shes ni rtsa ba nas dor zin/ da lta sde ba 'di'i bza' zla re la byis pa gnyis yan yod pa'i khyim tshang phal cher med la/ 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye tshad ni92lkoyan la bslebs yod/ mi grangs 'phar kyang rtswa sa je cher 'gro rgyu med la rtswa sa med na nor lug 'tsho thabs med/ nor lug med na 'brog pa 'tsho thabs dang bral ba'i gnas lugs de sus kyang rtogs yod/ sde ba'i kri pu'u hru'u ci skal bha yis bshad rgyur/ nga tsho mi rabs 'dis yi ge ma shes pas phyogs gang thad du bkag rgya chen po thebs yod la/ mi rabs rjes ma rnams slob grwar bskyal rgyu ni nga tsho'i 'os 'gan du brtsis nas dam por bzung stabs/da lta sde ba yongs kyi slob lo ran pa'i byis pa slob grwar zhugs tshad dang gtan 'jags kyi tshad gnyis ni98 8lkol bslebs pa dang / lo drug gi slob chung 'os 'gan slob gso khyab gdal du btang tshad 1998lor zhing chen gyis bkrams pa'i tshad gzhi ltar zhib bsher rtsis len byas nas tshad longs yod/mi dar ma'i slob gso yang1999lor zhing chen gyis bkrams pa'i tshad gzhi ltar zhib bsher rtsis len byas nas tshad longs zin/ dpal 'byor gong du 'phar ba bstun nas sde ba 'di'i brnyan 'phrin gyi khebs tshad98ṣ+kal bslebs la/ 'tsho ba dang thon skyed sogs 'phel rgyas byung ste je rgyas su 'phel bzhin yod pa dang / rgya che'i rong 'brog mang tshogs kyi rig gnas lus rtsal dang 'phrod bsten bde srung sogs kyi chu tshad kyang mngon gsal gyis je mthor song bas/ zhing chen yongs su ches thog mar 'byor 'bring chu tshad du bsleb pa'i 'brog sde ru 'gyur bar re ba yod/(2003lo'i zla8pa'i tshes28nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal)— 290 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad warmog ri gong ma'i mthong snang /gsar 'god pa/ ban de tshe ring /dbyar zla7pa'i nyin zhig gi char babs pa'i rjes su nga tsho mtsho sngon po'i lho phyogs su gnas pa'i rkyang sul shang du bcar 'dri byed du phyin/gung hi rdzong rkyang sul shang ni phyugs las gtso gnyer gyi shang zhig yin pa dang / rgyal lam109yi 'gram du gnas shing sa'i gnas bab legs la rtswa chu phun tshogs gnas shig red/ shang 'dis rang byung rtswa sa khrims ltar bdag skyong dang lugs mthun ngang bed spyod byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng mi'i thabs kyis rtswa 'debs pa dang rtswa sar lcags ra bskor ba/ phyugs khang las pa/'brog pa'i gtan chags khang ba las pa bcas nang don gtso bo yin pa'i cha sdeb bzhi yi 'dzugs skrun dam por bzung thog chu dang glog gzhung lam/rig gnas slob gso/ sman bcos 'phrod bsten bcas kyi sgrig bkod 'dus pa'i cha sdeb mang po mngon 'gyur byung bas 'brog pa rnams kyi 'gro sdod sbyod gsum thad 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod/nga tsho shang de'i rmog ru gong ma sde bar song nas sde ba de'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed thad kyi gnas tshul rgyus lon byas/ gtan chags khang ba dang go nyis chod kyi phyugs khang / phyugs 'jug khebs bya chen po bcas mnyam du yod pa'i 'brog khyim zhig gi sgo khar rlangs 'khor las — 291 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/babs te khebs bya'i phyogs su song ba na/ a ne 'brog mo zhig gis drod 'dzin khebs bya nang gi sngo tshod la yur rtswa 'jom bzhin 'dug khebs bya nang du hong kwa dang sir pan/ tshal kwa sogs sngo tog rigs mang po btab yod cing skye tshul ha cang bzang / khebs bya gzhan pa de'i nang du la ser btab yod la de'ang skye tshul ha cang yag khyim bdag mas bshad rgyur/ khebs bya gcig gi nang du na ning la ser rgya ma7000lhag thon/ khebs bya gzhan gcig gi nang du sngo tog btab na rang la za rgyu 'dang ba las btsongs nas lo rer sgor mo800lhag gi yong sgo btsal thub zer/ ngas kho mo la tshod ma 'debs e shes zhes dris pa na/ kho mos sngon chad 'brog mo zhig gis tshod ma 'debs kyin yod zhe na ngo ma dgod bro ba zhig yin mod/ da lta nga tsho rong ba dang 'dra bar tshod ma 'debs bzhin yod/ dang thog tshod ma 'debs mi shes mod gzhan gyis mdzub ston byas 'og cung tsam re btab nas da lta 'debs mi shes rgyu med la/ sa 'di ru'ang tshod ma sna tshogs 'khyongs ba red/ nga tshos kho tshang gi mus gru bzhi ma300yod pa'i tshad mtho'i phyugs khang dang gzan chas 'jog sa/ sngo tog gi rigs 'jog sa'i dong phug bcas zhib tu bltas/ gzan chas 'jog sar khang mig gsum yod cing nang du na ning 'thag pa'i gzan chas kyi lhag ma da dung ha cang mang po yod/ rtswa 'thag 'phrul 'khor dang rtswa gtub 'phrul chas sogs nor lug tsho gso byed par mkho ba'i 'phrul chas kyi rigs ma tshang ba med/ kho mo dang kha brda byas pa brgyud nas khyo ga'i ming la rdo rje tshe ring zer ba dang sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci yin pa shes/ hru'u ci rdo rje tshe ring nyin der khyim tshang gzhan zhig na tshogs 'du 'tshogs bzhin yod zer/ kho tshang dang sde ba yongs kyi gnas tshul gsal bo shes ched nga tsho khyim tshang der song nas hru'u ci rdo rje tshe ring la bcar 'dri byas/ khos mtshams sbyor byas pa ltar — 292 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da na/ da lta sde ba yongs kyi khyim tshang gi80lkol tshad mtho'i phyugs khang las yod cing / phyugs khang dang khebs bya gnyis la gong rim gyis ma dngul gyi50lkobatang ba dang khyim tshang rang gis505rang tshags byas pa red/rmog ru gong ma sde bar zhing phyugs gnyis kyi khyim tshang183dang mi grangs1100lhag yod/ sde ba 'di'i rtswa sa che rgyu med na'ang rtswa sa'i rmang ga'i sgrig bkod kyi 'dzugs skrun dang phyugs las kyi grub tshul legs sgrig byas pa sogs bzang bas na/ dpal 'byor gyi yong sgo/lo re bzhin gong du 'phar nas da lta sde ba yongs kyi mi re'i cha snyoms yong sgo sgor4200lhag la bslebs pa red/dpal 'byor gong du 'phel ba dang bstun nas sde mi yongs kyi bsam pa 'i go rtogs kyang rim gyis je mthor song nas slob lo ran pa'i byis pa slob grwar zhugs tshad dang gtan 'jags kyi tshad gnyis ka99lkol bslebs pa dang /gtsang sbra dang 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye tshad kyang je mthor song nas da lta90lkolhag la slebs 'dug sde ba 'dir da lta rlangs 'khor che chung20lhag dang lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo67dang ma'o tha'o 'khor lo165bcas yod/ rdo rje tshe ring gi bshad pa ltar na sde ba 'dis khang ba las nas gtan chags byas pa nas da lta'i bar lo17las 'gor med pa dang / de'i yar sngon khang ba las dgos par skul yang las mkhan ha cang nyung mod/ da lta sde ba 'di'i 'brog pa rnams kyis 'gran bsdur byas nas khang ba gsar ba las bzhin yod pas gcig las gcig lhag cing gcig las gcig yag pa red/ khos bshad rgyur/da lta tang gi dmangs phyug srid jus 'di 'dra bzang bo'i 'og ‘ra brag 'dod kyis brag dang lug spang 'dod kyis spang zhes pa'i dpe ltar khrims dang mi 'gal ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng rang gis ci zhig bsgrub 'dod kyang sgrub chog pas/ phyug por 'gyur min de gtso bo rang gis rtsol bar rag las yod/— 2()3 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/rang gis 'bad pa byas na phyug por 'gyur mi thub pa zhig yod mi srid/ sde ba 'dir mtshon na da lta phyugs las kyi zhor du tshong las gnyer sogs sna mang bdag gnyer byed par kha phyogs yod pas sde ba yongs kyi dpal 'byor yong sgo ha cang bzang ba red zer/(2003lo'i zla9pa'i tshes16nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal)dbul thar phyug sgrur gyi sne khrid pa g.yang tho/gsar 'god pa/ ban de tshe ring /tin tha sde ba ni hod kha grong rdal dang bar thag spyi le gnyis lhag las med pa'i sa na chags shing sde ba 'dir da lta khyim tshang 195dang mi grangs1064yod pa red/ 'grim 'grul dang nyo 'tshong sogs phyogs gang thad nas sde ba gzhan dang bsdur na cha rkyen ha cang 'dzoms po yod pas dpal 'byor gyi che rkyen ltos bcas kyis bzang ba yin/ yin na'ang mgo nag skyid sdug gnam gyi lag ces pa'i dpe ltar/ lo rabs dgu bcu bar rang byung gnod 'tshe tshabs chen byung nas 'brog pa rnams kyi phyugs zog la yal gyong tshabs chen thebs pas/ phyugs zog nyung ba dang phyugs zog med pa'i khyim tshang 'bor tshad mi chung ba zhig byung ste sde ba 'di yang bskyar dbul phongs kyi gnas su gyar la zhing chen gyis dbul phongs sde bar gtan khel byas shing / sde ba — 294 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa 'dir re zhig dpal 'byor dang thon skyed sogs kyi thad dka' khag chen po byung na'ang sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci g.yang tho yis sne khrid de 'bad pa byas pa dang gong rim sde khag gis shugs chen pos rgyab skyor dang rogs ram byas par brgyud grub 'bras nges can zhig blangs/g.yang tho(g.yang skyabs rgyal)yis sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci'i 'gan 'khur nas lo ngo mang po zhig 'gor zhing sde ba yongs phyug bsgyur gyi lam du zhugs par dka' sdug dang sems khral ji 'dra myangs pa dang rngul chu'i thigs pa ga 'dra zhig 'thor ba sus kyang brjod dka'/ kho rang la bcar 'dri byed skabs khos bshad rgyur/ nga tsho'i sde ba 'di sngon chad de 'dra'i phyug rgyu med na'ang sde ba yongs su dka' khag can gyi khyim tshang nyung / 1993lor rang byung gnod 'tsho tshabs chen byung bas phyugs zog la 'chi gyong tshabs chen thebs nas dbul phongs khyim tshang70lhag byung / nga rang sde ba'i mgo khrid pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas skabs der ngo ma ci zhig byed dgos pa'ang mi shes/ lo mang po'i ring la sde ba'i don dag che ma chung gsum gyi mgo rnga tshang mar ma thon sa zhig med/ yin na'ang rang nyid kyi rig gnas chu tshad zhan pa dang lta rgya mthong rgya chung ba'i stabs kyis las khyad par ba zhig bsgrub rgyu ha cang khag po red zer/ 1995lor zhing chen tang u'i rtsa 'dzugs pu'u yis 'ing chen yongs kyi sde ba'i rim pa'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci skor zhig sgrig 'dzugs byas te nang logs su lta skor slob sbyong byed du khrid pa dang / kho rang de'i gras su tshud pas 'brog pa'i rtswa thang yangs po nas phyir bud de phyi yul gyi 'jig rten la ltad mo blta pa'i go skabs shig thob/ thengs der hran 'i dang cang su'u dang su'u kra'u dang hrang he bcas dar rgyas che ba'i grong khyer 'gar lta skor du phyin pas/ sa gnas kyi 'dzugs skrun dang dpal 'byor cha rkyen dang mi'i bsam — 295 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/pa'i go rtogs dang 'tsho ba rol stangs bcas kyis kho rang ha las bcug la rang gi pha yul dang gtan nas bsdur thabs med pa zhig yin pa shes/ phyir pha yul du log rjes phyug por bsgyur dgos na 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi bsam pa'i 'du shes bsgyur dgos pa dang rtswa sa'i rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod kyi 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa'i nges shes zab mo zhig rgyud la skyes/ khos nus pa yod tshad bton nas sde ba'i rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod kyi 'dzugs skrun dang phyugs las kyi grub tshul legs sgrig sogs thad nas sne khri de dbul thar phyug sgyur byed par 'bad pa byas/ 2001lor rdzong 'char gzhi dpal 'byor u yon lhan tshogs la mnyam 'brel dbul skyor byed rgyu gtan khel byas pa brgyud nas rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod kyi 'dzugs skrun thad las gzhi brtson len byas te/ ma dngul sgor khri400lhag btang nas rang 'bab chu dang glog 'then pa dang gzhung lam dang brnyan 'phrin bsdu len stegs bu sogs las pas rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod mngon gsal gyis je legs su song zhing dus yun thung ngu'i nang dpal 'byor mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas su song / mnyam 'brel ma byas sngon gyi dbul phongs khyim tshang70lhag las50lhag dbul phongs las thar nas da lta sde ba 'dir dbul phongs khyim tshang15las med la sde ba yongs su lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo50lhag dang ma'o tha'o 'khor lo180lhag yod par gyur pa dang /sde ba yongs kyi khyim tshang gi50lko yan la brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas dang7bukhri'aphrul chas yod pa red/ sde ba'i dpal 'byor gong du 'phar ba'in yod la slob gso gtsigs su 'dzin pa dang 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye sogs kyi go rtogs kyang mngon gsal gyis mtho ru phyin nas slob lo ran pa'i byis pa slob grwar zhugs tshad dang gtan 'jags byung tshad gnyis ka99lkol bslebs pa dang / 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye tshad kyang90ཿla bslebs yod/ hru'u ci — 296 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da g.yang tho yis sde ba'i 'phel 'gyur gyi ched du rang nus yod tshad bton pas kho rang‘‘zhingasgochen yongs kyi sngon thon tang kri pu'u hru'u ci’’la bdams myong ba dang / zhing chen dmangs 'thus skabs bcu ba'i 'thus mir bdams myong /khos rang gi mig rgya bskyed nas gzhan la mig dpe ston ched ma dngul rang 'tshag byas te seng ge phur dang ma le zhi ya dang the rgyal khab bcas su lta skor du song zhing / 2002lor khos ma dngulo sgor khri4lhag btang nas khang ba gsar ba zhig las yod cing khang ba'i nang du deng rabs kyi khyim spyod glog chas 'dzoms po zhig yod pa las cha rkyen bzang ba rtogs thub/ kho'i sne khrid 'og sde ba yongs phyug por bsgyur bar lam thag ring bo mi dgos pa ni nga rang la yid ches yod/(2003lo'i zla10pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/ 1dpa' bo'i byas rjes nam yang nga tsho'i sems khong du gnas/nga srog dor nas gzhan srog skyob mkhan bsod nams don 'grub kyi gnas tshul bkod pa/gsar 'god pa/ tshe ring bkra shis/bsod nams don 'grub ste pho lo21la bud ma thag pa'i bod kyi gzhon nu — 297 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/zhig dang / zhing pa gla rgyug mi phal ba'i khrod kyi phal ba zhig gis chu rka'i nang lhung ba'i lo8can gyi rgya rigs byis pa zhig skyob ched rang gi rin chen tshe srog phangs med du sbyin/kho ni rang srog dor nas gzhan srog skyob pa'i dpa' bo zhig yin pa ma zad/ rang zhing gi mi rigs mthun sgril yar thon gsar skrun bya 'gul khrod 'bur du thon pa'i mig dpe zhig kyang yin/ kho'i bla med spobs pa dang byas rjes la zhing chen yongs kyi mi rigs so so'i las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyis slob sbyong byed bzhin yod pa dang / tang dang srid gzhung gis kho'i ya rabs spyod bzang la gdeng 'jog mthon po gnang bzhin mchis/myun du byis pa skyob rogs/da lo'i zla4ba'i nang bsod nams don 'grub la rgyu lhag byung nas gshag bcos byas pas lus phung slar sos pa de 'dra mi bzang mod/ 'on kyang bsod nams don 'grub kyis khyim tshang gi dbul phongs kyi rnam pa bsgyur ched dang 'drud 'then 'khor lo zhig nyo phyir pha mas 'gro mi dgos tshul ji ltar bshad kyang ma khogs par phu bo lcags byams dang nu bo rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ da dung sde ba'i nang gi gsar bu gzhan dag dang mnyam du zla8pa'i tshes31nyin gyi snga dro yul mi dang kha bral te zi ling la gla rgyug tu chas/ de ni kho nyid rang gi pha yul dang gnyen nye/ spun zla sogs dang gtan du bral ba khos ga la shes/ kho tsho zi ling du bslebs rjes thog mar gla rgyag sa'i gnas btsal cing de nas mal sa sogs btings rjes/ kho tsho'i gras kyi mi la la thog dang por zi ling la yong ba yin pas phyi rol du nyul 'dod skyes/ phyi dro'i chu tshod5tsam gyi steng gla rgyug sa rnyed pa'i dga' snang dang bcas phan tshun la ku re rtsed mo rtsed zhor khra'o dbyang — 298 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ lnged jo glog 'don bzo grwa gnyis pa'i chu rka'i 'gram brgyud skabs/ byis pa 'ig chu nang nas 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa mthong bas bsod nams don 'grub kyis8‘myur du byis pa skyob rogs’’zhes bshad ma thag rgyug thengs gcig gis byis pa'i drang thad nas mar mchongs pa dang / de dang mnyam du rogs pa nam mkha' dang kun bzang chos 'phel gnyis kyang 'tshab 'tshub ngang chu nang du mchongs/kho rang chu nang du nub pa'i skad cig mar lag zung gis byis pa yar bkyags te nam mkha' gtad pas/ byis pa nyen kha las yongs su thar na'ang bsod nams don 'grub chu'i gting du 'thims song gsar 'god pas kho'i 'gro rogs nam mkha' la bcar 'dri byed dus/khos ha cang skyo snang dang bcas‘‘nga dang kun bzang chos 'phel gnyis kyis byis pa de chu khar bzhag nas phyir 'khor dus bsod nams don 'grub kyi lag pa g.yug g.yug tsam byed pa las ci yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug myur du kho rang skyob bsam dus chu gting ba dang rnyog pa yin pas dngos gnas skyob ma thub’’ces bshad cing gdong la nongs 'gyod dang phangs sems shig skyes 'dugadon bya de dngos su mthong mkhan rgya rigs bud med son shang lan gyis rnam pa der phyir dran byed skabs‘‘ji 'dra 'dra'i pho gsar ya rabs shig de 'dra'i gting zab pa'i chu nang du the tshom ci yang med par mchongs song / kho'i na tshod de 'dra chung / ji 'dra'i yid phangs pa la’’zhes ngag nas yang yang zlo bzhin 'dug 'di ltar bsod nams don 'grub nga tsho 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i mi yul dang gtan du gyes/bsod nams don 'grub kyi rin chen gser lus la mi rnams phangs sems skyes shing / kho'i dpa' bo'i mdzad rjes la mi rnams kyis yi rang byed/— 299 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/kho ni byis pa ya rabs shig yin/ zla9ba'i tshes1nyin gyi phyi dro gsar 'god pas dpa' bo bsod nams don 'grub kyi 'das rkyen la dmigs nas ched du kho'i pha yul khri ka rdzong ka ring shang sngo kyā sde bar bcar 'drir phyin/ bsod nams don 'grub kyi pha yul ni ka ring shang gzhung yod sa nas spyi le4tsam phyin tshe chu bo zhig brgal nas 'gro dgos/ chu bo che rgyu med na'ang rlangs 'khor mi bud la zam pa'ang med pas nges par du chu la mi brgal thabs med yin/ bsod nams don 'grub de snga 'tsho myong ba'i sde ba de ni bod rigs rkyang rkyang gi sde ba zhig yin la dud khyim19las med/ gsar 'god pa kho'i khyim la bslebs dus pha ma gnyis zi ling du bud song na'ang sde mi rnams der 'dus nas zang zing lang long byed kyin 'dugakho'i a khu rin chen don grub la de'i skor gleng dus/ khos‘‘bsod nams don 'grub ni byis pa rig yag cig yin/ slob sbyong la ha cang bzang mod/ 'on kyang khyim tshang la dka' khag che bas rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring las mthar phyin rjes slob mtshams bskyur nas yul du las ka mi las thabs med byung’’zer/sde mi rnams kyis gcig kha gcig gis 'phrog ste gsar 'god par bsod nams don 'grub kyi ya rabs spyod bzang gi mi gshis gleng 'go brtsams/ na ning dbyar khar sde ba'i gram pa'i nang chu log byung bas khyim tshang zhig gi lug5khur/ bsod nams don 'grub kyis de mthong nas the tshom med par chu nang du lding zhing lug2skyob thabs byas/ yang thengs mang por sde ba'i nang gi zhing la chu gtong ba'i lcags sbug chu log gis khur ba chu khar blangs/— 300 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa kho chu la rkyal mi shes na'ang yar 'gro mar 'gro byed dus chu la brgal dgos pa dang de'i khar spobs pa cung che bas chu la de 'dra mi skrag sde ba nang gi rgan pa tshos bshad rgyur/ bsod nams ni kha len tshig brtsi byed pa'i byis pa ya rabs shig yin/ su tshang la rogs byed rgyu yod na kho de tshang la rang 'gul gyis thon yong/ nga tsho tshang mar las ka ci zhig las dgos kyang kho la yid ches ha cang yod/sngo kyā sde ba'i hre krang sgrol ma bkra shis kyis bshad rgyur/ bsod nams don 'grub ni byis pa yar rabs shig yin/ sde mi rnams kyis kho glo bur du med song ba go rjes sems sdug byed kyin 'dug yin na'ang phyogs che sa nas 'dang brgyab na gzhan gyi byis pa zhig skyob ched rang srog phul ba ni nga tsho sde ba'i gzi brjid cig kyang red/bsod nams don 'grub kyi nu bo rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gdong la skyo nyams shig shar te‘‘nged tshang la spun5yod/ kho ni nga'i phu bo bzhi ba yin/ phu bo dus rgyun du nga la ha cang bzang / kho'i lag tu sgor mo re gnyis tsam las med na'ang nga la ka ra dang stabs bde rgya thug sogs nyos yong / kha sang nga dang phu bo lcags byams/ khong bcas gsum po zi ling la gla rgyag tu song ba yin/ sgor mo kha shas btsal rjes phyir yong nas lag skyor 'drud 'then 'khor lo zhig nyo rtsis yod/ yin na'ang phu bo kho rang ’’zhes mig nang du mchi ma 'khyil zhing ngag 'dar 'dar gyis bshad/'jin grwa'i kru'u nin gyi sems khong gi bsod nams don 'grub/bsod nams don 'grub kyi khyim nas sde 'dabs kyi chu bo de brgal cing kyag kyog gi ri lam zhig ded nas song tshe/ sngo kyā slob chung ni ri sted kyi ngos da 301 — —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/cung snyoms sa zhig tu chags yod/ kho rang slob chung 'grim skabs nyin rgyun lam 'di brgyud nas slob grwar song zhing khyim du log pa red/rdo rje lhun grub ni bsod nams don 'grub slob chung 'grim skabs kyi 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin yin la/ da lta slob chung 'di'i slob gtso'i 'gan 'khur 'dug bsod nams don 'grub slob chung 'grim skabs kyi gnas tshul gleng dus khos mnos bsam phran tsam byas rjes gsar 'god par gleng byung /1992lo'i zla9bar/ lo7la bud pa'i bsod nams don 'grub sngo kyā slob chung du zhugs pa yin/ lam thag ring ba dang lam de 'dra mi bzang bas kho rang zhogs pa'i chu tshod7steng slob grwar 'gro dgos pa dang / mtshams rer char babs na'ang khos thabs brgya jus stong gis chur brgal nas slob grwar yong ba las slob zhol byas ma myong / don bya gcig ni dge rgan rdo rje lhun grub kyis nam yang brjed pa min/ ‘‘de ni bsod nams don 'grub slob chung gi lo rim gnyis pa'i skabs yin/ nyin zhig khos lam bar du sgor zur3rnyed pas/slob grwar thon ma thag nga la sprad’’zer/ sgor zur3yin na'ang dka' khag che ba'i khyim tshang zhig la mtshon na de'ang ha cang gal chen zhig yin/ bsod nams don 'grub kyi ya rabs spyod bzang gi gshis rgyud ni chung dus nas goms pa yin pas don chung des kyang dge rgan rdo rje lhun grub la bag chags zab mo bzhag pa red/bsod nams don 'grub kyi slob sbyong gi grub 'bras ha cang bzang /slob rim gnyis pa'i skabs su na chung gdong len ru khag nang zhugs pa dang /slob rim gsum pa'i skabs nas bzung ‘‘gsum bzang slob mar’’bdams/sngo kyā sde ba'i nor bu 'tsho dang kho tshang ni hre gcig yin/ dgun khar nor bu 'tsho'i rkang lag rgyun du tsag gis phyid de 'gro mi thub/ bsod nams don — 302 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad wa 'grub kyis thengs mang por nor bu 'tsho khur nas slob grwar yong ba red/1995lo'i dbyar kha'i nyin zhig chu log chen po byung bas slob ma 'ig gi lham chu log gis khur/ slob ma des chu log nang khur nas 'gro bzhin pa'i rang gi lham la bltas nas ngu 'bod byas par bsod nams don 'grub kyis thabs brgya jus stong spyad de lham chu khar len thabs byas/ zhing pa'i byis pa 'ig la mtshon nas bshad na lham zhig gi rin thang ni nga tshos blo yul du shong bka' ba yin/ dge rgan rdo rje lhun grub kyi bag chags khrod bsod nams don 'grub ni ngal rtsol la dga' ba dang / slob sbyong la dga' ba/ dge rgan la brtsi bkur byed cing slob ma gzhan dang mthun sgril yong ba'i byis pa ya rabs shig yin/bsod nams don 'grub kyi slob 'bring gi 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin te/ da lta khri ka rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring gi slob dpyod khru'u yi kru'u rin gyi 'gan khur yod pa'i dge rgan rdo rje tshe brtan gyis gsar 'god par bsod nams don 'grub kyi gnas tshul ngo sprod byas/ slob 'bring gi skabs su bsod nams don 'grub la las ci gtad kyang 'gan khur ba ma zad/ dge rgan gyis khor bcol ba'i las ka yod tshad ma 'grub pa gcig kyang med/ slob 'bring lo rim3pa'i nang bsod nams don 'grub kyis 'tsho ba'i u yon gyi 'gan khur pa yin/ khos zla re rer 'dzin grwa yongs kyi za yig len pa dang slob grogs tshor ster dgos/ nor 'khrul thengs gcig kyang byung ma myong pas slob grogs tsho kho la yid ches brtan po yod/ dge rgan rdo rje tshe brtan gyis da dung bshad rgyur/kho rang khyim tshang gi cha rkyen de 'dra mi bzang na'ang khos rang gi za yig rang las cha rkyen lhag tu mi bzang ba'i slob grogs la ster bar byed 'dug bsod nams don 'grub kyis rang srog dor nas gzhan srog bskyabs pa'i bla med byas rjes slob grwa'i dge rgan yongs kyis go rjes kho la dran gso byed kyin 'dug ge 303 —
