gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/la/ kho tsho'i sems par slob grwa'i nang slob ma 'di 'dra ya rabs shig byung ba ni gzi brjid cig tu 'dod/ khri ka rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring du rgya bod gnyis ka'i slob ma yod pas/ bsod nams don 'grub ni mi rigs mthun sgril gyi mig dper bgrang nas slob sbyong byed rgyu yin zer/bsod nams don 'grub‘‘pha yul du log pa’’ zla9ba'i tshes4nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod6steng nam da dung gsal thag chod pa zhig min/ char ba 'jo ba'i shag sgra'i khrod nas gsar 'god pa dpa' bo bsod nams don 'grub kyi yul mi dang lhan du kho'i bem po bskyal te sbyin sreg khang du phyin/kho'i pha ma dang gnyen nyes kho la ches mtha' mjug gi skyel ma byasarjes/sbyin sreg gi cho ga ha cang stabs bde zhig bsgrubs/ de ni bsod nams don 'grub khu sim mer mi yul du bslebs pa dang 'dra bar/ da lta yang kho rang khu sim mer mi yul dang gtan du gīs/nyin de'i snga dro chu tshod9dang skar ma30yas mas su bsod nams don 'grub kyi rus thal yul mi'i 'gro rogs 'og pha yul du log pa'i lam la zhugs/chu tshod3ring gi lam thag brgyud chu tshod12dang skar ma30steng pha yul gyi sde 'dabs su bslebs dus/ sde mi rnams kyis snga mo nas gzhung lam 'gram du dpa' bo bsod nams don 'grub‘‘pha yul du log par’risgug 'dug kho'i rus sgrom rlangs 'khor nang nas phyi rol du blangs pa'i skad cig mar yul mi tsho'i ngu sgras re zhig khor yug gi lhing 'jags yongs su dkrogs/dpa' bo bsod nams don 'grub lags/ khyed rang gnyen nye spun zla dang yul mi rnams kyis bsu ma'i khrod nas da lta dngos su pha yul du 'byor — 304 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wad wasong / khyed kyis ltos dang sde 'dabs kyi gram chus smre mgur 'gug la/mdun phyogs kyi ri bo 'tsho 'khyil gyis khu sum mer mya ngan zhu bsod nams don 'grub bud song / yin na'ang khos rang srog dor nas gzhan srog skyob pa'i dpa' bo'i byas rjes nam yang nga tsho'i sems khong du gnas shing / kho'i ya rabs spyod bzang gis deng rabs na ga'on gyi yus mthong dpa' skyed dang bla na med pa'i snying stobs mtshon pa ma zad/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi srol rgyun spyod bzang bo yang mtshon pa red/ 'di ni deng rabs na gzhon gyis slob sbyong bya ba'i mig dpe dang / mi rigs so so'i bar kha 'bral thabs med pa'i dpe mtshon ngo ma zhig kyang red/(2004lo'i zla9ba'i tshes8nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/ )rdo gos tshong las gnyer snga bas/gsar 'god pa/ ban de tshe ring /dbyar zla bzhi ba ni zhing las sa khul du ljon shing gi 'dab lo rgyas shing 'bru rigs sna lnga'i ljang smyug gis sa 'dzin gyi phang bar g.yu yi man+dal byugs pa lta bu'i mdzes nyams brgyan yod/ yin na'ang nga tsho hi nan sog rigs rang skyong rdzong thog tu thon skabs da dung kha ba'i 'dab ma lhab lhub tu 'bab bzhin yod pas/ 'brog khul gyi nam zla dang rang byung khor yug gi cha rkyen sogs ji — 305 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'dra yin pa dngos gnas myong tshor thob song /hi nan rdzong ni phyugs las kho na gnyer ba'i rdzong zhig yin la/ bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byas pa'i tshun dang lhag par du nub rgyud gsar spel chen po'i srid jus lag tu bstar ba'i 'gros dang bstun nas yul 'di'i rmang gzhi bkod sgrig thad kyi 'dzugs skrun dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen dang mi'i bsam blo bcas thad 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod/ rdzong mkhar gyi khod yangs pa'i gzhung lam dang gral 'grig pa'i thog khang / tshong ra/ rig gnas thang chen bcas kyis yid kyi brtan pa cig car 'phrog nges/ da dung srang lam du phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed bzhin pa'i yul de'i 'brog pa rgan gzhon pho mo rnams kyi lus kyi gyon pa dang bzhon pa ma'o tha'o 'khor lo dang nyo 'tshong byed tshul sogs las de ga'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi dpal 'byor dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen tshad ji 'dra zhig la son yod pa tshod dpag byed thub/rdzong mkhar gyi nyo 'tshong tshong ra'i nang gi tshong khang zhig gis bdag gi yid sems dbang med du bkug tshong khang nang du g.yu dang byu ru/ sram/gos/ rgyal smug bzho long dang skeg bcings/ 'dogs gri sna tshogs/rigs mi 'dra pa'i ma'o tha'o 'khor lo sogs tshong zog sna 'dzoms shing ma rtsa mtho bas dngos nas ha las pa zhig red/ nga tshos tshong khang 'di'i tshong gnyer gnas tshul rgyus lon gsal bo zhig byed ched tshong bdag btsal du song / tshong bdag gi ming la rdo go zer zhing pho lo53la son 'dug kho rang tshong rgyag pa'i lam la zhugs snga bas rmang gzhi bzang tsam chags yod/ nga tsho kho tshang du 'byor ba na ra skor nub phyogs su khang ba nyis thog can zhig dang byang ngos su so phag dang shing chas grub pa'i khang leb kyi bar khyams shel gyis bcad yod/shar phyogs su rlangs 'khor dang dngos po rtsag rtsig 'jog sa'i khang ba gral — 306 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da 'grig pa dag las yod/ lhas dkyil du‘‘san lin’’rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor chung ba zhig bsdad yod/tshong bdag rdo go la bcar 'dri byas pa las kho rang ni tho ye ma ༅nga gi yin la kho rang la bu bu mo gnyis las med pas so sor khyim ga'is bzung yod/khos bshad rgyur/ rtswa sa 'gan gtsang len byas pa dang tang gi dmangs phyug srid jus lag tu bstar bas/ ‘‘ra brag 'dod kyis brag dang lus spang 'dod kyis spang’’zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ srid jus dang mi 'gal ba'i ga'ir rang rang gis ci zhig sgrub 'dod na de sgrub chog pas/ nga tsho 'brog pa rnams la'ang 'ur cha bskyur nas tshong las sogs gnyer ba'i go skabs thob/ de bas nga rang gis thog mar nor lug 'ga' btsongs nas sgor rdog 'ga' rer brjes te zi ling dang sku 'bum/ lan kra'u/ bla brang / ka chu sogs su song nas 'brog khul du mkho pa'i dngos po re khyer yong nas 'brog pa'i ru nang nyul/ de ltar sun snang dang yid chad med par lo mang po'i ring la 'bad pa byas pas nyams myong dang ma rtsa je bzang la song ba dang / sa cha mang por song nas rig rgyu mthong rgyu mang na sems la dran rgyu'ang mang bas/ rdzong mkhar du yong nas tshong las gnyer na yong sgo bzang zhing byis pa slob grwar bskyal ba sogs 'gro mal spyod gsum gang la'ang stabs bde ba bsams nas da lta'i tshong khang 'di 'byed rgyur sems thag chod song zer/kho tshang gis tshong khang 'di gnyer nas lo ngo10tsam las ma 'gor na'ang sa de'i tshong khang mang po'i khrod na rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur gyur 'dug dang thog kho tshang gis nor lug yongs rdzogs sgor khri40lhag la brjes te ma rtsar bzhag nas phyes pa'i tshong khang der da lta sgor khri180lhag gi ma rtsa yod dang /sgor khri20lhag gi 'khor rgyug ma dngul yod pa'i tshong ba che thos shig tu gyur — 307 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'dug rdo gos bshad rgyur/ da lta bu tshe brtan nar son nas tshong gnyer thub cing / chang mi 'thung ba dang sho mi rgyag pas nga'i sems bde la babs chogayar mar la dus rgyun tshong len par 'gro dgos pas/ na ning sgor khri20lhag byin nas rlangs 'khor gsar ba zhig nyos te bkol bzhin yod/ nga rang lo bgres na'ang rta pho'i tshab tu rlangs 'khor bskor na 'dod phyir/ rlangs 'khor skor ba'i lag rtsal bslabs pa ma zad/ rlangs 'khor chung ba zhig kyang nyos yod zer/dngos gnas mi la brtson 'grus ldan gyur na/ 'jig rten 'di na dka' ba med ces pa'i dpe ltar/ dang thog tshong rgyag pa'i ma co sgor brgya shog 'ga' las med pa'i 'brog pa rdo go da lta sgor khri nyis brgya lhag yod pa'i phyug po zhig tu gyur 'dug rtswa sa 'gan gtsang len byas te rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod kyi 'dzugs skrun byas pa dang /‘‘bzhi sdeb’’mngon 'gyur byung bas rtswa chur bsnyegs nas phyugs 'tsho ba'i rnam pa yongs su bsgyur la/ 'brog mi mang po zhig kyang ngal rtsol pa lhag mar gyur 'dug pas/ kha nyi mar ldes nas 'dug pa las tshong las sogs las ka gzhan pa gnyer na yong sgo bzang la rang nyid kyi blo rgya'ang bskyed thub pa red/(2004lo'i zla9ba'i tshes12nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/ )

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da snge don rang don gnyis ka skyong mekhasaṃ pa'i rdo rje nebang sgrol/gsar 'god pa/ ban de tshe ring /dbyar zla'i gnam ngo dwangs shing tsha gdug che ba'i nyin zhig gi nyin gung gi dus su nga tsho gcan tsha rdzong du 'byor/ ma gi thang grong rdal gyi bod rigs mang po zhig gi kha nas rdo rje dbang rgyal zhes pa'i mi 'jon thang can zhig yod pa shes te nga rang ched du khor bcar 'drir phyin pa yin/rdo rje dbang rgyal ni rgyu 'byor ba yod cing ming grags la dga' ba'i mi zhig gtan nas min/ ya rabs tshul ldan dang gzhung drang la bab chags pa'i gshis kar brten nas 'bad 'bungs byed bzhin pa'i mi brtson 'grus can zhig red/kho nyid ma gi thang grong rdal 'khon sa thang sde ba'i yin la/ sde ba de ni rdzong mkhar dang bar thag spyi le10lhag yod pa'i bar sa'i (sa zhing chu ma dang ri ma'i bar na yod pas bar sa zer) sa khul zhig red/ sa rgya chung la mi grangs mang ba dang sa gshis mi bzang ba dang sa chu 'dzin pa'i nus pa nyams pa bcas kyis sa de'i mang tshogs rnams phyug sgyur gyi lam du bskyod par bkag rgya chen po bzos/ 1985lor khos sde dpon gyi 'gan khur skabs thog mar ljon 'dzugs nags skrun byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad de yar rgyug mar snyeg —— rī3()9 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/byas nas sdong phran nyos nas lo re bzhin sdong phran drug stong lhag 'dzugs pa rgyun 'khyongs byas par ma zad/ sde mi yongs la rang rang sa nas ri rgod thang stong du sdong po 'dzugs par skul ma byas stabs/ sde mi rnams kyis kyang gcig la gcig 'gran sgos lo mang po'i ring la ri rgod thang stong po sdong btsugs pas sngon chad skya thing nger snang ba'i yul phyogs de da lta sngo ljang ljon shing gis mdzes par brgyan yod/ yin na'ang mi grangs mang la sa rgya chung stabs sa lag mthil tsam yang gser ltar rtsa che/ mig mdun gyi sa zhing nyung ngu de tsam la brten nas 'byor phyug lam du bskyod rgyu ni las sla mo zhig ga la yin/ rig gnas shes bya'i chu tshad zhan pa dang lta rgya mthong rgya chung ba'i zhing pa rnams la mtshon na/ thabs lam ci zhig 'tshol dgos pa'ang ma shes pa'i skabs der/khos rang nyid kyi lag rtsal te shing las pa dang gyo mog brtsigs pa sogs kyi lag rtsal na gzhon rnams la khrid nas snga gzhug tu shing bzo120dang gyo bzo12bcas skyed sring byas shing / sgo'i phyir bud nas zhor las gnyer bar skul/kho rang ni shing bzo ming grags shig yin pas/ lag rtsal la brten nas dgon pa mang po'i 'du khang dang lha khang sogs las pas yong sgo mi nyung ba zhig thob la/ gzhan la gtong phod kyi phyag zung yang je yangs su gyur/ de ltar khos sne khrid dang 'bad pa byas 'og sde ba yongs kyi dpal 'byor dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen je legs su song na'ang kho tsho sa cha'i tsho bzhi slob chung gis dge rgan gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang slob grwa'i do dam mi bzang pa'i rkyen gyis bstud mar lo 'ga'i ring la mi rigs slob 'bring du slob ma gcig gis kyang rgyugs ma 'phrod/ byis pa ni yul sde dang khyim tshang gi re ba nyag gcig yin pas byis pa'i slob gso dam por 'dzin dgos pa'i 'dun pa skyes/ skabs der kho rang ni sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci yin pas mig snga'i snang tshul der ha cang 'tshab ste gong rim 'brel — 310 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ ——r+hayod sde khag la dge rgan gyi do dam dang slob grwa'i sgrig chas phyogs su shugs snon dgos pa'i re ba nan mo yang yang zhus pas slob khang sogs bskyar du las pa dang / kho rang mi sger gyis slob grwa'i slob ma yongs la cog tse nga stegs/ cha tshang bar bsgrigs/ slob grwa de legs por sgrub ched gong rim 'bre'/ yod sde khag dang yul mi rnams kyis kho rang slob grwa de'i mtshan 'dzin slo ba gtso ru bdams/ kho'i sne khrid 'og ma 'gor bar slob grwa'i rjes lus kyi rnam pa yo/ngas su bsgyur nas do dam dang slob gso sogs gang thad nas mthor 'degs byung ba dang / rim bzhin mi rigs slob 'bring du rgyugs 'phrod tshad dang slob lo ran pa'i byis pa slob grwar zhugs tshad95lkoyan la bslebs pa red/ khos da dung lo mang po'i ring la drug gcig byis pa'i dus chen gyi skabs su rang steng nas slob ma rnams la dpe khug dang 'bri deb sogs slob sbyong gi mkho chas nyos nas bya dga' byin pa ma zad/ dpal 'byor thad dka' khag che ba'i slob ma rnams kyi slob yon yang sprod rogs byas pas/ kho'i bya spyod la sa de'i mang tshogs khrod bstod pa'i mthe bong mi bsgrengs pa gcig kyang med/rdo rje dbang rgyal gyis de ltar lo ngo17ring la sde ba'i tang kri pu'u hru'u ci'i 'gan 'khur bas/ 'khon sa thang sde bar phyogs gang thad nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung / kho tshang gyis rdzong mkhar du gzhis bcas te lo mang po 'gor na'ang‘‘wa chu 'thung gi rna cog byang la gtad’’pa'i dpe ltar/ kho'i sems su nam yang sde don bcangs pa dang sde ba'i don du brel bzhin 'dugad lta'ang khos da rung sde mi rnams la rdzong mkhar du yong nas tshong las dang za khang gnyer bar skul ma gtong bzhin yod/ gzhan la mig dpe ston ched khos rdzong mkhar du thog khang zhig nyos te lo rer sgor khri gcig re byas nas gzhan la glas pa ma zad/ rdzong rlangs 'khor sa tshigs kyi ltag rgyab nas khang mig— 311 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/10dang che chung la mus gru bzhi ma1300lhag yod pa'i sa cha zhig nyos te rdo sol dpar du blug nas btsongs pas lo rer sgor khri4lhag gi yong sgo yod pa'i khar/pha yul gyi mi bdun brgyad tsam la las ka'ang bkod sgrig byas yod pa red/dngos gnas sems pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang zhes pa'i dpe ltar/gzhan la phan btags na kho rang la'ang de las lhag pa'i 'bras bu 'byung bzhin yod/ rdo sol btsongs ba'i yong sgo bzang ba'i khar/ bu chung bas rlangs 'khor bskor nas zhor las gnyer nas kyang lo rer sgor khri 4lhag gi yong sgo lon 'dug kho rang nyid kyang dbyar dus su yul gzhan la song nas shing las byas na delas lhag pa'i yong sgo yod pa red/ khos bshad rgyur/ngas da lta rdo sol btsong sa'i sa cha 'di'i steng thog khang las te khang gzhis thon las gnyer bar 'bad pa bya rgyu yin/ da lta gzhi rim gyi rong 'brong mang tshogs mi nyung ba zhig rdzong mkhar du yong bzhin yod la/ rgyal khab kyis kyang 'di'i phyogs su rgyab skyor byed bzhin yod pas 'di'i phyogs su mdun lam chen po ldan zer/ gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri rdzogs nas zla ba du ma 'das kyang rdo rje dbang rgyal gyi bzhin ras da dung mig lam du gsal ler snang zhing /sde ba re la khong lta bu'i mi du ma yod na/ zhing pa rnams 'byor 'bring du 'gyur ba'am grong rdal du yong ba'i lam zhig cis kyang 'byed yong nges yin pa'i yid ches skyes/(2005lo'i zla1po'i tshes12nyin gyi par ngos dang por gsal/ )

rgyasa'aphrin/ d+ngharngebrag dkar sprel rdzong gi mthong snang /so nam pa/da lo bod lugs ltar na shing sprel gyi lo res la bab yod pas/ brag dkar sprel rdzong ngam sprel rdzong dgon par gnas mjal gtsos pa'i gnas skor du phebs pa'i mi ha cang mang / skabs 'gar nang skor phar zhogaphyi skor dbang du btang na/ lam dog sa dag tu 'tshang ga brgyab ste gshar nas 'gro ba'i mi rnams las rkang ba'i snga rting gis phyi rting brdzis 'gro ba'i tshul du snang /sprel rdzong gi gnas yig las/ gnas 'di ni‘‘brag phug sgrub pa mdzang pa dang / / slob dpon dbang drag 'bar ba yis/ / ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ / srin pos brag sgor pha bong tsho bkab/ / rdo rje gsor bas steng nas byon/ / zhes dang / mtha' 'dul gnas kyi nang nas che'o’’zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs su o rgyan mtsho skyes rol ba'i rdo rje de nyid rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas 'dre srin btul zhing gnas 'dir byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su yang 'bri gong 'jig rten mgon po sogs skyes chen du mas zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs par grags/ spyir gnas kyi bkod pa ni spang ris brag ri bskor ba/ brag rir nags kyis brgyan pa/ chu rgyun che min chung min gnyis kyis gnas ri rngo rje lhun grub de'i mdun rgyab gnyis su dar kha ring mo tshul du brgyan zhing / brag — 313 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/ri'i ngos su lha sku dang yig 'bru sogs rang byon 'bur dod du bzhugs pa dang / rtog snang du lha yi dga' tshal dpal he ri ka'i pho brang mngon sum du grub 'dra lags te/ ngag rgyun du gnas sgo che 'bring chung gsum bco brgyad dang rang byon sum stong du grags pa red/ de ni rdo rje phug pa'i gnas/yongs su grub pa'i gnas/ dag pa shel gyi gnas/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi gnas/ bde gshegs brgyad kyi gnas/ yang rdzong 'du mo'i gnas/ sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i gnas/ drin lan 'jal sa'i gnas bcas gnas sgo che ba brgyad dang / dung dkar chos kyi gnas/ dur khrod bsil ba'i gnas/ rnam 'dzoms khrus kyi gnas/ bkra shis la yi gnas/ 'dzam lha'i gter gyi gnas/o rgyan sngags chu'i gnas bcas gnas sgo 'bring ba drug dang / glang chen kha la chu 'bebs longs spyod kyi gnas/ sha skyo smug ris gter mdzod kyi gnas/ro drug bdud rtsi sman chu'i gnas/ ya ma thar khung sri gnon gyi gnas bcas gnas sgo chung ba bzhi dang / thugs rje chen po rang byon/ gsang bdag rang byon/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser rang byon/ sgrol ma bu sbyin rang byon/gshin rje'i skam pa/ tsi dung thos phug mthun pa spun bzhi dang tshe ring rnam drug rang byon/ g.yu 'brug tshang nyal rang byon/ rnga rung grub chen nas sa gzigs pa'i rdo skas/ 'khor ba'i bskyur ba'i them skas/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong dang slob dpon pad 'byung la rtags ris kyi bskor ba/bcom ldan rnam snang la sems dpa' du mas bskor ba/ o rgyan zhabs rjes/dung las bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ gshin rje'i grong khyer/ sman bla rang byon/dpal ldan lha mo'i drel rjes dang be con rang byon/ ge sar rgyal po'i rta rkyang nge'i rmig rjes dang ral gris gshags shul/ dpa' rtul sum cu'i phyag mtshan/rje btsun mi las mgur gsung ba'i rtul zhugs/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor/— 314 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wakhro bo sme brtsegs sgrub phug dang sgrub chu'i g.yas g.yon du lha bdud gnyis nas dge sdig grangs ka brtsi ba'i rde'u spungs/ gshin rje chos rgyal rang byon dang phyag nas lcags thag thogs te gshin rje'i 'phrang la 'then pa'i tshul/ 'gag 'phrang mthil du dmyal ba'i zangs chen bco brgyad ces chu chen ni khro chu lhog lhog tu gdu ba lta bu'i 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas dang tsha grang 'thab pas smi ngag 'don par snang ba'i chu'i 'ur sgras khengs pa/ o rgyan mtsho skyes rol ba'i rdo rje nyid kyis brag zur gsum gyi sna khar 'dre srin spun bdun rmeg med du bzos nas dong rim nang mnan zhing bskal ba'i bar du sems can la mi 'tshe ba'i dam bzhag par grags pa sogs shin tu mang / 'di dang 'di lta bu spyi la rang byon sum stong zer ba red/mjal ba'am gnas skor pa'i nang du mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul khongs kyi rdzong khag gzhan dag gi bzhud mgron mang ba ma zad/ da dung rma lho khul dang mgo log khul dang mtsho byang khul sogs nas yong ba'i bzhud mgron yang mang tsam mthong / gzhan du mtsho nub khul dang mtsho shar sa cha/ kan su'u zhing chen gyi kan lho khul dang dpa' ris rdzong / si khron zhing chen gyi rnga ba khul/ tha na bod ljongs nas yong ba'i rlangs 'khor yang du ma mthong /gsar 'god pa nged cag de gar bsdad longs nyin gnyis tsam las med kyang /g.yo skol dang gnas tshang du sne len dang dbor skyel dang sil tshong la brel ba'i sprel rdzong gtogs khongs kyi zhin te rdzong gi rong 'brog mang tshogs kha nas bo ba ltar na/ bod mi 'dus pa'i zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs lnga yi rdzong khag dbang du brtsis na/ phal cher rdzong thams cad kyi phyed ka longs tshod nas bzhud mgron yong tshul shes 'dug nyin re rer mjal ba'am gnas skor du yong ba'i bzhud mgron nyung mthar lnga brgya yas mas dang mang nyin chig stong lnga — 315 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/brgya yas mas longs pa red/ sdom brtsi las khungs kyi mi snas kyang kho thag chod pa'i grangs ka zhig da dung brjod kyi mi 'dug cing / gong gleng yid dpags byas tshod la 'thad pa yin tshul gyi rnam 'gyur 'dzin/zhin he rdzong nas sprel rdzong dgon pa dbar du spyi le32yod pa de shang grong gzhung lam yin pas da dung bzang rgyu med pa red/ de 'dra'i dbang gis 'grim 'grul yo byad de g.ye skyod rlangs 'khor min pa na/ yul de ga'i sger gnyer rlangs 'khor las mthil gshong mtho ba'i rigs gla 'tshal/ de rigs mang che ba pe cin rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor yin te/ kha lo ba mang shas bod rgya hos gsum gyi rigs su gtogs pa red/ rgya rigs kha lo ba rus li can zhig la dris pa'i gnas tshul ltar na/ kho rang mi brel mi dal yun yod nga/'i tshul du rgyug pa yin la/ bzhud mgron rnams yar 'gro mar yong la ma ltos par cha mnyam thengs rer mi re la sgor bcu'i gtan khel ltar bskyal na/ nyin rer yar skyel thengs gnyis dang mar bsu thengs gnyis 'khyongs pa red/ de lta na nyin re'i yong sgo sgor300yas mas yin pa dang / 'gro song phud rjes de'i phyed ka tsam 'bab rkyang yin 'dug brer/ bod rigs kha lo ba ming du bsam brtan don 'grub(gces ming la bsam pe)zhu ba zhig la dris pa'i lan du/ nyin rer yar skyel thengs gsum dang mar bsu thengs gsum grub pa na/yong 'bab sgor500yas mas lon pa dang / bzhud mgron nyung ba'am rang gis skyel rgyu ma lon na/ yar skyel mar bsu so sor thengs gcig las mi 'grub pa'i gnas tshul yod/ de lta na nyin rer sgor150tsam las mi lon/rlangs snum la yong sgo'i sum cha'i gcig gi che mi 'gro mod/ rlangs 'khor gyi 'dzad gron dang khral nyung tsam dang rang gis za khang nas za ma zos na/ 'gro gron de yong 'bab kyi phyed tsam la nye ba yin zer/ spyir brda 'phrod bde ba — 316 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa da wadang mjal ba la byams brtse ldan pa dang rlom rung ba bcas kyi dbang du/bod rigs kha lo ba mang shas shig gi yong sgo mi rigs gzhan pa'i kha lo bar ltos na cung tsam bzang zer/ gzhung lam gyi dum mtshams 'dir rgyug pa'i pe cin rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor40tsam yod cing / mthil gshong mtho ba'i 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor chung gras10grangs longs min tshod yin la/ thams cad por brel tshub kyi ngang tshul mngon 'dug gal te char ma babs na 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor che gras dang g.ye skyod rlangs 'khor du bsdad pa'i bzhud mgron rlangs 'khor brje mi dgos par thad kar sprel rdzong phyi skor gyi rdzogs mdo'i spang gzhung du 'byor nges/ de nas dgon pa nang bar da dung spyi le3tsam yod pas/ mi mi nyung ba zhig gis rang gi rlangs 'khor zhin he rdzong du bskyur nas sger gnyer rlangs 'khor la bsdad nas thad kar dgon pa nang bar 'gro ba red/sprel rdzong gi byin rlabs sam 'gug stobs kyi dbang du phyugs las thon skyed gtso ba'i zhin he rdzong thog gi 'grul khang dang za khang sil 'tshong tshong khang dang tshigs thung 'grim 'grul la ltos bcas kyis dpal tsam ldan 'dug de ma zad sprel rdzong lung khog dang phyi skor rdzogs mdo'i spang gzhung du sbra gur dang stabs bde'i khang ba mang po chags 'dug zas mal rol rtsed kyi cha rkyen rags rim tsam chags zin yod/sprel rdzong dgon pa'i nang skor la lha khang 'du khang gsum dang nang chen gnyis dang grwa shag brgya phrag longs tshod tsam las med pas/ ja yun tsam dgos mi dgos tshod du bskor ba gcig rgyag thub/ rkang thang du phyi skor rgyag pa na/ brel brel ngang song na chu tshod gnyis dang dal dal ngang song na chu tshod gsum tsam dgos pa red/ brgyangs phyag 'tshal nas phyi skor brgyab na chu tshod — 317 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/drug lhag dgos pa dang / nangs dus chu tshod bdun tsam steng 'go brtsams na/phyi dro'i chu tshod gnyis steng rdzogs thub zer/spyir sprel rdzong dgon pa 'di la chag 'jig du mas rkyen gyis da dung slar gso byed bzhin pa'i sgang ste/ lha khang la la zhig gso byed bzhin pa'i skabs yin pa dang / dgon pa spyi dang grwa shag bar gyi srang lam dang skor ba rgyag pa'i lam sogs kyi 'char bkod/ tha na gad snyigs khyim thal sogs gtsang spra phyogs kyi do dam yang da dung nyams zhan par snang / da lo gnas mjal gnas skor du yong ba'i mi shin tu mang bas/ dgon pa nang dang tha na phyi skor gyi lam kha dag tu'ang gad snyigs mang tsam thor 'dug de 'dra'i dbang du yid 'ong gnas mchog de'i khor yug gam rang mdangs la dri ma thebs 'dugadagon pa rang gi 'dzugs skrun dang nang skor phyi skor gyi bgrod lam dang zhin he rdzong nas dgon pa bar gyi gzhung lam sogs la 'dzugs skrun ma dngul gyi dgos pa che ba rede/ 'di skor la rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung dang dgon pa'i dmangs gtso do dam u yon lhan tshogs sogs 'brel yod phyogs so sos do snang byed bzhin yod/rdo rjes lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas ri de'i shar mdun nas phyi skor brgyab nas nub rgyab tu bslebs pa na/ g.yon log tu gshin rje'i grong khyer zhes pa'i brag ri 'jigs su rung ba dang dmyal zangs bco brgyad ces pa'i grog rong rngam zil ldan pa dag yod pa mthong tshe/ 'du shes sam rtogs snang gi sgo nas srid phyi gnyis kyi bar du zam pa zhig 'phangs te mi rnams kyi tshe thog lus thog gi dge nyes skyid sdug dang srid phyi gnyis su rjes chod pa'i rgyu 'bras ra mda' yod par yid ches pa'i chos lugs kyi sdig spong dger brtson gyi bsam blo'i 'dren phyogs sngar las gting zab pa'i rtogs pa rnyed srid/ de bzhin du — 318 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wa da wa sems byung sna tshogs bskyed pa'i gzhi ste chos lugs kyi 'du shes dang ldan pa'i mi zhig yin tshe da gzod rang byon du ngos 'dzin pa'i rang byung bkod pa'am brag ris sogs bstan pa na/ mthong yul du lhang nger 'char ba'i snang ba skyes/gzhi de nas bya ba'i yul dang byed po gang 'dra'i sems dang de gnyis bar gyi byed las dbang du/ yag snang gi byed las ji ltar 'byung ba'i gnas lugs la sngar las zab pa'i go ba lon srid/ lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang bo dag gi gsung rgyun du/ gnas skor thon las 'di'i phugs sam 'byung khungs ni gnas 'jal dang 'khyar sbyang la khungs bcol yod pa dang / gang zhig la skyabs bcol ba dang 'khyar 'grim brgyud nas/ slob sbyong byed pa'i dgos pa de deng sang yin kyang nyams med pa dang / khams bsang ba dang ngal gso ba dang lus po'i sbyong brdar sogs dmigs yul du 'dzin pa'i mi mang yin na'ang rung / gnas mjal dang 'khyar sbyang gi yon tan sngar bzhin nges 'dug zer/sprel rdzong du song myong ba'i mi zhig yin pa na/ gnas lugs 'di'ang ci ma bden snyam srid/ brgyangs phyag 'phen pa'i mi rnams la ltos dang / gon pa ngan hrul gyon pa de 'khor ba'i don du gron chung bya ba'i ched de/ de 'dra'i dka' ba spyad nas mi rtag pa las sgrol bar rtag pa gang zhig snyeg 'dug mod/lus sems gnyis kyi sbyang ba ni rang rtogs ldan min la ma ltos par zhor du the yod pa ma yin nam/ sprel rdzong lung ba dang phyi skor rdzogs mardo'i spang gzhung du la la bza' btung dang glu gar la g.yeng 'dug mod/ la la kha 'ardon skyor ba'am lag 'khor bskor bar sems phyogs 'dug rang cag gi 'tsho ba rol stangs 'di lta bu nas yang dang yang du myangs kyang zad pa med pa'i bro ba 'ig ldan 'dug pa red/(2004lo'i zla8pa'i tshes28nyin gyi par ngos gsum par gsal)— 319 ——

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/'jang sa dam sa cha'i yul srol gyi mthong thos/rgyal sras/nga tsho dga' spro 'phel zhing gdong la sngar med kyi 'dzum mdangs me tog rgyas bzhin/ ngal dub chad snang spu tsam yang med par mu mthud du mtshan brgyab nas gna' thog cig tu chags yod pa'i 'jang sa dam rgyal po'i mnga' dbus su bskyod pa yin/yul der 'byor ba na dbang phyogs sa 'dzin gyi lhun po'i phang ba las skya rengs kyi bu mo 'dzum dmul ler shar ba dang / rim gyis shar phyogs kyi mkha' mtha' je gsal je dwangs su gyur te mdzes sdug gi yul ljongs khyad du mtshar ba zhig mig la mngon/ gral dag cing star mnyam pa'i gna' bo'i grong khyer 'di ni li cang(glo'i)zhesa'ajang rigs(popoṭha)chags yod pa'i yul gru zhig red/ sa dam gna' mkhar 'di'i da lta'i gzhung lam 'then phyogs ltar bshad na/ yun nan zhing chen gyi lte gnas khung men grong khyer nas nub byang mtshams nas bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul sems kyi nyi zla rdzong(sngon chad rgyal thang rdzong du 'bod)du bskyod tshe lam bar nas zhag sdod kyi sa tshigs gal chen zhig yin te/ lo rgyus ha cang ring po mchis shing mi rigs kyi goms srol ma nyams par khyad chos 'bur du thon pas/ 1997lo'i zla12par — 320 —

zugāthabakhur13cad/ da wa da wamanyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis 'dzam gling rig gnas shul ba'ag srung skyong bya yul gal chen gyi gras su bkod/ de'i 'dzugs skrun gyi thad du mkhas pa tshos smras pa ltar na/ rang rgyal khab kyi grangs nyung mi rigs nga lnga'i khrod kyi 'jang rigs dang bod rigs dang pa'e rigs dang rgya rigs bcas kyi bzo skrun nying bcud 'dus yod zer/ ming du grags pa'i sa dam khrom gyi srang lam kun tu rdo gcal brgyud mur bting nas gtsang zhing gral dag par 'dug la/ srang 'gram du lhung lhung bzhur ba'i chu rgyun gyi rka lam drang zhing zab/ khor yug rtsi bcud rgyas shing char chu mod pas sa rdul langs rgyu med par gtsang zhing dganam rgyun khor yug kun tu smug sprin 'thibs nas thag ring mthong ba'i go skabs dben/ re chad re 'bab tshul du sbrang char zim zim 'jo bas yul mi skyes pho mo rgan gzhon kun gyis lag la rtag par char gdugs thogs nas bag phab ngang 'jang pa'i rol dbyangs snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'gug pa'i sbugs su mi rigs lag rtsal thon rdzas bshams pa'i tshong rar myul ba la skyid snang dang ldan/ gzhan yang gna' mkhar de na da dung rus dmu yin pa'i sa dbang chen mo 'jang sa dam rgyal po'i pho brang gzi byin 'bar ba dang / shing rkyang gis las pa'i khang ba dang rtsibs brgyad zo chun gyi chu 'khor/ mthong dkon pa'i gna' bo'i thon skyed 'tsho ba'i yo chas ngo mtshar ba/ mtsho mtshe'u ri nags kyi mdzes ljongs khyad par ba/ lha klu gnyan gsum gyi ngag rgyun yid du 'ong ba sogs gnas skor byed sa mang tsam mchis/ lhag par du gzhan na med pa'i yul srol rig gnas mthong ba ni/ sa dam yul gyi dmangs srol grong ba ste g.yu chu sde ba'i(cha7khri྾)sa thog ru ngom pa'i shing brkos gzugs ris kyis grub pa'i srid pa chags stangs kyi bkod pa rgya chen de red/ 'di rmi 'jang rigs ston pa'i chos lugs dang 'brel ba'i 'jig rten lta ba mtshon byed kyi sdi 321 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/snang brnyan nyams dang ldan pa zhig red/ gdod ma'i bon gzhung du bshad pa'i srid pa'i sgo nga dkar nag gi byung ba dang cha 'dra bar/ dkar nag dbye ba gsal bor bkar nas las dge sdig byas pa'i 'bras bu chud mi za bar bde sdug gi rnam smin ma nor bar myong zhing skye ba len pa'i go don bzhengs yod/'di na rigs lnga cod pan gyi prog zhu dbu zhwa kha 'bus mnabs mkhan gto ston yod la/ shing gi mchod stegs chen po'i sne mgo gnyis kar mes po tshos bla gnas su bkur ba'i stag dang g.yag gi brkos ris btod yod pa dang / bon sgrung dang cha 'dra bar srid pa'i zhing khams 'dir 'gro ba mi byung ba'i thog ma ste yod khams srid pa'i rgyal po sangs po 'bum khri dang med khams srid pa'i rgyal mo chu ma rgyal mo gnyis kyi thabs shes zung sbyor la brten nas 'gro ba mi'i rigs spel ba'i ngag rgyun mtshon rtags pho mtshan mo mtshan zung gi rtags ris brkos pa'i shing gi ka ba ha cang mang po bslangs te/ bar lam gyen dbus su dkar rtsi byugs pa'i thang ga ring bo yid du 'ong ba zhig bkod 'dug pa'i khrod na/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' bcas 'byung ba lnga'i rgyu las ltos bcas gtan tshigs kyi 'gros thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin sgo nga dkar nag gnyis las srid pa'i rgyal po dang srid pa'i rgyal mo gnyis 'byung ba dang / de dag zung du 'brel ba las ming sring dgu dgu bco brgyad 'byung tshul sogs nang bcud kyi sems can rnams grol tshul bstan yod/ bon gyi lta ba dang mthun par bkod pa'i 'jang yul gto chos kyi srid pa grol lugs dang rgyu 'bras rnam gzhag dge sdug las kyi rnam smin 'khor tshul/ sbal sbrul khyung ris sogs mi dang klu'i ngag rgyun mtshon pa'i ri mo go rim ldan pa bris pa rnams nyams dang ldan zhing gzi byin mchis/ dbus kyi gyen thur du bshams pa'i thang ris ring mo'i g.yas phyogs su srid pa'i sgo nga dkar po yod la/ 'jang pa tshos bshad — 322 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da wan kho tsho'i lta tshul du/ de ni 'gro ba rigs drug la ngan 'gro'i gnas dang bde 'gro'i gnas zhes zhing khams gnyis su phye ba las bde 'gro'i zhing khams yin zhing / rgyun du las dkar po'i dge ba bsgrubs na skye tshwaphyi mar srid pa'i sgo nga dkar po las skyes te bde 'gro'i zhing khams su skyid la rol ba'i bskal ba yod zer/ ye sku 'od dkar(r+sā.oṃtshiṣ+ṭha)ni dkar phyogs dge las can gyi lha rigs rnams kyis gtso bor ngos 'dzin/ g.yon gyi phyogs su srid pa'i sgo nga nag po yod la/ de ni ngan 'gro'i zhing khams yin zhing / ye sku ting nag(skru.oṃ྾smokhyi)ni nag phyogs sdig las can gyi lha rigs rnams kyis gco bor ngos 'dzin/ tshe 'dir rgyu 'bras mi brtsi bar las nag po sdig pa tshad med bsags te pha ma la gcar rdung dang grogs por mgo skor gtong ba/ srog gcod pa/log g.yem byed pa/ 'phrog rku ham 'dzin byed pa/ rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub gnod 'tshe phrag dog 'khon 'gras la sogs sems can la gnod pa'i ngan pa'i sbyor ba sna tshogs brtsams na/ ngan 'gro'i zhing khams 'dir srid pa'i sgo nga nag po las skyes te sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong ba'i bshad tshul yod zer/ zangs li mas bzhengs yod pa'i ston pa gshen rab dang bod rigs dang pa'e rigs/ 'jang rigs/ mo srol pa bcas kyi sku brnyan ngo mtshar can bsgrigs legs par bzhugs pa༈mthong skabs/ 'jang pa tshos bshad pa ltar na/ 'jang rigs dang pa'e rigs dang bod rigs sasum ni ma gcig gi bshang khog las skyes pa'i bu spun yin pa dang / gna' rabs bod kyi lo rgyus dang chos lugs rig gnas thog nas dpyad na'ang 'jang bod mi rigs gnyis la 'brel ba zab mo zhig 'dug pa shes thub/ srid pa'i sgo nga grol stangs kyi 'jig rten bkod pa'i lta ba las 'phros na/ bod kyi bon chos dang 'jang rigs gto chos gnyis kyi ston pa dang / srid pa'i lta ba/ lha — 323 — —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gdon rigs kyi ming / de bzhin mchod pa'i yo byad dang grangs tshig gi khyad chos dag la bsdur nas dbye zhib byas tshe/ bon dang gto lugs gnyis ni rtsa ba gcig la thug pa'i yal ga lta bur snang / 'brel yod yig cha sna tshogs bklags rjes/ bon lugs kyi ston pa gshen rab mi bo che dang gto lugs kyi ston pa gshen rab (13sgotsho) gnyis 'khrungs tshul dang 'khrungs yul/yab gyi mtshan dang ston pa'i mtshan/ slob ma'i grangs/ dgra ya gtso bo/mdzad rnam sogs phal cher 'dra mtshungs su 'duga'ajang rigs gto lugs khrod du 'jang pa'i mes po gong ma rnams kyis stag dang g.yag('brong)dang sbal ba dang bya khyung rnams la dad mos byed srol yang mchis pa ni sa de'i zangs dang shing gi mchod chas rags mo dang 'bag bzhengs la mos bkur byed pa las shes thub/ de bas kyang 'jang pas gang sar sbal ris bris nas sbal bar dad mos byed pa 'di ni gto lugs su thog mar mi dang klu gnyis pha gcig las mched pa'i gcen gcung yin par 'dod pa'i ngag rgyun dang 'brel ba yod cing / gto pa'i 'du shes la sa steng gang sar klu rgyal gyis ma khyab sa med par 'dod pa dang / klu rigs mang po zhig gi gzugs brnyan ni stod sbal ba dang smad sbrul las grub pa zhig yin par snyam/kho tsho'i 'khrab ston byed pa'i gna' bo'i bro gar thun mong ma yin pa de ni sbal chen gser 'od can gyi mchongs stangs la dpe byas te byung ba zhig yin par 'dod cing / da lta yang 'jang pa tshor〈a rin rin〉zhes pa'i glu tshig med pa'i gdod ma'i dus kyi zhabs bro'i stangs stabs bsgyur lugs zhig yod pa'i nang sbal ba'i mchongs rtsal lta bu'i bro gar 'khrab rgyu yod la/ de 'khrab skabs pho mo mnyam skor byas te ldem myur che la rngam pa'i stangs stabs bsgyur cing /skyes pa tshos gdangs la ngag gi gzengs mtho ba'i ki sgra sgrog cing / skyes ma — 324 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da da tshos gdangs thung la dbugs 'tshang ba'i rnam pas ngag 'byin par byed pa dang / rtsis dang spar kha'i ri mo mi 'dra ba sbal ba'i lus steng du 'argod srol 'dug pa de bzhin/ gang sar bris pa'i sbal ba'i gzugs ris de gto ྅/gas rig gnas kyi mtshon rtags lta bur gyur yod/ 'dir gto chos zhes pa'i‘‘gto’’ni ston pa gshen rab ces pa'i ston pa yi bod skad g.yar ming yin nam snyam/ rgya yig thog‘lko3 zer ba la 'jang skad du sgra gdangs cung zad 'gyur te lko3’zhes 'bod pa dang / der sgra bsgyur byas nas zur chag pas rgya yig nang da dung‘‘skye06'i’’dang lkoglo dang 7kha dang 77 zhes bris 'dug pa mthong bas/ chos lugs gzhan dang khyad btod phyir/ gong nas gcig mthun du ston pa'i chos lugs zhes ma bris par‘‘gto ba'i chos lugs’’zhes spyad pa yin/ mtshams sbyor mkhan la klu rgyal dang mi yi mes po gnyis ni gcen gcung yin pa'i 'jang pa'i bshad rgyun lha sgrung lta bu la lo rgyus rgyu mtshan ci yin gting 'dri byas pa na/ 'jang pa tshos bshad don/ dus phyis gcen gcung ma 'chams par pha mas bzhag pa'i rgyu nor dang sa 'ing ngang ri klung sogs tshang ma bgo bsha' brgyab cing / nor bu'i zhwa mo brkus pa'i rtsod gleng byed skabs phan tshun 'khon res byas/ ya nga ba'i 'thab 'dzing gi skyo gar der gzhigs nas mi klu bar gyi 'thab rtsod med par bzo phyir ston pa gshen rab kyis bya khyung la bcibs nas klu bdud btul zhing mi mthun 'gal zla thag gcod dam bar 'dum byas pa'i gtam rgyud gzhir bzung stabs/ 'jang yul 'di na deng sang klu la bkur zhing klu la mchod pa'i goms srol khyad par ba ma nyams par mchis/ de dang mnyam du da dung bon lugs dang mtshungs par bya khyung la yang shin tu bkur bar 'dug pas/ thang ris ngos su khyung gi ri mo yang bris pa mang du mthong zhing / kho tsho'i bshad tshul la bya khyung ni ston pa — 4325 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/gshen rab kyis klu btul ba'i dpung rogs gtso bo yin par brjod la/ de'i gzugs dbyibs ni spyir btang gi bod kyi dar lcog dang rlung rta'i steng du bris pa'i stag seng khyung 'brug bcas rlung rta sde bzhi'i khrod kyi ya gyal du bgrang ba'i bya rgyal khyung gi dbyibs las 'das te/ lha bzo mkhas pa'i rtog btags kyis thod par ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan zhing lus ni bya yi lus dang lag pa mi yi lag pa byas pa'i dug sbrul zhal la bsnams pa zhig bris yod/ de ni bon lugs kyi yi dam drag po'i gras‘‘yi dam khyung dmar’’gyis bzhengs steng dang khyad par spu tsam yang mi 'dug de dag mthong ba na 'jang rigs gto ba'i chos lugs ni bon lugs su khyung 'di klu dang gnyan dang sa bdag rnams kyi kha gnon yin par grags pa'i lta ba gsal ston byas par mngon/ da dung dmangs srol grong ba'i 'jang ba'i khyim tshang 'ga' rer phyin pa na/ 'jang pa rnams za ma za ba'i sngon du bod kyi sa cha kha shas kyi goms srol ltar nges par ja phud dang zas phud blangs te thab lhar mchod 'bul byed dgos pa'i srol zhig 'dug pa yang mthong zhing / de ni bod kyi dmangs khrod du thab tu gnas yod pa ni klu rigs shig yin par ngos bzung nas‘‘thab klu’’zhes 'bod cing / dus rgyun du me thab kyi 'gram du gtsang sbra shin tu legs po byed dgos pa yin/ gal te thab ka'i steng rkang lham gyis 'gom g.yug lta bu btang ba dang 'phongs sha bzhag nas btsog pa/ thab khung du snabs lud 'dor ba/ sha tshil bsreg pa/ thab 'gram du bshang gci dri ma gtong ba sogs mi gtsang ba'i rigs byas nas thab lha khros pa'i las ngan bsags tshe/ thab klu khros nas nang mi la rma rigs 'bud cing mdze nad dang klu nad sogs 'dra min 'byung 'dod/ da dung kho tshos bshad pa ltar na/ bu phrug rnams gnyom lag rgyas te khyim tshang gsar ba bzung skabs/ gna' mi'i lugs srol ltar thog mar‘‘thab mgo'i cho ga’’spel — 326 —

rgyasa'aphrin/ da r+hadagos zer/ dus der pha khyim gyi thab rnying ba'i me blangs te thab gsar ba'i nang sbar dgos pa yin/ de ltar byas rjes da gzod thab gsar ba ru thab lha gsar ba zhugs par brtsi bzhin yod/ de bzhin 'jang pa tshos da skabs mes po'i goms srol ltar khyim lha dang yul lha/ dgra lha/ lam lha/ nor lha/ chu lha/lo lha sogs la mchod pa'i lugs srol rgyun skyong ba'in/ skye khams khor pug srung skyong legs shing sdod yul nye 'gram gyi rtsi shing gang byung du gcod 'bres mi byed/ lha rigs de dag la rgyun du sgo gsum dad pa'i sems kyis mchod bstod gus pa 'bul na/ mi phyugs rgyu nor sogs la god kha dang shi chad ri 'byung ba ma zad/ kha las rlung rta dar zhing stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas nga ga'is byes sems kha bro ba dang lo la mu ge mi 'byung ba/ lam 'gro'i bar chad 'i 'ing sdongs grogs gang legs mdzad de ci bya yar 'gro gang bsam yi/da ba'in 'grub nges pa'i yid ches bcangs yod/ khyad par du 'jang rigs rnams kyis mi dang klu gnyis gnyen tshan gyi 'brel ba yod par 'dod pa'i thos nas chu mgo dang shing rigs rnams klu yi gnas bca' sa lta bur brtsis ste klu chu klu sdong zhes 'bod cing / chu mig kha dang sdong rgan chen po'i rtsa tshang mar kha btags bal mda' bsgron yod la/ yal ga'i steng gzungs sngags sna tshogs bris ba'i dar lce btags nas rmu thag kyang 'then yod/ chu khung ma go na rgya yig tu(lo21)zer ba sogs klu yi rgyal po'i sku brnyan bzhengs te/ ma chod gsol du dmar zas ma 'dres pa'i chu gtsang dang 'o ma dang shing tog sna chogs bcas bshams 'dug pa yang 'ga' zhig mthong / klu gnas de das la bco lnga gnam gang tshes brgyad kyi dus bzang gi skabs su gsol kha yang ngag byas na/char chu dus su 'bab pa dang lo tog legs pa/ phyugs rigs 'phel ba/than pa'i gegs sel thub par bshad/ kho tshos spyir btang du shing rigs — 327 —

gom stabs dang zhabs rjes/rnams ni klu yi thob skal yin par ngos 'dzin te/ rang rang gang 'dod kyis gcod gcog brlag gsum byas na/ klu la phog thug bzoso te mi'i rigs la rnam smin 'byung zhing / char chu dus su mi 'bab par rtsi shing lo tog than pas gdung 'gro bar 'dod pas/ 'jang rigs rnams kyis dus dang rnam pa kun tu shing rigs gcod rgyur 'dzem dogs chen po byed kyin yod/deng sang 'dzam gling yongs su skye khams khor yug la srung skyong dang snod bcud do snyoms yong bar 'bad bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang cag gis kyang 'jang yul gyi legs cha gang yod dper drangs nas/ rma 'bri rdza gsum 'byung yul gyi skye dngos srung skyong gi slob gso khyab par spel 'tshal ba dang /bskal ba'i bar du spyi tshogs 'di mu mthud du 'cham mthun dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar brtson pa mi lhod pa zhig 'khyongs dgos snyam/(2006lo'i zla1pa'i tshes30nyin gyi par ngos gnyis par gsal/ )
